_root/ScenarioModelCodes-AutoCreated.jso.zh: S公司 节度使 - 肉

StoryData/S1017B.json#0#content.zh: 按下按钮的瞬间，我的视野清晰了起来。
StoryData/S1017B.json#0#content.en: My vision cleared up once I pressed the button.

StoryData/S1017B.json#1#content.zh: 我感到自己撞上了坚硬的地面，但那阵震得发麻的疼痛很快就过去了。冰冷的水随潮涌吞没我的身体，把它拖向水下。
StoryData/S1017B.json#1#content.en: I feel the sensation of striking a hard floor, but the rattling aches pass before long. Cold water swallows my body in its tides and drags it under.

StoryData/S1017B.json#2#content.zh: 很快，水灌满了我的肺。我无法呼吸。
StoryData/S1017B.json#2#content.en: Soon, the water fills my lungs. I can't breathe.

StoryData/S1017B.json#3#content.zh: 模糊的视野里，我看见荡漾的水波与翻起的白沫。阳光倾泻在水面之外的景色上。
StoryData/S1017B.json#3#content.en: Through my blurred vision, I see rippling water and cresting white foam. Sunshine pours down over the scenery beyond.

StoryData/S1017B.json#4#content.zh: 没过多久，压迫胸口的窒息感便消失了。包裹着我的水，像一个温暖的拥抱。
StoryData/S1017B.json#4#content.en: It isn't long before the pressure crushing my chest disappears. The water that surrounds me feels like a warm embrace.

StoryData/S1017B.json#5#content.zh: 平时绝不会冒出的念头不受控制地涌现，淹没了我的脑海。
StoryData/S1017B.json#5#content.en: Thoughts I normally would never entertain spring uncontrollably, flooding my mind.

StoryData/S1017B.json#6#content.zh: 我能感觉到自己的神经在搏动。
StoryData/S1017B.json#6#content.en: I can feel my nerves pulsating.

StoryData/S1017B.json#7#content.zh: 我觉得这颗长在我身上、却又不真正属于我的头，将会永远沉在水里。
StoryData/S1017B.json#7#content.en: I feel as though this head, attached to me but not really mine, is going to be submerged underwater forever.

StoryData/S1017B.json#8#content.zh: 涌上来的是安心吗……？还是说……
StoryData/S1017B.json#8#content.en: Is it comfort that washes over me...? Or is it...

StoryData/S1017B.json#9#content.zh: <color=#916e46>谨向今日莅临西西弗百货的各位贵宾致以最热忱的欢迎。</color>
StoryData/S1017B.json#9#content.en: <color=#916e46>We extend our warmest welcome to the valued guests of Grand Magasin Sisyphe visiting today.</color>

StoryData/S1017B.json#10#content.zh: <color=#916e46>西西弗百货始终珍视顾客在店内购得的每一份体验。</color>
StoryData/S1017B.json#10#content.en: <color=#916e46>Grand Magasin Sisyphe is ever committed to cherishing every experience our customers procure within.</color>

StoryData/S1017B.json#11#content.zh: <color=#916e46>为紧跟最新潮流，本百货积极鼓励店内各色商铺依流行趋势开张与歇业。在店内游览时，敬请留意不要迷路。</color>
StoryData/S1017B.json#11#content.en: <color=#916e46>To keep abreast of the latest fashions, we actively encourage the wide variety of shops available at the department store to open and close according to trends. Please take care not to lose your way as you explore the establishment.</color>

StoryData/S1017B.json#12#content.zh: <color=#916e46>一如既往，各层洗手间目前均在维修中。安排行程时敬请留意。给您带来不便，我们深表歉意。</color>
StoryData/S1017B.json#12#content.en: <color=#916e46>As always, restrooms on every floor are currently under repair. Please take note of this when planning your visit. We apologize for the inconvenience.</color>

StoryData/S1017B.json#13#content.zh: <color=#916e46>为防止卫生问题，各层仅限达到相应评级的顾客进入。如有疑问，敬请前往六层的顾客服务中心。</color>
StoryData/S1017B.json#13#content.en: <color=#916e46>To prevent hygiene issues, entry to each floor will be limited to customers who have achieved the required Prestige Tier. Please visit our Customer Service Center on the sixth floor for any further queries.</color>

StoryData/S1017B.json#14#content.zh: <color=#916e46>欢迎顾客与展出的所有人台进行身体接触。反之，人台亦可与所有顾客进行身体接触。如您愿意参与，请向相应商铺的店员说明，他们将乐于为您效劳。</color>
StoryData/S1017B.json#14#content.en: <color=#916e46>Customers are welcome to make physical contact with all Mannequins on display. Conversely, Mannequins are also allowed to make physical contact with all customers. Should you wish to participate, please talk to the sales associate at the relevant shop, who will be delighted to assist you.</color>

StoryData/S1017B.json#15#content.zh: <color=#916e46>愿各位竭尽所能，为顾客再度呈上值得的消费体验。感谢您选择西西弗百货，祝您购物愉快。</color>
StoryData/S1017B.json#15#content.en: <color=#916e46>We ask everyone to do their best to ensure another day of worthwhile consumer experience for our customers. Thank you for choosing Grand Magasin Sisyphe, and enjoy your shopping.</color>

StoryData/S1017B.json#17#content.zh: 我只知道，那种事我再也不想经历第二次……我是说，在这支队伍里我已经用各种方式死过了，可在根本不是战斗的场合被迫直面死亡……再加上还得亲身体会自己动手的感觉，这实在是……绝对不行。
StoryData/S1017B.json#17#content.en: I just know it's something I never want to go through again... I mean, I've been killed in a variety of different ways on this team, but to be forced to face death when it wasn't even a combat situation... And on top of that, having to feel the sensation of doing it myself is just... a big no.

StoryData/S1017B.json#18#content.zh: 难以相信N公司的居民竟然会花钱买这种恶心的体验。就算倒贴我钱，我也不想再来一次。
StoryData/S1017B.json#18#content.en: Can't believe residents in N Corp. pay money to purchase that nasty experience. You couldn't pay me to go through that twice.

StoryData/S1017B.json#20#content.zh: 将断绝性命一事包装成消遣，再当作商品售卖……
StoryData/S1017B.json#20#content.en: To package the very severing of life as amusement, then sell it as a product...

StoryData/S1017B.json#21#content.zh: 征服无聊诚然绝非易事，然此举……唔……
StoryData/S1017B.json#21#content.en: Though conquering boredom is, forsooth, no simple feat, this is... hmm...

StoryData/S1017B.json#22#content.en: It felt more real than I imagined.

StoryData/S1017B.json#23#content.zh: 我明明知道那一切都发生在机器里……可就在那一瞬间，我真的觉得……自己正在目睹生命的最后时刻呢。
StoryData/S1017B.json#23#content.en: I knew it was all taking place within a machine... Yet in that moment, I truly felt as though... I were witnessing the final moments of my life.

StoryData/S1017B.json#24#content.zh: 绳套收紧的时候，我还以为我的脖子要断掉了呢……
StoryData/S1017B.json#24#content.en: When the noose tightened, I thought my neck was gonna snap...

StoryData/S1017B.json#25#content.zh: 我跟以实想的一样……居然真有人花钱找这种罪受？
StoryData/S1017B.json#25#content.en: I'm with Ishy... People actually pay money to put themselves through this?

StoryData/S1017B.json#26#content.zh: 有些人并无明确目的，却会把自己绑在绳索上从高处一跃而下，或是把自己交给汹涌的浪涛，看看会不会被卷进去。
StoryData/S1017B.json#26#content.en: There are those who, with no real purpose in mind, tie themselves to a cord and leap from great heights, or surrender themselves to violent waves to see whether or not they will be swept under.

StoryData/S1017B.json#27#content.zh: 据说，人通过无限接近死亡的体验，能更敏锐地感受到自己活着。
StoryData/S1017B.json#27#content.en: It is said that people come to feel the sensation of being alive more keenly via experiences that bring them infinitely close to death.

StoryData/S1017B.json#28#content.zh: ……所以你是说，他们是故意的啦？
StoryData/S1017B.json#28#content.en: ... So ya sayin' they do it on purpose?

StoryData/S1017B.json#30#content.zh: 等等，我……我以前听过这段对话，一字不差。
StoryData/S1017B.json#30#content.en: Wait, I've... I've heard this exact conversation before.

StoryData/S1017B.json#31#content.zh: 什么时候……在哪儿听过这段对话……？我的脑子像是被打散的信息搅成一团——感觉要理清楚还得花上一阵。
StoryData/S1017B.json#31#content.en: When... where did I hear this conversation before...? My brain feels like a chaotic scramble of disconnected information—I feel it's going to take a while to get it all in order.

StoryData/S1017B.json#33#content.en: Wha? The Fount? We're obviously in a—

StoryData/S1017B.json#36#content.zh: 一处可将心中郁结尽数放空之所。
StoryData/S1017B.json#36#content.en: A place where one's innermost troubles may be emptied.

StoryData/S1017B.json#37#content.zh: 我们在那台该死的机器里遭了那么多罪……就为了到个厕所？
StoryData/S1017B.json#37#content.en: We went through all that shite in that bloody machine... just to get to a toilet?

StoryData/S1017B.json#38#content.zh: 耐莉确实撒过谎，害我们陷入过危险，不过这一次，我倒不觉得她是想害我们或是骗我们呢……
StoryData/S1017B.json#38#content.en: It's true Nelly's lies did put us in danger before, but it didn't appear to me that she was trying to harm or deceive us this time around...

StoryData/S1017B.json#39#content.zh: 小浮。我们启动的那台机器……是某种传送装置吗？
StoryData/S1017B.json#39#content.en: Fau. The machine we triggered... was it some kind of teleporter?

StoryData/S1017B.json#40#content.zh: 结论取决于我们如何解读那段体验，但可以肯定，我们的身体并未被实际送到此处。不过这不成问题——这里确实是我们要去的目的地，而我们已经成功抵达。
StoryData/S1017B.json#40#content.en: The verdict would differ depending on our interpretation of the experience, but it is certain that our bodies were not physically sent to this place. That shouldn't be an issue, however, as this is indeed the destination we were bound for, which we have reached successfully.

StoryData/S1017B.json#41#content.zh: 那……我们到底在哪儿啊？要去哪里才能找到默尔？
StoryData/S1017B.json#41#content.en: So... where the heck are we? Where do we go to find Meur?

StoryData/S1017B.json#42#content.zh: <你们在说什么？默尔索不就在他惯常的位置站着吗，出口旁边——>
StoryData/S1017B.json#42#content.en: <What are you talking about? Meursault's right there in his usual spot, by the exit—>

StoryData/S1017B.json#44#content.zh: 我转向出口，看向默尔索……原本所在的位置，才发现他不在那儿。我在洗手间里四下张望，寻找他的踪影，却哪儿都看不见他。
StoryData/S1017B.json#44#content.en: I turned toward the exit point to where Meursault... used to be, and realized that he wasn't there. I looked around the restroom, searching for his whereabouts, but I couldn't see him anywhere.

StoryData/S1017B.json#45#content.zh: 您在说什么呢，但丁？我们来这儿的理由就是找默尔索，您忘了吗？
StoryData/S1017B.json#45#content.en: What are you talking about, Dante? The whole reason we're here is to find Meursault, remember?

StoryData/S1017B.json#46#content.zh: ……喂，那台自杀贩卖机八成把钟的齿轮给磕掉了一颗。他现在神游天外呢。
StoryData/S1017B.json#46#content.en: ... Oi, the Suicide Vending Machine must've knocked a gear off the Clock or somethin'. They're out of it.

StoryData/S1017B.json#47#content.zh: <不，你们到底在说什么？！我们失败了。注定要永远——>
StoryData/S1017B.json#47#content.en: what are you guys talking about?! We failed. Doomed to forever—>

StoryData/S1017B.json#48#content.zh: 我转向浮士德，那个几乎总能指望她知情的人……
StoryData/S1017B.json#48#content.en: I turned to Faust, someone I could almost always trust to be in the know...

StoryData/S1017B.json#50#content.en: ... Ah. If... if that is the case...

StoryData/S1017B.json#51#content.zh: ……那么这件事，我还是尽量少说为好。
StoryData/S1017B.json#51#content.en: ... then I'd better speak as little as possible on this matter.

StoryData/S1017B.json#52#content.zh: ……可她只是把视线从我身上移开——明摆着不打算透露任何事。
StoryData/S1017B.json#52#content.en: ... but she simply looked away from me—a clear sign that she wasn't willing to divulge anything.

StoryData/S1017B.json#54#content.zh: <只有我记得吗？我们已经……我们亲眼见过西西弗百货的结局……我们……>
StoryData/S1017B.json#54#content.en: <Am I the only one who remembers this? We already... we were there for the end of the Grand Magasin... We...>

StoryData/S1017B.json#55#content.zh: 既视感……我来过这儿。见过什么，然后回来了……或者说，被倒回来了吧。
StoryData/S1017B.json#55#content.en: Déjà vu... I've been here before. Witnessed something before returning... or being rewound, I suppose.

StoryData/S1017B.json#58#content.zh: 阿赖耶识震了一下，发出一声轻鸣，像是在附和。
StoryData/S1017B.json#58#content.en: Arayashiki vibrates, letting out a light hum as though in agreement.

StoryData/S1017B.json#59#content.zh: ……等等，等等。我可不敢说他这状态还能不能往前走。连他脑袋上那团火，我瞧着都比刚才旺了些……
StoryData/S1017B.json#59#content.en: ... Hang on, hang on. I ain't so sure if they're okay to move on. Even that fire on their noggin feels a bit hotter, I think...

StoryData/S1017B.json#60#content.en: Who knows. Must be M.P. or something.

StoryData/S1017B.json#61#content.zh: “记忆中毒之类的”……？像食物中毒那样吗？那到底算是什么……
StoryData/S1017B.json#61#content.en: "Must be memory poisoning or something"...? Like food poisoning? What does that even...

StoryData/S1017B.json#62#content.zh: 哦——所以但丁才会在出口那儿看见默尔索的幻觉吧。那些关于西西弗百货的莫名其妙的话也说得通了——他多半是在过来的路上被默尔的记忆轰了个正着！
StoryData/S1017B.json#62#content.en: Ohh, maybe that's why Dante hallucinated Meursault by the exit. That explains the random stuff they said about the Grand Magasin—they were probably bombarded by Meur's memories on the way here!

StoryData/S1017B.json#63#content.zh: 说不定就是这样呢。每当轮到某个人的“回合”，但丁总能得到一次窥见对方记忆的机会。
StoryData/S1017B.json#63#content.en: Maybe that's what happened. Whenever someone's "turn" comes, Dante tends to get a chance to peek into their memories.

StoryData/S1017B.json#64#content.zh: 良秀环视着房间，紧蹙的眉头里透出不适。
StoryData/S1017B.json#64#content.en: Ryōshū looked around the room, discomfort visible in her knitted brows.

StoryData/S1017B.json#65#content.zh: 难道良秀真的记得之前西西弗百货的什么事……？不，我觉得不是这样。可我总甩不掉那种漏了什么的别扭感，眼下也下不了什么定论。
StoryData/S1017B.json#65#content.en: Maybe Ryōshū actually remembers something about the Grand Magasin from before...? No, I don't think that's what's happening. But I can't shake this nagging feeling that I'm missing something to be making any definite guesses at this moment.

StoryData/S1017B.json#66#content.zh: 那么，那一切都是我想象出来的？还是一场梦？
StoryData/S1017B.json#66#content.en: Has all of that been a figment of my imagination, then? Or a dream?

StoryData/S1017B.json#68#content.zh: 如果那真的只是幻觉或一场梦，浮士德就不会摆出一副知情的反应。何况我们在西西弗百货经历的一切都太鲜明了，鲜明到无法当作一时的妄想打发过去——至少对我而言是这样。
StoryData/S1017B.json#68#content.en: If it really were just an illusion or a dream, Faust wouldn't have reacted as though she knew something. Besides, everything we went through at the Grand Magasin was vivid enough to dispel any notion of dismissing it as a product of momentary delusion—at least for me.

StoryData/S1017B.json#69#content.zh: 眼下……我以为您该靠着这面墙歇息片刻，恢复一下。此刻似乎并无直接的威胁。
StoryData/S1017B.json#69#content.en: For now... I say that you must rest upon this wall awhile and recover. At present, naught appears to pose a direct threat.

StoryData/S1017B.json#70#content.zh: 我们本不该如此盲目地投身进那台功能不明的机器……
StoryData/S1017B.json#70#content.en: Never should've thrown ourselves so blindly into that machine of dubious function...

StoryData/S1017B.json#71#content.zh: 或许可以趁执行经理进行必要的休整时，向那边那位女性问话，收集些情报。
StoryData/S1017B.json#71#content.en: Perhaps we can question that woman there and gather some information while the Executive Manager takes their much-needed rest.

StoryData/S1017B.json#73#content.zh: 她看上去……和德米安有些像……

StoryData/S1017B.json#74#content.zh: 报上身份。你对这个地方知道些什么？
StoryData/S1017B.json#74#content.en: Identify yourself. What do you know about this place?

StoryData/S1017B.json#76#content.zh: 那女人唇边挂着慈和的微笑，安详地注视着我们。
StoryData/S1017B.json#76#content.en: The woman, with a benevolent smile gracing her lips, is watching us serenely.

StoryData/S1017B.json#78#content.zh: ……这里是一切被冲走之物的归处。“泉”……
StoryData/S1017B.json#78#content.en: ... It is where everything that is washed away comes to rest. The "Fount"...

StoryData/S1017B.json#79#content.zh: 泉？！喂，但丁刚才就是这么叫这地方的——
StoryData/S1017B.json#79#content.en: The Fount?! Hey, that's what Dante called this place earlier—

StoryData/S1017B.json#81#content.zh: 奥提斯顿了顿，等罗佳和良秀那场短暂的争执结束，才继续向那名神秘女子发问。
StoryData/S1017B.json#81#content.en: Outis paused, waiting for Rodya and Ryōshū's brief altercation to end, then continued her query toward the mysterious woman.

StoryData/S1017B.json#83#content.zh: 你隶属于这家店吗？不可否认，你身上有种令人熟悉的感觉。
StoryData/S1017B.json#83#content.en: Are you affiliated with this establishment? Can't deny there is something familiar about you.

StoryData/S1017B.json#84#content.zh: ……万物呈现出的模样……取决于人如何相信。
StoryData/S1017B.json#84#content.en: ... All things appear... as one believes them to be.

StoryData/S1017B.json#85#content.zh: 唔，至少她看起来对我们没有敌意……
StoryData/S1017B.json#85#content.en: Well, at least she doesn't seem hostile to us...

StoryData/S1017B.json#86#content.zh: 您是否知道我们……在这里该做些什么……？如果知道的话，能告诉我们吗？
StoryData/S1017B.json#86#content.en: Do you happen to know what we're... supposed to do here...? Could you tell us if you do?

StoryData/S1017B.json#88#content.zh: ……蓝衣女人似乎没有更多要说的了。她只是带着同样慈和的微笑，沉默地继续注视着我们。
StoryData/S1017B.json#88#content.en: ... The woman in blue doesn't seem to have anything more to say. She just continues to regard us in silence with that same, benevolent smile.

StoryData/S1017B.json#89#content.zh: 如果我们就这么……从那边那扇门出去，还安全吗？
StoryData/S1017B.json#89#content.en: Would it still be safe if we just... left through that door over there?

StoryData/S1017B.json#91#content.zh: 要弄清这一切究竟是不是我的想象，有一个再明确不过的办法，而我已经准备好去验证了。一旦我们从那个出口出去，迎接我们的首先会是一道名副其实的尸体瀑布。然后，正当我们为这突变惊慌失措时，克罗默姐姐会从某处现身，用她那假惺惺的亲切跟我们搭话。
StoryData/S1017B.json#91#content.en: There was one very clear-cut way of finding out whether this had all been just a product of my imagination or not, and I was ready to confirm it. Once we leave through that exit, we'll first be greeted by a veritable waterfall of corpses. Then, as we panic at the sudden turn of events, Kromer's sister will emerge from somewhere and chat us up with her feigned affability.

StoryData/S1017B.json#92#content.zh: 至少，我对上一次经历的记忆还在。每一个细节我都记得。
StoryData/S1017B.json#92#content.en: If anything, my memory of the previous experience remains. I remember every detail.

StoryData/S1017B.json#93#content.zh: <先办要紧事……我们动身，去看看外面是什么情况。>
StoryData/S1017B.json#93#content.en: <First things first... Let's get a move on and see what's outside.>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 在各式化妆品的瓶瓶罐罐之间，一枚小小的钉子格外显眼。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: A small nail stands out among the vials and containers of various makeup products.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 默尔索拿走了那枚小钉子。

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: Might we rest our steps awhile?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: <你是想说，大家都变得跟刚和我签下契约那会儿一样虚弱了，对吧？>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: <You want to talk about how everyone's grown as weak as they were immediately after they entered into a contract with me, right?>
I see that it hasn't escaped your notice as well, Manager.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: <应该没什么好担心的。反正这多半不是永久性的现象。对吧，浮士德？>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: <I'm sure it's nothing to worry about. This is likely not a permanent phenomenon, anyway. Right, Faust?>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 的确。即便是借自杀贩卖机这类间接手段进入西西弗，也不改变我们已作为百货的“顾客”进入另一种存在状态这一事实。因此，我们在现象层面所感知到的身体，必然是依照此处的规则重构过的，而这规则牵涉到阴影界与象征界——
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: Indeed, Entering Sisyphe through indirect means, such as the Suicide Vending Machine, does not change the fact that we have entered another state of existence as "customers" of the department store. Ergo, our bodies as we perceive them in the phenomenal sense must have been reconstructed according to the rules of this place, which involves the Shadowed and the Symbolic—

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 所以你的意思基本就是，我们变弱都怪这地方，等出去了就能恢复原样，对吧？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: So you're basically sayin' that this place is to blame for making us weaker, and we're gonna get back to normal once we're out, am I right?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 嗯~那么，与其在这儿等更多解释，或是绞尽脑汁想办法变强……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: Hmm~ Then rather than waiting for more explanation or brainstorming for ways to get stronger...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 不如赶紧找到默尔，麻溜儿离开这地方。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: Best we find Meur and get out of this place, chop-chop.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 难得达成共识，甚好。当前最高优先级是找到默尔索；在首要目标达成之前，一切与此现象相关的情报最好暂且搁置。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: Happy to have a consensus for once. Our highest priority at the moment is locating Meursault; we best table any intelligence pertaining to this phenomenon until that primary objective is accomplished.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 那要是撞上战斗呢？有对策吗？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: And if we run into fights? Any plans for that?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: <不用担心。反正没有默尔索在，他们多半也没法好好察觉到我们。>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: <Not to worry. I don't think they can perceive us very well without Meursault, anyway.>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 我们……先继续走？一直往前？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: Should we... keep movin' for now? Straight ahead?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 执行经理。我建议返回洗手间重整队列。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: Executive Manager. I recommend returning to the restroom to regroup and reorganize.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 吾……赞同罗佳姑娘之谏言。诚然，我等当速速启程……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: I... assent to Young Rodya's counsel. Let us set forth with all haste, forsooth...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: <没人受伤吧？我想之后还有时间重整。>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: <No one's injured, right? I think we'll have time to reorganize later.>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 正准备出发时，良秀朝我走了过来。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: Ryōshū came up to me as we were preparing to proceed.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: <所以你也记得？这里发生的一切——那都不只是梦或幻觉。我们是——>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: <So you remember too, huh? Everything that happened here—they weren't just a dream or an illusion. We were—>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: ——被倒回来了？是啊。但发生的那件事并没有扭曲时间的流向。更接近于……丢掉时间。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: —rewound? Yes. But whatever happened didn't distort or twist the flow of time. It felt closer to... discarding time.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: <不过，至少知道记得那些的罪人不止我一个，挺好。>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: <Well, glad to hear that I'm not the only Sinner who remembers all that, at least.>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: *吐烟* 那给你个失望的消息，钟头：我什么都不记得。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: *puff* Then here's something that'll disappoint you, C.H.: I don't remember anything.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 我只是察觉到了那些被斩断的记忆的断面。*吐烟* 这和你那样拥有记忆不一样。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: I've only noticed the cross-sections of the memories that were severed away. *puff* It's different from having the memories like you.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 不过有一点我可以告诉你——你的困惑不是你自己臆想出来的。有什么发生过，而我们都经历了。这一点确定无疑。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: I can tell you this, though—your confusion isn't all in your head. Something happened, and we all experienced it. That's for certain.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 怎么？终于肯带我去洗手间了？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: What? Finally decided to show me to the restroom?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 还有剩下的空瓶子吗？多余的手掌也行。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: Got any empty bottles left? A spare palm would do, too.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 我们……应该没有空瓶子，也没有……多余的手掌……抱歉……哈……哈……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: I... don't think we have any empty bottles or... spare palms... Sorry... ha... ha...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 可恶。我的眼球不够买这一季的新款……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: Damn. I don't have enough eyeballs for this season's new collection...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 那位顾客焦躁地啃着自己的指甲。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: The customer gnaws anxiously at their fingernails.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 幸好我在这股潮流过气之前就预约上了皮肤烫卷！等他们把卷度一层层烫进我皮肤的每一道纹路里，谁都没法把视线从我身上挪开！
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: Thank goodness I booked my dermal perm before the trend died! Once they layer the curl into every ridge of my skin, nobody will be able to tear their eyes away from me!

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 陌生人——别盯着我看。我的改造护理才做到一半。就算你们想认，也认不出我是谁。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: Strangers—stop checking me out. I'm halfway through my makeover treatment. You couldn't tell who I was even if you tried.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: *叹气* 所以我才讨厌下来这一层。不过也没办法——只有一楼提供这项服务……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: *sigh* This is why I hate coming down here. I suppose it can't be helped—the first floor is the only place that provides the service...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 这股潮流最好赶紧过去。我身上连一块能再点上一个波点的空皮肤都没有了。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: This trend had better die soon. I don't have a single patch of bare skin left for another polka dot.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 一堆从楼上某层坠落、摔得面目全非的尸体。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: A pile of unrecognizably mangled bodies that fell from one of the upper floors.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 三三两两的褐派正忙着在血肉堆里翻找，把能捞到的黄金皮革碎屑和眼球统统揣进兜里。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: A scattered group of Le Kaki are busily scouring through the gore, pocketing what Golden Hide dregs and eyeballs they can get their hands on.
<S-so... Were you able to find them?>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 他们不见了……我不是说少了一两个人——除了我们，所有人都凭空消失了。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: They're gone... And I don't mean that like we lost one or two people—everyone except us vanished into thin air.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 拜、拜托啦~玩笑开够了，各位都出来吧……这、这一点都不好笑！
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: C-come on~ Joke's over, everybody, come on out... Th-this isn't funny!

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: <……我不清楚他们那边出了什么状况，但应该不至于要慌。>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: <... I'm not sure what the issue is on their side, but I don't think it's anything to panic about.>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 哦！对了！但丁能看到每个人在哪儿。好，其他人在哪儿？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: Oh! Right! Dante can see where everyone is. All right, where are the others?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: <……他们在洗手间。看样子在想各种办法出来，但……不太顺利。>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: <... They're in the restroom. Looks like they're trying all sorts of things to leave, but... not with much success.>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 这种情况下，他们不可能折回去偷懒。也许是这地方特有的某种规则或现象，把他们全都拽回洗手间了？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: They wouldn't have doubled back just to loaf around in a situation like this. Maybe there's some rule or phenomenon peculiar to this place that dragged them all back to the restroom?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: <先去找默尔索吧。洗手间那边的事……大概还能再等一等。>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: <Let's go find Meursault first. The restroom issue can... probably wait a little longer.>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 会不会是落在后面了？我是说，过来的那段路挺绕的，所以……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: Maybe they fell behind? I mean, the path here got pretty twisty, so...
... That might be the case. Let me go check.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: <所有人都回到洗手间了——我确认过。这种情况下他们不可能折回去偷懒，所以我猜是这地方特有的某种规则或现象，把他们全都拽了回去。>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: <Everyone's back in the restroom—I checked. They wouldn't have doubled back just to loaf around in a situation like this, so I assume there's some rule or phenomenon peculiar to this place that dragged them all back in there.>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 啊……好吧，既然如此，等我们回到洗手间，应该就能和他们会合了。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: Aha... Well, if that's the case, I'm sure we can catch up with them once we're back in the restroom.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: <嗯。当务之急是和默尔索会合。>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: <Yeah. Our first priority is reuniting with Meursault.>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: <默尔索，你果然在这儿！我就知道。>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: <There you are, Meursault! I knew you'd be here.>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 搞什么啊默尔！好歹装作见到我们很惊讶嘛。我们可是来救你的！
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: What the heck, Meur! Ya could at least pretend to be surprised to see us. We came to save ya!

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 我用只有默尔索能听见的方式悄悄传了话。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: I quietly communicated in a way that only Meursault could hear.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 是。我记得进入西西弗百货之后的每一件事，包括二层发生的事。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: Yes. I remember every event following my entry to the Grand Magasin Sisyphe, including the events on the second floor.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: <不过其他罪人似乎都不记得。>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: <I don't think the other Sinners do, though.>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 我听说，西西弗百货会定期对存货进行一次重置，内部代号为“清仓”。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: I have heard that the Grand Magasin periodically conducts a reset of its stock, internally designated "Liquidation."

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: <好，那既然我们有了第二次机会……你觉得，如果这一次做出不同的选择，我们能拿到金枝、逃出西西弗百货吗？>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: <Okay, so now that we have a second chance... Do you think, if we were to make different choices this time around, we could secure the Golden Bough and escape the Grand Magasin?>
There is no way to know that at the present.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 不过，有些东西经过清仓仍然保留了下来。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: However, some things have carried over through the Liquidation.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 我们在各层商铺购买的所有物品。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: Every item we have purchased from the shops on each floor.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: <眼球也在？太好了。至少还有这个。>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: <The eyeballs, too? Good. At least we have that.>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 默尔索以他一贯不动声色的语调说着，取出了一块撕下来的血肉。那上面缠绕着金色的光辉。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: With his usual, stoic cadence, Meursault produced a piece of torn flesh. It was wreathed in a golden glow.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: <……像红派在奢侈品馆造出来的那个东西的一块。八成就是从那儿来的。>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: <... a piece of that thing the Rouges created in the Luxury Hall. That must be where it's from.>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 这多半是我们撕开他们所谓的“摇篮”时，从中现身之物留下的残片。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: It is likely a vestige of what emerged when we tore through what they called "the Cradle."

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: <……呃，很微弱，但我觉得它在跳。像心脏一样……>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: <... Um, it's faint, but I think it's beating. Like a heart...>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 喂喂！你们俩在那边嘀咕什么呢？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: Hey, hey! Whatcha two gossiping about over there?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: <没、没有，我们没嘀咕。我们只是在……很正常地久别重逢，懂吧？>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: <N-no, we weren't gossiping. We were just... having a very normal reunion, y'know?>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: <对吧，默尔索？啊，你根本不知道能再见到你我有多高兴！>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: <Right, Meursault? Aw, you have no idea how glad I am to see you again!>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 这事暂时最好瞒着罪人们，至少要等我把这个叫人不安的预感打消掉再说。幸好，默尔索似乎察觉到了我不愿声张。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: We'd better keep this on the down low from the Sinners for now, at least until I can put this troubling hunch to rest. Thankfully, Meursault seems to have picked up on my reluctance to share.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 退后。这份材料是我先找到的。先到先得。它现在属于我们店了。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: Back off. I found this material first. Finders keepers. It belongs to our store now.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: “材料”……？呃……听我说，这家伙是我们的……呃，“同事”。能把他还给我们吗，拜托？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: "Material"...? Um... Look, this dude is our... uh, "colleague." Can we have him back, please?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: “同事”……唔。这个词我听过。是个品牌名吗？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: "Colleague"... Hm. I've heard that word before. Is it a brand name?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 就我们目前看到的这地方来说……我不知道常识在这儿还靠不靠得住。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: From what we've seen of this place so far... I don't know if common sense is all that reliable in here.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 您说他属于你们店……意思是要让他干活吗？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: When you said he belongs to your store... does that mean you're gonna put him to work?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 不。本店的店员绰绰有余。短缺的是材料。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: No. We have more than enough staff for this shop. It's the material that's in shortage.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 材料……？哦，好吧。那您是想，呃……借默尔索的制服？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: Material...? Oh, okay. I suppose you wanna, uh... borrow Meursault's uniform, then...?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 你们这些异乡人根本没法沟通。我真是拿你们没办法……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: You strangers are impossible to communicate with. I'm at my wits' end here...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 那名店员露出一副无可奈何的神情看着我们。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: The employee gave us an exasperated look.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 我说了我们短缺材料。材料。这有什么难懂的？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: I said we're in a shortage of material. Material. What's so hard to understand about that?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 刚才的广播你们没听见吗？潮流又变了。再过几季，又会有别的东西成为新潮流。所以我们——还有这家店——永远需要更多的材料！
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: Didn't you hear the announcement just now? The trend has changed again. A few seasons from now, there will be another thing that becomes the new trend. That's why we—and this shop—will always be in need of more material!
I get that, I get that, but what the hell does that have to do with—

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: <默尔索，我们把这事了结了吧。>
<没必要把这整套戏码再演一遍。>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: <No point in doing this whole song and dance all over again.>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 我们将提供与我可供给的布料等值的劳务。作为劳务的回报，你们将释放我。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: We will conduct services of equivalent value to the fabric I would offer. In return for the services rendered, you will release me.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 将过时的人台送至出口这项工作，应当足以抵值。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: The task of helping the out-of-fashion Mannequins to the exit should provide sufficient value.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 此外，我请求暂时解除你们的看管，随这些人同行。我手上的这副护手，在将人台送至出口时会很有效。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: In addition, I request a temporary release from your custody to accompany these individuals. These gauntlets in my possession will be effective in helping the Mannequins to the exit.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 这……这倒公道。反正那件事我们确实得赶紧办完。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: That's... that's fair. We really need to get that over with, anyway.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 行，这笔交易我接了。三个应该就够了。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: Fine, I'll take that deal. Three should be enough.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: ……人台是什么鬼东西？还有“送到出口”到底是什么意思……？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: ... The hell's a Mannequin? And what does "helping them to the exit" even mean...?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: <人台是这儿对扭曲的叫法，“送到出口”就是“打倒它们”。……我想是这样。>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: <Mannequins are what they call Distortions in here, and "helping them to the exit" means "defeating them." ... I think.>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: ……但丁，是我漏看了什么宣传册吗？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: ... Dante, did I miss a pamphlet or something?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 各位，默尔索已经到手了。我们干脆开溜，再也不回来，怎么样？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: Guys, we have Meursault now. Why don't we just split and never come back?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: <光靠逃跑解决不了这个问题，罗佳。>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: <I don't think we can solve this problem by just running away, Rodya.>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 呃……为什么不行？我可很擅长跑路。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: Uh... why not? I'm a good runner.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 逃走并不能阻止我被收进仓库。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: Fleeing would not prevent me from being placed in storage.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 嗯……？可你现在不是已经出“仓库”了吗？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: Hm...? But you're out of "storage" now, aren'tcha?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 也许这地方有它自己的法则——就像大湖那样。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: Maybe this place has its own Laws—just like the Great Lake.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: *叹气* 就照默尔索说的办吧。我不知道为什么、也不知道是怎么回事，但他似乎对这家百货很熟。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: *sigh* Let's do as Meursault says. I don't know why or how, but he seems to be well-acquainted with the department store.
<For now... let's head to where the Mannequins are.>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 好吧，那……我们就送它们到出口。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: Okay, then... we'll help them to the exit.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 明智的选择。你们只需要送三个人台到出口。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: Good choice. You only need to help three Mannequins to the exit.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 我可没法干等一整天。快点拿定主意。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: Can't wait around all day. Hurry up and make up your mind.
Well? Have you given it some thought?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 若您需要我效力，把店员所需之物给她大概是最好的办法，经理。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: Giving the clerk what they need is probably best if you require my service, Manager.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 既然你们已经接了这活……能快点吗？这一季随时可能结束……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: Since you're already on the job... hurry up, will you? This season could end any minute...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 你们总算把它们送到出口了。多亏你们，现在能进本店的顾客更多了。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: So you managed to help them to the exit. Thanks to you, more customers can now access our shop.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 呼……我们眼下事情多得很。潮流一变，整条产品线都得重新设计、翻新一遍。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: Whew... We've got so much on our plates at the moment. We need to redesign and revamp the entire lineup, what with the trend changing.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 不得不放走这份材料真可惜，不过也就这样了……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: Shame we're forced to part with this material, but that's that...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: <color=#916e46>敬请注意。千鸟格季已正式结束。我们很高兴地通知各位……</color>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: <color=#916e46>Your attention, please. The Houndstooth Season has officially ended. We are pleased to inform you that...</color>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 天哪！我跟你们闲扯的这会儿工夫，潮流又变了。不买东西就赶紧走开！
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: Good grief! The trend changed again while I was wasting time shooting the breeze with you. Scram if you're not buying anything!

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 那……你哪儿都没受伤吧，默尔？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: So... you're not hurt anywhere, are you, Meur?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 自进入西西弗以来未发生武力冲突。我没有受伤。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: There have been no violent altercations since I entered Sisyphe. I have sustained no injuries.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 话说回来，他们当初为什么把你扣下？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: Why did they seize you in the first place?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 这家百货的顾客大致可分为四类。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: The customers of the department store can be classified into four principal groups.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 第一类叫红派，他们偏好皮革这种材料，以及张扬的红色。其次是黑派，其成员偏好在作品中使用精致的黑色与布料。第三类与其说是派别，不如说是一种称呼——褐派。他们不隶属于任何特定阵营，只追逐不断变化的潮流。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: The first group is called Le Rouge, and they prefer leather as a material and a striking red color. Then there is Le Noir, whose members prefer to use refined black color and fabrics in their work. The third group is less a grouping and more a denomination—Le Kaki. They are those who belong to no particular affiliation and instead chase the changing trends.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 那名店员认定我是褐派，因此才将我扣下充作材料。褐派之中，有些人并不抱有绝大多数顾客共有的目的——即购买并穿戴衣物与装束。我属于那一类。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: That employee believed that I was a Kaki, which explains why she took me into her custody to be used as material. There are those among Le Kaki who do not share the same purpose the vast majority of customers share—which is to purchase and don themselves in garments and attire. I belonged to that category.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 他们从不现身，也无人召唤他们。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: They are those who never reveal themselves, nor are they called upon by anyone.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 我还是没完全搞懂……所以在这儿必须有个跟时尚有关的目的？比如……买衣服、试穿什么的？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: I still don't get the full picture... So you need to have a fashion purpose here? Like... buying clothes, trying 'em on and stuff?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 这里的人……看起来除了衣服什么都不关心。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: The people here... seemed interested in nothing but clothes.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 与其说是目的，不如说是存在的理由。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: It is less a purpose than a raison d'être.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: <好了……这部分暂时讲到这儿吧。>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: <Alright... I think that's enough of that for now.>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: <不如多讲讲西西弗百货本身？我想罗佳和以实玛利会想听个简要的说明。>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: <Why don't you explain more about the Grand Magasin Sisyphe itself? Rodya and Ishmael would appreciate a quick rundown on that, I think.>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: ……我现在就向他们说明相关信息。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: ... I will now brief them regarding any pertinent information.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 第一点：此处并非以实体构筑之……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: Point one: This is not a physically constructed...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 在一阵条理分明却黏稠如泥的言辞风暴扫过那两人之后，我决定把默尔索这番讲解里比较要紧的部分重述一遍、划个重点。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: After a veritable storm of articulate verbal sludge passed over the two, I decided to repeat and highlight some of the more relevant information from Meursault's lecture.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: <总结时间。西西弗百货不是实体场所。它是虚拟现实，我们只是意识在这儿。默尔索的身体被泡在西西弗塔的培养槽里，而我们的肉体正睡在我们用过的那台自杀贩卖机里。>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: <Summary time. Grand Magasin Sisyphe is not a physical place. It is a virtual reality, and we're here only in our minds. Meursault's body has been put in a vat at the Sisyphe Tower, while our physical bodies are sleeping inside the Suicide Vending Machine we used.>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 听起来我们的计划挺简单：解救默尔——办到了——确认他囫囵个儿——确认了——把天台上的金枝顺走，然后离开这儿。对吧？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: Sounds like our plan's looking pretty simple: rescue Meur—we did that—find him in one piece—he is—yoink the Golden Bough on the rooftop, and get ourselves outta here. Is that right?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 你这口气……像是以前来过这儿似的，默尔。来过吗？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: Ya sound like... you've been here before, Meur. Have you?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 不，我未曾来过。不过我在N公司任职时，从一位熟人那里听过一些事，这便是我对西西弗百货了解甚详的缘由。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: I have not been here before, no. However, I heard some stories from an acquaintance when I worked for N Corp, which explains my in-depth knowledge regarding the Grand Magasin Sisyphe.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 那……我们大概只能一路往上爬了。我们连大湖都找到了航行的办法——这地方也一样能找到路。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: Then... I suppose our only option is to climb toward the top. We found a way to sail through the Great Lake—we will find a way to navigate this place as well.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 多亏了——姑且不论“多亏”这个词用在这儿是否恰当——那场“清仓”，我们的处境比第一次尝试时好得多。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: Thanks to—disregarding the notion of whether "thanks to" would be the most apt choice of words here—the "Liquidation," we're at a much better place than we were on our first attempt.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 我们的评级已经相当高，用辛苦攒来的眼球买下的东西也全都还在手上。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: Our Prestige Tier was already decently high, and all the items we'd purchased with hard-earned eyeballs were still in our possession as well.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 这一次，我们说不定真有机会……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: We might have an actual shot this time...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: <我们快往前赶吧。谁知道呢？说不定能碰上自动扶梯什么的。>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: <Let's hurry on ahead. Who knows? Maybe we'll come across an escalator or something.>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 随便看看。快销服饰馆专为瞬息万变的潮流而设。快时尚不必挑三拣四——趁潮流还没过去，赶紧买一件穿上！
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: Take a look around. The Casualwear Hall is catered to ever-changing trends. No need to weigh your options when it comes to fast fashion—just get one and dress up before the trend goes!

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh:
致迷路的顾客：
欲欣赏红派系列，请将视线保持上扬。欲欣赏黑派系列，请将视线保持朝下。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en:
For Lost Customers:
Please keep your eyes raised up to enjoy the Rouge collection. Keep your eyes fixed on the ground to enjoy the Noir collection.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 哦！看样子你们也是刚到这儿吧！对不对？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: Oh! You look like you've just got here, too! Right?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 太好了。我是被判了西西弗刑才送到这儿来的，可根本没人肯跟我解释一句！一提起这地方，所有人说的都是些谜语和胡话——我是说外面的人也一样。这儿的人呢？他们还会生气，抱怨我没有常识！
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: Thank goodness. I got sent here after being sentenced to the Sisyphe Penalty, but nobody would explain anything to me! All anyone says are riddles and nonsense when it comes to this place—and I mean people outside as well. The ones here? They even get angry and complain about me not having common sense!

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 你猜怎么着，还有人问能不能拿我当材料用。八成是这儿的什么行话吧。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: And guess what, one person even asked if they could use me as material. Must be some kind of jargon they use in here.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 那……你是什么时候到这儿的？
我正想搞清楚这个呢。这儿没有钟，他们数日子的方式也怪得很。哦！说到钟——你脑袋上就顶着一个！能告诉我现在几点吗？我很确定上一顿饭已经是老早以前的事了，可不知怎么就是不觉得饿……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: That's exactly what I'm trying to figure out. There are no clocks here, and they have this weird way of counting days. Oh! Speaking of clocks—you've got one for a head! Could you tell me what time it is now? I know for sure it's been ages since my last meal, but somehow I don't feel hungry...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 看到杜布瓦，我才想起我们其实再没遇见过他。直到现在——在整座百货上一次清仓之后。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: Seeing Dubois, I recalled that we never actually got to encounter him again. That is, until now—after the last Liquidation of the entire department store.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 他或许真如浮士德解释的那样，去到了“另一个”二层，但是……想想我们在三层听说的、那些不合时令就跳上自动扶梯的人的下场……他在加入我们之后立刻把自己害死，也完全有可能。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: He really might've reached a "different" second floor as Faust had explained, but... from what we heard on the third floor about what happens to those who jump on the escalator out of season... It was entirely possible that he'd simply gotten himself killed immediately after joining us.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 哇，那是制服吗？你们肯定属于哪个挺像样的帮派吧。你们到底干了什么，让人把你们整批扔进这儿来？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: Whoa, are those uniforms? You must've belonged to a pretty serious Syndicate. Just what did you do that they decided to throw everyone in here as a package?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 唔，该怎么说呢……他们给我们定的罪名是“对某位同事关心得有点过头”，你能懂吗？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: Hm, how should I put this... They charged us with "caring a lil' too much about a certain colleague of ours", if that makes sense?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: <……好了，闲聊到此为止。继续往前走吧。>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: <... Alright, that's enough chit-chat. Let's keep moving forward.>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 呃……真的吗？我们不是该尽量多打听打听这地方吗？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: Uhh... Really? Shouldn't we try to learn as much as we can about this place?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: <是啊，可这家伙跟我们一样是新来的。我看他也说不出什么有价值的东西。>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: <Yeah, but this guy's as new to this place as we are. Doubt he's got anything revelatory to share with us.>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 但丁，我之前就说过，你今天真的很奇怪。特别像小浮。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: Dante, I've said this earlier, but you've been acting real weird today. Real Fau-like.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 我能摸摸您的头吗？是不是又烧起来了？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: Can I feel your head? Is it getting fired up again?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 越想越觉得，把清仓的事瞒下去的理由越来越少。可是……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: The more I think about it, the fewer reasons there are to keep the Liquidation a secret. But...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 唔……这回我再放过你一次。不过那只是因为看样子你那颗脑袋里正盘算着什么计划。可要答应我，之后全都讲出来，好吗？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: Hmmm... I'll let it slide a second time. But that's only because it looks like you've got a plan or something cooking up there. Promise to tell us everything later though, 'kay?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 话说回来……你叫什么名字，新来的？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: Anyways... What's your name, new guy?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 对了，我叫杜布瓦。大家也叫我“刀疤D”。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: The name's Dubois, by the way. People also call me "Scar D."

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 真的很抱歉，小杜，可是……我们现在有点赶时间。还得往别处去呢，你懂吧？要不是特别特别要紧的事，能不能……回头再说？下次见面的时候？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: I'm real sorry, Dubbs, but... we're in a bit of a hurry right now. Got places to be, ya know? If it isn't something super duper important, can we do this... maybe later? Next time we meet?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 啊，呃……我、我明白。我不介意，嗯……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: Ah, uh... I-I see. I don't mind, yeah...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 杜布瓦的眼睛紧张地四下乱瞟。
这位店员似乎不太乐意招呼我们。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: This employee here isn't so eager to greet us.
<He probably doesn't need to talk to us.>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 那好，我们就别打扰他，继续往前？听着挺双赢的。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: Welp, then let's not bother 'em and move on? Sounds like a win-win.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: <color=#916e46>敬请注意。条纹季已正式结束。我们很高兴地通知各位，千鸟格为新的潮流。</color>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: <color=#916e46>Your attention, please. The Stripe Season has officially ended. We are pleased to inform you that Houndstooth is the new trend.</color>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 什么？！不！我为了做出那些条纹，从大腿上剥了那么多皮……全都白费了？！我才刚把横条一路排到下巴。他们不能现在换潮流！
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: What?! No! I flayed so much skin off my thighs to make those stripe patterns... and it was all for nothing?! I only just got the horizontal lines all the way up to my chin. They can't change the trend now!

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 新品陈列架还得我来填！得想办法，得想办法……要不把现有的撕成格纹？我可不能让那些货落到清仓打折去！
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: I have to fill the new-arrivals displays! Need a plan, need a plan... Maybe tear what's there into a checkered pattern? I can't let those go to clearance!
Huh? How'd you know that, Dante?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: <我透过默尔索的视野看到过，认出了那片地方。快走，该和默尔索会合了。>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: <I recognized that part of the room after viewing it through Meursault's sight. Hurry up, time to reunite with Meursault.>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 在搞清状况之前，最好别跟罪人们说这是我第二次来。直觉告诉我，现在还不该把一切都抖出来……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: Best not to share with the Sinners that this is my second time here until I know what's going on. Something tells me I shouldn't reveal everything just yet...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: ……咦，您今天完全是经理状态……有点反常。呃，倒不是说您平时不是，只是…… 该怎么说呢？嗯，您好像比平时更……笃定、更果断。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: ... Huh, you're fully in your manager mode today... weirdly. Uh, not to say that you usually aren't, but...  How should I put this? Yeah, you seem more... confident and decisive than usual.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 这事绝对有蹊跷，但丁……不过这一次我就放过你。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: Something definitely smells fishy here, Dante... But I'll let it slide just this once.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 他那警惕的目光几乎能让人在皮肤上感觉到。既然不打算阻止我们看货，又为什么像鹰一样盯着我们……？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: We can almost feel his guarded stare against our skin. If he's not about to stop us from browsing, why is he watching us like a hawk...?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 我认不出这种材料……你觉得这些衣服是用什么做的？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: I don't recognize the material... What do you think these clothes are made of?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 顾客。也就是说，他们既购买并穿着衣物，也可能自己成为衣物。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: The customers. This means they purchase and wear clothing, but may also become clothing themselves.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 顾客？哦……我明白了。所以刚才那名店员才管你叫“材料”。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: Customers? Oh... I see now. That's why the clerk called you "material" earlier.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 是啊……那西西弗的“客源”有多大？就是被困在这地方的顾客。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: Right... So how big is Sisyphe's "clientele"? The customers trapped in this place?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 你没有听错。西西弗刑没有刑满之日，进入者永久留在此处。其人口在理论上呈无限增长的趋势。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: You did not. There is no discharge date for the Sisyphe Penalty, and those who enter remain permanently. Its population is theoretically on an infinite upward trend.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: <color=#7d7d7d>尔等谛听，今日吾再行宣谕。愿吾等安息之殿，永蒙保全之福。</color>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: <color=#7d7d7d>Heed ye, for again I proclaim this day. Blessed be the hall of our rest with eternal preservation.</color>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: <color=#7d7d7d>然而即便今日，丑恶与邪佞仍不息地自墙上剜取黄金，将那金辉据为己有，尔等却无所作为。尔等还要宽宥自身怯懦之魂、软弱地承受末日到几时？</color>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: <color=#7d7d7d>Yet even today, ye do naught as the hideous and the wicked ceaselessly tear out the Golden from its walls and take its aureate light for themselves. How long will ye forgive your own craven spirits and feebly accept the end of days?</color>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 我谨遵您的号令，主啊。胆敢掠夺黄金松脂的背教者，必将——
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: I shall heed your command, Lord. Apostates who dare plunder the Golden Resin shall—

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 我看见我们的顾客之中……有人正欣然沐浴在渎神那污浊的光辉里。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: I see among our clientele... those who gladly bask in the tarnished glow of sacrilege.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 他为什么盯着我们看……？喂，我们只是在逛店，安分守己得很！
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: Why is he looking at us...? Hey, we were just shopping and minding our own business!

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 那名店员是在对经理说话。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: The employee is speaking to the Manager.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 红派的势力竟妄图煽动骚乱、亵渎这片圣域……回答我，这般厚颜地要作废古老的休战，意欲何为？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: That the forces of Le Rouge would seek to foment disorder and profane the sacred domain... Answer, what is this brazen attempt to null the ancient truce?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 你听好了，老兄。我根本不知道这什么好笑的“红派”是怎么回事，明白吗？我们是无名小卒，不属于什么势力，也不想惹麻烦！
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: You listen here, Buddy. I don't even know what this funny "Rouge" business is, 'kay? We're nobodies, we're not in any forces of whatever, and we don't want any trouble!

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 啊，那么你们自称是褐派？你们大摇大摆地穿过本店，脸上还炫耀着那等不敬的饰物？还指望我们相信？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: Ah, then you claim to be Kakis? You, who strut through our store flaunting those irreverent trinkets on your face? Do you expect us to believe you?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 让我斗胆猜一下的话……“亵渎的饰物”指的应该是但丁的钟表指针吧……？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: If I were to hazard a guess... I'd say the "blasphemous trinkets" are referring to Dante's clock hands...?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh:
<color=#7d7d7d>凡剜取黄金者，尔不可容。
尔当涤净吾等之域中的背教。</color>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en:
<color=#7d7d7d>Thou shalt not suffer those who would scrape out the Golden.
Thou shalt cleanse our domain of apostasy.</color>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 我绝不予他们宽赦……我要亲手夺回那光辉的松脂，撑住这圣所日渐黯淡的光……是的——您的声音传到我这里了。作为黑派这一意志之手，我将在此立定，并……！
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: I shall grant them no mercy... I shall reclaim that radiant resin with my own hands and shore up the fading light of this sanctuary... Yes—your voice reaches me. As the hand of the will that is Le Noir, I shall make my stand here and...!

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh:
<color=#7d7d7d>尔当驱逐背教者……
尔当守护那黄金之色……
尔已受神圣职责之祝圣，当遮蔽亵渎之光，永恒安息的守护者啊……</color>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en:
<color=#7d7d7d>Thou shalt banish the apostates...
Thou shalt preserve the Golden hue...
Thou art hallow'd with the divine duty to shade the profane light, O keeper of eternal rest...</color>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 我觉得这儿能看的东西，我们基本都看过了。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: I think we've looked at pretty much everything they have to offer here.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 那我们去前面那家店看看，不就知道了。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: Well, let's head to the other store up ahead and find out.
<Yeah, to the next store we go.>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 你们身上的金色痕迹……虽然相似，却与我们必须守护的黄金松脂大不相同。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: Your aureate traces are... while similar, quite unlike the Golden Resin we must preserve.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 是啊，那我们早说的时候你怎么不听？本来这一通乱子都能免了……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: Yeah, well, why didn't you listen when we said as much? Could've avoided this whole mess...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 以实玛利带着威胁的意味朝那名店员迈了一步，对方连忙缩了回去。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: Ishmael took a threatening stride toward the employee, who quickly shrank back.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 哦！我明白了……您的声音又一次在我心中回响！这些是真正的异乡人，对我们的规矩一无所知——不过是被本品牌的价值吸引而来的顾客罢了。我当重新迎接他们。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: Oh! I understand... Your voice resounds within me once more! These are true strangers, innocent of our ways—customers drawn here by the worth of our brand, and nothing more. I shall receive them anew.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 请恕我冒犯，亲爱的顾客。萦绕在你们身上的金光，与我们必须守护的、蒙福的黄金松脂极为相似。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: Forgive my affront, dear customers. The golden light that hangs over you much resembles the blessed Golden Resin we must preserve.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 能像你这样察觉到金枝气息的人，我们可没遇上几个……你是怎么做到的？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: We haven't met too many people who could pick up the Golden Bough's presence like you did... How'd ya do it?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 我们每一个人都能感到那金色的脉动……并为之干渴。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: Every one of us feels that golden pulse... and thirsts for it.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 我们的指引之光……将我们织成所愿之形的金色微光……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: Our guiding light... The golden gleam that weaves us into our desired forms...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 那份璀璨，我们同样渴求。但不同于屈从于低劣欲望的红派，我们黑派是那蒙福之粒永世立誓的守卫。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: We desire it too, that brilliance. But unlike the Rouges who surrendered to their base urges, we Noirs are the eternally sworn guards of the blessed grain.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 想必你们已经注意到……墙上满是那些亵渎的红色之徒留下的丑陋咬痕。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: As you have doubtless noticed... The walls are riddled with the hideous bite marks left by those blasphemous red ones.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 那可是黄金松脂的颗粒啊……可那些红派的野蛮人，正忙着把这坚固堡垒的精粹一把把塞进自己的喉咙里……！
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: Grain of the Golden Resin, indeed... But those Rouge savages are busy shoveling that very essence of the stalwart bastion into their gullets...!

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 好吧，那……“黄金松脂”到底是什么？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: Okay, so... just what is the "Golden Resin"?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: <他说的大概是填在墙面裂缝里的那些金色斑块。>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: <He's probably referring those patches of gold filling the fractures on the walls.>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 原来那些就是“黄金松脂”啊……
那是九个树季之前——破灭之世以墙面上裂开的灾厄裂缝之形，降临于西西弗百货。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: The time was nine arboreal Seasons ago—when the Age of Ruin descended upon Grand Magasin Sisyphe in the form of cataclysmic cracks forming upon its walls.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 随后，就在厄运即将吞没我们的前一瞬，救赎以只能称作神迹的形态降临——璀璨的金色松脂在那些本将毁灭我们的裂缝中显现，将其修补如初。我们岂能不赞美、不崇奉这份天意？可叹……红派却无法领会这份敬奉中毫无歧义的道理，反倒选择剥剜墙壁……荒谬绝伦。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: Then, mere moments before doom took us, salvation arrived in a form that couldn't be anything else but divine—brilliant resin of gold, materializing in the cracks that would have been our ruin, patching them back to wholeness. Are we not to praise and worship this providence? Alas... The Rouges fail to comprehend the unequivocal logic in this veneration, and instead elect to flay the walls... Preposterous.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 尽管两派之间维系着岌岌可危的休战……可摆在眼前的真相无人看不见：这份和平不过是片刻的间歇罢了。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: Though a precarious truce between the two factions is in place... None fail to see the truth that is plainly before them: this peace is but a momentary lull, nothing more.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 届时……唯有届时……我的心智才会向广播之外那真正的“声音”敞开。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: Then... only then... shall my mind be opened to the true "Voice," beyond the broadcast.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: ……？那刚才那通关于声音的大惊小怪又是怎么回事？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: ...? What was all that fuss about voices earlier, then?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 呃……！对，没错……我确实听得见那“声音”……我的意思是，我的心智会敞开得更多，好让我更频繁地听见它……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: Uh...! Right, indeed... I do hear the "Voice..." What I meant to say is that my mind shall be opened further so that I may hear it more frequently...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 话说回来……你要是知道上楼的路，愿不愿意透个底给我们？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: Anyways... If ya know a way upstairs, care to let us in on the secret?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 啊，原来你们是想前往顾客服务中心的顾客……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: Ah, so you are customers who seek to reach the Customer Service Center, I see...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 上行即是积累评级，而所谓有评级，就是不断花费、不断消费，直到你的开销配得上他们所要求的身份。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: To rise is to gain prestige, and to be prestigious is to spend and consume until your expenditure befits the status they demand.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 虽说我受缚于职守，必须留在这家店里侍奉顾客……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: Though I am bound to my post, to remain in this establishment and attend to its customers...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-npc-floor-1-b-enemy.js.zh: 黑派店员 居斯塔夫

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-1-b.json#Q.zh: 有些不对劲。我们回到了洗手间，但所有人都像是什么也不记得，默尔索也不见踪影。这一切不可能只是一场梦。去百货商场里看看吧。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-1-b.json#Q.en: Something's off. We're back in the restroom, but everyone is acting like they don't remember a thing, and Meursault is nowhere to be seen. This couldn't all have been a dream. Let's look around the department store.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-1-b.json#Q.zh: 至少看来，那一切并不全是梦。现在先继续前进，专心寻找默尔索。他可能还在上次那家店里。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-1-b.json#Q.en: At least it doesn't seem like it was all a dream. For now, let's keep moving and focus on finding Meursault. He may be back at the same store as last time.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-1-b.json#Q.zh: 默尔索应该就在附近。找到他，和他谈谈。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-1-b.json#Q.en: Meursault should be somewhere nearby. Find him and talk to him.
Show the Mannequins to the Exit

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-1-b.json#Q.zh: 想带默尔索一起走，就得先帮含羞草一个忙。尽快解决这些人台，然后离开这里吧。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-1-b.json#Q.en: If we want to take Meursault with us, we'll have to do Mimosa a favor first. Let's make quick work of the Mannequins and get out of here.
Show the Mannequins to the Exit (2)

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-1-b.json#Q.zh: 没必要再把这场谈话拖下去了。清理掉人台，继续前进吧。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-1-b.json#Q.en: There's no need to drag this conversation out any longer. Let's clear out the Mannequins and move on.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-1-b.json#Q.zh: 情况已经比上次顺利了。要想迎来不同的结果，我们就必须继续前进。当务之急是离开1层。先离开快销服饰馆，前往下一家店吧。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-1-b.json#Q.en: Things are already going better than last time. If we're going to get a different outcome, we need to keep moving. First priority: get off 1F. We should leave the Casualwear Hall and head for the next store.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-1-b.json#Q.zh: 我们遇到了上次也曾和我们交谈的杜布瓦。不过，现在没时间长谈。直接前往下一层吧。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-1-b.json#Q.en: We ran into Dubois, who spoke to us last time as well. There's no time for a long conversation, though. Let's head straight to the next floor.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: ……或许你们可以代我上行，转达我对黄金松脂永世不渝的忠诚……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: ... perhaps you may be able to ascend in my stead and relay the account of my eternal fidelity toward the Golden Resin...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 明白了。所以想上楼就得花钱。若不介意，再问一个问题——在这儿到底怎么赚钱？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: Gotcha. So if we want to go upstairs, we're gonna need to spend some cash. One more question, if you wouldn't mind—how exactly do we make money around here?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 这儿说到钱好像都叫“眼球”……对吧？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: The lingo for money here seems to be "eyeballs"... Right?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 哦……你们这些异乡人的决心果真与众不同。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: Oh... You strangers truly possess a determination unlike any other.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 那么我便告知获取眼球之法。从人台身上取。它们无休无止地寻找一切展示自己的机会；只要你们勤加努力，所需的眼球必能凑足。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: Then I shall reveal the means by which eyeballs may be won. Take them from the Mannequins. They seek every opportunity to exhibit themselves without end; if you apply yourselves diligently, you will gather all the eyeballs you require.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 还有一事——过了此处请务必时刻警惕，因为你们将进入红派的地盘。那些粗鄙的异教恶徒连一匹布都披不周正，便去撕扯我们的黄金松脂，再缝合成任何他们中意的亵渎形状……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: And another thing—pray, be constantly vigilant beyond this point, for you will be entering the territory of the Rouges. The vulgar, heathen fiends cannot even drape a bolt of fabric properly, so they rend our Golden Resin and stitch it back together in whatever blasphemous shape that pleases them...
... The Rouges... All right. Will keep that in mind.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 若无他事，勇敢的异乡人，我荣幸地通知诸位：本店现已向你们开放选购。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: If there isn't anything else, brave strangers, I am honored to inform you that this establishment is now open to your perusal.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 哦……真是遗憾。本店没有适合您这种……品味的异乡人的货品。等您对时尚有了些领悟——顺便把评级也提上去——再回来吧。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: Oh... How regrettable. We carry nothing suitable for Strangers of your... sensibilities. Return once you've cultivated some understanding of fashion—and raised your rank, too.
And how do we raise that?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 在百货商店里提升地位，不就只有一种办法吗？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: There is but one way to raise one's standing in a department store, is there not?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 正是。那么，再会了，穿着实在……引人注目的异乡人们。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: Precisely. Then until we meet again, Strangers of truly... arresting fashion.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 那东西看起来有点像西装……只是剪裁的设计要高档得多。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: It looks something like a suit... only cut from a far more classy design.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 咦。比我想的要好看多了。真时髦！
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: Huh. That's actually a lot nicer than I expected. So chic!

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 哦，你们不觉得这件简直是为但丁做的吗？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: Ooh, don'tcha think this one's made for Dante?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 当然！这一身简直在求着你穿。而且我们还有之前那些眼球——干嘛不给自己买点好的？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: Ya bet! That fit is practically beggin' for ya. And we've got those eyeballs from earlier—why not treat yourself?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 等等。这是这儿唯一肯收的货币。在这么挥钱之前，我们该先把优先顺序理清——
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: Hang on. It's the only kind of currency they'll accept around here. We should set our priorities right before we splash cash like—

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 呃……450颗眼球？这不是抢钱吗！
也可能只是我们太穷了。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: Or maybe we're just too broke.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: ……我犹豫了一下，要不要说我们这趟走到现在已经花掉了好几个450颗眼球，但还是没说。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: ... I considered for a moment whether I should mention that we've spent multiples of 450 eyeballs in our journey so far, but I decided against it.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: <是啊，这些衣服看起来对“跟上潮流”没什么兴趣。>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: <Yeah, these garments don't seem that interested in being "trendy.">

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 设计师的名头够响的时候，就不用追潮流了。是潮流来追你。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: When a designer's name carries enough weight, ya don't chase trends. Trends chase ya instead.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 这么讲究的东西，贴上个名牌标、标个离谱的价，你什么都不用做，人就排起队来了。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: Slap a famous label and a ridiculous price on something this fancy, and people will line up before ya lift a finger.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 用不着把自己累垮……去追每一阵小风潮。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: No need to run yourself ragged.. to keep up with every little craze.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 整套服装恰好完整地映入视野。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: The entire outfit fits neatly into view.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 啊……我是不是瞧见了一位真正的时尚鉴赏家？与本店如出一辙的风格……精致……优雅……还有那对色彩的驾驭——妙不可言。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: Ah... Do I spy a true connoisseur of fashion? A style much like our own... sophisticated... elegant... and that command of color—exquisite.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 那句夸奖是冲着经理说的。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: The compliment was directed at the Manager.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: <哈……看来我在这儿算是挺“潮”的？>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: <Huh... Guess I'm pretty "hip" here, as they say?>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 您似乎对时尚有相当不俗的眼光，那我或许可以为您的选购提供一点专家的建议……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: You appear to possess a respectable eye for fashion, so perhaps I can offer an expert's advice on shopping...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 本品牌的灵魂是解放——确切地说，是令人窒息的解放。你们经过黑派的店了吧？那些一根根钉穿布料的钢针，只是对克制的一场虚伪做作——红派的理念从根本上就不同。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: The soul of our label is liberation—strangling liberation, to be exact. You passed through the Noirs' store, yes? All those steel pins hammered through the fabric are a hypocritical pantomime of restraint—the philosophy of Le Rouge differs at its very root.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 请看这里……您看见这材料那种顺滑而自然的弹性了吗？除了带齿的——是的，字面意义上的带齿——圆编工艺，别的制法都做不出这种效果。皮革向下垂坠，成就出一道既毫不费力又崇高非凡的廓形。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: If I may direct your attention... here, do you see the smooth, natural give of the material? You won't see that from any production technique other than toothed—yes, it is quite literal—loopwheeling technique. The hide spills downward, completing a silhouette at once effortless and sublime.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 啊！还有一点若不说便是我的失职了：这材料里掺入了0.3盎司的黄金皮革。您只要用手摸一摸——啊，那种妙不可言的光泽几乎在表面上流动，对不对？对不对？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: Ah! And I would be remiss not to share that this includes 0.3 ounces of Golden Hide blended into the material. Simply feel it in your hands—ah, it has such a wonderful luster that practically gleams along the surface, doesn't it? Doesn't it?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 啊，请恕我失礼……我是不是说得太投入了？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: Ah, do pardon me... I got carried away, didn't I?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 实话说，我就是这个品牌的设计师。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: The truth is, I am the designer of this label.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 天哪，为了在这座百货里拥有这么小小一角，我克服过多少麻烦，能讲上好几个钟头。在西西弗创立一个设计师品牌可不容易呢。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: Gosh, I could go on for hours about all the troubles I had to overcome to have this tiny corner of the department store to myself. It's no easy task launching a designer label at Sisyphe, you know.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 嘛……至少她看起来算是友善的那一类。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: Well... at least she seems to fall into the friendly camp.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 您有心仪的廓形吗？若您愿意，我可以从我的系列里挑出一条线，把您的身形勾勒得完美无瑕。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: Is there a particular silhouette you're after? If you like, I can select a line from my collection that will articulate your physique to perfection.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 我们……其实是在找上楼的路。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: We're... trying to find our way upstairs, actually.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 啊，我就知道……你们也更中意奢侈品牌，对不对？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: Ah, I knew it... You're more interested in the Luxury brands too, aren't you?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 不过我向你们保证，我设计的品质标准与那份古典气韵，并不比奢侈品牌差多少……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: But I assure you, the quality standards and the classique air of my designs are not so far behind those of Luxury brands...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 是的，当然，奢侈品牌的魅力无可否认。曾经有一段时日，连我也像着了魔一样一心攒眼球，只为求一个亲眼见到奢侈品馆的机会……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: Yes, of course, the allure of Luxury brands is undeniable. There once was a time when even I devoted myself to collecting eyeballs like a thing possessed, all for the chance of witnessing the Luxury Hall...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 我认识一个红派，在获准进入奢侈品馆之前就在这儿做事。我不想说人坏话，可在打版和设计上明明远不如我的人竟被批准了，这让我很不痛快。而且这位“奢侈品设计师”当年还是个生手时，手艺是在我手下学的，你们信吗？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: I know a Rouge who used to work here before they were allowed to join the Luxury Hall. I don't want to badmouth, but I do take umbrage with how they approved somebody who is so clearly my inferior in patterning and design. And to think this "Luxury designer" learned their craft under my tutelage as a greenhorn, can you believe it?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 直到……听着，接下来才是真正荒唐的地方……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: Until... listen, this is where it gets really ridiculous...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: ……他们用牙齿在每一件单品的领口和下摆上，整整咬出七十六个齿痕。不知道顾客到底看出了什么，反正普遍的评价说那造出了一种“解构式廓形”，货架几乎被抢空。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: ... they used their teeth to line each and every one of their items with exactly 76 tooth marks along the necklines and hems. Whatever it was that the customers saw, the general reception claimed it cast a "deconstructive silhouette," and practically emptied their shelves.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 唉，那种事说到底只是碰巧，我可不会算作他们的本事……我的设计比他们精致得多，优雅更是无从比较。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: Eh, I wouldn't attribute that to their skill when it ultimately amounts to a fluke... My designs are far more sophisticated than theirs, not to mention incomparably elegant.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 我也理应被认定为奢侈品屋。一个属于我自己的高定品牌！可我到底要怎样才能——
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: I deserve to be recognized as a Luxury house, too. A couture label of my own! But just what must I do to—

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 能不能麻烦你们从展示人台那里弄一根针给我？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: Would you mind grabbing me a needle from the Exhibiting Mannequins?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 给我找根够大的，我会设法让你们不白忙一趟。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: Find me a sizable one, and I'll try to make it worth your while.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 那个人台好像比别的都难对付……你们觉得是因为这根金针吗？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: That Mannequin seemed tougher than the others... Ya think it's this golden needle?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 喏，你的针。那……能解释一下这东西怎么就成了你加入奢侈品牌的钥匙吗？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: Yeah, here's your needle. So... care to explain how this is your key to joining the Luxury brands?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 那是突然涌上我心头的念头。我的品牌要进入高级时装的世界，需要深厚的传承吗？不。需要技术上的完美吗？显然不。需要稀有的高级材料吗？完全不需要……可我一直执着于满足那些凭空定下的条件，把自己困死在这个被美化成大厅的玻璃罐里。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: It's just something that's struck me all of a sudden. Does my brand need strong heritage to enter the world of high fashion? No. Technical perfection? Clearly not. Rare, high-grade materials? Not at all... But I've been so obsessed with meeting those arbitrary conditions that I've trapped myself in this glorified glass jar of a lobby.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 是的，一件招牌作品……我缺的正是那一件招牌作品——你们明白我的意思吗？——那个只需一眼就能抓住每位顾客眼球的独一无二的构想……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: Yes, a signature piece... What I lacked was the signature piece—do you understand what I'm getting at?—the singular idea that would seize every customer's eye just from a quick glance...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 和上一次一样，那女人开始往自己的皮肤上刺出花纹。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: Just as she did last time, the woman began stabbing a pattern into her skin.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 只要给它一个漂亮的花纹……像这样……就能轻松造出立体感。等着看材料整体均匀地肿胀起来吧。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: If I give it a nice pattern... like so... I can easily create a sense of three-dimensionality. Just wait until you see the material swell up evenly across the board.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 哦哦，我等不及要感受花纹上每一个孔洞都被柔软多汁的脓液填满了！那手感会多么柔韧……怎么样？摆进上层奢侈品馆的杰作之间也毫不逊色，对不对？对不对？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: Ohh, I can't wait to feel each hole in the pattern fill up with soft, juicy pus! It'll result in such a supple touch... How's that? It'll fit right in among the masterpieces of the Luxury Hall on the upper floors, won't it? won't it?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 你就只有这点话可说？你有审美的眼睛——用起来啊！好好欣赏眼前的东西！
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: Is that all you've got to say? You have an eye for beauty—use it! Appreciate what you see!

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: ……横轴二十一孔，纵轴二十一孔，以均等间距交错。这样可得最大密度。
