RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: ... 21 punctures along the horizontal axis and 21 along the vertical, intersecting at uniform intervals. That would produce the greatest density.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 当然……绗缝工艺与压纹设计的混合结构，成型为菱形。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: Of course... A hybrid construction of the quilting process and embossed design formed into diamond shapes.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 总之，我们按约定帮了你。我想也该轮到你履约，告诉我们怎么上楼了。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: Anyway, we helped you out, as promised. I think it's about time you held up your end of the deal and told us how to get ourselves upstairs.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 哦，那个？你们只需要把评级攒上去。当然，以你们现在的等级，购物之旅大概该从楼下的快销服饰馆开始……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: Oh, that? You simply need to build up your Prestige Tier. At your current level, of course, you should probably start your shopping journey down at the Casualwear Hall...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: ……不过既然你们对我的时尚事业帮助极大，我就为你们破个例，允许你们购买本品牌的商品。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: ... But since you've been tremendously helpful in my fashion ventures, I'll make a special exception for you and allow purchase from my brand.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 记住我的话：下次见面时……你们或许会在奢侈品馆看到我，在尊贵的橱窗里展示我的作品——或者该说，展示我自己。啊……那该多幸福……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: Mark my words: the next time we meet... perhaps you will see me in the Luxury Hall, showcasing my piece—or shall I say, myself—in an exalted window display. Ahh... What bliss...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 瞧我，下一季系列的截止日眼看就到了，我却在这儿浪费时间闲聊……恕我先把肩缝的压纹做完……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: Look at me, wasting my time chattering away when the deadline for the next collection is fast approaching... Excuse me while I finish embossing the shoulder seam...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 这期间请随意浏览我的设计师系列！没有哪一件是不能购买的……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: In the meantime, feel free to browse my designer collection! No item is off limits for purchase...
Have you brought me the needle?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 坠在这层中央的那堆尸体似乎爆开了，血肉一路飞溅到了这边。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: The corpse pile that fell in the center of the floor appears to have burst and splattered all the way over here.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 再过一会儿，褐派就会把它捡得一干二净，给我们腾出过路的地方。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: Give it some time, and the Kakis'll pick it clean and make the way for us to pass.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 哦，嘿！看样子我们的评级点数够上下一层了。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: Oh, hey! Looks like we have enough Prestige points to move on to the next floor.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 看着是这样。不知道这是不是意味着我们现在成了西西弗的VIP什么的？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: Sure looks like it. Wonder if this means we're now Sisyphe VIPs or something?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 哦，又见面了！我找到自动扶梯了，可它不动。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: Oh, hello again! I found the escalator, but it won't run.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 真的？怪了，为什么不动呢……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: Really? That's weird, why wouldn't it...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 等等，你们一来它就动了！你们肯定是找到了通往上层的解锁办法！
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: Wait, it's running now that you're here! You must've found a way to unlock your way onto the upper floor!

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 嘛，我们买了点东西……干了点苦力活……又干了点苦力活……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: Well, we did a lil' shopping... some grunt work... some more grunt work...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 我能跟着你们吗？我保证等自己找到赚钱的门路，马上就报答你们。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: Can I tag along? I promise I'll repay you guys as soon as I find a way to make some money myself.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 好像也没什么坏处……那就上来吧？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: Don't see what the harm could be... Hop right on, I guess?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 多亏你们，我终于能上楼了！你们帮我的这份情，我不会忘。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: I can finally go upstairs, thanks to you! I won't forget what you've done for me.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 这儿到底在卖什么？不对，说到底，这地方为什么会有东西在卖？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: What exactly are they selling here? No, actually, why's anything being sold here in the first place?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 我是说，这可是百货商店嘛~
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: I mean, it's a department store~

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 大百货……百货商店究其本质，是无数小小方格为逐利而彼此挤压之所。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: Grand Magasin... A department store is, by nature, a place where a myriad little squares crowd upon one another in pursuit of profit.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 想知道得更详细些，大概就只能四处看看了——
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: I suppose we'll have to look around if we want to learn anything more in detai—
It should be right about... now.
<... Yi Sang, come this way for a minute?>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 嗯？可有需要我留意之事？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: Hm? Is there aught that requires my attention?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 我不知道，但不管那是什么，有个巨大的东西……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: I don't know, but whatever it is, something huge...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 多谢您，但丁。我险些被他们的血浇个满身。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: You have my gratitude, Dante. I was nearly bathed in their blood.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 好险。若我们再往旁边挪上几步……便会遭受严重冲击。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: That was close. We would have sustained a severe impact... had we moved a few steps closer to the side.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 直觉卓绝，执行经理！您再一次力挽狂澜，避免了不必要的人员损失。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: Fantastic intuition, Executive Manager! Once again, you have saved the day and prevented unnecessary loss of personnel.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 那似乎是……一大团纠缠在一起的人体，不过残骸损毁得太过严重，已分辨不出单独的形体。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: It appears to be... a huge mass of human bodies tangled together, though the remains are far too severely mutilated to discern any individual forms.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 掉下来个大的。这回说不定能捞上不少。但愿那些顾客是舍得砸眼球的主。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: A big one dropped. Might be plenty worth salvaging this time. Hope the customers were heavy eyeball-spenders.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 该死，我的空瓶子用完了！喂，你上一季从我这儿借了三个。什么时候还？！
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: Damn it, I'm out of empty bottles! Hey, you borrowed three from me last season. When are you going to pay me back?!

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 滚开！这一季的新货全都……全都是我的。谁也别想！
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: Fuck off! This season's new drop is all... all mine. No one else's!

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 从天而降的那一堆，原来是被毁坏得面目全非的尸体。一种奇异的金色光芒，明亮如日光，在尸体的缝隙间一闪一闪。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: The pile that fell from the sky turns out to be corpses, mangled beyond all recognition. A curious golden glow, bright like sunlight, winks through the gaps between the bodies.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 属于“褐派”这一类的百货顾客，正在尸体之间拼命争抢眼球和黄金皮革的碎屑。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: Customers of the department store, of "Le Kaki" variant, are desperately scrambling among the corpses for eyeballs and dregs of the Golden Hide.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: <好吧……这就回答了那个问题。我不是在幻想。>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: <Well... that answers the question. I'm not imagining things.>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 我——以及我们所有人——已经经历过这一幕了。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: I—and all of us, by extension—have experienced this already.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 你们这些人总是运气好得要命，对吧？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: You people are always so awfully lucky, aren't you?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 瞧瞧那摊血肉！八成是从六层上下掉下来的。这一堆够让这块地方红上一阵子，成为头号落货区啦。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: Look at that gory mess! Must've fallen from the sixth floor, give or take. This pile'll make this spot famous as a prime drop zone for a while.
... Might you be talking to us?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 怎么这么久才来？我可是日夜不停地眼巴巴等着你们呢！
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: What took you so long? I've been anxiously waiting for you 'round the clock!

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 等我们？你他妈为什么要……？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: For us? Why the hell would you...?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 不管怎么说，刚才从上面掉下来的那些……不是人的尸体吗……？还有那些人到底在捡什么……？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: In any case, aren't those... human bodies that just fell from above...? And what're those people even scavenging...?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 她说是人！哦，你可真会异想天开。那些是顾客。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: Human, she says! Oh, you're positively whimsical, aren't you? Those were customers.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 至于那些捡破烂的，他们听见“咚”的一声，就聚过来想捞点什么。这儿的日子可不好过，你知道的。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: As for the scavengers, they heard a thud, so they've gathered up to try to get anything they can. Life's pretty rough in here, you know.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 必须先将人台引至出口，经理。其次才是以我为交换对象的交易。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: The Mannequins must first be guided to the exit, Manager. Next is the transaction in which I am the object of exchange.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 走吧，但丁。我们得去把默尔索接回来。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: Come on, Dante. We need to go get Meursault.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 那个人台好像比别的都难对付……你们觉得是因为这根金针吗？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: That Mannequin seemed tougher than the others... Ya think it's this golden needle?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 看着足有一尺多长。这种尺寸……更像是鱼叉头了。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: It looks well over a foot long. At that size... it's more like a harpoon head.

StoryData/S1018B.json#0#content.zh: 大家为什么都对这堆……被撕得稀烂的尸体这么着迷？还有那道亮光是怎么回事……？那些人是在翻找尸体生前戴着的黄金吗？
StoryData/S1018B.json#0#content.en: Why's everyone so obsessed with this... pile of mangled bodies? And what's with that bright light...? Are those people scavenging for gold these corpses were wearing when they were alive?

StoryData/S1018B.json#3#content.zh: 你们这些人还是这么有意思！“死之前”——真是太棒了。
StoryData/S1018B.json#3#content.en: You guys really are always such a riot! "Before they died"—so good.

StoryData/S1018B.json#5#content.zh: 你看，那一个是从六层掉下来的，说明其放弃了前往顾客服务中心。也可能是为了一块黄金皮革起了争执或打了一架，最后没能占到便宜。
StoryData/S1018B.json#5#content.en: Look, that one fell from the sixth floor, which means they gave up on reaching the Customer Service Center. Or maybe there was a kerfuffle or a fight over a piece of Golden Hide that didn't end in their favor.

StoryData/S1018B.json#6#content.zh: 呃……好吧……放弃去顾客服务中心……这个我勉强能懂，可为什么一放弃就会一路掉到一层来啊……？
StoryData/S1018B.json#6#content.en: Uh... okay... Gave up on reaching Customer Service... I get that, I guess, but why does giving up make you plummet all the way down to the first floor...?

StoryData/S1018B.json#7#content.zh: 轮到我提问了！我们走路时为什么要把一只脚迈到另一只脚前面？
StoryData/S1018B.json#7#content.en: My turn to ask! Why do we put one foot in front of the other to walk?

StoryData/S1018B.json#9#content.zh: ……现在你知道我听你问个没完是什么感受了吧。懂了吗？
StoryData/S1018B.json#9#content.en: ... And now you know how I feel listening to your endless questions. Get it now?

StoryData/S1018B.json#11#content.zh: 而且，顾客们才不在乎那种空壳，也不在乎你所说的那堆曾经“活着”的“尸体”——他们要找的是尸体的眼球，或者……运气好时或许能翻出来的黄金皮革碎屑。
StoryData/S1018B.json#11#content.en: And the customers aren't interested in an empty husk like that, or that "pile of bodies" you say were once "alive"—they're looking for the eyeballs it had, or... scraps of Golden Hide that might be there if they're lucky.

StoryData/S1018B.json#12#content.zh: 说回来，你们究竟是怎么从那里出来的？
StoryData/S1018B.json#12#content.en: Anyway. How is it that you managed to emerge from there?

StoryData/S1018B.json#14#content.zh: 嘘……！你非得把每个字都说得那么响吗？想惹恼楼层经理不成？
StoryData/S1018B.json#14#content.en: Shh...! Do you have to articulate every syllable so loudly like that? Are you trying to piss off the Floor Manager?

StoryData/S1018B.json#16#content.zh: 我从没见过有顾客从泉里走出来。一次都没有。无论经历多少季节，我都没见那扇门打开过。
StoryData/S1018B.json#16#content.en: I've never seen a customer walk out of the Fount. Not once. In all the seasons I've gone through, I've never seen that door open.

StoryData/S1018B.json#17#content.zh: 而且你们……还是可悲地寒酸又过时。逛了这么久就逛出这副样子？
StoryData/S1018B.json#17#content.en: And you guys are... still lamentably shabby and out of fashion. So much for all that shopping, huh?

StoryData/S1018B.json#18#content.zh: 这段对话与我的记忆相比，已经发生了几乎难以察觉的变化。她的回答不同了——态度也不同了。若说先前我还不能确定，那么此刻我已经确信：
StoryData/S1018B.json#18#content.en: Something had almost imperceptibly changed from what I recalled of this exchange. Her replies were different—and so was her attitude. If I wasn't certain before, I was now:

StoryData/S1018B.json#19#content.zh: 克罗默记得追求永恒的西西弗百货迎来的“结局”。
StoryData/S1018B.json#19#content.en: Kromer remembers the "end" of the Grand Magasin that sought eternity.

StoryData/S1018B.json#21#content.zh: 所以，这就算回答你是谁了吗？
StoryData/S1018B.json#21#content.en: And this is supposed to answer the question of who you are?

StoryData/S1018B.json#23#content.zh: 哎呀，要我当众自我介绍还真有点害羞呢……你们瞧，我是“隐士”。
StoryData/S1018B.json#23#content.en: Oh, dear. I'm quite bashful about introducing myself out in the open, you know... I'm the "Hermit," you see.

StoryData/S1018B.json#24#content.zh: ……这丫头满脸都写着一副油腔滑调的“背后捅刀子”相，明摆着呢。咱也懒得琢磨她到底在胡扯什么，先顺着她应付几句，然后赶紧动身吧。
StoryData/S1018B.json#24#content.en: ... Lass has that smarmy "backstabber" look written all over her mug, clear as day. We can't be arsed figurin' out what nonsense she's on about, so let's just humor her for a bit and get our arses moving.

StoryData/S1018B.json#25#content.zh: 喂，这话该对整个团队说吧？需要您说服的人又不是我……
StoryData/S1018B.json#25#content.en: Hey, tell that to the whole team, huh? I'm not the one you've got to convince, you know...

StoryData/S1018B.json#26#content.zh: 自从我们遇见你，你就一直在胡言乱语。明确表明立场：你是朋友，还是敌人？
StoryData/S1018B.json#26#content.en: You've done nothing but babble nonsense from the moment we ran into you. Clarify your position: are you a friend, or are you a foe?

StoryData/S1018B.json#27#content.zh: 若你确实有意协助我们，就报出你的条件。若你用无偿相助这种荒谬说辞作保证，我们会将其视为欺骗……并将你视为敌人。
StoryData/S1018B.json#27#content.en: State your price if you truly intend to aid us. If you give us some absurd assurance about wanting to help for nothing in return, we'll take that as deception... and you as an enemy.

StoryData/S1018B.json#28#content.zh: 我只想要一件事。从西西弗开业那天直到此时此刻，我想要的始终只有一件事：
StoryData/S1018B.json#28#content.en: I only want one thing. From the day Sisyphe opened until this very moment, I've wanted one thing alone:

StoryData/S1018B.json#29#content.zh: 解构西西弗百货这一存在——将它的每一处、每一个角落彻底解构，让任何人都再也不敢创造这种东西！
StoryData/S1018B.json#29#content.en: Deconstruct the very existence of the Grand Magasin—every nook and corner of it, so that no one will ever dare to create something like this again!

StoryData/S1018B.json#30#content.zh: 女人压低了声音，仿佛在向我们吐露一个天大的秘密。
StoryData/S1018B.json#30#content.en: The woman lowered her voice as though confiding a great secret to us.

StoryData/S1018B.json#32#content.zh: 嗯哼。在等待中受苦之人有福了，因为他们无所不能。
StoryData/S1018B.json#32#content.en: Mmhmm. Blessed are those who suffer in waiting, for there is nothing they cannot do.

StoryData/S1018B.json#33#content.zh: 明白了吧？所以我依然在……等待。
StoryData/S1018B.json#33#content.en: See? That's why I'm still... waiting.

StoryData/S1018B.json#34#content.zh: 过去经历的碎片提醒我，此时应该有某位罪人正怒火中烧。果不其然，我转过身，发现辛克莱双拳紧握，仿佛正强忍着呕吐的冲动。
StoryData/S1018B.json#34#content.en: The fragment of my past experience reminded me that a certain Sinner should be fuming by this point. Sure enough, I turned around to find Sinclair with his fists clenched, as though he were suppressing the urge to retch.

StoryData/S1018B.json#35#content.zh: 看来在这个时候，他就已经认出了她。
StoryData/S1018B.json#35#content.en: So he'd already realized who she was at this point.

StoryData/S1018B.json#37#content.zh: 经理……我想我知道她是谁了。
StoryData/S1018B.json#37#content.en: Manager... I think I know who she is.

StoryData/S1018B.json#38#content.zh: <如果她真是你想的那个人……无论你有多愤怒、多害怕，都别把视线从她身上移开。>
StoryData/S1018B.json#38#content.en: <If that's really who you think she is... Don't tear your eyes away from her, no matter how angry or scared you might be.>

StoryData/S1018B.json#39#content.zh: 克罗默歪着嘴对我笑。她一定也记得我们……
StoryData/S1018B.json#39#content.en: Kromer looks at me with a crooked grin. She must remember us, too...

StoryData/S1018B.json#41#content.zh: 辛克莱的神情瞬间冷若冰霜，他以淬满毒意的声音说出了那个名字。
StoryData/S1018B.json#41#content.en: The look on Sinclair's face turned to ice, his voice dripping with venom as he said the name.

StoryData/S1018B.json#42#content.zh: 虽无法辨清其面容，但她的一言一语间都透着一股寒意……
StoryData/S1018B.json#42#content.en: Though I could not discern her countenance, there was a certain chill pervading each turn of her speech...

StoryData/S1018B.json#43#content.zh: 你终于肯用那个名字叫我了。我可是等得连钟都快看腻了。
StoryData/S1018B.json#43#content.en: So you've finally decided to call me by that name. I was starting to get tired of waiting around the clock.

StoryData/S1018B.json#45#content.en: Yeah... I see the resemblance now...

StoryData/S1018B.json#48#content.zh: 汝与克罗默血脉相连。那么，莫非……
StoryData/S1018B.json#48#content.en: Thou art of the same blood as Kromer. Then, mayhaps...

StoryData/S1018B.json#49#content.zh: 一股凛冽的寒意悄然渗入堂吉诃德的目光。
StoryData/S1018B.json#49#content.en: A sharp chill quietly slipped into Don Quixote's gaze.

StoryData/S1018B.json#50#content.zh: 哦，我当然是她姐姐。等等，你该不会以为我是妹妹吧。
StoryData/S1018B.json#50#content.en: Oh, I'm her big sister, obviously. Wait, don't tell me you thought I was the little sister.

StoryData/S1018B.json#52#content.zh: 那个贱人……她杀了我的家人。爸爸……妈妈……姐姐……她夺走了我的一切！
StoryData/S1018B.json#52#content.en: That bitch... she killed my family. Dad... Mom... My sister... She took everyone from me!

StoryData/S1018B.json#53#content.zh: 嗯，这确实像是她会干的事。她有个很糟糕的小习惯：只要是她喜欢的人或东西，不管对方受不受得了，她都要欺负一番。
StoryData/S1018B.json#53#content.en: Yeah, that sounds like her all right. Nasty little habit of hers. She'd pick on anyone and anything she was fond of, whether or not they could take it.

StoryData/S1018B.json#54#content.zh: 不准你把这说得无关痛痒——

StoryData/S1018B.json#55#content.zh: 哎呀，好啦，好啦。反正我也受够这场荒唐的对话了。说正事——你们知道该怎么做，对吧？加入我，诸如此类，然后让我们一起解构西西弗百货，等等等等。
StoryData/S1018B.json#55#content.en: Gosh, fine, fine. I'm done with this ridiculous conversation anyway. Moving on—you know the deal, right? Join me, so on and so forth, together we shall deconstruct the Grand Magasin, yadi yada.

StoryData/S1018B.json#57#content.zh: 虽然我早就料到你会拒绝，但这还是让我太伤心了。不过不用担心我。你们已经在以自己根本想象不到的方式帮助我了！
StoryData/S1018B.json#57#content.en: Not that I didn't see that coming from a mile away, but I'm so heartbroken by that rejection. But don't you worry about me. You're already helping me in ways you can't even imagine!

StoryData/S1018B.json#58#content.zh: 伟大的事物即将在西西弗再度启程，我的异乡人们，杀害我亲爱妹妹的凶手们。伟大、壮观而辉煌。你们可以好好期待。
StoryData/S1018B.json#58#content.en: Great things are beginning once again in Sisyphe, strangers mine and murderers of my sister dear. Great, spectacular, and magnificent. You may look forward to it.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: <摸着很像我们之前见到的那个……黄金松脂。>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: <It feels a lot like that... Golden Resin thing we saw earlier.>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 咦。那说不定这个人台也是被金枝灌了劲儿？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: Huh. Then maybe this Mannequin got juiced up by the Golden Bough too?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: <不好说……但我觉得是。默尔索，先把那个拿着吧？>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: <Can't say for sure... but I think so. Meursault, could you grab that for now?>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 本以为这只是一堆废料……看来里头还有别的东西？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: Thought this was just a pile of waste... Looks like there's something more to it?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 默尔索在布布指的地方挖了起来。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: Meursault dug through the spot Pwie indicated.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 我们在尸体中间找到了一块黄金皮革。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: We found a piece of Golden Hide among the corpses.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 从我们撕下黄金皮革的地方，掉出一样浸满血、缠着筋腱的东西。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: Something drenched in blood and tangled in sinews falls from the area we tore off the Golden Hide from.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: <默尔索，能看看刚掉下来的是什么吗？>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: <Meursault, can you check what just fell?>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: ……似乎是一本笔记本，或者类似的记事本。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: ... It appears to be a notebook, or a notepad of sorts.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 喂……说不定是日记？我们偷偷瞄一眼怎么样？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: Hey... maybe it's a diary? Why don't we take a little peek?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 我说不好，偷看别人的日记感觉有点……不地道。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: I don't know, it feels a bit... icky peering into someone's diary.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 血正慢慢浸透那本笔记和里面的内容……我们该怎么办？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: Blood is slowly starting to soak the notebook and its contents... What should we do?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 这一带尚有未了之事，经理。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: There is still unfinished business left in this area, Manager.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 里面透出一道熟悉的蓝光。眼下应当优先搜索周边区域。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: A familiar blue light leaks out from within. For now, searching the surrounding area should take priority.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 我们应该先回洗手间重整。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: We should return to the restroom and regroup first.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 我们尚未达到前往下一层所需的评级。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: We have not yet attained the rank required to proceed to the next floor.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 自动扶梯现在似乎可以运行了，经理。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: The escalator now appears operational, Manager.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 不过在动身之前，仍有事项需要了结。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: However, there are still matters to conclude before our departure.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: <好吧，我们以防万一回来了一趟，可是……>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: <Well, we returned here just in case, but...>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 执行经理。您能看到默尔索当前所处的环境吗？我记得您为了援护队内较为欠缺的成员，觉醒过一项极为便利的能力。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: Executive Manager. Are you able to see Meursault's present surroundings? I recall you awakened a highly convenient ability in an effort to assist the more lacking members of our team.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 可否请您使用那项能力，告诉我们您看见了什么？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: Would you use that ability and tell us what you see?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 是啊，经理老兄。说说你看到了什么。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: Yeah, Manager Bud. Tell us what you see.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: <我看到铺着地毯的地面，还有一排排展示的衣服。默尔索一动不动地站着。>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: <I see a carpeted floor, and rows of clothes on display. Meursault's standing absolutely still.>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: <他没被绑住，旁边有个看着像店员的人。>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: <He's not tied up, and there's someone who looks like a store clerk beside him.>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 啧。行刑之后没过多久，他就让自己被人扣下了。这般无能可不像他——而且还是在好几个方面。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: Tch. Not much time has passed since the execution, and he already allows himself to be taken captive. An uncharacteristic display of incompetence coming from him—and on multiple fronts.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 唔……地毯，还有展示的衣服……好歹比我们之前手上的线索多了点。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: Huh... Carpet, and clothes on display... Well, it's more than we had to go on before, at least.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 幸好，默尔索还在上次那个位置。那就没什么好耽搁的了……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: Thankfully, Meursault is at the same spot he was last time. Well, no reason to dally...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 据默尔索说，这个物件被赋予了“禁止通行”的象征功能。所以我们过不去。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: According to Meursault, this object has been assigned the symbolic function of denying passage. So, we can't cross it.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: <这不是屏障。只是两根杆子中间连了根绳子，也就是说我能跳过去。跳过去是安全的。反正我们本来就不受这些规则约束……>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: not a barrier. It's just two rods connected with a rope, which means I can leap over this. It's safe to leap over this. We are not bound by these rules anyway...>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 您是想跨过那道绳栏的时候绊倒了吗？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: Did you trip trying to jump over that rope barrier?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: <我、我以为只要把它定义成别的东西，就能跳过去……>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: <I-I thought I could leap over it if I defined it as something else...>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: ……表层的自我欺骗无法真正重新定义一个象征要素，经理。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: ... Surface level self-deception cannot truly redefine a symbolic element, Manager.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 象征是被牢牢钉进意识最深处的东西。若想重新定义象征，就必须投入可观的时间……或者天生具备那样的“资质”。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: Symbols are things nailed solidly into the deepest parts of consciousness. One must commit to a significant time investment should they wish to redefine the symbol... or be born with the "aptitude" to do so.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: <唔……好吧，那你呢？不能像在自动扶梯那间屋里那样再来一次吗？>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: <Ugh... Okay, then what about you? Can't you do what you did back at the escalator room?>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 那是因当时情形特殊才得以成立——我与一名巨人同时注视着同一个象征。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: That was made possible due to the particulars of that situation, in which I and a Giant were both gazing at the same symbol.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 你们俩嘀咕什么呢，聊得这么起劲？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: What are ya two having so much fun gossipin' about?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: <啊，就是在商量怎么绕过这玩意儿。结果是没辙——我们绕路走吧。>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: <Ah, just discussing ways to get around this thing. Turns out there isn't—let's just take the roundabout route.>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 一个陈列架，上面摆满了辨认不出是什么的物件。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: A display shelf full of unidentifiable objects.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 只是一把椅子。可以在这儿喘口气，不过没什么理由这么做。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: Just a chair. We could take a quick breather here, but there's no reason to do that.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 细如针的骨头像刺一样，从松垂的血肉褶皱间支棱出来。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: Needle-thin bones jut like thorns from folds of sagging flesh.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 一张被什么东西缝过的皮，像没洗过的抹布一样黏在地板上。它的嘴唇、眼睛和牙齿都已失去各自的特征，乳化成滑腻的一团。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: A hide of skin stitched with something lies stuck to the floor like an unwashed rag. Its lips, eyes, and teeth have all lost their distinguishing features and emulsified into one slick mass.

StoryData/S1019B.json#2#content.zh: ——教过我，开始交谈时露脸是最基本的礼貌？其实有人教过，只不过我并不和你们待在一起，没法当面问候。
StoryData/S1019B.json#2#content.en: —taught me that showing my face is the barest courtesy when initiating conversation? I was taught, actually, but I'm not in there with you to give you an in-person greeting.

StoryData/S1019B.json#3#content.zh: <color=#a5ab8e>我不是西西弗百货的顾客。我属于所谓的“巨人”——支撑西西弗屹立不倒的支柱。</color>
StoryData/S1019B.json#3#content.en: <color=#a5ab8e>I'm not a customer here at the Grand Magasin. I'm one of what is called the "Giants"—the pillars that keep Sisyphe standing.</color>

StoryData/S1019B.json#4#content.zh: 你说“巨人”……嗯，那是什么？一个——
StoryData/S1019B.json#4#content.en: A "Giant," you say... Hm, what's that? A—

StoryData/S1019B.json#5#content.zh: <color=#a5ab8e>——派系？不算是吧。西西弗百货的日常运营完全依赖我们巨人的管理。我们甚至都不能想什么时候休带薪假就什么时候休。</color>
StoryData/S1019B.json#5#content.en: <color=#a5ab8e>—faction? Not really. The daily operations of the Grand Magasin rely entirely on us Giants' management. We don't even get to take PTO when we want to.</color>

StoryData/S1019B.json#6#content.zh: <color=#a5ab8e>对了，你们在西西弗百货里前进时，可能会听到有些顾客向没有实体的“声音”呼喊。通常说话的就是我们这些“巨人”。当然，也可能有例外。</color>
StoryData/S1019B.json#6#content.en: <color=#a5ab8e>Oh yeah, you might hear some of its customers calling out to disembodied "Voices" as you make your way through the Grand Magasin. That'd usually be us speaking, the "Giants." Though there might be some exceptions.</color>

StoryData/S1019B.json#9#content.zh: <color=#a5ab8e>*轻笑* 当然没有。只是你的问题太好猜了，我实在忍不住抢答而已。</color>
StoryData/S1019B.json#9#content.en: <color=#a5ab8e>*chuckle* Of course not. The questions were just so predictable that I couldn't help myself, that's all.</color>

StoryData/S1019B.json#11#content.zh: 辛克莱小心翼翼地插进了两人的对话。
StoryData/S1019B.json#11#content.en: Sinclair gingerly sidled into the conversation.

StoryData/S1019B.json#12#content.zh: 如果你们曾经是恋爱关系……那是不是说……
StoryData/S1019B.json#12#content.en: If you two were in a romantic relationship... once, does that mean...

StoryData/S1019B.json#13#content.zh: 他说的就是字面意思——我们的关系燃烧着彼此的渴望，只有立刻满足才能将其浇灭……而我们从不浪费哪怕一分一秒，总会让两人之间的气氛变得火热。直到某一天，默尔索连句像样的告别都没有，就这样永远离开了N公司。
StoryData/S1019B.json#13#content.en: He meant it quite literally—our relationship burned with mutual yearning, the kind doused only by immediate gratification... And we never squandered so much as a single moment to get things steamy between the two of us. Until Meursault one day up and left N Corp. forever without so much as a proper goodbye.

StoryData/S1019B.json#16#content.zh: <color=#a5ab8e>既然我们已经经历过一轮清仓，我再问一次。你是因为想我才回来的吗？</color>
StoryData/S1019B.json#16#content.en: <color=#a5ab8e>Lemme ask again, now that we've gone through a round of Liquidation. Did you return because you missed me?</color>

StoryData/S1019B.json#17#content.zh: 出于对旧情人应有的基本礼节……
StoryData/S1019B.json#17#content.en: As it is basic courtesy one extends to an old flame...

StoryData/S1019B.json#19#content.en: <color=#a5ab8e>Hehe, fine. That's good enough for me.</color>

StoryData/S1019B.json#20#content.zh: 我不知道你们两个在玩什么把戏，但是……
StoryData/S1019B.json#20#content.en: I don't know what game you two are playing, but...

StoryData/S1019B.json#21#content.zh: 如果你是巨人，而巨人又相当于这座“百货商场”的管理者，那么你是否有权限放我们离开这里？
StoryData/S1019B.json#21#content.en: If you're a Giant, and if the Giants are akin to overseers of this "department store," is it within your authority to release us from here?

StoryData/S1019B.json#22#content.zh: ……她做不到。即使她有能力，也不会那么做。
StoryData/S1019B.json#22#content.en: ... She cannot. She will not, even if it were within her ability to do so.

StoryData/S1019B.json#24#content.zh: 奥提斯斜眼瞪着默尔索。

StoryData/S1019B.json#25#content.zh: <color=#a5ab8e>你的这位新同事——她一直都是这样吗？疑心真重。</color>
StoryData/S1019B.json#25#content.en: <color=#a5ab8e>So this new coworker of yours—she's always like this, huh? So untrusting.</color>

StoryData/S1019B.json#27#content.zh: <color=#a5ab8e>我是西西弗百货的巨人——保护并维护西西弗百货就是我的工作。我可以讲些这里的故事陪你们解闷，不过……</color>
StoryData/S1019B.json#27#content.en: <color=#a5ab8e>I am a Giant of the Grand Magasin—protecting and maintaining the Grand Magasin is my job. I can keep you company with stories about this place, but...</color>

StoryData/S1019B.json#28#content.zh: <color=#a5ab8e>……我可没法像抓娃娃一样，单独把你们13个人夹出去。</color>
StoryData/S1019B.json#28#content.en: <color=#a5ab8e>... I can't pick out just the 13 of you like it's a crane game.</color>

StoryData/S1019B.json#29#content.zh: 还是得遵守规则与条件，是吗？那么你能提供的不过是全能的假象。平平无奇。
StoryData/S1019B.json#29#content.en: Still have to follow the rules and conditions, hm? Then you have nothing to offer us but the illusion of omnipotence. Unremarkable.

StoryData/S1019B.json#30#content.zh: <……她不可能一直盯着我们。毕竟她还得管理这座百货商场。>
StoryData/S1019B.json#30#content.en: <... She won't always have her eyes on us. She still has a department store to manage, after all.>

StoryData/S1019B.json#31#content.zh: 我开始看清了，执行经理。每位“巨人”想必还各自负责监管这里的某个方面。
StoryData/S1019B.json#31#content.en: I'm starting to get a clearer picture, Executive Manager. Each "Giant" must also be responsible for overseeing an aspect of this place.

StoryData/S1019B.json#32#content.zh: <color=#a5ab8e>哦？看来她不只是个妄想狂……噗，你的朋友们还真是各有特色啊？</color>
StoryData/S1019B.json#32#content.en: <color=#a5ab8e>Oh? Looks like she's more than just a paranoiac... Pfft, your friends each have something special about them, huh?</color>

StoryData/S1019B.json#34#content.zh: 那个……我能问您一个问题吗，让娜小姐？您为什么让我们听见您的声音？只是因为见到默尔索很高兴吗……？
StoryData/S1019B.json#34#content.en: Um... May I ask you a question, Miss Jeanne? Why did you let us hear your Voice? Was it just because you were happy to see Meursault...?

StoryData/S1019B.json#35#content.zh: <color=#a5ab8e>工作时，我通常……都是孤身一人。</color>
StoryData/S1019B.json#35#content.en: <color=#a5ab8e>At work, I'm usually... all by myself.</color>

StoryData/S1019B.json#36#content.zh: <color=#a5ab8e>我坐在那间不大不小、尺寸适中的房间一角……凝望着西西弗百货令人难以承受的无边广阔，仿佛这是世上再正常不过的事。</color>
StoryData/S1019B.json#36#content.en: <color=#a5ab8e>I sit in one corner of this moderately-sized room that isn't too big or too small... staring into the unbearable vastness of the Grand Magasin like it's the most normal thing in the world to do.</color>

StoryData/S1019B.json#39#content.zh: <color=#a5ab8e>……有时候，我只是想找个人谈谈这种感受。</color>
StoryData/S1019B.json#39#content.en: <color=#a5ab8e>... Sometimes I just want to talk about this feeling with someone.</color>

StoryData/S1019B.json#41#content.zh: <color=#a5ab8e>该互道再见了。我知道你们很想见我，但现在还是稍微克制一下吧。</color>
StoryData/S1019B.json#41#content.en: <color=#a5ab8e>Time to bid each other adieu. I know you're dying to see me, but try to exercise some restraint for now.</color>

StoryData/S1019B.json#45#content.zh: 我已经习惯应付你这种人了。
StoryData/S1019B.json#45#content.en: I'm used to dealing with the likes of you.

StoryData/S1019B.json#46#content.zh: <color=#a5ab8e>喂，别这么认真嘛。我工作时可没多少机会这样玩闹。</color>
StoryData/S1019B.json#46#content.en: <color=#a5ab8e>Hey, don't take it too seriously. It's not often that I get to fool around like this at work.</color>

StoryData/S1019B.json#48#content.en: ... It doesn't feel all that real.

StoryData/S1019B.json#50#content.zh: 偏偏是默尔索，竟然曾经和某个人谈过恋爱。
StoryData/S1019B.json#50#content.en: That Meursault of all people used to be romantically involved with someone.

StoryData/S1019B.json#51#content.zh: 我们的关系包含了与通常意义上的“恋人”并无不同的要素。
StoryData/S1019B.json#51#content.en: Our relationship entailed elements that are no different from what is conventionally expected from "romantic partners."

StoryData/S1019B.json#52#content.zh: 我们约过会，也一起共度过时光。
StoryData/S1019B.json#52#content.en: We went on dates and spent time together.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 寻常衣物之间，挂着几件怪诞的单品。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: Among the ordinary clothes hang grotesque pieces.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 其中有些衬衫和裤子，我在地下楼层见过。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: I recognize some of those shirts and pants from the basement floors.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: <嗯。我想是。哦对了——在这儿好像只有默尔索能动手，所以你可以把锤子放下了。>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: <Yeah. I think. Oh, also—only Meursault seems to be able to fight in here, so you can put your mace down.>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 构成西西弗百货的诸世界之中，有“象征界”与“阴影”。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: Of the worlds that comprise the Grand Magasin Sisyphe are "the Symbolic" and "the Shadow."

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 在象征界中，只有我被允许与其中的物件及存在直接交互。他人只要靠近我，或可获得略微扩展的操作余地，但仍不足以与这些敌人交战。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: Only I am permitted to directly interact with items and entities within the Symbolic. Though one may be able to exert a marginally extended level of control as long as they are in my close proximity, it will not be sufficient enough to engage these enemies in battle.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 你是说……在这儿发生的战斗，我们都插不上手？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: Are ya sayin'... we can't participate in any battles that take place in here?
It is possible in the Shadowed.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 好~吧！这话对我来说基本等于没说，那就谢谢你啦……？看来只能走一步看一步了。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: O~kay! That kinda doesn't mean anything to me, so thanks for nothing...? Guess we'll have to find out as we go.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: *叹气* 就这么办吧。坐在这儿对这地方每一件荒唐小事刨根问底，我们哪儿也去不了。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: *sigh* Let's do that. Sitting here and questioning every little nonsensical thing we find in this place won't get us anywhere.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: ……奇怪。默尔索还是那个默尔索，可在这种局面下这么沉着冷静，可不像但丁……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: ... Weird. Meursault's just being Meursault, but it's not like Dante to be so calm and collected in a situation like this...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 就像刚才，您毫无凭据却那么笃定地说，没有默尔索这些人就察觉不到我们……啊，算了。这事以后再谈也来得及。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: Like earlier, when you so confidently stated without proof that these people won't be able to perceive us without Meursault... Ah, well. We'll have time to talk about this later.
No way... The trend changed again?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 现在流行什么？我没听到广播。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: What's in fashion now? I didn't hear the announcement.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 更要紧的是，你们怎么能穿着那么难看的衣服到处走？一点都不觉得羞耻吗？那绝不可能是当下的潮流！
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: More importantly, how can you be walking around in hideous clothes like those? Aren't you even ashamed of yourselves? That couldn't possibly be the current trend!

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 条纹总有一天会回来的！时尚永远会轮回！
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: Stripes will return one day! Fashion always comes back around!

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 咳嗬……你们穿着那么恶心的破布……却说我过时……？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: Kergh... You dress in such repulsive rags... yet you call me outdated...?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 下一次……我一定能行。一定会是我……走上T台……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: Next time... I'll make it. I'll be the one... to make it to the runway...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: “遮盖力永不褪色！感受刚蜕下的皮肤那清新的淋巴！瞬间售罄！”
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: "Coverage That Never Fades! Feel the Refreshing Lymph of Freshly Shed Skin! Instant Sellout!"

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: ……看来还是没必要细看商品本身。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: ... Still seems unnecessary to inspect the product itself.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 要是不打算借我东西，就别跟我搭话……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: Don't bother talking to me you're not going to lend me anything...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 我大概明白这件装置想表现什么了。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: I think I understand what this installation was trying to depict.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 一只手提包，或者一双手套……用顾客做的。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: A handbag, or a pair of gloves... Made from customers.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 做工平庸的装置。看起来它自己都没想好是要当手提包，还是当一双手套。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: An installation of mediocre craftsmanship. Doesn't look like it knows whether it wants to be a handbag or a pair of gloves.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 那件衣物低垂的褶皱微微颤动。这景象算不上诱人。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: The garment's drooping folds quiver faintly. It's not a very enticing sight.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: <……默尔索，能让那些东西把脸转开吗？>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: <... Meursault, can you get those things to look away?>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 默尔索一拳打在人台脸上，把它的头拧向墙壁。对其余几个，他又重复了同样的动作。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: Meursault punched the Mannequin in the face, rotating its head toward the wall. He repeated that process several more times against the other ones.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 我们突然拿路过的人台撒气，是因为……？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: And we're suddenly letting off steam against random Mannequins because...?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 这具尸体和我们见过的那些没什么两样。沾满血的眼球——显然是从坠落的尸体上捡来的——散落在它周围。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: This corpse is not so different from the others we've seen. Blood-slick eyeballs—apparently scavenged from the bodies that fell—lie scattered around it.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 这具尸体和我们见过的那些没什么两样。沾满血的眼球——不知从哪儿捡来的——散落在它周围。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: This corpse is not so different from the others we've seen. Blood-slick eyeballs—scavenged from somewhere—lie scattered around it.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 摊开的杂志上有一篇关于皮肤烫卷的文章，据说这是只有一楼才提供的特别项目。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: The open magazine contains an article about dermal perms, a special procedure apparently offered only on the first floor.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 杜布瓦倒在那里，已经死了。
您的指示已执行完毕，经理。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: Your instruction has been carried out, Manager.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: ……说实话。杀掉一个一直对我们很友善的人，我心里不舒服。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: ... I'll be honest. Killing someone who's been nothing but nice to us doesn't sit right with me.
... We need money if we're going upstairs.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 这算是一条来钱的路……除非我们打算蹲在这儿卖衣服——或者像外面那些人一样，整天在尸体堆里翻找。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: This was one way to get it... Unless we plan on squatting here selling clothes—or spending the whole day rummaging through corpses like the people outside.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 我并不是想为这个决定责怪但丁。他吩咐默尔索那么做，心里一定有他的打算。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: Well, I'm not trying to guilt Dante for making that decision. They must've had something in mind when they ordered Meursault to do that.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 一件被塑成鸟形的衣装。也可能是一位被收进仓库的顾客。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: An attire fashioned into the shape of a bird. Could also be a customer who's been put in storage.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 牌子上写着“当下流行”，可我一个戴这顶帽子的顾客都没见过。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: The placard reads "TRENDING NOW," but I haven't come across a single customer wearing this hat.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 黑色的衣物悬在聚光灯下。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: Black garments hang beneath the spotlights.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 人台伫立在展台上。它们的头被拧向墙壁，再也看不到我们了。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: Mannequins stand on display. With their heads rotated to face the wall, they can't look at us anymore.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 一张百货的楼层指引图。大半已被损毁遮掩，但这家百货显然不止四层。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: A department-store directory. Damage has obscured much of it, but this department store definitely goes higher than the fourth floor.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: ……喂，这张图是怎么回事？我看着有点怪……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: ... Hey, what's up with this map? Looks a bit weird to me...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-ui-common-a1c10p1.json.zh:
你尚未购买本楼层所有可购买的物品。
仍要前往其他楼层吗？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-ui-common-a1c10p1.json.en:
You haven't yet purchased all available items from this floor.
Move on to a different floor anyway?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-ui-common-a1c10p1.json.zh: 虚拟摇杆维持疾跑半径

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: <既然我们所处的空间与其说是实体，不如说是精神的构造物，那它的实际大小比外观大上许多倍，我也不会意外。>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: <Since the space we're inhabiting is more of a mental construct than a physical one, I wouldn't be surprised if its size is many times greater than its appearance might suggest.>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 有道理，毕竟这地方据说要装下……三亿人呢。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: Makes sense, this place is supposed to hold... 300 million people, after all.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 哦，上面有写金枝在哪一层吗？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: Oh, does it say which floor has the Golden Bough?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 谁会把那种东西写在指引图上——唔。在这儿倒也不是不可能，让我仔细看看。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: Why would anyone put that in the direc—Hm. I suppose that's not so implausible in here, lemme take a closer look.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 一张百货的楼层指引图。楼层一直往上超过4F……而我们要去的就是那里。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: A department-store directory. The floors go higher than 4F... and that's where we must go.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 优雅的花体字写着：“红派本季最大胆的前卫系列！若它的讯息无法打动你，说明你还配不上它的华美！”
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: In elegant script: "The season's boldest avant-garde collection from Le Rouge! If its message fails to move you, you're not ready for its magnificence!"

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 展台上摆着一件无法辨识的物品，红布与血肉纠缠在一起，再也分不开。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: An unidentified object sits on display, red cloth and flesh snarled together beyond distinction.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 一具倒立的人台，双脚直指天花板。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: An upside-down Mannequin juts its feet toward the ceiling.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 一具倒立的人台，上半身、下半身、头与双脚同时展示出来。整套服装的确恰好完整地映入视野。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: An upside-down Mannequin that displays its upper body, lower body, head, and feet all at once. The entire outfit does fit neatly into view.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 一面用黄金皮革补过的墙。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: A wall patched over with Golden Hide.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 气息很微弱，但它身上有种像是金枝的感觉。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: The presence is faint, but something about it feels like the Golden Bough.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 一阵柔和温暖的笑声，从贴在墙上的指尖拂过。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: A soft and warm peal of laughter brushes past the fingertips laid against the wall.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 一道令人联想到金枝的淡光，在它表面之下闪烁。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: A pale light, reminiscent of the Golden Bough, glimmers beneath its surface.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: <……我想到会疼……但没想到它会把你整个吞下去。>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: <... I figured it would hurt... but I didn't expect it to swallow you whole.>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: *叹气* 好吧，这算是学了一课。它一颤抖，就当是它在蓄力冲撞的警告。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: *sigh* Well, that's a lesson learned. When it trembles, take it as a warning that it's winding up to charge.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 那东西是真能窜啊？从房间另一头一路冲过来……这到底要怎么躲啊……？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: That thing can really zoom, huh? Like, all the way from the other end of the room... How the heck are you supposed to dodge that...?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 因潮流季更替而过时的衣物。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: Clothes that have fallen out of fashion due to the passing of the trend seasons.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 它们被塞在这么偏僻的角落。简直像是有人想把它们藏——你、你在干什么？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: They're tucked away in such an out-of-the-way corner. It almost seems like someone was trying to h— Wh-what are you doing?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 翻查这堆东西里都有什么。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: Rummaging through the pile for its contents.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: <……除了眼球，还有什么值得注意的吗？>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: <... Are there anything of note other than eyeballs?>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 几片写了字的皮革碎片。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: Few scraps of leather with something written on them.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: ……“荧光格纹的潮流时代很快就会到来，我知道的。”
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: ... "The era of fluorescent plaid trend will be upon us soon, I know it."

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: “等那一天来了，我就带着这些衣服登上T台，然后——”
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: "When that time comes, I'll take these clothes and rise to the runway, and—"
... I think that's enough, Meur. Let's move on.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 我们，呃……把那些放回堆里吧。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: Let's, uh... put those back into the pile.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 墙上的裂缝里藏着什么东西。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: Something is concealed within a fissure in the wall.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 默尔索捡起了过时的红派衣物。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: Meursault picked up the Out-of-style Rouge Clothing.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 各种气味开始混成一团。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: All the scents are starting to blend together.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 香水区的空气里飘着一股熟悉的香气。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: A familiar fragrance hangs in the air of the perfume section.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 这气味有种说不出的古怪。……越闻越像是一股恶臭。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: There's something strange and peculiar about the smell. ... It's starting to register more as a stench.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 空气中萦绕着一股苦甜交织的香气。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: A bittersweet fragrance lingers in the air.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 这里的货品和一路上陈列的那些不一样。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: The merchandise here is different from what was on the displays along the way.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 褐派偏爱的衣装堆在这里。多半是有人藏在这儿的。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: Outfits favored by the Kakis are piled up here. Someone probably stashed them here.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 衣服胡乱地堆在角落里。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: Clothes have been heaped haphazardly in the corner.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 货架上塞满了用皮肤与血肉织成的衣服。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: The shelves are packed with clothes woven from skin and flesh.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 牌子上写着“清仓大甩卖”。看起来没一件值得花眼球去买。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: The sign reads, "BLOWOUT SALE". None of it seems worth spending eyeballs on.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 上面写着[折纸系列 ° 92，五件之一]。
一件形似缠绕交错的肢体的展品。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: An exhibit shaped like a tangle of intertwined limbs.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 一具红派的尸体。她的头软软地垂向前方，血从脸上的窟窿里涌出。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: The corpse of a Rouge. Blood pours from the holes in the face as her head hangs limply forward.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 那边……说不定那边能捡到的更多……？该死，我占错地方了！
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: That way... Maybe there's more to gather over there...? Dammit, I took the wrong spot!
This spot is mine. Fuck off!

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 哇，你脾气还挺冲的嘛。好啦好啦~我们退开~
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: Whoa, you're a prickly one, aren'tcha. Fine, fine~ we'll back off~

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 喂！把脚抬起来。你刚才是不是踩到一颗眼球了？！
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: Hey! Lift your foot. Didn't you just step on an eyeball?!
... Uh, are you talking to me?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 是我看错了吗……？算了。那就别在这儿鬼鬼祟祟的！你害我分心！
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: Did I see that wrong...? Whatever. Stop skulking around, then! You're throwing me off!

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: ……喂，搞错了不是该道个歉吗？*叹气* 算了，当我没说。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: ... Hey, don't you think you should apologize if you got the wrong idea? *sigh* Actually, never mind.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 他们似乎忙着收集眼球。
你们该送去出口的是人台，不是我！
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: You're supposed to show the Mannequins to the exit, not me!

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-narration-common-warde.en: Not of the same caliber... won't reach...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 哎哟……！那是不小心的，对吧？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: Oww...! That was an accident, right?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 我是不是哪里得罪你们了？拜托，我道歉。别伤我！
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: Did I offend you or something? Please, I'm sorry. Don't hurt me!

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 你们是来杀我、从我血肉里刮走黄金松脂的吗？！
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: Are you here to kill me and scrape the Golden Resin from my flesh?!

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 有什么问题吗？是我的品牌不合您的心意？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: What is the issue? Do you not find my label to your liking?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 用血染衣服？这种时尚追求未免太过时了吧？真俗气。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: Dyeing clothing with blood? That's a rather outmoded fashion to pursue, isn't it? How tacky.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 它的金光已彻底黯淡。剩下的只是一堆正缓缓向内塌陷的尸体。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: Its golden light has completely faded. What remains is a pile of bodies slowly caving in on itself.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 大部分书页浸满了血，很难辨认写了什么。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: Most pages are soaked in blood and difficult to tell what it says.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 我将念出仍可辨读的部分。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: I will read out loud what is legible.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: “该死——你他妈——婊——搞得好像站上——台是什么了不得的大事……”
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: "Godda— —otherfu— —tch—like it's some great undertaking to —ing on the —unway..."

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: “狂妄的小——新——，才刚爬上来就给我认清自己的位——”
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: "Cockly little— —eenhorn, know your place if you've just climbed up he—"

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 默尔索翻过了几页浸血太多、无法辨读的纸。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: Meursault flipped past a few pages that have soaked up far too much blood to be legible.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: “可憎的——小杂种。我就知道。我早知道像他们那样的——不可能靠自己走到这——步。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: "Abhorre— —tle shit. I knew it. I knew a— —like them couldn't have made it thi— —ar on their own.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: “——可悲的水蛭，跟红——勾结，把整座百——的——全都吸干。”
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: "—thetic leech, working with Le— to— suck up all the— —of the— —artment store."

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: “我要当着所有——的面，让他们丢尽——脸。”
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: "I'm goi— to embarrass the— —hit out of them in— —of everyone."

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: <……这家百货不管爬到多高，每一层都是这副样子啊。>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: <... This department store's like this through all the floors no matter how high you climb, huh?>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 这里本来写着什么，现在已经没了。这本日记浸的血太多。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: There was something written in here, but it's gone now. The journal has soaked up too much blood.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: <……可恶，我们分神的时候被它得手了。>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: <... Damn, it got us while we were distracted.>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 不过它挺慢的。而且也没多强。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: It was pretty slow, though. And not even that strong.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 试试吧。只要不大意，我觉得默尔索对付它不难。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: Let's try. I don't think Meursault'll have a hard time fighting it unless he lets his guard down.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: <它的出招我明明已经知道了……>
<……抱歉。我的指示慢了。你没事吧，默尔索？>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: <... Sorry. My instructions were late. Are you okay, Meursault?>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: *叹气* 好吧，这算是学了一课。它一颤抖，就当是它在蓄力冲撞的警告。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: *sigh* Well, that's a lesson learned. When it trembles, take it as a warning that it's winding up to charge.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 那东西是真能窜啊？从另一头一路冲过来……这到底要怎么躲啊……？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: That thing can really zoom, huh? Like, all the way from the other end... How the heck are you supposed to dodge that...?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: <听到声音，就朝声源的垂直方向往左或往右挪。>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: <When you hear the sound, just move left or right perpendicular to its origin.>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: <这样躲开应该不难。要不然也可以趁它动起来之前直接宰了它。>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: <Shouldn't be too hard to avoid them, then. Or we could also just kill it before it has a chance to move.>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 皮肤烫卷用的加热灯。它多半能让使用者把皱纹折成自认美观的形状，或是让皮肤的纹理更为细致。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: Heat lamp for dermal perm. It likely allows for its users to fold wrinkles into shapes they deem aesthetic, or allow them to refine the grains of their skin.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 啊哈……可是为什么？为了什么……？
默尔索讲解的时候，加热灯下压着的一本说明手册引起了我的注意。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: As Meursault explained, an information pamphlet tucked under the heat lamp caught my eye.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 我刚把它拿起来，以实玛利就已经站到了我面前，手伸出来，像是在等着接什么东西。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: The instant I picked it up, Ishmael was in front of me with her hand jut out like she was waiting to receive something.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: <呃……要吧……？不过……你先看也行，我不介意。>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: <Uh... Yeah...? But... You can read it first, I don't mind.>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 我投降了——我是说，我把手册递给了以实玛利。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: I surrendered—I mean, I handed the pamphlet over to Ishmael.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 唔，我看看……在接受皮肤烫卷的过程中，客人的形态会变成“护理中顾客”，与他人无从分辨……啊哈！所以他们才都戴着那种防毒面具……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: Hmm, let's see... While undergoing the dermal perm procedure, the client's form assumes that of a "procedure customer," and becomes indistinguishable from others... Aha! So that's why they're all wearing those gas masks...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.zh: 这是她进来之后最放松的一次了。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-1-b.jso.en: This is the most at ease she's been ever since we entered here.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-common-a1c10p.zh: 他们站在入口旁边，远离其他人，怎么也不肯挪动。大概只是因为洗手间里太拥挤而感到不安。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-common-a1c10p.en: They are standing by the entrance and refusing to budge, away from everyone else. Probably just anxious because of how crowded the restroom is.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-common-a1c10p.zh: 布布
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-common-a1c10p.en: Pwie

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-common-a1c10p.zh: 我们……现在出去吗？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-common-a1c10p.en: Do we... head out now?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-common-a1c10p.zh: 也许我的前世真的是一棵树。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-common-a1c10p.en: Maybe I really was a tree in a past life.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-common-a1c10p.zh: 当我遇见以树木形态呈现的心灵图示与结构时……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-common-a1c10p.en: When I encountered the diagram and structure of the mind in arboreal form...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-common-a1c10p.zh: ……我被它吸引，并断定那便是灵魂的图景。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-common-a1c10p.en: ... I felt drawn toward it and concluded it to be the rendering of the soul.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-common-a1c10p.zh: 但我不禁好奇……灵魂真的呈树木的形态吗？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-common-a1c10p.en: But I wonder... does the soul really take the shape of a tree?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-common-a1c10p.zh: 或许树木只是一种表现方式。心灵可能过于不稳定，根本不存在固定的结构。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-common-a1c10p.en: Perhaps a tree is merely one way of representing it. The mind may be too unstable to possess a fixed structure at all.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-common-a1c10p.zh: 然而，我目睹都市各翼塑造出的人类形态，一次又一次地汇聚成树的结构。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-common-a1c10p.en: Yet, the human forms I saw the Wings shape throughout the City converge again and again upon the structure of a tree.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-common-a1c10p.zh: 仅N公司的西西弗系统蓝图便足以说明这一点，不是吗？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-common-a1c10p.en: The blueprint for N Corp.'s Sisyphe System alone suggests as much, does it not?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-common-a1c10p.zh: 曾经，有个孩子自星辰而降，化作雨水洒落。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-common-a1c10p.en: Once, a child descended from a star and rained down as water.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-common-a1c10p.zh: 赋予心灵物质形态的水。脑啡肽。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-common-a1c10p.en: Water that gives the mind material form. Cogito.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-common-a1c10p.zh: 使用脑啡肽进行的实验令我确信：
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-common-a1c10p.en: The experiments conducted using Cogito gave me the certainty:

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-common-a1c10p.zh: 树结有十枚果实。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-common-a1c10p.en: The tree bears ten fruits.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-common-a1c10p.zh: 树分为三个领域。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-common-a1c10p.en: The tree is divided into three domains.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-common-a1c10p.zh: 而攀登这棵树的顺序亦有其意义。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-common-a1c10p.en: And the order in which the tree is ascended carries significance.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-common-a1c10p.zh: 即便心灵并不呈树木的形态，
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-common-a1c10p.en: Even if the mind does not take the form of a tree,

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-common-a1c10p.zh: 若能将心灵固定为树状模型并借此加以解读，这种方法便值得一试。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-common-a1c10p.en: this method is worth attempting if the mind can be fixed into an arboreal model and interpreted through it.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-common-a1c10p.zh: 语言不也是如此吗？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-common-a1c10p.en: Is language not the same?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-common-a1c10p.zh: 我们将毫无意义的声音振动束缚于语言的形式之中——并借此进行沟通。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-common-a1c10p.en: We take mere sonic vibrations, devoid of meaning, and confine them within the form of language—and through it, we communicate.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-common-a1c10p.zh: 我将这无形而不稳定的心灵定义为树。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-common-a1c10p.en: I define this invisible, unstable mind as a tree.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-common-a1c10p.zh: 脑啡肽以同类相引，化作最不易引发排斥的形态。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-common-a1c10p.en: Cogito draws like from like, taking the form that provokes the least aversion.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-common-a1c10p.zh: 但我们需要的并非被汲取之物，而是绽放之物。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-common-a1c10p.en: But what we need is not something which is drawn up, but that which blooms.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-common-a1c10p.zh: 水桶必须化作种子。它必须化作喷薄而出的意志。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-common-a1c10p.en: The bucket must become a seed. It must become a will that bursts forth.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-common-a1c10p.zh: 物质层面的人体及其结构，依照铭刻于基因之中的设计构筑而成。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-common-a1c10p.en: The material human body and its structure are built according to a design inscribed in our very genes.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-common-a1c10p.zh: 同理，必须将承载树之图示的蓝图植入人们体内。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-common-a1c10p.en: In the same manner, a blueprint bearing the diagram of the tree must be implanted within people.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-common-a1c10p.zh: ……但该怎么做？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-common-a1c10p.en: ... But how?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-common-a1c10p.zh: 或许脑啡肽本该化作光，而非水。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-common-a1c10p.en: Perhaps Cogito should have taken the form of light, not water.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-common-a1c10p.zh: 因为凝视某物，意味着光已经进入了我的体内。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-common-a1c10p.en: Because to gaze upon something means that the light has entered me.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-common-a1c10p.zh: 因为凝视某物，便意味着无从抗拒地承载下它的种子。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-common-a1c10p.en: Because to gaze upon something is to bear its seed beyond any power to resist.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-common-a1c10p.zh: 如果能够重生，你想成为谁，又或是成为何物？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-common-a1c10p.en: If you were born again, who or what would you want to become?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-common-a1c10p.zh: 我想……我还是想成为一个声音动听的人。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-common-a1c10p.en: I think... I'd still want to be someone with a beautiful voice.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-common-a1c10p.zh: 这样，所有人都会更加留意我说的话。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-common-a1c10p.en: So that everyone would pay more attention to what I say.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-common-a1c10p.zh: 人类起源于水，而水在人类体内循环。或许正因如此……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-common-a1c10p.en: Humanity originated from water, and water circulates within the human body. Perhaps this is why...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-common-a1c10p.zh: 我所祈望的星辰，已经不可逆转地固定成了水的形态。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-common-a1c10p.en: The star I wished for has already been irreversibly fixed into the form of water.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-common-a1c10p.zh: 只要我继续思考，脑啡肽就会将我的愿望化为物质。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-common-a1c10p.en: So long as I continue to think, Cogito will materialize what I desire.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-common-a1c10p.zh: 这意味着，只要我能活下去……只要我创造的脑啡肽能够像星辰一样发挥作用……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-common-a1c10p.en: That means if I can stay alive... if the Cogito I create can be made to function as the stars do...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-common-a1c10p.zh: 那就还有办法。还有治愈所有人的办法。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-common-a1c10p.en: Then there is still a way. A way to heal everyone.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-common-a1c10p.zh: 这项工作值得为之付出。或许正因如此，你从未要求我解释自己。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-common-a1c10p.en: This work is worth it. Perhaps that is why you never asked me to explain myself.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-common-a1c10p.zh: 对吧，Ayin……？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-common-a1c10p.en: Isn't that right, Ayin...?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-common-a1c10p.zh: 我将它留在这里——《光之种计划草案》。唯一的道路。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-common-a1c10p.en: I leave it here—"Project Seed of Light Draft". The only way.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-common-a1c10p.zh: 你应当能够承受这一切。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-common-a1c10p.en: You should be capable of enduring it.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-common-a1c10p.zh: 所以……我将此托付给你。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-common-a1c10p.en: Which is why... I entrust this to you.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-common-a1c10p.zh:
致我亲爱的后辈，
——Carmen。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-common-a1c10p.en:
To my beloved junior,
- Carmen.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-common-a1c10p.zh: 治疗或交谈无法治愈灵魂。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-common-a1c10p.en: Therapy or conversation cannot heal the soul.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-common-a1c10p.zh: 以这套图式衡量，心理治疗不过是一种原始的权宜之计。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-common-a1c10p.en: Measured against this schema, psychotherapy is no more than a primitive stopgap.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-common-a1c10p.zh: 但如今我已经知晓人类心灵的形态，难道不能对其进行诊断与治疗吗？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-common-a1c10p.en: But now that I know the shape of the human mind, could I not diagnose and heal it?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-common-a1c10p.zh: 若真如此，或许不仅能治愈我出生的N公司，也能治愈笼罩都市本身的可怕苦难。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-common-a1c10p.en: If so, it may be possible to heal not only N Corp., where I was born, but also the terrible suffering that has enveloped the City itself.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-common-a1c10p.zh: 或许能够治愈都市中那些身患疾病的人——他们在迈向死亡的旅途中，无法知晓自己究竟是谁。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-common-a1c10p.en: It may be possible to heal the people of the City who are afflicted by an illness that makes them unable to know who they are in their journey toward death.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-common-a1c10p.zh: 这棵树的形态只是汇集我诸般发现后产生的结果；我并未预先规定它必须如此。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-common-a1c10p.en: The shape of this tree is but an outcome of compiling my eclectic discoveries; I did not prescribe this form.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-common-a1c10p.zh: 正如人体有解剖图，这棵树便是人类心灵的图示。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-common-a1c10p.en: Just as the human body has an anatomical diagram, this tree is a diagram of the human mind.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-common-a1c10p.zh: 要治疗患者，必须先理解其身体。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-common-a1c10p.en: To treat the afflicted, one must first understand the body.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-common-a1c10p.zh: 然而，迄今无人完整地将人类灵魂——或意识——化为可视形态，更遑论构建将其结构系统化的方法。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-common-a1c10p.en: Yet no one has thus far completed a visualization of the human soul—or consciousness—let alone devised the means of systematizing its structure.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-common-a1c10p.zh: 无论以何种方式诞生，任何事物在获得物质存在的瞬间，都无一例外地被赋予了结构。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-common-a1c10p.en: No matter the manner of its inception, the moment something acquires material existence, it is without exception assigned a structure.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-common-a1c10p.zh: 我断定，这可以被视为人类的命运。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-common-a1c10p.en: I concluded that this could be regarded as human fate.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-common-a1c10p.zh: 这并非叙事意义上的命运。它毫无形而上的玄妙或宏大可言——不过是一段基因序列那般简单。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-common-a1c10p.en: This is not fate in the narrative sense. There is nothing metaphysical or grand about it—nothing more complicated than a genetic sequence.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-common-a1c10p.zh: 鱼的细胞可以分化为各种形态，但鱼终究无法离开水。一旦鱼放弃水中的生存方式，它便不再被归类为“鱼”。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-common-a1c10p.en: The cells of a fish may differentiate into all kinds of forms, but ultimately, the fish cannot leave the water. Once a fish has abandoned its aquatic existence, it is no longer categorized as "fish."

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-common-a1c10p.zh: 人类身上同样能够观察到这样的结构。一种等同的命运。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-common-a1c10p.en: Such a structure is also observed in human beings. An equivalent fate.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-common-a1c10p.zh: 而在某种巧合之下，那一结构呈现为树的形态。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-common-a1c10p.en: And by some stroke of coincidence, that structure took the shape of a tree.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-common-a1c10p.zh: 这棵树名为赛菲洛特。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-common-a1c10p.en: The tree's name is Sephirot.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-common-a1c10p.zh: 一个燃烧的钟表头映入眼帘。和平时并没有什么不同，可是……为什么感觉如此陌生？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-common-a1c10p.en: A burning clock head comes into view. There's nothing different from the usual, but... why does it feel oddly unfamiliar?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-common-a1c10p.zh: 一只腐烂的幼虫。这绝不可能用作食材。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-common-a1c10p.en: A rotten larva. This can't possibly be used as food ingredient.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-common-a1c10p.zh: 一摞摞布料东倒西歪地散落着。它们原本要被送到哪里？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-common-a1c10p.en: Stacks of fabric lie toppled every which way. Where were they supposed to be taken?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-common-a1c10p.zh: 洗手间的门关着。既然连破门而入都做不到，就没有费心管它的必要。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-common-a1c10p.en: The restroom door is shut. If it can't even be broken down, there's no reason to bother with it.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-common-a1c10p.zh: 奥提斯
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-common-a1c10p.en: Outis

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-common-a1c10p.zh: 嗯……纹丝不动。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-common-a1c10p.en: Hm... It's not even budging.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-common-a1c10p.zh: 希斯克利夫
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-common-a1c10p.en: Heathcliff

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-common-a1c10p.zh: 奥提斯
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-common-a1c10p.en: Outis

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-common-a1c10p.zh: 没听见我说话吗？这扇门纹丝不动。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-common-a1c10p.en: Did you not hear what I said? The door's not budging.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-common-a1c10p.zh: 希斯克利夫
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-common-a1c10p.en: Heathcliff

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-common-a1c10p.zh: *哈欠*
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-common-a1c10p.en: *yawn*

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-common-a1c10p.zh: 但丁
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-common-a1c10p.en: Dante

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-common-a1c10p.zh: <希斯克利夫……我觉得她是在和你说话。>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-common-a1c10p.en: <Heathcliff... I think she's talking to you.>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-common-a1c10p.zh: 希斯克利夫
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-common-a1c10p.en: Heathcliff

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-common-a1c10p.zh: ……这门确实打不开。那你想让我怎么办？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-common-a1c10p.en: ... The door won't budge, yeah. What do you want me to do about it?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-common-a1c10p.zh: 奥提斯
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-common-a1c10p.en: Outis

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-common-a1c10p.zh: 真是荒谬的问题。障碍出现——你便不考虑风险与现有战术，直接用那根球棒将其清除。这不正是你平日奉行的行动准则吗？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-common-a1c10p.en: What an absurd question. An obstacle emerges—you and that bat of yours terminate it without any thought given to the risk involved or the tactics available. Isn't that supposed to be your day-to-day doctrine of action?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-common-a1c10p.zh: 奥提斯
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-common-a1c10p.en: Outis

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-common-a1c10p.zh: 执行经理，前方区域尚未完成排查。请退至便于防守的距离。由希斯克利夫破门并先行侦察。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-common-a1c10p.en: The location beyond is yet to be screened, Executive Manager. Please fall back to a defensible distance. Heathcliff shall breach the door and scout ahead.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-common-a1c10p.zh: 希斯克利夫
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-common-a1c10p.en: Heathcliff

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-common-a1c10p.zh: 妈的，你还真敢使唤我把门砸开！随便看一眼都知道他们在这地方砸了大价钱……我要是把门砸得稀烂，他们让咱们赔钱怎么办？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-common-a1c10p.en: Bloody hell, you've got some nerve telling me to put that door in! One look round and you can tell they spent a fortune on this place... What if they make us foot the bill after I've smashed it to bits?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-common-a1c10p.zh: 但丁
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-common-a1c10p.en: Dante

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-common-a1c10p.zh: <……没事。试一下也无妨。砸吧。>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-common-a1c10p.en: <... It's fine. No harm in trying. Smash it.>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-common-a1c10p.zh: 希斯克利夫
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-common-a1c10p.en: Heathcliff
Huh...?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-common-a1c10p.zh: 希斯克利夫
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-common-a1c10p.en: Heathcliff

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-common-a1c10p.zh: 好吧，钟，这可是你要求的。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-common-a1c10p.en: All right, you wanted it, Clock.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-common-a1c10p.zh: 希斯克利夫使尽全力挥出球棒，却仿佛被什么东西推开一般向后飞去。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-common-a1c10p.en: Heathcliff swung his bat with all his might, only to be thrown backward as if something had shoved him away.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-common-a1c10p.zh: 奥提斯
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-common-a1c10p.en: Outis

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-common-a1c10p.zh: 嗯。执行经理，看来它无法通过物理手段破坏。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-common-a1c10p.en: Hmm. It seems it can't be broken by physical means, Executive Manager.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-common-a1c10p.zh: 但丁
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-common-a1c10p.en: Dante

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-common-a1c10p.zh: 无法从这里通过。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-common-a1c10p.en: Can't pass through here.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-common-a1c10p.zh: 没有回应。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-common-a1c10p.en: There is no response.

StoryData/S1020B.json#1#content.zh: 肩缝垂得略低了些……袖口又短了一拃。这一身要改的地方可不少。那么，你们想改什么？
StoryData/S1020B.json#1#content.en: Shoulder seams hanging a touch too low... hems of the arm a span too short. Much work to be done, this one. So, what would you like to have altered?

StoryData/S1020B.json#2#content.zh: 我们希望购得一把剪刀。
StoryData/S1020B.json#2#content.en: We would like to procure a pair of scissors.

StoryData/S1020B.json#4#content.zh: ……我的剪刀可不是挂在货架上卖的工具。我的刃，不是随便什么人都能拿走的。
StoryData/S1020B.json#4#content.en: ... My scissors are not tools to be hung and sold from the product racks. I do not part with my blades for just anyone, you see.

StoryData/S1020B.json#5#content.zh: 它们只留给那些眼里闪着咔嚓咔嚓渴望的顾客。就像黑派，我的老主顾——他们总来找我，让我为他们织布。
StoryData/S1020B.json#5#content.en: They're reserved for customers whose eyes twinkle with the desire to go snip-snip. Like the Noirs, my longtime customers—they always visit me to have me weave fabric for them.

StoryData/S1020B.json#6#content.en: Are you... well-acquainted with the Noirs?

StoryData/S1020B.json#7#content.zh: 我给他们供布已有一阵子了，算得上是伙伴。
StoryData/S1020B.json#7#content.en: I've been supplying them with fabric for a while now, so one could say that we are partners.

StoryData/S1020B.json#8#content.zh: 黑派最近忙得很——四处放话、四处打听，怀疑红色那帮人在搞鬼。
StoryData/S1020B.json#8#content.en: The Noirs have been quite busy as of late—spreading and fishing tales, suspicious that the red ones are up to no good.

StoryData/S1020B.json#9#content.zh: 我在你们身上看不到那份炽热的渴望。不过，别的东西倒是可以卖给你们。
StoryData/S1020B.json#9#content.en: I simply do not see that same passionate desire in you. I do have other items available for purchase, however.

StoryData/S1020B.json#10#content.zh: <看来对她直来直去行不通……这跟上次不一样。>
StoryData/S1020B.json#10#content.en: <Looks like getting straight to the point won't work on her... This isn't what happened last time.>

StoryData/S1020B.json#11#content.zh: 或许……剪刀可以等下次机会再购得，经理。
StoryData/S1020B.json#11#content.en: Perhaps... we could procure the pair of scissors at our next opportunity, Manager.

StoryData/S1020B.json#12#content.en: <Don't think we have any other choice.>

StoryData/S1020B.json#13#content.zh: 那个……我们到底为什么需要一把剪刀来着？
StoryData/S1020B.json#13#content.en: So... why did we need a pair of scissors, again?

StoryData/S1020B.json#14#content.zh: 剪刀若磨至锋锐，便是极佳的武器。这显然是在为即将到来的战争做准备。
StoryData/S1020B.json#14#content.en: Scissors, when honed to perfection, can be excellent weapons. It is obviously in preparation for the coming war.

StoryData/S1021B.json#0#content.zh: 希斯克利夫朝那孩子迈出一步，孩子一缩，退了开去。
StoryData/S1021B.json#0#content.en: The child flinched as Heathcliff took a step toward them, and backed away.

StoryData/S1021B.json#1#content.zh: 等意识到已无处可退，孩子便缩到地上，开始发抖，看上去像是……在害怕。
StoryData/S1021B.json#1#content.en: And when they realized there was nowhere to go, they shrank to the ground and began to tremble in... what appeared to be fear.

StoryData/S1021B.json#5#content.en: ... What're you lookin' at me like that for?

StoryData/S1021B.json#7#content.zh: 我打那小孩了吗？没有！我他妈什么都还没干！我就说了句“喂”，就这样！
StoryData/S1021B.json#7#content.en: Did I hit the kid? No! I ain't even done shite yet! I just said "Oi," that's all I did!

StoryData/S1021B.json#8#content.zh: 希斯克利夫，对自己在孩子眼里是什么模样稍有些自觉，会有帮助。
StoryData/S1021B.json#8#content.en: Heathcliff, a degree of self-awareness of how one might appear to a child would be helpful.

StoryData/S1021B.json#9#content.zh: 你时常表现出的那种粗率，通常会让弱者感到恐惧。
StoryData/S1021B.json#9#content.en: That bluntness you often exhibit generally instills fear in the weak.

StoryData/S1021B.json#10#content.zh: 你们不是认真的吧。妈的，那就从洗手间叫别人来啊……！我长这样也没办法，是吧？
StoryData/S1021B.json#10#content.en: You can't be serious. Bloody hell, get someone else from the restroom, then...! Can't help the way I look, yeah?

StoryData/S1021B.json#11#content.zh: 我认为这并非外表的问题，而是举止的问题。
StoryData/S1021B.json#11#content.en: I believe this not to be a matter of appearance but of bearing.

StoryData/S1022B.json#3#content.zh: 嚯？！布布小家伙，汝原来一直都会说话？
StoryData/S1022B.json#3#content.en: Hoh?! Young Pwie, thou possessed the gift of speech all along?

StoryData/S1022B.json#5#content.zh: 布布的目光警惕地在默尔索和我之间游移。
