StoryData/S1022B.json#5#content.en: Pwie's gaze wavered warily between Meursault and me.

StoryData/S1022B.json#6#content.zh: 我哭了……好多……因为好痛……也因为好难过……我起不来……
StoryData/S1022B.json#6#content.en: I cried... a lot... 'Cuz it hurt a lot... and 'cuz I was sad... And I couldn't get up...

StoryData/S1022B.json#7#content.zh: 因为你们两个……我好害怕……而且越来越怕，越来越怕……
StoryData/S1022B.json#7#content.en: 'Cuz of you two... I was scared... And it only got scarier and scarier...

StoryData/S1022B.json#8#content.zh: <……布布记得清仓之前发生的事。>
StoryData/S1022B.json#8#content.en: <... Pwie remembers what happened before the Liquidation.>

StoryData/S1022B.json#12#content.zh: 因为我们的行为让你受了苦。
StoryData/S1022B.json#12#content.en: Because our actions have led to your suffering.

StoryData/S1022B.json#15#content.zh: ……所以……我也不知道眼泪是什么意思了。
StoryData/S1022B.json#15#content.en: ... So... I dunno what tears mean anymore.

StoryData/S1022B.json#16#content.en: I wanna forget... but... I shouldn't...

StoryData/S1022B.json#18#content.zh: 布布盯着地面嘟囔了一阵，然后试探着朝我们迈了一步。
StoryData/S1022B.json#18#content.en: Pwie muttered for a bit while staring at the ground, then took a tentative step toward us.

StoryData/S1022B.json#22#content.zh: 这个……我们目前还答不上来。或许是有什么把我们引向了你。
StoryData/S1022B.json#22#content.en: That's... not a question we have an answer to at the moment. Perhaps something drew us toward you.

StoryData/S1022B.json#23#content.en: ... I gotta go up to fifth floor.

StoryData/S1022B.json#24#content.zh: 我睡着的时候……那里还有别人和我在一起……
StoryData/S1022B.json#24#content.en: When I was sleeping... there were others there with me...

StoryData/S1022B.json#25#content.zh: 他们说……他们悄悄说……等我醒来，大家都会很高兴见到我，会欢迎我。他们还唱了一首很好听的歌……
StoryData/S1022B.json#25#content.en: They said... They whispered that... everyone's gonna be so happy to see me and welcome me when I wake up. They even sang a really nice song... too.

StoryData/S1022B.json#27#content.zh: 不。唱歌的不是我们。为你唱歌的，是你醒来不久后亲手碰过的那个女人。
StoryData/S1022B.json#27#content.en: No. We did not sing to you. The one who sang to you is the woman whom you laid your hands on shortly after your awakening.

StoryData/S1022B.json#28#content.zh: 可是……她不动。也不跟我说话。
StoryData/S1022B.json#28#content.en: But... she didn't move. Or speak to me.

StoryData/S1022B.json#30#content.en: You can't move... when you're dead?

StoryData/S1022B.json#33#content.zh: 因为身体已停止运作，意识也已熄灭。
StoryData/S1022B.json#33#content.en: Because the body has ceased to function, and the mind has been extinguished.

StoryData/S1022B.json#36#content.zh: <唔……是啊，这些概念本来就不好懂。尤其是在西西弗百货里面。>
StoryData/S1022B.json#36#content.en: <Hmmm... Yeah, they're not the most straightforward of concepts. Especially inside the Grand Magasin.>

StoryData/S1022B.json#37#content.en: I was lying on the ground... and my eyes were closed...

StoryData/S1022B.json#38#content.zh: 我觉得……那就是死。可是我又醒过来了。没有熄灭。
StoryData/S1022B.json#38#content.en: I think... that was death. But I woke up again. Didn't get extinguished.

StoryData/S1022B.json#39#content.zh: ……因为在西西弗百货里死去，与在外面死去，是根本不同的概念。
StoryData/S1022B.json#39#content.en: ... Because dying within the Grand Magasin is a fundamentally different concept from dying outside of it.

StoryData/S1022B.json#42#content.zh: ……我不知道。我不知道是否真的存在差别。
StoryData/S1022B.json#42#content.en: ... I don't know. I don't know if there really is any difference.

StoryData/S1022B.json#44#content.en: I don't want to... get extinguished.

StoryData/S1022B.json#47#content.zh: 所以我想吃东西，可是……有人从我手里抢走了。
StoryData/S1022B.json#47#content.en: So I tried to eat something, but... someone took it from me.

StoryData/S1022B.json#48#content.zh: 呸，没想到世上还有别的灵魂，做着年轻的希斯克利夫先生那般的行径！
StoryData/S1022B.json#48#content.en: Fie, to think that there were other souls with young Heathcliff's antics!

StoryData/S1022B.json#50#content.zh: 这一层好像没有餐厅呢，不过……如果这儿真是“百货商店”，那总该有卖吃的地方吧。
StoryData/S1022B.json#50#content.en: I don't see any restaurants on this floor, but... if this really is a "department store," there has to be places selling food somewhere.

StoryData/S1022B.json#51#content.zh: 我们一起去找找看，好吗？
StoryData/S1022B.json#51#content.en: Let's go find one together, hmm?

StoryData/S1022B.json#53#content.zh: 布布似乎仍和我们隔着些距离，但我注意到，祂不像先前那样远远落在后面了。祂站在离我们不远处，眼神发着直……
StoryData/S1022B.json#53#content.en: Though Pwie seemed to be giving us a somewhat wide berth still, I noticed that they weren't hanging as far back as they were before. They were standing some distance from us with a blank stare in their eyes...

StoryData/S1022B.json#54#content.en: ... as though they were waiting for us to go somewhere.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.zh: 曾经承载着快乐衣橱继续存在之愿的容器。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.en: The vessel that once held the Happy Closet's wish to go on existing.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.zh: 红宝石之心
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.en: Red Ruby Heart

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.zh: 百货商场里的每一位顾客与员工，都已经在经历各自的扭曲。既然扭曲的终点是异想体，那么这里没有出现任何异想体，反倒才是真正的异常。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.en: Every customer and employee in the department store is already undergoing their own Distortion. Since the terminus of Distortion is an Abnormality, the true abnormality would be if no Abnormalities had appeared here.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.zh: 飘散粉红花瓣的异想体之卵
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.en: The Egg of an Abnormality that Scattered Pink Petals

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.zh:
在象征界中，使用<color=#F8C200>普通攻击</color>命中敌人时，施加<color=#F8C200>花瓣标记</color>
- 仅在敌人没有此<color=#F8C200>标记</color>时施加该效果
- <color=#F8C200>花瓣标记</color>持续10秒
- 花瓣标记冷却时间：10秒（从施加标记时开始计算）
- 默尔索的<color=#F8C200>普通攻击</color>对带有花瓣标记的目标造成+1<color=#fe4b48>伤害</color>
- 带有此标记的目标被击败时，以目标为中心，对3×3格范围造成5点<color=#fe4b48>伤害</color>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.en:
In the Symbolic, when landing a hit using <color=#F8C200>Basic Attack</color> on the enemy, inflict <color=#F8C200>Petal Mark</color>
- This effect is inflicted only when the enemy does not have this <color=#F8C200>Mark</color>
- <color=#F8C200>Petal Mark</color> lasts for 10 seconds
- Petal Mark cooldown: 10 seconds (counts from the moment the mark is inflicted)
- Meursault's <color=#F8C200>Basic Attack</color> deals +1 <color=#fe4b48>Damage</color> against targets inflicted with Petal Mark
- When a target that has this mark is defeated, deal 5 <color=#fe4b48>damage</color> on 3 x 3 tiles centered on the target

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.zh: 用黄金松脂制成的纽扣。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.en: A button fashioned from Golden Resin.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.zh: 黄金纽扣
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.en: Golden Button

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.zh: 用黄金皮革缝合起来的牙齿。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.en: A tooth stitched together with Golden Hide.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.zh: 黄金牙齿
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.en: Golden Tooth

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.zh: 被抽成缕缕金丝的头发。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.en: Hair drawn out into strands of gold.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.zh: 黄金发丝
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.en: Golden Hair

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.zh: 一名苦苦等待声音的员工的脊椎骨。钉子用于固定事物。骨头将血肉固定在原位。骨头就是钉子。钉子如针一般刺穿事物。这截脊椎不仅是一枚上好的钉子，也是一根针。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.en: The vertebra of an employee who waited desperately for the Voice. A nail exists to hold things fast. Bone holds flesh in place. Bone is a nail. A nail pierces like a needle. This vertebra is not only a quality nail but also a needle.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.zh: 赤红尖钉
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.en: Red Nail

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.zh: “信就是所望之事的实底，是未见之事的确据。”
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.en: "Now faith is the substance of things hoped for, the evidence of things not seen."

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.zh: 信念
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.en: Faith

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.zh:
在象征界中，受到足以致死的<color=#fe4b48>伤害</color>时，有10%概率以1点<color=#00ff9c>体力</color>存活
- 即死等特定伤害除外

象征界<color=#00ff9c>体力</color>+2
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.en:
In the Symbolic, upon taking <color=#fe4b48>Damage</color> that would result in death, 10% chance to survive with 1 <color=#00ff9c>HP</color>
- Excluding certain damages such as Instant Death

Symbolic <color=#00ff9c>HP</color> +2

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.zh: 能将任何人带回家的鞋。每一步散发的余香都浸透着思慕，因为穿上它的人会开始向往离家最遥远的地方。毕竟，对家的思念越深，便必然越接近归途。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.en: Shoes that bring anyone home. The faint aroma scattered by each footfall is steeped in longing, for whoever wears them begins to yearn for the farthest place from home. After all, the more one longs for home, the closer to home one inevitably draws.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.zh: 粉红玛丽珍鞋
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.en: Pink Mary Janes

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.zh:
在阴影界战斗期间，布布的脉动威力+1
- 速度下限与上限+3
- “赤红尖钉”硬币+1（使用追加硬币命中时，发射<color=#F8C200>花瓣弹体</color>）
- 使用“打起精神”技能时，每拥有2点脉动威力，攻击加权值+1（最多+2）
- 解放“牵住我的手”技能（有友方陷入混乱时自动使用，使其<color=#F8C200>解除混乱</color>并<color=#00ff9c>回复</color><color=#00ff9c>体力</color>；每回合2次）
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.en:
Pwie's Pulsation Potency +1 during battle in the Shadowed
- Min & Max Speed +3
- "Crimson Nail" Coin +1 (On Hit using additional Coins, fire <color=#F8C200>Petal Projectiles</color>)
- Upon using the "Perk Up" Skill, gain +1 Atk Weight for every 2 Pulsation Potency (max 2)
- Unlock the "Grab My Hand" Skill (used automatically when an ally is Staggered to <color=#F8C200>recover them from Stagger</color> and <color=#00ff9c>heal</color> their <color=#00ff9c>HP</color>; 2 times per turn)

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.zh: 保留着黄金皮革毛皮的羊剪绒斗篷。这件衣物将外来之物拒之门外，同时催促内在之物绽放。孩子披上它的那一刻，童年便宣告结束。孩子学会他人有何期待、什么必须复原，并被迫依此行事。其不再被允许对世界怀有好奇。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.en: A shearling cape that preserves the fur of the Golden Hide. This garment keeps what comes from outside at bay, while hastening what blooms within. Once the child dons it, childhood reaches its end. The child learns what others expect and what must be restored, and is compelled to act accordingly. It is no longer permitted to be curious about the world.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.zh: 黄金裹布
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.en: Golden Shroud

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.zh:
在象征界中，布布会在经过之处留下<color=#F8C200>呕吐物</color>
- 布布1格内的敌人与站在<color=#F8C200>呕吐物</color>上的敌人每2秒受到4点<color=#fe4b48>伤害</color>
- 对所有因此效果受到<color=#fe4b48>伤害</color>的敌人施加<color=#F8C200>黄金启示</color>
- 带有<color=#F8C200>黄金启示</color>的敌人死亡时，对其周围1格内造成4点<color=#fe4b48>伤害</color>（0.1秒受击硬直）

在阴影界战斗期间：
- 布布获得1点脉动威力
- 防御等级+10
- 回合结束：若布布陷入混乱，则解除混乱并<color=#00ff9c>回复</color>50%<color=#00ff9c>体力</color>（每场遭遇战1次）
- 使用“赤红尖钉（第2枚硬币）”、“走开”或“赤红尖钉之洗礼”命中时，施加1层<color=#F8C200>黄金启示</color>
- 使用“赤红尖钉之洗礼”时，若脉动威力达到5点以上，则攻击加权值+2，硬币威力提升（脉动威力-3）
- 使用“不要受伤”时，额外<color=#00ff9c>回复</color>（脉动威力×2）%<color=#00ff9c>体力</color>与（脉动威力×3）精神力
- 使用“牵住我的手”命中时，下回合为目标施加等同于其<color=#00ff9c>体力</color>上限50%的护盾
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.en:
In the Symbolic, Pwie leaves <color=#F8C200>Le Vomissement</color> in their tracks
- Enemies 1 tile within Pwie and enemies on top of <color=#F8C200>Le Vomissement</color> take 4 <color=#fe4b48>Damage</color> every 2 seconds
- Inflicts <color=#F8C200>Golden Revelation</color> on all enemies who took <color=#fe4b48>Damage</color> from this effect
- When enemies that have <color=#F8C200>Golden Revelation</color> dies, they deal 4 <color=#fe4b48>Damage</color> within 1 tile around them (0.1 seconds Hitstun)

During battle in the Shadowed:
- Pwie gains 1 Pulsation Potency
- Defense Level +10
- Turn End: If Pwie is Staggered, recover from Stagger and <color=#00ff9c>heal</color> 50% <color=#00ff9c>HP</color> (once per Encounter)
- On Hit using "Crimson Nail (2nd Coin)", "Go Away", or "Baptism of Crimson Nails", inflict 1 <color=#F8C200>Golden Revelation</color>
- On "Baptism of Crimson Nails" use, at 5+ Pulsation Potency, gain +2 Atk Weight and Coin Power +(Pulsation Potency - 3)
- Upon using "Don't Get Hurty", additionally <color=#00ff9c>heal</color> (Pulsation Potency x 2)% <color=#00ff9c>HP</color> and (Pulsation Potency x 3) SP
- On Hit using "Grab My Hand", apply Shield equal to 50% of target's max <color=#00ff9c>HP</color> next turn

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.zh: 血肉从骨骼上剥离，皮则从血肉上揭下。随后，必须将附着其上的毛发溶解殆尽，直到只剩生皮。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.en: As flesh is stripped from bone, hide is peeled from flesh. Then the hair clinging to it must be dissolved away until only the raw skin remains.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.zh: 生皮捆
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.en: Bundle of Rawhide

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.zh: 皮革在制革厂中经单宁转化，呈现出棕褐色。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.en: Hide takes on the color of tan as tannins transform it inside the Tannery.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.zh: 鞣制皮革
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.en: Tanned Hide

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.zh: 皮革是肉转化为植物的过程。血肉溶解，木质枝条填满其留下的空洞。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.en: Hide is the process by which meat becomes plant. The flesh dissolves, and branches of wood fill the hollows left behind.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.zh: 柔韧皮革
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.en: Supple Hide

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.zh: 红派渴求皮革的理由很简单。皮革意味着耗竭；织物意味着过剩。他们吃掉肉，再穿上剩余之物，从不思考食物被吃尽后会发生什么。现在就吃。现在就穿。红派崇拜耗竭。他们并非因为热爱皮革才走向耗竭。他们之所以穿上皮革，是因为耗竭从一开始就是它的归宿。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.en: The reason the Rouges desire hide is simple. Hide is depletion; fabric is excess. They eat the meat, then wear what remains, never wondering what happens when nothing is left to eat. Consume now. Wear now. The Rouges worship depletion. They do not walk toward depletion because they love hide. They came to wear hide because depletion was always its destination.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.zh: 改造工具
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.en: Alteration Tools

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.zh:
在象征界中，解放<color=#F8C200>监督者弹体</color>
- 向5格内随机一名敌人发射（冷却时间2.5秒）
- 命中目标时，对其周围1格内造成3点<color=#fe4b48>伤害</color>（0.1秒受击硬直）

在阴影界战斗中，为布布解放“我来替你结束……”
- 敌人未被攻击技能击杀时，对该敌人使用（每回合1次）
- 目标每损失1%<color=#00ff9c>体力</color>，造成的<color=#fe4b48>伤害</color>+0.5%（最多30%）
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.en:
In the Symbolic, unlock <color=#F8C200>Overseer Projectiles</color>
- Fired to a random enemy within 5 tiles (2.5 seconds cooldown)
- On hitting the target, deals 3 <color=#fe4b48>Damage</color> within 1 tile (0.1 seconds Hitstun)

In Shadowed Battles, unlock "I'll End It for You..." for Pwie
- If an enemy is not killed by an Attack Skill, use it on that enemy (once per turn)
- Deal +0.5% <color=#fe4b48>damage</color> for every 1% missing <color=#00ff9c>HP</color> on target (max 30%)

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.zh:
如此说来，黄金皮革可以被描述为一种结构中密集塞满微小黄金束的皮革。曾经填补裂隙的皮，的确是某个人的皮肤与血肉。而在经过鞣制后，它获得了与金枝相称的树木性质。

但金枝真的曾被确定为植物吗？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.en:
The Golden Hide, then, could be described as a hide whose very structure is densely packed with minute bundles of gold. The Hide that once filled the cracks truly had been someone's skin and flesh. And once it was tanned, it came to take on arboreal properties befitting the Golden Bough.

But was the Golden Bough ever truly established to be a plant?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.zh: 黄金皮革织物
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.en: Golden Hide Fabric

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.zh: 百货商场建成之前，一个古老的存在奇迹般幸存下来，并留下了后代。那名幸存的子嗣搁浅在岸边，将在那里成为新时代的材料。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.en: Before the department store was built, a being of eld survived as if by miracle and left behind an offspring. That surviving descendant was beached on the Shore, there to become material for a new age.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.zh: 幼虫
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.en: Larva

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.zh: 它嫉妒太阳的光辉，于是成为了一盏灯。然而灯必须比太阳更贴近人们，因为太阳过于耀眼、炽热，无法留在身边。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.en: Envious of the sun's radiance, it became a lamp. Yet a lamp must stay closer to people than the sun, because the sun is too dazzling and hot to keep at one's side.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.zh: 灯火
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.en: The Lights

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.zh: 在象征界中，静止不动时受到攻击，承受的<color=#fe4b48>伤害</color>-2（最低承受1点<color=#fe4b48>伤害</color>）
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.en: In the Symbolic, <color=#fe4b48>Damage</color> Taken -2 when hit while standing still (min 1 <color=#fe4b48>Damage</color> taken)

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.zh: 焦香是一种香气，不是味道，听清楚了吗？香气和味道并不相同，可它们总是黏在一起，听清楚了吗？总有一天，我要做一道只由香气构成的菜，听清楚了吗？那样一来，这里的所有人都能吃饱，再也不用担心食物耗尽，听清楚了吗？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.en: Toasty is an aroma, not a flavor, you hear? Aroma and taste are different, but they cling together, you hear? Someday, I'll cook a dish made only of aroma, you hear?  Then everyone here can have their fill without worrying about food running out, you hear?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.zh: 是焦香，听清楚了吗？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.en: It's Toasty, You Hear?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.zh: 在象征界中，击杀敌人时<color=#00ff9c>回复</color>3点象征界<color=#00ff9c>体力</color>（冷却时间4秒）
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.en: In the Symbolic, <color=#00ff9c>heals</color> 3 Symbolic <color=#00ff9c>HP</color> upon killing an enemy (4 seconds cooldown)

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.zh: 鲜味很能勾起食欲，听清楚了吗？一旦有了食欲，就会开始渴望下一道菜，听清楚了吗？渴望下一道菜，就意味着期待下一种味道，听清楚了吗？所以，鲜味就意味着期待，听清楚了吗？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.en: Savory flavor really brings up the appetite, you hear? Once you feel that appetite, you start craving the next dish, you hear? Craving the next dish means looking forward to the next flavor, you hear? So, savory means anticipation, you hear?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.zh: 是鲜味，听清楚了吗？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.en: It's Savory, You Hear?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.zh: 象征界中的<color=#fe4b48>攻击速度</color>+15%
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.en: <color=#fe4b48>Attack Speed</color> +15% in the Symbolic

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.zh: 你尝过塞在裂隙里的黄金皮革吗？哦，用那种皮革调味的衣服……那可是永远无法忘怀的味道。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.en: Have you ever tasted the Golden Hide packed into the cracks? Oh, clothes seasoned with that hide... now that is a flavor one can never forget.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.zh: 红派快销服饰单肩包
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.en: Le Rouge Casualwear Shoulder Bag

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.zh: 象征界<color=#00ff9c>体力</color>+3
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.en: Symbolic <color=#00ff9c>HP</color> +3

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.zh: 有时候，啃食黄金皮革会让裂隙变得更宽。这种时候，就抓住那些企图控制皮革的讨厌黑派，把他们塞进缺口，堵严实……瞧，问题解决了。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.en: Sometimes, gnawing away at the Golden Hide makes the crack wider. When that happens, you catch these nasty Noirs who tried to control the Hide. Stuff them into the gap, plug it up... And voilà, problem solved.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.zh: 红派快销服饰连帽衫
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.en: Le Rouge Casualwear Hoodie

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.zh: 象征界中造成的<color=#fe4b48>伤害</color>+1
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.en: <color=#fe4b48>Damage</color> Dealt +1 in the Symbolic

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.zh: 曾有人疑惑：“西西弗百货建成之前，这里矗立着什么？”这个念头很快被放进一顶帽子，从此沉没不见。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.en: Someone once wondered, "What stood here before the Grand Magasin was built?" The thought was soon placed inside a cap, where it sank out of sight.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.zh: 红派现代服饰帽
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.en: Le Rouge Contemporary Cap

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.zh:
在象征界中，解放<color=#F8C200>闪避</color>
- 按下<color=#F8C200>闪避键（键盘Z键）</color>，向移动方向<color=#F8C200>闪避</color>1格；静止时则向当前朝向闪避（冷却时间0.5秒）
- <color=#F8C200>闪避</color>会触发0.2秒<color=#F8C200>无敌帧</color>，攻击期间也可发动
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.en:
In the Symbolic, unlocks <color=#F8C200>Evade</color>
- Press the <color=#F8C200>Evade button (Z on keyboard)</color> to <color=#F8C200>Evade</color> 1 tile in the direction of movement, or the direction currently faced while stationary (0.5 seconds cooldown)
- <color=#F8C200>Evade</color> triggers <color=#F8C200>Invul. Frame</color> for 0.2 seconds and can also be activated during attacks

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.zh: 黄金皮革既可食用，也可穿戴。皮革就是血肉本身；它确确实实活着、呼吸着。它与我们身体上的皮肤并无不同。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.en: The Golden Hide may be consumed or worn. Hide is flesh itself; it quite literally lives and breathes. It is no different from the skin of our own bodies.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.zh: 红派现代服饰手套
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.en: Le Rouge Contemporary Gloves

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.zh: 象征界<color=#00ff9c>体力</color>+3
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.en: Symbolic <color=#00ff9c>HP</color> +3

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.zh: 哦，裂隙正在闭合。封住缺口的是黄金——黄金松脂。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.en: Oh, the crack is closing. Sealing the breach is the gold—the Resin of Gold.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.zh: 黑派现代服饰长袜
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.en: Le Noir Contemporary Long Socks

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.zh:
在象征界中解放2级<color=#F8C200>防御</color>
- <color=#F8C200>防御</color>时间：2.5秒
- <color=#F8C200>防御</color><color=#fe4b48>伤害</color>：象征界攻击<color=#fe4b48>伤害</color>+2
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.en:
Unlocks Level 2 <color=#F8C200>Garde</color> in the Symbolic
- <color=#F8C200>Garde</color> Time: 2.5 seconds
- <color=#F8C200>Garde</color> <color=#fe4b48>Damage</color>: Attack <color=#fe4b48>Damage</color> +2 in the Symbolic

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.zh: 保护黄金松脂。反过来，黄金松脂也保护西西弗百货免于崩塌。一条简单的因果链。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.en: Protect the Golden Resin. The Golden Resin, in turn, keeps the Grand Magasin from collapsing. A simple chain of cause and effect.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.zh: 黑派现代服饰领带夹
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.en: Le Noir Contemporary Tiepin

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.zh:
在象征界中解放<color=#F8C200>完美格挡</color>
- 触发条件：按下<color=#F8C200>格挡</color>键后的0.3秒内，朝<color=#F8C200>格挡</color>方向进行<color=#F8C200>格挡</color>，使承受的<color=#fe4b48>伤害</color>降至0
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.en:
Unlocks <color=#F8C200>Perfect Block</color> in the Symbolic
- Trigger Condition: Within 0.3 seconds of pressing the <color=#F8C200>Block</color> button, <color=#F8C200>Blocking</color> in the <color=#F8C200>Block</color> direction reduces incoming <color=#fe4b48>Damage</color> to 0

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.zh: 鞋必须毫无差错地保护穿戴者。它必须让人稳稳直立于大地，不偏不倚、毫不动摇。世界危机四伏；立于不稳的地面时，鞋便是稳定的最后堡垒。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.en: A shoe must protect its wearer without fault. It must hold them upright upon the earth, steady and unshaken. The world is dangerous; on unstable ground, the shoe is the final bastion of stability.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.zh: 黑派鞋履馆布洛克鞋
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.en: Le Noir Footwear Hall Wingtip Shoes

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.zh:
在象征界中，使用2级以上<color=#F8C200>防御</color>时触发向前3格的<color=#F8C200>突进</color>
- 路径被障碍物阻挡时提前停止
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.en:
In the Symbolic, using Level 2 or higher <color=#F8C200>Garde</color> triggers <color=#F8C200>Dash</color> 3 tiles forward
- Stops early if an obstacle blocks the path

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.zh: 护理说明：黑派鞋履由石头制成。石鞋坚硬且不会破裂，但很容易出现划痕，因此必须用鞋油掩盖痕迹。划痕严重的鞋显得陈旧；显旧的鞋看起来结构脆弱，而看起来结构脆弱的鞋便可能破裂。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.en: Care Instructions: Noir shoes are made of stone. Stone shoes are hard and do not break. However, they scratch easily, so you must conceal marks with polish. Heavily scratched shoes look old; old-looking shoes appear structurally fragile, and structurally fragile-looking shoes may break.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.zh: 黑派鞋履馆鞋油
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.en: Le Noir Footwear Hall Shoe Polish

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.zh: 象征界<color=#F8C200>防御</color>速度+25%
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.en: Symbolic <color=#F8C200>Garde</color> Speed +25%

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.zh: 存活到被冲上岸的幼虫闻到了诱饵的气味。它们试图爬上岸边，却被露天的热量烹熟。这里是水域之外的世界。水族箱时代已经结束，如今必须忍受百货商场时代。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.en: The larvae that survived long enough to wash ashore caught the scent of chum. They tried to crawl onto the Shore, only to be cooked in the heat of the open air. This is a world outside the waters. The Age of the Aquarium is over, and the Age of the Department Store must now be endured.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.zh: 糊状诱饵
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.en: Paste Bait

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.zh:
象征界<color=#00ff9c>体力</color>+4

在象征界中，将2级<color=#F8C200>防御</color>作为<color=#F8C200>攻击连段2</color>发动
- 所有动作与效果均以<color=#F8C200>攻击连段2</color>生效
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.en:
Symbolic <color=#00ff9c>HP</color> +4

In the Symbolic, activates Level 2 <color=#F8C200>Garde</color> as <color=#F8C200>Attack Chain 2</color>
- All motions and effects are applied as <color=#F8C200>Attack Chain 2</color>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.zh: 它令太多事物降生，因此罪孽深重。诞下如此之多，与杀死同等数量并无区别。于是，曾游弋于黑丝之中的古老存在，在最深处静静孵育着卵，繁衍自己的罪孽。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.en: It brought far too many things into being, and thus, grave is its sin. To give birth to so much is no different from killing just as much. And so the thing of eld that once swam through the Blackthread quietly brooded over its eggs at the lowest depths, propagating its sins.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.zh: 岸边黑水
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.en: Black Water of the Shore

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.zh:
在象征界中，解放布布的<color=#F8C200>黑水弹体</color>
- 向5格内最近的敌人发射（冷却时间2.5秒）
- 命中时，在3秒内共造成2点<color=#fe4b48>伤害</color>

在阴影界战斗中，布布的脉动威力+1
- 使用“打起精神”后，若处于无法控制的暴走状态且脉动次数达到10以上，消耗10点脉动次数，对目标施加1层<color=#F8C200>基础威力强化</color>
- 使用“不要受伤”时，若脉动威力达到3以上，则攻击加权值+2；命中时，回复等同于技能威力的精神力
- 解放“赤红尖钉之洗礼”（攻击3名敌人）
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.en:
In the Symbolic, unlocks Pwie's <color=#F8C200>Blackwater Projectile</color>
- Fires at the nearest enemy within 5 tiles (2.5 seconds cooldown)
- On hit, deals a total of 2 <color=#fe4b48>Damage</color> over 3 seconds

In Shadowed Battle, Pwie's Pulsation Potency +1
- After using "Perk Up", if in Uncontrollable Rampage and at 10+ Pulsation Count, consume 10 Pulsation Count to apply 1 <color=#F8C200>Base Power Up</color> on the target
- When using "Don't Get Hurty" and at 3+ Pulsation Potency, gain Atk Weight +2; On Hit, heal SP equal to Skill Power
- Unlocks "Baptism of Crimson Nails" (attacks 3 enemies)

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.zh:
在百货商场的最底层，恶臭而残酷的制革作业正在进行。

皮革是剥除生命痕迹后留下的东西。然而若放任不管，它只会腐烂。唯有经过鞣制，它才不再是仍携带生命温度之物，而会变成致密的纤维团块……彻底成为别的东西。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.en:
At the very bottom of the department store, foul-smelling, brutal leatherwork takes place.

Hide is what remains after the traces of life have been stripped away. Left as it is, however, it does nothing but rot. Only through tanning does it cease to be something that still carries the warmth of the living, becoming instead a dense mass of fibers... something else entirely.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.zh: 单宁
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.en: Tannin

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.zh: 在象征界中，<color=#F8C200>防御</color>造成的<color=#fe4b48>伤害</color>+3
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.en: In the Symbolic, <color=#F8C200>Garde</color> <color=#fe4b48>Damage</color> Dealt +3

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.zh:
加工皮革有快有慢。铬鞣会将皮浸入铬中以加快过程，使其在硬化时吸收自然状态下绝不可能接触的金属。

它速度很快，但为获得这种速度而强行将时间向前拖拽，因此无法长久维持。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.en:
There are fast ways and slow ways to process hides. In chrome tanning, the hide is steeped in chromium to hasten the process, drawing into itself a metal it would never have encountered in nature as it hardens.

It is fast, but having dragged time forward to gain that speed, it does not endure for long.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.zh: 铬盐
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.en: Chromium Salt

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.zh: 在象征界中，<color=#F8C200>防御</color><color=#F8C200>突进</color>速度+30%
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.en: In the Symbolic, <color=#F8C200>Garde</color> <color=#F8C200>Dash</color> Speed +30%

StoryData/S1023B.json#0#content.en: ... She was happy to see me, too.

StoryData/S1023B.json#1#content.zh: 但我不能带她回家。我甚至不知道她的家在哪……或者说，“家”究竟是什么。
StoryData/S1023B.json#1#content.en: But I can't bring her home. I don't even know where her home is... or what home is.

StoryData/S1023B.json#2#content.zh: 即便如此……她还是心怀感激，很高兴见到我。
StoryData/S1023B.json#2#content.en: Even still... she was grateful and happy to see me.

StoryData/S1023B.json#5#content.zh: 那是个总会欢迎主人归来的地方……？唔……吾从未觉得这是个难以解释的概念……
StoryData/S1023B.json#5#content.en: Some place that always welcomes its master's return...? Hmm... I had not thought this to be a difficult concept to explain...

StoryData/S1023B.json#6#content.zh: ……是迈出人生第一步的地方。因为家，是我们所有人启程的起点。
StoryData/S1023B.json#6#content.en: ... The place where you take your first steps. Because home is where we all began our journeys.

StoryData/S1023B.json#8#content.zh: 不。但我们的家，就在“外面”。
StoryData/S1023B.json#8#content.en: No. But "outside" is where our homes are.

StoryData/S1023B.json#9#content.zh: 那她呢……？她的家是在西西弗百货吗……？
StoryData/S1023B.json#9#content.en: What about her...? Is her home in the Grand Magasin...?

StoryData/S1023B.json#10#content.zh: 不。她也曾是……住在“外面”的人。
StoryData/S1023B.json#10#content.en: No. She was also... someone who used to live "outside."

StoryData/S1023B.json#11#content.zh: ……那……那位独腿的女士呢？还有那位以前常给我唱歌的女士……？
StoryData/S1023B.json#11#content.en: ... What about... the one-legged lady? Or the lady who used to sing me a song...?

StoryData/S1023B.json#14#content.zh: 我是……唯一一个在这里出生的吗？为什么……？
StoryData/S1023B.json#14#content.en: Am I the... only one who was born here? Why...?

StoryData/S1023B.json#15#content.zh: ……你是失去了本该聆听的“声音”的红派编织出来的。他们造出你，是要你成为他们新的声音。
StoryData/S1023B.json#15#content.en: ... You were woven into being by the Rouges, who lost the Voice they were supposed to hear. They made you to be their new Voice.

StoryData/S1023B.json#16#content.en: Am I... supposed to be a "Voice"...?

StoryData/S1023B.json#17#content.zh: 小布布，世间本无所谓“应当成为什么”——汝之路，理当由汝自己去开辟，而非由他人来定义。
StoryData/S1023B.json#17#content.en: Young Pwie, there is no such thing as what thou art "supposed to be"—thy path ought to be something thou pavest, not to be defined by others.

StoryData/S1023B.json#18#content.zh: ……那……我出生的时候，难道没有什么是我本该成为的吗？
StoryData/S1023B.json#18#content.en: ... So... there wasn't anything you were supposed to be when you were born?

StoryData/S1023B.json#20#content.zh: ……的确，我们生来便被赋予了某些名分。
StoryData/S1023B.json#20#content.en: ... There are, indeed, certain designations that were bestowed upon us at our birth.

StoryData/S1023B.json#21#content.zh: 然而，吾宁愿不让那些名分来定义吾此生之目的。吾亦努力不使其如此。
StoryData/S1023B.json#21#content.en: Yet, I would rather not have them define my purpose in life. I endeavor not to make it so.

StoryData/S1023B.json#22#content.zh: 我曾……“本该”是大观园里的那块玉。那便是我出生的唯一目的。而，有那么一阵子……我确实是。
StoryData/S1023B.json#22#content.en: I was... "supposed to be" the jade of Daguanyuan. That was the sole purpose for which I was born. And, for a while... I was.

StoryData/S1023B.json#23#content.zh: 但如今不再是了。因为“玉”，是长辈们想要我成为的样子，而不是我自己想成为的人。
StoryData/S1023B.json#23#content.en: But not anymore. Because a jade was what the elders wanted me to be, not who I wanted to become.

StoryData/S1023B.json#24#content.zh: ……那么……我就不能成为我本该成为的样子吗？哪怕那正是我被生下来的全部理由？
StoryData/S1023B.json#24#content.en: ... Then... can I not be something that I'm supposed to become? Even if that's the whole reason I was birthed for?

StoryData/S1023B.json#26#content.zh: 堂吉诃德抿紧了嘴唇，神情凝重。布布的问题，想必让她陷入了沉思。
StoryData/S1023B.json#26#content.en: Don Quixote pursed her lips with a grim expression. Pwie's question must've given her much to think about.

StoryData/S1023B.json#27#content.zh: 察觉到房间里古怪的气氛，又想起我们先前的讨论，布布轻轻举起了手……又放了下来，转而选择去问默尔索。
StoryData/S1023B.json#27#content.en: Sensing the odd current of the room, and reminded of our earlier discussion, Pwie briefly raised their hand... and lowered it, instead choosing to ask Meursault.

StoryData/S1023B.json#29#content.zh: 那……是只有你自己才能决定的事。不过……
StoryData/S1023B.json#29#content.en: That is... something only you can decide for yourself. But...

StoryData/S1023B.json#30#content.zh: ……这并不是个容易回答的问题。
StoryData/S1023B.json#30#content.en: ... it is not an easy question to answer.

StoryData/S1023B.json#32#content.zh: 房间里彻底安静了下来。布布的目光在房间里游移，不知该落在何处……
StoryData/S1023B.json#32#content.en: The room had fallen completely silent now. Pwie's eyes darted around the room, not knowing where to rest...

StoryData/S1023B.json#36#content.zh: 我现在明白了……为什么你不想让气氛变得尴尬。
StoryData/S1023B.json#36#content.en: I understand now... Why you don't want things to get awkward.

StoryData/S1024B.json#2#content.zh: 啊，小布布……这是鞋子，吾想。
StoryData/S1024B.json#2#content.en: Ah, Young Pwie... These are shoes, I believe.

StoryData/S1024B.json#3#content.zh: 它们护汝双足免受伤痛……挡住风雪与寒风……使嬉戏玩耍成为一桩乐事。诚然，每位冒险者都该穿一双结实的鞋。
StoryData/S1024B.json#3#content.en: They shield thy soles from pain... keep out the snow and rain and bitter wind... and make frolicking about a most joyous thing. Forsooth, every adventurer ought to wear a stout pair of shoes.

StoryData/S1024B.json#5#content.zh: 这些鞋能让饥饿消失吗？
StoryData/S1024B.json#5#content.en: Will these shoes make the hunger go away?

StoryData/S1024B.json#8#content.zh: 诚然，忍受那份渴望——不，那份饥饿——是桩艰苦的考验。故而……吾始终不懈地压抑着这股冲动。
StoryData/S1024B.json#8#content.en: Verily, 'tis a grievous trial to endure the yearning—nay, hunger. Wherefore... I labor to suppress the urge without end.

StoryData/S1024B.json#9#content.zh: 压抑这股冲动有什么好处？
StoryData/S1024B.json#9#content.en: What's good about suppressing the urge?

StoryData/S1024B.json#10#content.zh: 其一，汝之冒险将不致蒙羞，而会化作汝无需羞于诉说的故事……
StoryData/S1024B.json#10#content.en: For one, thine adventure shall remain unmarred, and become tales thou shan't be ashamed to tell...

StoryData/S1024B.json#11#content.zh: ……借此，汝方能梦见汝所渴望成为的、未来的自己。
StoryData/S1024B.json#11#content.en: ... through which thou mayest dream of the future self thou seekest to become.

StoryData/S1024B.json#12#content.zh: 终有一日，汝将毫无愧色地，向那愿聆听汝一切经历的人，诉说汝的冒险。
StoryData/S1024B.json#12#content.en: And someday, thou wilt, without suffering dishonor, tell all about thine adventures to another soul who shall heed thine accounts.

StoryData/S1024B.json#13#content.en: The self I want to become...

StoryData/S1024B.json#14#content.zh: 布布久久凝视着那双鞋……
StoryData/S1024B.json#14#content.en: Pwie stared at the shoes for a long while...

StoryData/S1024B.json#15#content.zh: 缓缓走上前去，最终把鞋穿上了脚。
StoryData/S1024B.json#15#content.en: And approached them slowly, before finally slipping them on.

StoryData/S1024B.json#17#content.zh: 如今便踏着属于汝自己的鞋，以更饱满的气力继续前行吧！
StoryData/S1024B.json#17#content.en: Now march onward with greater vigor, astride shoes of thine own!

StoryData/S1024B.json#19#content.zh: <但你不觉得……布布最近跟我们跟得比以前更紧了吗？>
StoryData/S1024B.json#19#content.en: <But don't you think... Pwie's started to follow us more closely than before?>

StoryData/S1025B.json#1#content.zh: <color=#E1B643>这是我们第一次离得这么近吧？</color>
StoryData/S1025B.json#1#content.en: <color=#E1B643>This is the first time we've met each other so up close, isn't it?</color>

StoryData/S1025B.json#3#content.zh: 不同于以往听到的那道微弱低语，这次同一个声音却带着仿佛贴耳低语般的清晰，撩拨并温暖着我那说不清道不明的耳朵。与此同时，那声音又像是从一个遥不可及的地方传来，每个字都只为我一人回响。
StoryData/S1025B.json#3#content.en: Unlike the faint murmur I've heard before, the same voice now tickled and warmed my proverbial ear with the clarity of someone whispering right into it. At the same time, it felt as though the voice were speaking from an impossibly far-away place, every word echoing just for me.

StoryData/S1025B.json#4#content.zh: 仿佛我终于被引领着，发现了那份共鸣……那份长久以来一直在呼唤着我的共鸣。是的，那种感觉，正是如此……
StoryData/S1025B.json#4#content.en: As though I've finally been made to discover the resonance... that had been calling out to me for so, so long. Yes, that's how it felt...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.zh: 将皮浸泡在植物鞣剂中，缓慢熟化。这需要耐心与时间，但经受如此漫长工序的皮革，反过来也能维持更久。皮首先源于食肉之物。然而，以这种方式制成的皮革却被称为植鞣革。将植物置入食肉之物，制革便就此完成。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.en: The hide is steeped in plant-based tanning agents and cured slowly. It demands patience and time, but leather that endures such a lengthy process can, in turn, endure for far longer. Hide is, above all else, carnivorous in origin. And yet leather made this way is called veg-tan leather. It is finished by putting the vegetable into the carnivorous.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.zh: 油脂
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.en: Oil

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.zh:
在象征界中，于<color=#F8C200>防御</color>期间应用<color=#F8C200>格挡</color>效果

象征界<color=#00ff9c>体力</color>+4
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.en:
In the Symbolic, applies the <color=#F8C200>Block</color> effect during <color=#F8C200>Garde</color>

Symbolic <color=#00ff9c>HP</color> +4

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.zh: 尖锐的滋滋声。温热的鲜血。汁水横流的肉。对尚未到来的味道与体验满怀期待。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.en: A sharp sizzle. Warm blood. Meat running with juice. Anticipation of flavors and experiences yet to come.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.zh: 红派精品店耳环
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.en: Boutique du Rouge Earrings

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.zh: 象征界中的<color=#fe4b48>攻击速度</color>+10%
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.en: <color=#fe4b48>Attack Speed</color> +10% in the Symbolic

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.zh: 脚越多，能穿的鞋就越多。这不是好事吗？制鞋馆从什么时候开始把腿少当成荣耀了？过去可是腿越多越好。真是的，这世界到底怎么了？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.en: More feet mean more shoes to wear. Isn't that a good thing? Since when has having fewer legs become a mark of honor in the Footwear Hall? In the old days, the more legs one had, the better it was. Seriously, what's the world coming to?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.zh: 红派制鞋馆凉鞋
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.en: Le Rouge Footwear Hall Sandals

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.zh: 在象征界中，<color=#F8C200>前进</color>造成的<color=#fe4b48>伤害</color>+2
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.en: In the Symbolic, <color=#F8C200>Avant</color> <color=#fe4b48>Damage</color> Dealt +2

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.zh: 鞋带闭合鞋的嘴，藏起它的舌头。它将嘴缝死并收紧，使其无法松开。被如此牢固地束缚，鞋或许再也无法说话……但也正因如此，脚的形状得以完全显露。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.en: Laces close the shoe's mouth and hide its tongue. They stitch the mouth shut and pull it tight so that it cannot come undone. Bound so firmly, the shoe may be unable to speak... But this allows for the shape of one's foot to be laid bare.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.zh: 红派制鞋馆孔眼鞋带
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.en: Le Rouge Footwear Hole Shoelaces

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.zh: 在象征界中，连续使用<color=#F8C200>闪避</color>的次数+1
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.en: In the Symbolic, successive <color=#F8C200>Evade</color> Use +1

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.zh: 夹在皮革之间的一块异质金属。搭扣的存在，是为了完成皮革独自无法做到的事。皮革是血肉。搭扣是骨骼。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.en: An alien shard of metal wedged between pieces of hide. The buckle exists to perform what hide alone cannot. Hide is flesh. The buckle is bone.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.zh: 红派箱包馆搭扣
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.en: Le Rouge Handbags Hall Buckle

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.zh: 在象征界中，以<color=#F8C200>攻击连段2</color>命中时<color=#00ff9c>回复</color>1点<color=#00ff9c>体力</color>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.en: In the Symbolic, landing <color=#F8C200>Attack Chain 2</color> <color=#00ff9c>heals</color> 1 <color=#00ff9c>HP</color>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.zh: 这只托特包空间充足，什么都能轻松装下。皮革制成的包看起来会被内容物撑大，但皮革其实并未真正伸展。它只是变得更加柔顺。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.en: This tote has plenty of room and can hold anything without issue. Bags made of hide may seem stretched to match the size of whatever is inside, but the hide does not truly stretch. It merely grows more pliant.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.zh: 红派箱包馆托特包
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.en: Le Rouge Handbags Hall Tote Bag

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.zh: 在象征界中，成功<color=#F8C200>弹反</color>时，向3格内最近的敌人发射1枚<color=#F8C200>追踪弹体</color>，造成2点<color=#fe4b48>伤害</color>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.en: In the Symbolic, upon a successful <color=#F8C200>Parry</color>, fires 1 <color=#F8C200>Homing Projectile</color> at the nearest enemy within 3 tiles, dealing 2 <color=#fe4b48>Damage</color>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.zh: 红派决意塑造赤红之神时，征用了无数箱包。从拆解的箱包躯体上剥下的皮革，有幸成为摇篮的一部分。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.en: When the Rouges resolved to fashion the Crimson God, countless bags were requisitioned. The hide stripped from their dismantled bodies had the honor of becoming part of the Cradle.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.zh: 红派箱包馆单肩包
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.en: Le Rouge Handbags Hall Shoulder Bag

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.zh: 在象征界中，成功<color=#F8C200>弹反</color>时，对攻击被<color=#F8C200>弹反</color>的目标造成的<color=#fe4b48>伤害</color>+2
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.en: In the Symbolic, upon a successful <color=#F8C200>Parry</color>, <color=#fe4b48>Damage</color> Dealt +2 against the target whose attack is <color=#F8C200>Parried</color>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.zh: 无数材料都可以奉献给神明的创造，但最终诞生的巨人永远无法逃离西西弗百货的法则。若想拥有与其他神明相等的权柄，它从一开始就不该诞生在这里。不该只作为百货商场的又一种材料。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.en: Countless materials may be dedicated to the creation of a god, but the resulting Giant will never be able to escape the Grand Magasin's laws. To wield authority equal to that of other gods, it should never have been born here. Not as just another material for the department store.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.zh: 黑派箱包馆手拿包
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.en: Le Noir Handbags Hall Clutch Bag

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.zh: 在象征界中，<color=#F8C200>格挡</color>近战攻击时，对攻击者造成3点<color=#fe4b48>伤害</color>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.en: In the Symbolic, <color=#F8C200>Blocking</color> a melee attack deals 3 <color=#fe4b48>Damage</color> to the attacker

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.zh: 即便如此，也必须阻止它。初生的神依然是神。若允许那东西存在，只会驱使红派啃食、吞噬更多黄金松脂。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.en: Even so, it must be stopped. A fledgling god is still a god. Allow that thing to exist, and it will only drive the Rouges to gnaw away and devour still more Golden Resin.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.zh: 黑派箱包馆双肩包
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.en: Le Noir Handbags Hall Backpack

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.zh: 在象征界中，成功<color=#F8C200>完美格挡</color>时，触发一次<color=#F8C200>追加攻击</color>，对默尔索周围1格内造成2点<color=#fe4b48>伤害</color>（0.1秒受击硬直）
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.en: In the Symbolic, upon a successful <color=#F8C200>Perfect Block</color>, triggers an <color=#F8C200>Extra Attack</color> that deals 2 <color=#fe4b48>Damage</color> within 1 tile of Meursault (0.1 seconds Hitstun)

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.zh: 据说黑派的品牌经理目前无法亲自往返楼层，因此只有距离最近的可用员工被派往奢侈品馆。不知道我们是否成功控制住了那里的局势。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.en: They say the Noirs' Brand Manager could not presently move between floors in person, so only the nearest available employees were sent to the Luxury Hall. I wonder whether we managed to bring the situation there under control.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.zh: 黑派箱包馆包带
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.en: Le Noir Handbags Hall Bag Strap

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.zh: 在象征界中，成功<color=#F8C200>完美格挡</color>时，将默尔索周围1格内的敌人击退1格
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.en: In the Symbolic, upon a successful <color=#F8C200>Perfect Block</color>, knocks back enemies within 1 tile of Meursault by 1 tile

StoryData/S1025B.json#6#content.zh: 请退后。不要回应那个声音。
StoryData/S1025B.json#6#content.en: Please step back. Do not answer the voice.

StoryData/S1025B.json#7#content.zh: 长时间……暴露在阳光下……并不明智……
StoryData/S1025B.json#7#content.en: Prolonged exposure... to the sunshine... is inadvisable...

StoryData/S1025B.json#8#content.zh: 默尔索的警告坚定而清晰——尽管如此，我发现自己竟无法从墙边挪开一步。
StoryData/S1025B.json#8#content.en: Meursault's warning was firm and crystal clear—despite that, I found myself unable to take so much as a single step away from the wall.

StoryData/S1025B.json#9#content.zh: 不止是我。鸿璐和堂吉诃德也像被什么钉在了原地一动不动——事实上，她们似乎连一块肌肉都动弹不得，甚至无法伸手捂住耳朵，把那声音挡在外面。
StoryData/S1025B.json#9#content.en: And I wasn't the only one. Hong Lu and Don Quixote stood rooted in their spots as though something pinned them to the ground—in fact, it appeared that they could not move a single muscle or even move to cover their ears and block out the voice.

StoryData/S1025B.json#10#content.zh: <color=#E1B643>默尔……看来你一如既往地不太乐意听到我的声音呢。</color>
StoryData/S1025B.json#10#content.en: <color=#E1B643>Meur... I can see you're not happy to hear from me, as always.</color>

StoryData/S1025B.json#11#content.zh: <color=#E1B643>可你知道吗……或许你不该让自己对我的厌恶，来决定我该不该跟你的朋友们聊天。/ 这不正是你最讨厌的那种、擅自评判是非对错的行为吗？</color>
StoryData/S1025B.json#11#content.en:
<color=#E1B643>But you know... maybe you shouldn't let your personal distaste for me
dictate whether I should or shouldn't chat with your friends.
Isn't that the sort of judgmental behavior about right and wrong that you so dislike?</color>

StoryData/S1025B.json#12#content.zh: 周遭是客厅的一片寂静，我心不在焉地坐在从窗台缝隙透进来的一小片阳光里。
StoryData/S1025B.json#12#content.en: Surrounded by the silence of the living room, I sat absentmindedly in a patch of sunlight peering through a gap in the windowsill.

StoryData/S1025B.json#13#content.zh: 曾经存在过的东西留下的真空。空气中流转的暖意寒风。阳光。
StoryData/S1025B.json#13#content.en: The vacuum of what was once there. The warm chill circulating the air. The sun.

StoryData/S1025B.json#14#content.zh: 然后……突然间，温暖的阳光充满了我的视野，仿佛我是在正午的公园里睁开了眼睛。
StoryData/S1025B.json#14#content.en: Then... suddenly, warm sunshine filled my vision, as though I had opened my eyes in a park at midday.

StoryData/S1025B.json#15#content.zh: 那光亮得没有边际……我不得不抬手遮住双眼。
StoryData/S1025B.json#15#content.en: It was so boundlessly bright... that I raised my hand to shield my eyes.

StoryData/S1025B.json#17#content.zh: <color=#E1B643>如果我的光芒让你觉得刺眼，那只是因为你在黑暗里待得太久了。</color>
StoryData/S1025B.json#17#content.en: <color=#E1B643>If my light dazzles you, it's only because you've been in the dark for so long.</color>

StoryData/S1025B.json#20#content.zh:
<color=#E1B643>我自认为跟不少沉默寡言的人打过交道，默尔索……
……但你绝对是他们当中最惜字如金的一个。</color>
StoryData/S1025B.json#20#content.en:
<color=#E1B643>I like to think I've spoken with my fair share of buttoned-up people, Meursault...
... but you've got to be the most taciturn out of them all.</color>

StoryData/S1025B.json#21#content.zh:
<color=#E1B643>那一定憋闷得很吧。
在那副安静、沉默的外表之下，是成千上万种念头在咆哮嘶吼……
……却没有一个人停下来听，对不对？

即便有人停下来听了，我想他们也理解不了这个世界在你眼中呈现的模样。</color>
StoryData/S1025B.json#21#content.en:
<color=#E1B643>It must've been so suffocating.
Tens of thousands of thoughts howling under that quiet, taciturn demeanor...
... and no one stopped to listen, did they? 

Even if they had, I don't suppose they would have understood how the world reflects in your eyes.</color>

StoryData/S1025B.json#22#content.zh: 那片阳光的帷幕，用一个美妙的嗓音对我说着话。明亮，令人振奋。
StoryData/S1025B.json#22#content.en: The curtain of sunshine talked to me in a beautiful voice. Bright. Uplifting.

StoryData/S1025B.json#23#content.zh: 它体谅着我心里那些无人理解的东西。它把我从未向任何人展露过的念头，都摊在了阳光下。
StoryData/S1025B.json#23#content.en: It sympathized with the things in my mind that no one understood. It laid bare the thoughts that I had never shown another soul.

StoryData/S1025B.json#24#content.zh: 我明知不该回应那个声音……可我的嘴唇却不受控制地颤动起来。
StoryData/S1025B.json#24#content.en: I knew I must not answer the voice... yet my lips quivered against my will.

StoryData/S1025B.json#25#content.zh: <color=#E1B643>我明白了。你选择了捂住耳朵，紧闭双眼。</color>
StoryData/S1025B.json#25#content.en: <color=#E1B643>I see. You've chosen to cover your ears and squeeze your eyes shut.</color>

StoryData/S1025B.json#26#content.zh:
<color=#E1B643>可是默尔索啊……
如果捂住耳朵就能充耳不闻，闭上眼睛就能视而不见……
……那从一开始，那大概就不是阳光。</color>
StoryData/S1025B.json#26#content.en:
<color=#E1B643>But Meursault...
If it could be unheard by covering your ears, if it could be unseen by closing your eyes...
... then that was probably never the sunlight to begin with.</color>

StoryData/S1025B.json#27#content.zh:
<color=#E1B643>要知道，我最喜欢的那位后辈费尽心思，将这道光点燃升上天空，播撒下来……
……它便会普照每一处，照耀每一个人。它不会区别对待。</color>
StoryData/S1025B.json#27#content.en:
<color=#E1B643>You see, the light that my favorite junior worked so hard to fire up into the sky, to plant...
... shines down everywhere, on everyone. It doesn't discriminate.</color>

StoryData/S1025B.json#29#content.zh:
<color=#E1B643>我想给你的，只是一个选择。
如果你不喜欢听到的内容，随时可以拒绝。</color>
StoryData/S1025B.json#29#content.en:
<color=#E1B643>All I want is to offer you a choice.
You can always say no if you don't like what you hear.</color>

StoryData/S1025B.json#30#content.zh: 空气从我的肺里不受控制地一阵阵漏出——狂喜，欢愉，激动，满怀期盼。每一次呼吸，那些暖洋洋、令人愉悦的情绪都涌进我的鼻腔，积在喉头深处。
StoryData/S1025B.json#30#content.en: Air leaks from my lungs in uncontrolled bursts of gasps—ecstatic, joyful, thrilled, hoping. With every breath I take, the warm, feel-good emotions enter my nose and pool in the back of my throat.

StoryData/S1025B.json#31#content.zh: 我在心底某处数到10，试图把它们按下去。接着，在脑海里数到20。我想象出一排排荒谬的念头。什么都没用。我的声带，被这无处可逃的阳光烤得连根发烫，开始兴奋地发痒。
StoryData/S1025B.json#31#content.en: Somewhere in my heart, I count to 10, trying to contain them. Then, in my head, 20. I imagine ranks upon ranks of absurdities. Nothing works. My vocal cords, heated to the roots by the inescapable sunlight, start to tingle excitedly.

StoryData/S1025B.json#34#content.zh: <color=#E1B643>你能想象吗……独自一人，从这个可怕的世界里被剥离出去，会是什么感觉。</color>
StoryData/S1025B.json#34#content.en: <color=#E1B643>Can you imagine what it'd be like... to be peeled away from this terrifying world? All by yourself.</color>

StoryData/S1025B.json#35#content.zh: <color=#E1B643>如果你再也不必把那些锁链缠在自己身上……再也不必被钉在谁的目光之下，再也不被他人俘获，也不被“常理”束缚，那会怎样？</color>
StoryData/S1025B.json#35#content.en: <color=#E1B643>What if you no longer had to wrap those chains around yourself... no longer be nailed beneath anyone's gaze, no longer captured by others or bound by "common sense"?</color>

StoryData/S1025B.json#36#content.zh: 我在光里被剥得赤裸。阳光揭开一切秘密，向我低语着那一件我一直真心渴望的事。
StoryData/S1025B.json#36#content.en: I am undressed, naked in the light. The sunshine reveals all secrets, and it whispers to me the one thing that I've truly wanted.

StoryData/S1025B.json#37#content.zh: 不必再在意别人的目光。 不必再在意别人的想法。 你可以单纯地做你自己……活成你自己。
StoryData/S1025B.json#37#content.en: No more minding the gaze of others. No more minding the thoughts of others. You could simply be yourself... live as yourself.

StoryData/S1025B.json#39#content.zh: <color=#E1B643>你说得对。都市从未允许过这样的事。</color>
StoryData/S1025B.json#39#content.en: <color=#E1B643>You're right. The City has never allowed such a thing.</color>

StoryData/S1025B.json#40#content.zh:
<color=#E1B643>你不可能知道该怎么做。找不到出路。
对你而言，这个世界始终是陌生的；无论你朝它撞过多少次，
它的回应永远只有沉默……让你变得哑口无言。</color>
StoryData/S1025B.json#40#content.en:
<color=#E1B643>You couldn't possibly have known how. Couldn't find the path.
To you, the world remained foreign; however many times you struck against it,
its only response was silence... rendering you mute.</color>

StoryData/S1025B.json#41#content.zh: 但一个崭新的时代，随着这道阳光已然降临。 一个你可以尽情呼喊，而……人们愿意倾听的崭新时代。
StoryData/S1025B.json#41#content.en: But a new era has come, bearing this sunlight. A new age where you can howl as loudly as you wish, and... people will listen.

StoryData/S1025B.json#43#content.zh:
<color=#E1B643>让我来帮你吧。
哪怕你的颜色是旁人无法理解的，
哪怕那颜色只存在于你自己的眼中……
我也会帮你，用它去描绘这个世界。</color>
StoryData/S1025B.json#43#content.en:
<color=#E1B643>Let me help you. 
Even if yours is a color no other person can understand,
even if that color remains only in your eyes... 
I'll still help you paint the world with it.</color>

StoryData/S1025B.json#44#content.zh: ……你也向我母亲提出过同样的提议吗？
StoryData/S1025B.json#44#content.en: ... Did you make the same offer to my mother?

StoryData/S1025B.json#45#content.zh:
<color=#E1B643>或许相似……但并不相同。
人总喜欢以为彼此理解，以为自己遇到了知己……
但到头来，他们对彼此一无所知——也不可能知道。
毕竟，我们都是各自独立的存在。</color>
StoryData/S1025B.json#45#content.en:
<color=#E1B643>Similar, maybe... but not the same.
People like to think they understand one another, think they're kindred spirits...
But in the end, they understand nothing about others—they can't.
We're all our own beings, after all.</color>

StoryData/S1025B.json#46#content.zh: 那道欢快的声音，仿佛挠到了我心底深处一个任何手都够不到的痒处。
StoryData/S1025B.json#46#content.en: The cheerful voice seemed to scratch an itch buried deep in my heart, somewhere no hand could ever reach.

StoryData/S1025B.json#47#content.zh: 你可以实现你的愿望。而那要从坦诚面对此刻在你心里翻涌的情绪开始。
StoryData/S1025B.json#47#content.en: You can get your wish. And that begins by being honest about the feelings bubbling inside you right this moment.

StoryData/S1025B.json#48#content.zh: <color=#E1B643>没关系的，默尔。你可以把那份情绪……说出声来。</color>
StoryData/S1025B.json#48#content.en: <color=#E1B643>It's all right, Meur. You're allowed to give voice... to that emotion.</color>

StoryData/S1025B.json#53#content.zh: 我尽可能把心中的不悦表现在回答里……
StoryData/S1025B.json#53#content.en: I tried to make my discomfort as evident as possible in my reply...

StoryData/S1025B.json#54#content.zh: ……可那阳光里，仍带着一丝隐约的、欢快的笑意。
StoryData/S1025B.json#54#content.en: ... But still there was a hint of laughter in the sunshine, full of cheer.

StoryData/S1025B.json#56#content.zh:
<color=#E1B643>我不会抛弃任何人。
再说……这家百货商店里的孩子们，需要阳光。
他们需要温暖、柔和的阳光照耀在自己身上。</color>
StoryData/S1025B.json#56#content.en:
<color=#E1B643>I don't turn my back on anyone.
Besides... the children in this department store need sunlight.
They need warm, gentle sunlight to shine on them.</color>

StoryData/S1025B.json#57#content.zh:
<color=#E1B643>这些孩子……他们的存在，源于有人在注视着他们。
那是他们的愿望，而我不过是想成全罢了。</color>
StoryData/S1025B.json#57#content.en:
<color=#E1B643>These children... they derive their existence from the fact that someone is gazing at them.
That is their wish, and I simply intend to grant it.</color>

StoryData/S1025B.json#58#content.zh:
<color=#E1B643>想象一下吧，默尔索。
想象这些沉闷的天花板和墙壁消失不见，露出外面的世界。
每个人都能一同躺在一片温暖的阳光里，仰望头顶那片辽阔的天空。</color>
StoryData/S1025B.json#58#content.en:
<color=#E1B643>Imagine it, Meursault.
Imagine these stuffy ceilings and walls falling away to reveal the world outside.
Everyone gets to rest together in a warm patch of sunshine, taking in the vast sky above.</color>

StoryData/S1025B.json#60#content.zh: <color=#E1B643>还是这么安静啊。你从那时起就一点都没变。</color>
StoryData/S1025B.json#60#content.en: <color=#E1B643>Still so quiet. You haven't changed at all since then.</color>

StoryData/S1025B.json#61#content.zh: <color=#E1B643>但丁，看来你这位经理，还得再多费点心才行。</color>
StoryData/S1025B.json#61#content.en: <color=#E1B643>Dante, I suppose you'll have to work a little harder as their Manager.</color>

StoryData/S1025B.json#64#content.zh: <抱、抱歉，我也不知道自己刚才为什么会那样……>
StoryData/S1025B.json#64#content.en: <S-sorry, I don't know why I did...>

StoryData/S1025B.json#65#content.zh: <color=#E1B643>至于默尔索……在这一轮与你同行的旅途结束之前，他或许还会改变。</color>
StoryData/S1025B.json#65#content.en: <color=#E1B643>As for Meursault... He may change yet... by the end of this round of the journey at your side.</color>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 啊……终于得以从那洗手间般的牢笼中解脱了……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: Ah... At last, to be graced with the sweet release from the gaol that was the restroom...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: *叹气*……真是可怜！诚然，无聊的疯病竟连小鸿璐也不放过，肆虐得他如今已开始跟茅厕外的世界攀谈起来……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: *sigh* ... What pity! Verily, the madness of boredom spareth not even young Hong Lu in its merciless rampage, for he hath begun to converse with the very world outside the restroom...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 吾亦曾为寻些乐子，与那位沉默的女士进行过瞪眼比赛……然而十局下来，吾竟无一局能胜……乏味实乃劲敌，竟能惑乱心智，使人将空气都视作同伴……唔唔……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: I too, in search of excitement, had attempted to engage in a contest of staring with the wordless lady... Yet of all 10 bouts, I failed to seize even a single victory... Tedium is indeed a formidable adversary, for it confuseth the mind to make fellows out of the very air... Hmm hmm...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 哎，我可不是在跟空气打招呼呀，堂吉诃德！我们这儿来了位新朋友，你看？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: Ah, I wasn't saying hello to the air, Don Quixote! We have a new friend with us, see?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 但丁，能劳烦你给我们介绍一下吗？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: Would you kindly introduce us, Dante?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 啊……原来如此。看来这位小娃娃是一路跟在我们身后的……不知是何方神圣？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: A-ah, quite true. It appeareth that the little bairn is on our heels... Whoever might they be?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 他们是我们在二楼捡到的。我们现在的目标，是把他们带去五楼。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: They are someone we picked up on the second floor. Our current objective is to bring them to the fifth floor.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 那是一种无需言明的相互默许。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: There was a mutual consent of unspoken nature.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: <红派拜托我们把他们送去五楼……>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: <The Rouges requested that we bring them to the fifth floor...>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 哦，你说是一份委托？那便是契约了！幸会，吾乃堂吉诃德！成为最出色的收尾人，便是吾之梦想！不知汝又是何方神圣？！
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: Ooh, a request, thou sayest? This be a contract, then! Well met, I am Don Quixote! 'Tis my dream to become the best Fixer there is! And whoever might thou be?!

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 唉，经理阁下？可否劳烦你为吾等引荐一番……？吾很想以一个名字来称呼这孩子，尽管他们或许连自己的名字都说不出来……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: Eh, Manager Esquire? Wouldst thou do the honors of introduction...? I would much like to call this child by a name, though they might not speak their own...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: <诶、诶？我们还没问过他们叫什么名字……>
哦嚯？！汝与这孩子同行了这么久，竟从未想过要问他们的名字！？敢问，你们至今为止，究竟是怎么称呼这孩子的？！
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: Hoh?! Hast thou traveled so long with this child and thought not to ask their name!? Pray, just what have you been calling this child thus far?!

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 这话说得有点欠考虑了，但丁。他们可是要跟我们一起踏上这段旅程的人——就算只是短短一段，我们至少也该努力记住人家的名字吧。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: That's a bit insensitive, Dante. They're someone who'll be coming along with us on this journey—the least we could do is try to learn their name, even if it's only for a short while.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: <品牌主管……没告诉我们这孩子叫什么……>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: <The Brand Director... didn't tell us the kid's name...>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: <那、那个，我该怎么称呼这孩子呢？要不我们给他们起个名字？>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: <U-uhm, what should I call this kid? Should we name them?>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 唔……不如我们直接问问他们本人？就算是还在学说话的孩子，有时候也能发出自己名字的音呢。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: Hmm... Why don't we ask them? Even children who are still learning how to speak sometimes know how to pronounce their own names.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 我们想请你告诉我们你的名字。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: We would like you to tell us your name.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 啊哈！你的名字真可爱呀～
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: Aha! What an adorable name you have~

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.zh: 一个盛满了足以迸裂的泪水；另一个，一滴也没有。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.en: One carries enough tears to burst; the other, not a drop.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.zh: 媒染剂
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.en: Mordant

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.zh:
在象征界中，<color=#F8C200>疾跑</color>时留下持续3秒的<color=#F8C200>黄色脓液格</color>
- 站在这些格子上的敌人移动速度-30%

象征界<color=#00ff9c>体力</color>+4
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.en:
In the Symbolic, <color=#F8C200>Sprinting</color> leaves behind <color=#F8C200>Yellow Pus Tiles</color> that last for 3 seconds
- Enemies standing on these tiles have Movement Speed -30%

Symbolic <color=#00ff9c>HP</color> +4

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.zh: 墙壁出现裂缝、声音渗入的那一天，兄弟姐妹各自许下了不同的愿望。一个希望再也不会受伤，另一个希望再也不会悲伤。摆脱伤痛的那个如今可以浸没在泪水中，因为令人落泪的并不只有疼痛。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.en: On the day cracks formed on the walls, on the day the Voice leached in, the siblings each made a different wish. One wished to never hurt again. The other wished to never be sad again. The one freed from hurt can now be soaked in tears, for it is not pain that draws tears.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.zh: 染料
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.en: Dyestuff

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.zh:
在象征界中，以<color=#F8C200>攻击连段2</color>命中时触发一次<color=#F8C200>追加攻击</color>（1秒受击硬直）
- 对被命中敌人3格内随机1名敌人造成4点<color=#fe4b48>伤害</color>
- 触发<color=#F8C200>追加攻击</color>后，有（80-触发次数×20）%概率对被命中目标1格内随机1名敌人再次触发
- 可以连锁（最多5次；最低触发概率10%）

在象征界中，<color=#F8C200>攻击连段2</color>范围+1格
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.en:
In the Symbolic, landing <color=#F8C200>Attack Chain 2</color> triggers an <color=#F8C200>Extra Attack</color> (1 second Hitstun)
- Deals 4 <color=#fe4b48>Damage</color> to 1 random enemy within 3 tiles of the enemy hit
- After triggering the <color=#F8C200>Extra Attack</color>, (80 - trigger count x 20)% chance to trigger again on 1 random enemy within 1 tile of the target hit
- Can be chained (max 5 times; 10% minimum trigger chance)

In the Symbolic, <color=#F8C200>Attack Chain 2</color> range +1 tile

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.zh: 随着时间流逝，楼层经理的形态扭曲成适合纺车无尽转动的模样。同一股意志保护她免于成为失去心智的人台，并将她分成三个部分。三者其实为一。我们自己也不过是各个部分组成的整体。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.en: Over time, the Floor Manager's form warped into a shape suited to the endless turning of the spinning wheel. That same will protected her from becoming a mindless Mannequin, splitting her into three parts. The three are, in fact, one. We, too, are all but wholes of parts ourselves.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.zh: 钉针
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.en: Naildle

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.zh:
在象征界中，为<color=#F8C200>前进</color>解放<color=#F8C200>攻击连段3</color>

- 触发<color=#F8C200>攻击连段3</color>时，象征界造成的<color=#fe4b48>伤害</color>+2、受击硬直+0.1秒，并<color=#00ff9c>回复</color>1点<color=#00ff9c>体力</color>
- 被此攻击击败的敌人不会当场化为尸体，而是被击退5格
- 敌人在击退期间发生碰撞时，立即爆炸，对1格内造成2点<color=#fe4b48>伤害</color>，随后化为尸体
- 若未发生碰撞，则在击退结束时爆炸，对1格内造成2点<color=#fe4b48>伤害</color>，随后化为尸体
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.en:
In the Symbolic, unlocks <color=#F8C200>Attack Chain 3</color> for <color=#F8C200>Avant</color>

- Upon triggering <color=#F8C200>Attack Chain 3</color>, Symbolic <color=#fe4b48>Damage</color> Dealt +2, Hitstun +0.1s, and <color=#00ff9c>heals</color> 1 <color=#00ff9c>HP</color>
- Enemies defeated by this attack are knocked back 5 tiles instead of becoming corpses on the spot
- If the enemy collides during knockback, it immediately explodes, dealing 2 <color=#fe4b48>Damage</color> within 1 tile, then becomes a corpse
- If no collision occurs, it explodes at the end of the knockback, dealing 2 <color=#fe4b48>Damage</color> within 1 tile, then becomes a corpse

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.zh:
他们转动纺车，纺出丝线。

他们如此劳作了太久，以至于因果本身也扭曲并卷入自身。是为了转动纺车而纺线，还是为了纺线而转动纺车？这个问题已经无法回答，但并不重要。在这一层，“为什么”无足轻重。楼层经理的职责始于且终于一个单一功能：纺出丝线，并将其交给收取者。因此，即使纺线者死去，纺车也不会停止。丝线在此等待尖钉到来，将此处与彼处系在一起。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.en:
They turn the wheel to spin the thread.

They have done so for so long that causality itself has warped into itself. Does one spin thread to turn the wheel, or turn the wheel to spin thread? The question has become unanswerable, but it does not matter. On this floor, the "why" is of little significance. The Floor Manager's role begins and ends with a singular function: to spin thread and give it to its recipient. Thus, the spinning wheel does not stop even when the spinners die. The thread waits here for the arrival of the nail, to tether the here to the there.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.zh: 纺车
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.en: Spinning Wheel

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.zh:
在象征界中解放<color=#F8C200>针刺弹体</color>
- 向10格内最远的敌人发射造成3点<color=#fe4b48>伤害</color>的弹体（冷却时间3秒，0.5秒受击硬直）
- 弹体命中时，有（100/效果触发次数）%概率向附近敌人再次发射弹体

在阴影界战斗期间，布布获得1点脉动威力
- 使用“走开”技能时，每2点脉动威力使攻击加权值+1（最多+2）
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.en:
Unlocks <color=#F8C200>Needle Projectile</color> in the Symbolic
- Fires a projectile dealing 3 <color=#fe4b48>Damage</color> against the farthest enemy within 10 tiles (cooldown 3 seconds, 0.5 seconds Hitstun)
- When the projectile hits, fires another Projectile against a nearby enemy with a (100 / number of times the effect triggers)% chance

During battle in the Shadowed, Pwie gains 1 Pulsation Potency
- On "Go Away" Skill Use, Atk Weight +1 for every 2 Pulsation Potency (max 2)

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.zh: 一坐上去便会碎裂的椅子。正因如此，它才价格昂贵。购买者明知它会碎裂，仍会买下它。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.en: A chair that shatters the moment one sits. That is why it is expensive. One purchases it knowing it will break.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.zh: 玻璃椅
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.en: Glass Chair

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.zh: 在象征界中，「实木桌」<color=#F8C200>追加攻击</color>范围纵横各+1格
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.en: In the Symbolic, 「Solid Wood Table」<color=#F8C200>Extra Attack</color> range +1 tile (both vertical and horizontal)

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.zh:
古老之物被冲上岸边。它们不属于西西弗百货，而是上个时代破碎且注定进一步破碎的遗留物。
因为这里如今是一座依照他人设计建造的百货商场。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.en:
Things of eld are beached upon the Shore. They are not of the Grand Magasin, but remnants of the previous age, broken and fated to break further.
For this place is now a department store built from another's design.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.zh: 钓竿
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.en: Fishing Rod

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.zh:
在象征界中，攻击命中时有30%概率触发<color=#F8C200>黑水追加攻击</color>，造成3点<color=#fe4b48>伤害</color>（1秒受击硬直）
- 对被命中敌人3格内随机1名敌人触发<color=#F8C200>黑水追加攻击</color>（最多3次）
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.en:
In the Symbolic, 30% chance to trigger <color=#F8C200>Blackwater Extra Attack</color>, dealing 3 <color=#fe4b48>Damage</color> upon landing an attack (1 second Hitstun)
- Triggers <color=#F8C200>Blackwater Extra Attack</color> on 1 random enemy within 3 tiles of the enemy hit (3 times max)

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.zh: 若再也无法听见赤红之神那赤红的声音，那便让它重新响起。这是红派珍视的愿望……也是他们被指派的劳作。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.en: If the Crimson God's crimson Voice can no longer be heard, then make it heard. This is the cherished wish of the Rouges... and their appointed labor.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.zh: 红派精品店项链
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.en: Boutique du Rouge Necklace

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.zh:
在象征界中，进行<color=#F8C200>闪避</color>时，有20%概率触发一次<color=#F8C200>雷击追加攻击</color>（0.5秒受击硬直）
- 雷击对3格内随机1名敌人造成2点<color=#fe4b48>伤害</color>

象征界<color=#00ff9c>体力</color>+2
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.en:
In the Symbolic, upon <color=#F8C200>Evading</color>, 20% chance to trigger a <color=#F8C200>Lightning Strike Extra Attack</color> (0.5 seconds Hitstun)
- Lightning Strike deals 2 <color=#fe4b48>Damage</color> to 1 random enemy within 3 tiles

Symbolic <color=#00ff9c>HP</color> +2

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.zh: 堆砌。覆盖。隐藏。保护。保存。此即黑派坚定不移的美德。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.en: To build up. To cover. To conceal. To protect. To preserve. Such are the steadfast virtues of Le Noir.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.zh: 黑派之家高顶礼帽
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.en: Maison du Noir Top Hat

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.zh: 在象征界中，<color=#F8C200>攻击连段2</color>范围+1格
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.en: In the Symbolic, <color=#F8C200>Attack Chain 2</color> range +1 tile

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.zh: 水族箱曾容纳无数鱼类与各式水槽。鳞片、水流与玻璃围栏贯穿形形色色的环境。最底层流淌着由黑之丝编织而成的水，其中有一条鱼静静沉睡。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.en: The Aquarium once held countless fish and tanks of every kind. Scales, waters, and glass enclosures threaded through environments of every variety. Lowest of all flowed water woven from Blackthread, and within it slept a fish in silence.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.zh: 抄网
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.en: Scoop Net

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.zh:
在象征界中，击杀敌人时有20%概率生成<color=#F8C200>黑色幼虫</color>
- <color=#F8C200>黑色幼虫</color>会爬向10格内最近的敌人
- 接触敌人时，或未能在3秒内接触敌人时，当场爆炸
- 爆炸时，对1格内造成5点<color=#fe4b48>伤害</color>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.en:
In the Symbolic, upon killing an enemy, 20% chance to generate <color=#F8C200>Black Larva</color>
- <color=#F8C200>Black Larva</color> crawls to the nearest enemy within 10 tiles
- When it touches an enemy, or if it fails to touch an enemy within 3 seconds, detonates on the spot
- Upon detonation, deal 5 <color=#fe4b48>Damage</color> within 1 tile

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.zh:
水族箱转变为西西弗百货时，水族箱的一切残余本应随之消失。然而，仍有某物留了下来——某个依旧记得自己曾在那里度过的时光之物。对长期被认为毫无缺陷的西西弗系统而言，这是必须修正的缺陷。

不知为何，那条未曾成为顾客便被遗留下来的鱼，无论西西弗百货重置多少次，都仍将是一条鱼。

要修正西西弗系统中的这一缺陷，负责那条鱼的罪人便必须死去。

但西西弗系统既是惩罚装置、资源收集设备，也是N公司道德观的具现。依照设计，它无法强行杀死自己的囚犯。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.en:
When the Aquarium transformed into the Grand Magasin, every remnant of the Aquarium should have disappeared with it. Yet something remained—something that still remembers its time there. For the Sisyphe System, which had long been believed to be flawless, this is a defect that must be resolved.

For whatever reason, the fish that was left behind without ever becoming a customer will remain a fish, no matter how many times the Grand Magasin resets.

To correct this flaw within the Sisyphe System, the Sinner responsible for that fish would have to die.

But the Sisyphe System is at once a punishment device, a resource-harvesting apparatus, and an embodiment of N Corp.'s morality. By design, it cannot forcibly kill one of its own prisoners.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.zh: 承载虚无之眼
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.en: Voidbearing Eye

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.zh:
在象征界中，强化布布的<color=#F8C200>监督者弹体</color>
- 弹体命中时，对2格内造成3点<color=#fe4b48>伤害</color>（0.1秒受击硬直）
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.en:
In the Symbolic, enhance Pwie's <color=#F8C200>Overseer Projectile</color>
- Upon landing the projectile, deals 3 <color=#fe4b48>Damage</color> within 2 tiles (0.1 seconds Hitstun)

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 我猜祂的名字是布布，但丁。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: I think their name is Pwie, Dante.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 哦，多么妙趣横生的名字啊，小布布！
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: Oooh, what a whimsical name thou hast, young Pwie!

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: <呃……你确定那是他们的全名吗？>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: <Uhm... Are you sure that's their full name?>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 如此浅薄的见识！放开你的心胸吧，经理阁下，每一个名字都是高贵的，都配得上属于它自己的一口气息！
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: Such narrow-mindedness! Expand the horizons of thy mind, Manager Esquire, for all names are noble and worthy of their breaths!

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 咳咳！吾在此张开双臂，欢迎汝加入吾等的冒险小队，小布布！
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: Ahem! I welcome thee with open arms into our adventuring party, young Pwie!

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 在启程之前，吾必须提醒汝：前路必将充满艰险！但汝无需担忧——无论遇上怎样的苦难，吾，堂吉——
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: I must warn thee afore we are to proceed: the journey ahead shall be fraught with danger! Yet worry thee not—for no matter the hardship, I, Don Q—

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: ……为何汝要站得如此遥远，小布布？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: ... Wherefore is it that thou standest at such a distance, young Pwie?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: <……我觉得他们只是对我们所有人都心存戒备。>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: <... I think they're just wary of us in general.>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 但是……从我们从二楼到四楼这一路短短的旅程中所看到的，我觉得布布最害怕的人……是默尔索和我。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: But... from what I've been able to see from our brief journey from the second to the fourth floor, I think the people Pwie was most afraid of... are Meursault and me.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 喔喔……仿佛我们穿过了一道门，走进了另一个世界。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: Ooooh... 'Tis as though we have walked through a portal into another world.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 汝可有什么想法要分享吗，小布布？来这儿，来这儿！喔喔……唔喔……！这家百货商店里，不知还藏着什么样的奇珍异宝呢？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: Hast thou any thoughts to share, young Pwie? Hie thee here, here! Ooooh... Hoooh...! What other wondrous curiosities await in this department store, I wonder?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 你再凑近一点，恐怕就要把那鞋吃下去了，堂吉诃德。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: Lean any closer, and you might end up eating the shoe, Don Quixote.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 咳咳，吾不过是在仔细端详一番罢了，仅此而已……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: Ahem, 'tis but a close inspection, nothing more...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 四脚人，你真是丢人现眼。分明只托付了你一件事——就一件——保持店内清洁。可我瞧见，你竟把这么简单的差事，办得一塌糊涂。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: What a disgrace you are, Four-legs. You were entrusted with but one duty—one—the shop's cleanliness. Yet I see that you've failed spectacularly at that simple task.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 尊敬的单脚人，我确实辜负了您。因我的愚钝与懈怠，未能完成这份简单的职责。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: I have indeed failed you, honorable One-leg. I couldn't carry out that simple duty on account of my stupidity and idleness.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 四脚人，你之所以要拖着那双难看的腿走路，是有原因的。愿你每迈出一步，都铭记这一点。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: There is a reason you are made to drag those unsightly legs with you, Four-legs. Remind yourself of that with every step you take.
... I understand, One-leg. My deepest apologies.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 恕我方才那副丢人的模样，尊贵的客人。鄙人虽卑微，如今便由我来为您效劳……当然，前提是您能容忍我这粗鄙之身。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: Forgive that shameful display, dear customer. Lowly though I am, I will now attend to you instead. ... Should you tolerate my vulgar presence, of course.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 都……都还好吗？那位独腿的女士，方才似乎欺凌汝甚是苛刻。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: Is... is all well? That one-legged woman seemed to be bullying thee quite harshly.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 在裁缝的技艺中，鞋子是一件为触碰大地、使躯体免受尘垢玷污而精心制成的衣物。触地的脚越少，其存在便越高贵——单只鞋履的意义，便也愈发崇高。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: In the sartorial arts, a shoe is an article of clothing wrought to meet the ground and spare the body from the impurities of dirt. The fewer the feet that touch the ground, the nobler the being—and the more exalted the purpose of the lone shoe.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 正如我们的名号所示，像鄙人这般卑微的四脚人，行走于世间时，肢体未免过多……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: As our names suggest, lowly Four-legs like myself walk the earth with too many appendages...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 制鞋馆全体员工共同的夙愿，便是超脱升华为更高的存在——那便是“单脚人”，其存在本身，便昂然平衡于一条腿之上。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: The universal aspiration of the Footwear Hall employees is to ascend into a higher state of being—"One-leg," whose sheer existence is balanced proudly upon a single leg.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 这……这样啊……既然汝这么说……那么，要成为一位……“单脚人”，须得如何？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: W-well... If thou sayest so... Then what must one do to become a... "One-leg"?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 不知疲倦地精心制鞋。忠诚不渝地售卖它们。磨砺自身的躯体，使双脚愈发少地踏上大地。坚忍与执着，便是我们的救赎——
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: Craft shoes with tireless devotion. Sell them in faithfulness. Discipline the body so that fewer and fewer feet may tread upon the ground. Perseverance and persistence shall be our salvation—

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 若你们还在问这种问题，想必是刚到这层楼不久吧。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: You must all be quite new to this floor, if you're still asking questions like that.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.zh: 味道……有那么重要吗？你又不知道蠕蠕好不好吃。如果你无论如何都想吃蠕蠕……你以前吃过蠕蠕吗？可是……味道一直都在变化。你为什么觉得蠕蠕还会和以前一样好吃？而且……蠕蠕就在这里。根本没人吃过蠕蠕。真奇怪……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.en: Is taste... that important? You don't know if Wriggley's gonna be tasty or not. If you wanna eat Wriggley anyway... have you eaten Wriggley before? But... taste is changing all the time. Why do you think Wriggley'll taste the same again? And... Wriggley's right here. No one's eaten Wriggley. Weird...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.zh: 针线之王的线团
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.en: Clew of the King of Needleworks

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.zh:
在象征界中，强化布布的<color=#F8C200>针刺弹体</color>
- 贯穿轨迹上的敌人，造成2点<color=#fe4b48>伤害</color>

在阴影界战斗期间，强化布布的“打起精神”技能
- 命中时，不施加<color=#F8C200>拼点威力强化</color>，改为施加1层<color=#F8C200>基础威力强化</color>
- 命中时施加的<color=#F8C200>攻击等级强化</color>会在下回合再次施加
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.en:
In the Symbolic, enhance Pwie's <color=#F8C200>Needle Projectile</color>
- Punches through enemies in its trajectory, dealing 2 <color=#fe4b48>Damage</color>

During battle in the Shadowed, enhance Pwie's "Perk Up" Skill
- On Hit, instead of applying <color=#F8C200>Clash Power Up</color>, apply 1 <color=#F8C200>Base Power Up</color>
- Applies <color=#F8C200>Offense Level Up</color> applied On Hit next turn as well

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.zh: ……我不明白。我们初次见面时，你想杀死默尔索、但丁和我。我需要你身上的东西……但你不肯给，所以真的没有其他办法了，对吧？你会死是因为……因为你很邪恶……而且也很弱。那为什么我会这么难受？你明明也做了同样的事——为什么……为什么只有我留下来承受这份罪恶感？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.en: ... I don't understand. You tried to kill Meursault, Dante, and me when we first met. I need something from you... but you won't give it, so there's really no other way, right? You die because... because you're evil... And weak, too. So why do I feel so awful? You did the same thing—Why... why am I the only one left to feel this guilt?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.zh: 洁净围裙
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.en: Clean Apron

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.zh:
在象征界中，强化布布的<color=#F8C200>黑水弹体</color>
- 在落点1格内生成<color=#F8C200>黑水格</color>（持续5秒）
- 处于受影响格子上的敌人：
  - 每2秒受到2点<color=#fe4b48>伤害</color>
  - 移动速度-20%

在阴影界战斗期间，强化布布的“赤红尖钉之洗礼”技能
- 使用时，目标每有4层<color=#F8C200>流血</color>，基础威力+1（最多+2）
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.en:
In the Symbolic, enhance Pwie's <color=#F8C200>Blackwater Projectile</color>
- Generate <color=#F8C200>Blackwater Tile</color> within 1 tile of the landing point (duration: 5 seconds)
- Enemies on top of affected tiles:
  - Take 2 <color=#fe4b48>Damage</color> every 2 seconds 
  - Movement Speed -20%
