During battle in the Shadowed, enhance Pwie's "Baptism of Crimson Nails" Skill
- On Use, Base Power +1 for every 4 <color=#F8C200>Bleed</color> on target (max 2)

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.zh: 有人在鸟笼中寻求安稳的睡眠。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.en: Some seek a peaceful sleep inside the birdcage.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.zh: 毛毯
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.en: Blanket

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.zh: 在象征界中，进行<color=#F8C200>格挡</color>时受到攻击，承受的<color=#fe4b48>伤害</color>-20%
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.en: In the Symbolic, <color=#fe4b48>Damage</color> Taken -20% when hit while <color=#F8C200>Blocking</color>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.zh:
摆脱悲伤之人会忘记眼泪。
他们变得干燥、僵硬而锐利。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.en:
Those who are freed from sadness forget tears.
They become dry, rigid, and cutting.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.zh: 软骨
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.en: Cartilage

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.zh:
在象征界中解放3级<color=#F8C200>防御</color>
- <color=#F8C200>防御</color>时间：3秒
- <color=#F8C200>防御</color><color=#fe4b48>伤害</color>：象征界攻击<color=#fe4b48>伤害</color>+3

在象征界中，<color=#F8C200>防御</color><color=#F8C200>突进</color>距离+2格
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.en:
Unlocks Level 3 <color=#F8C200>Garde</color> in the Symbolic
- <color=#F8C200>Garde</color> Time: 3 seconds
- <color=#F8C200>Garde</color> <color=#fe4b48>Damage</color>: Attack <color=#fe4b48>Damage</color> +3 in the Symbolic

In the Symbolic, <color=#F8C200>Garde</color> <color=#F8C200>Dash</color> distance +2 tiles

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.zh:
不属于百货商场的某物留下的烟灰。

西西弗系统随着时代变迁一次又一次改变形态。西西弗百货不过是其一名巨人——也就是同时身为改造师的建筑师——认为最便于在象征界中实现、也最适合实现的形态。

依据被指派到这一职位的人选，西西弗系统可以化作百货商场、水族箱、加油站、洞窟、山脉，或完全不同的其他事物。

它是百货商场还是洞窟并不重要。无论采取何种形态，西西弗系统总会在内部构建某种制造“落差”或波动的手段。巨人所需要的，只是一个能够想象这种结构的视角。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.en:
Soot left behind by something that does not belong to the department store.

The Sisyphe System has changed its form time and again with each passing age. Grand Magasin Sisyphe is simply the form one of its Giants—namely the Architect, who was also an Alterationist—deemed the most convenient and suitable for realization within the Symbolic.

Depending on who is assigned to this position, the Sisyphe System may take the form of a department store, an aquarium, a gas station, a cave, a mountain range, or something else entirely.

Whether it is a department store or a cave is beside the point. Whatever shape it takes, the Sisyphe System will always construct some means of creating a "drop", or fluctuations, within itself. All the Giant needs is a perspective capable of imagining such a structure.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.zh: 烟灰
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.en: Soot

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.zh:
在象征界中，将3级<color=#F8C200>防御</color>作为<color=#F8C200>攻击连段3</color>发动
- 所有动作与效果均以<color=#F8C200>攻击连段3</color>生效
- 玩家持有「糊状诱饵」时，动作以<color=#F8C200>攻击连段3</color>生效
- 此效果发动时，同时触发<color=#F8C200>攻击连段2</color>效果与<color=#F8C200>攻击连段3</color>效果
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.en:
In the Symbolic, activates Level 3 <color=#F8C200>Garde</color> as <color=#F8C200>Attack Chain 3</color>
- All motions and effects are applied as <color=#F8C200>Attack Chain 3</color>
- When player has 「Paste Bait」, motion is applied as <color=#F8C200>Attack Chain 3</color>
- When this effect activates, triggers both <color=#F8C200>Attack Chain 2</color> effect and <color=#F8C200>Attack Chain 3</color> effect

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.zh:
线与针。地下2层因这两个概念的需要而建成。

线试图穿入针中，而针渴望被穿入。要触及本质，自身也必须贴近本质；因此，越深入地下，存在的清晰度就越会模糊并分裂，直至被还原为零碎片段的集合。
线与针的概念确实十分接近衣物的本质，却并不等同于本质。操纵丝线的改造师走向溶解，是不可避免的命运。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.en:
Thread and needle. B2F was built from the need for these two concepts.

Thread seeks to penetrate the needle, while the needle longs to be penetrated. To handle the essence, one must draw close to the essence oneself; therefore, the deeper one descends to the basement, the clarity of existence blurs and segments until it is reduced to a collection of bits.
Though the concept of thread and needle does, indeed, approach the essence of clothing closely, it is not the same as the essence. The dissolving of the Alterationist, who handles thread, is an inevitable fate.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.zh: 针线之王的直针
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.en: Straight Pin of the King of Needleworks

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.zh:
在象征界中，以<color=#F8C200>攻击连段2</color>命中时，施加<color=#F8C200>针线之王的标记</color>
- 仅在不存在带有此<color=#F8C200>标记</color>的目标时施加该效果
- 针线之王的标记持续5秒
- 受影响目标移动速度-30%
- 受影响目标被击杀时，对3格内造成3点<color=#fe4b48>伤害</color>（0.1秒受击硬直）
- 效果持续时间结束后，移除标记并造成5点<color=#fe4b48>伤害</color>
- 若该伤害击杀受影响目标，则对1格内造成3点<color=#fe4b48>伤害</color>（0.1秒受击硬直）
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.en:
In the Symbolic, upon landing <color=#F8C200>Attack Chain 2</color>, inflict <color=#F8C200>Mark of the King of Needleworks</color>
- Inflicts this effect only when there are no targets that have this <color=#F8C200>Mark</color>
- Mark of the King of Needleworks duration: 5 seconds
- Affected target Movement Speed -30%
- When the affected target is killed, deals 3 <color=#fe4b48>Damage</color> within 3 tiles (0.1 seconds Hitstun)
- After the effect duration expires, removes the Mark and deals 5 <color=#fe4b48>Damage</color>
- If that Damage kills the affected target, deals 3 <color=#fe4b48>Damage</color> within 1 tile (0.1 seconds Hitstun)

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.zh: “我在袭击者中看见了红派的品牌总监。她将一枚卵抱在胸前。我能感觉到——从中散发出的微弱神圣暖意。啊……我想我或许明白，她屠杀我们所有人究竟是为了达成什么……”
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.en: "I saw the Rouges' Brand Director among the raiders. She held an egg against her chest. I could feel it—the faint, godly warmth that spread from within it.  Ah... I think I may understand what she slaughtered us all to accomplish..."

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.zh: 某黑派的笔记
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.en: A Noir's Note

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.zh: 在象征界中进行<color=#F8C200>格挡</color>后，下一次攻击造成的<color=#fe4b48>伤害</color>+2（冷却时间5秒）
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.en: After <color=#F8C200>Blocking</color> in the Symbolic, <color=#fe4b48>Damage</color> Dealt +2 on the next attack (5 seconds cooldown)

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.zh: 无论你去往何处，我都会用这把花剪咔嚓、咔嚓地一路剪下去，直到你脚下的道路开满飘落的花朵。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.en: Wherever you go, I will snip-snip with these blossom shears until the path beneath you blooms with fallen blossoms.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.zh: 花剪
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.en: Blossom Scissors

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.zh: 在象征界中，攻击命中时有30%概率触发造成5点<color=#fe4b48>伤害</color>的<color=#F8C200>花剪咔嚓追加攻击</color>（0.3秒受击硬直）
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.en: In the Symbolic, 30% chance to trigger <color=#F8C200>Blossom Scissors-snip Extra Attack</color> dealing 5 <color=#fe4b48>Damage</color> upon landing an attack (0.3 seconds Hitstun)

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.zh: 黄金皮革是力量之物。心灵或许会摇摇欲坠地走向人台，但黄金皮革会赋予其意识，引导其成为完整的扭曲。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.en: The Golden Hide is an object of power. Minds may teeter on the brink of descent into a Mannequin, yet the Golden Hide gives them consciousness, guiding them to become a complete Distortion.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.zh: 调色板的黄金松脂
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.en: Palette's Golden Resin

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.zh: 抵达终点的扭曲会获得一种只有自己能够理解的语言。它无法以这种语言与他者交流。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.en: A Distortion that has reached the terminus acquires a language only it can understand. It cannot communicate with others with such a language.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.zh: 地下2层楼层经理的黄金皮革
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.en: B2F Floor Manager's Golden Hide

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.zh: 尽管漫长岁月流逝，它却没有退化成人台；相反，在黄金皮革的帮助下，它仍保持着具有智慧的扭曲形态。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.en: Though ages passed, it did not devolve into a Mannequin; instead, aided by the Golden Hide, it remained a sapient Distortion.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.zh: 针线之王的黄金皮革
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.en: Golden Hide of the King of Needleworks

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.zh: 为什么从黄金皮革中渗出的光，会成为维系人台智慧的锚点？它难道不该加速其堕落为失去心智的扭曲吗？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.en: Why does the light, bleeding out of the Golden Hide, act as an anchor to the Mannequins' sapience? Should it not instead hasten their descent into mindless Distortions?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.zh: 副主厨的黄金皮革
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.en: Sous Chef's Golden Hide

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.zh:
矛盾的是，金色光芒希望所有扭曲都抵达终点，却又同时不希望如此。
栖居于光中的并非单一实体，而其中某个实体内的心也同样不止一个。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.en:
Paradoxically, the golden light wishes for all Distortions to reach their terminus, and at the same time, it does not.
What dwells within the light is more than a single entity, and neither is the heart inside one of them.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.zh: 尸堆中的黄金皮革
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.en: Golden Hide from the Corpse Pile

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.zh:
扭曲可以保持智慧，并通过各种交流途径向他者传达自己的意志。
光并未抹除其智慧，这实在讽刺，或许也泄露了仍栖居于光中的一丝人性。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.en:
Distortions can remain sapient and convey their wills to others through various avenues of communication.
That the light does not obliterate their wisdom is an irony, and may betray a glimpse of the humanity still dwelling within it.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.zh: 红派品牌总监的黄金皮革
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.en: Le Rouge Brand Director's Golden Hide

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.zh: 通过与光对话，持有一片黄金皮革的顾客获得了超越他人的力量，使他们得以将影响力扩展到西西弗百货各处。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.en: Through dialogue with the light, customers who carried a piece of the Golden Hide gained powers beyond those of others, which allowed them to expand their influence throughout the Grand Magasin.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.zh: 3层楼层经理的黄金皮革
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.en: 3F Floor Manager's Golden Hide

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.zh:
虚无派的目的不止是解构这座百货商场。
他们渴望毫无阻碍地完全拥抱光。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.en:
Le Néant's purpose goes beyond the deconstruction of this department store.
They desire the full, unhindered embrace of the light.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.zh: 墙壁裂缝中的黄金皮革
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.en: Golden Hide from the Crack in the Wall

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.zh: 西西弗系统是一套为了高效且非暴力地从囚犯身上提取经验而建造的装置。囚犯在其中经历众多体验，其多样性会成为经验面团的基础原料。经验是对变化的感知：静止与运动之间不间断的交替。黑派掌管静止。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.en: The Sisyphe System is an apparatus built to extract experience from prisoners efficiently and without violence. Within it, prisoners undergo a multitude of experiences, and the variety becomes the base ingredient of Experience Dough. Experience is the perception of change: an unbroken alternation between stillness and motion. Le Noir governs stillness.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.zh: 服从
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.en: Obedience

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.zh:
在阴影界战斗期间，<color=#00ff9c>体力</color>低于或等于50%的人格即将被敌方技能命中前，该人格获得等同于已损失<color=#00ff9c>体力</color>20%的护盾
- 每个人格每场遭遇战1次
- 此护盾不会在回合结束后消失
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.en:
During battle in the Shadowed, immediately before an Identity that has 50% or lower <color=#00ff9c>HP</color> is hit by an enemy Skill, the said Identity gains Shield equal to 20% of its missing <color=#00ff9c>HP</color>
- Once per Identity per Encounter
- This Shield does not expire after the turn ends

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.zh: 人们常说要体验当下。然而，若经验是预见即将发生之事并目睹其实现的行为，那么经验便必然永远存在于未来。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.en: People speak of experiencing the present. Yet if experience is the act of anticipating what is to come and seeing it realized, then it must always lie in the future.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.zh: 脉动
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.en: Pulsation

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.zh:
在象征界中解放<color=#F8C200>弹反</color>
- 弹反：操控默尔索时，在敌人攻击前0.2秒命中敌人以取消该攻击（特定攻击除外）

在象征界中解放<color=#F8C200>格挡</color>
- 格挡：按住<color=#F8C200>格挡</color>键（键盘C键），维持默尔索的<color=#F8C200>格挡</color>架势
- 进行<color=#F8C200>格挡</color>时，来自<color=#fe4b48>格挡</color>方向的承受<color=#fe4b48>伤害</color>-30%

在象征界中，为<color=#F8C200>前进</color>攻击解放<color=#F8C200>攻击连段2</color>
- 发动前进后，<color=#F8C200>再次进行攻击</color>以发动攻击连段2
- <color=#F8C200>攻击连段2</color>：对敌人造成的<color=#fe4b48>伤害</color>+2，<color=#F8C200>受击硬直</color>+0.1秒
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.en:
Unlocks <color=#F8C200>Parry</color> in the Symbolic
- Parry: While controlling Meursault, hit the enemy 0.2 seconds before its attack to cancel the attack (excluding certain attacks)

Unlocks <color=#F8C200>Block</color> in the Symbolic
- Block: Press and hold <color=#F8C200>Block</color> (C on keyboard) to maintain Meursault's <color=#F8C200>Block</color> stance
- While <color=#F8C200>Blocking</color>, <color=#fe4b48>Damage</color> Taken -30% from the <color=#fe4b48>Blocked</color> direction

Unlocks <color=#F8C200>Attack Chain 2</color> for <color=#F8C200>Avant</color> Attack in the Symbolic
- After activating Avant, <color=#F8C200>repeat the attack</color> to activate Attack Chain 2
- <color=#F8C200>Attack Chain 2</color>: <color=#fe4b48>Damage</color> Dealt +2 and <color=#F8C200>Hitstun</color> +0.1 seconds against the enemy

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.zh: 一把锤子。它使尖钉得以履行自身用途。然而即使单独使用，锤子也同样是称手的破坏工具。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.en: A hammer. It allows a nail to fulfill its purpose. Yet even alone, a hammer serves just as well as an instrument of destruction.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.zh: 锤子
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.en: Hammer

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.zh:
象征界中造成的<color=#fe4b48>伤害</color>+1
在阴影界战斗期间，对带有<color=#F8C200>束缚</color>的敌人造成的<color=#fe4b48>伤害</color>+10%
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.en:
<color=#fe4b48>Damage</color> Dealt +1 in the Symbolic
During battle in the Shadowed, deal +10% <color=#fe4b48>damage</color> against enemies that have <color=#F8C200>Bind</color>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.zh: 这太难了……数量好多……太多就不好玩了……发亮的表面太多……光芒就不再特别了……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.en: This is too hard... There are so many... Too many will make it less fun... Too many shiny surfaces... won't make the shine special anymore...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.zh: 发光鞋
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.en: Luminous Shoes

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.zh: 在象征界中进行<color=#F8C200>闪避</color>后，下一次攻击造成的<color=#fe4b48>伤害</color>+3（冷却时间10秒）
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.en: After <color=#F8C200>Evading</color> in the Symbolic, <color=#fe4b48>Damage</color> Dealt +3 on the next attack (10 seconds cooldown)

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.zh: 鲜艳的红、肃穆的黑、游移的褐……无论针引向何方，所有颜色都必将随之而行。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.en: Vibrant red, austere black, drifting khaki... all colors are bound to follow wherever the needle leads.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.zh: 彩色线束
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-item-common-a1c10p2.js.en: Colorful Skein

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.zh: 如你所见，奢侈品馆正在进行室内装潢翻新。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.en: Interior design renovation is underway at the Luxury Hall, as you can see.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.zh: 啊，抱歉扰民了。这次翻新可是个大工程。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.en: Ah, apologies for the noise. This renovation is a rather large-scale construction project.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.zh: 我那老大以前常说，“伙计们，抄家伙！咱们要去‘翻新’一大堆脸了！”——每回去找别的帮派麻烦时都这么说。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.en: My old bossman used to say "grab yer tools, lads! We're headin' out to renovate a whole lotta mugs!" whenever we went after other Syndicates.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.zh: 你说的就是这个意思吧，小姐？
不完全是；这只是一次非常特别的改造，跟以往任何一次都不一样——不只是换几件过时的陈列品那么简单。这一次的工程，是要建一座摇篮……以迎接一位十分重要之人的降临。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.en: Not exactly, no; this is just a very special refitting, quite unlike any before it—more than just switching out a few out-of-fashion displays. This time, the project is to build a cradle... in anticipation of the advent of a very important someone.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.zh: 我这才明白过来。原来就是在这个时候，红派袭击了黑派，夺下了奢侈品馆的控制权。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.en: I see now. This is when the Rouges attacked the Noirs, taking control of the Luxury Hall.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.zh: 所以……他们里头在吃什么呢？搞什么食人盛宴不成？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.en: So... what're they eatin' back there? Some kinda cannibal feast?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.zh: 我们正在享用黑派。不过这恐怕还远远填不饱我们的饥饿……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.en: We are feasting on the Noir. Though this will hardly sate our hunger...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.zh: 施工完成后请再来。届时，你们将会看到这地方脱胎换骨，变得更加壮丽！
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.en: Please return once the construction work is complete. You will soon see this place reborn into a far grander state of beauty!

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.zh: （她哼着一段悦耳的小调，看起来颇为自得。）
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.en: (She hums a nice tune, seemingly pleased with herself.)

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.zh: ……等他们的“施工项目”完成后，再回奢侈品馆看看，方为上策。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.en: ... It would be prudent to revisit the Luxury Hall once their "construction project" is completed.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.zh: ……嗯。你是怎么知道他们不会让咱们进去的，钟？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.en: ... Huh. How'd you know they won't let us in, Clock?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.zh: 我一直没跟罪人们透露循环的细节，因为在自己都还没弄明白它是怎么回事之前就说出去，恐怕只会让他们陷入更深的不确定之中。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.en: I'd been holding back on sharing the details of the loop with the Sinners, as doing so before I even understood how it worked might only plunge them into further uncertainty.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.zh: 但既然我们已经走到了这一步，或许把……循环的事告诉他们，能让他们提供些新的见解。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.en: But now that we're this far in, maybe they could provide further insight if I kept them in the loop about... the loop.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.zh: 就在我准备认真考虑这个念头时，一个遥远的声音，穿透了某种深不可测的距离，直接闯进了我的脑海。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.en: Just as I was about to entertain that thought, a distant voice, breaking through an unfathomable stretch, cut through into my head.
<color=#515aee>Beset by... the gaze of the multitude...</color>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.zh: 看来能听见这个声音的，只有我一个。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.en: I must be the only one who can hear this voice.
<color=#515aee>Then... cannot be... free from the... sunshine...</color>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.zh: <……嗯，我就是有种直觉，觉得他们大概不会让我们进去。>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.en: <... Well, I just had this gut feeling that they probably won't let us in.>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.zh: 是吗？也有道理，伙计。就算隔着老远看，他们那副样子也不像是好相与的。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.en: Yeah? Fair enough, mate. I 'spose they didn't look like the friendliest sort even from a distance.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.zh: 先提升你的评级，再回来敲门吧。到那时，我们或许会重新考虑你的资格。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.en: Raise your Prestige Rank first and come knocking again. Then, perhaps, we will reconsider your qualifications.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.zh: 哈！小意思，姑娘！瞧好了，这对我来说不费吹灰之——
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.en: Hah! That's child's play, lass! Lookee, it ain't no trouble reaching my elbo—

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.zh: ——哦啊啊啊！我的老天，我这是在哪儿！？
看来你已经找到在楼层间移动的办法了，但丁。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.en: It appears that you have discovered the means of moving between the floors, Dante.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.zh: <唔……我也不知道。既然我们进不去二楼正门……>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.en: <Well... I don't know. Since we can't enter the second floor proper...>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-2-b.json#Q.en: Take a Quick Look Around 2F

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-2-b.json#Q.zh: 我们回到了2层。和上次一样，恐怕没法直接进去。先快速查看一下周围吧。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-2-b.json#Q.en: We're back on 2F. Just like last time, we probably won't be able to head straight in. Let's take a quick look around first.
Explore 2F
Enter the Luxury Hall

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-2-b.json#Q.zh: 守在入口的人不见了。也许情况发生了变化。进去看看吧。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-2-b.json#Q.en: The one guarding the entrance is gone. Maybe things have changed. Let's head inside.
Enter the Luxury Hall
Enter the Luxury Hall (2)

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-2-b.json#Q.zh: 奢侈品馆里遍布黑派的尸体。继续深入吧。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-2-b.json#Q.en: The Luxury Hall is littered with Le Noir corpses. Let's keep moving in.
Head deeper into the Luxury Hall
Enter the Luxury Hall (3)

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-2-b.json#Q.zh: 红派造出的同一处入口再次出现在这里。穿过去吧。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-2-b.json#Q.en: The same entrance created by the Rouges is here again. Let's go through.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-2-b.json#Q.zh: 通过入口进入奢侈品馆
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-2-b.json#Q.en: Enter the Luxury Hall via the entrance
Inspect the Cradle

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-2-b.json#Q.zh: 红派的品牌总监说，沉睡在摇篮里的东西很快就会醒来，并请求我们留在它身边。现在先靠近摇篮吧。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-2-b.json#Q.en: Le Rouge's Brand Director says whatever is sleeping in the Cradle will wake soon, and asked us to stay by its side. For now, let's approach the Cradle.
Inspect the Cradle
Bring the piece near the Cradle
Try feeding the piece to the Cradle
Rescue the child from the Cradle
Talk to the child from the Cradle

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-2-b.json#Q.zh: 从摇篮中出现的东西看起来像个小孩子。试着和他交谈吧。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-2-b.json#Q.en: What emerged from the Cradle looks like a small child. Let's try talking to them.
Talk to the child from the Cradle
Catch the runaway child

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-2-b.json#Q.zh: 摇篮中的孩子一看到我们，就飞快逃进了角落。追上他，试着和他交谈吧。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-2-b.json#Q.en: The child from the Cradle bolted into a corner the moment they saw us. Catch up and try talking to them.
Catch the child from the Cradle
Leave the Luxury Hall

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-2-b.json#Q.zh: 摇篮中的孩子开始跟着我们，尽管他仍然保持着距离。现在先离开奢侈品馆吧。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-2-b.json#Q.en: The child from the Cradle has started following us, though they still keep their distance. For now, let's leave the Luxury Hall.
Leave the Luxury Hall
Head to 4F

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-2-b.json#Q.zh: 我们带走了红派商贩的脊椎。没人知道接下来会发生什么，不妨把可能派上用场的东西都留在手上。这里暂时处理完了。前往4层吧。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-2-b.json#Q.en: We took the Rouge vendor's spine with us. There's no telling what will come next, so we may as well hold on to anything that could prove useful. We're done here for now. We should head to 4F.
Head to 4F

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: ……等等，你们听见了吗？听着像是剪刀的声音。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: ... Wait, do you hear that? Sounds like a pair of scissors.
It might be worth checking out.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: <……嘿，默尔索。上次在改衣室拿到的那把剪刀，你还留着吗？>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: <... Hey, Meursault. Do you still have that pair of scissors we got from the Alteration Shop last time?>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 是的。不过它的刃口在剪断上一件两件套的过程中已经有些崩损了。那项工作将需要一把新剪刀。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: Yes. However, its edges have chipped slightly in the process of cutting through the last Two-piece. We will require a new pair of scissors for that task.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: <我们要继续前进就得剪开两件套，所以……看来又要弄一把新剪刀了。>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: <We need to cut through Two-piece if we want to proceed, so... looks like we'll be getting ourselves a new pair of scissors.>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 声音不是从这边来的，经理。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: This isn't where the noise is coming from, Manager.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 这不是去商贩那边的路，经理。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: This isn't the way to the vendor, Manager.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 据让娜小姐所说，似乎每个派系都有一个……引导他们的“声音”，而那声音其实是一位“巨人”。这道声音，恐怕也是属于其中之一的。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: According to Miss Jeanne, it seems like each faction has a... guiding "Voice," who is, in truth, a "Giant." This voice probably belongs to one of them, too.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 一种典型的操纵手段。通过向群体灌输根深蒂固的“我方对外部”心态，来巩固该派系内部的凝聚力。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: A classic manipulation tactic. It bolsters solidarity within a faction by instilling its population with the entrenched in-group-versus-out-group mentality.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 它不再闪烁，也不再舞动了。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: It doesn't twinkle or dance anymore.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 一具红派的尸体。他们的血管已停止蠕动，变得干枯灰暗。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: The corpse of a Rouge. Their veins have stopped writhing, turning dry and grey.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 一滩血肉摊在地上。看起来像个瘪掉的气球。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: A slough of flesh is splayed on the ground. Looks like a popped balloon.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 一化作了二。化作二的那一位，已不再动弹。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: One has become two. The one who has become two stirs no longer.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 又一家店铺，又一件用血肉做成的、乏味无趣的连衣裙。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: Another shop, another boring, insipid dress made from flesh.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh:
[坠落之微分 第2号：“西格尔”
这件装置的灵感来自一具人台坠落穿越西西弗百货的过程。其意象唤起了时间坠落般延续不绝的印象。]
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en:
[Differential of Falling Series 2: "Siegel"
This installation was inspired by a Mannequin's fall through the Grand Magasin. The imagery evokes the falling continuity of time.]

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 看着它大概也不会让我对它多一分理解。……不过也没必要理解就是了。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: Looking at it probably won't advance my understanding of it. ... Not that there's any need to.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh:
[坠落之微分 第3号：“斯道克曼”
这件装置的灵感来自一具人台坠落穿越西西弗百货的过程。其意象唤起了时间坠落般延续不绝的印象。
相较第1号装置，雕塑尺寸更小。]
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en:
[Differential of Falling Series 3: "Stockmann"
This installation was inspired by a Mannequin's fall through the Grand Magasin. The imagery evokes the falling continuity of time.
Sculpted in a smaller size relative to the Series 1 installation.]

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 展示着一条看似金属制成的项链。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: A necklace that appears to be made of metal is on display.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 一台收银机。里面似乎什么都不剩了。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: A cash register. There doesn't seem to be anything left inside.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 一具毫无装饰的人台躯干。
一件染着独特花纹的T恤。还没见过哪个红派穿这个。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: A T-shirt dyed in a unique pattern. Haven't encountered a single Rouge who's wearing this.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh:
[总统67'签名系列。
浓缩了红派独有的选材眼光与悠久传承，这一非凡融合在这变革的时代中，塑造出了独属于自己、却又恰如其分的身份特质。——如需了解价格，请咨询客服代表。]
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en:
[Le Président 67' Signature Collection.
An encapsulation of Le Rouge's unique choice of material and bygone heritages, this exceptional blending has established a unique yet fitting identity for itself in the age of change. - Please enquire a customer representative for more information on its price.]

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 一台收银机。伸手进抽屉看看还剩下什么……摸出了几颗还在角落里打转的眼球。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: It's a cash register. Reaching into its drawer to see if there's anything left... yields some eyeballs that were rolling around in its corner.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 收获不错，执行经理。拿上吧——尽可能多找些、留着这些东西，对我们有好处。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: Not a bad get, Executive Manager. Take it—it should do us good to find and keep as many of these as we can.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 等、等一下，这不就是明摆着的偷窃吗？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: W-wait, isn't this just straight-up thievery?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 更准确的说法应该是“战地征用战术”。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: A more accurate designation for this strategy would be "field requisition tactics."

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: <color=#ebcaa2>我看呐，这种战术在这儿大概就叫“盗窃”。</color>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: <color=#ebcaa2>I don't know, this strategy probably falls under the designation we call "larceny" here.</color>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: <等等，从收银机里拿眼球都不行，那我们杀掉——不对，是“送去出口”的那些人台又算什么？>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: <Wait, we're not allowed to take eyeballs from cash registers? What about all those Mannequins we kill—I mean, "helped to the exit"?>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: <color=#ebcaa2>呼呼，你是想说“故意损毁财物”吧？</color>
<反正在这家百货商店里，这种事根本不重要，辛克莱。默尔索，把那些眼球拿上。>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: <It doesn't matter inside this department store anyway, Sinclair. Take those eyeballs, Meursault.>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: <color=#ebcaa2>就因为听不懂玩笑，现在干脆决定无视我了，是吧？</color>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: <color=#ebcaa2>Just decided to ignore me now 'cuz you can't understand how jokes work, huh?</color>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 还没到非要这些东西不可的地步。
下方有一行说明文字，写着：[使用活体新鲜融化的脂肪组织处理并涂覆而成。触碰即可感受那玻璃般、瓷釉般的质感。]
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: There's a caption below that says the following: [Treated and coated with fresh-melted fat tissue from a living subject. Touch it and feel the glassy, enamelistic surface.]

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 从沙发缝隙里掉出来的几颗眼球，被顺手拿走了。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: Obtained some eyeballs that fell through the cracks in the couch.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-narration-floor-3-b.js.zh: <color=#cf0000>欲求。依汝欲求之量，吞尽一切。</color>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-narration-floor-3-b.js.en: <color=#cf0000>Desire. And to the measure of your desire, consume all.</color>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-narration-floor-3-b.js.zh: <color=#cf0000>以一切披挂己身。毫无节制地吞噬。</color>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-narration-floor-3-b.js.en: <color=#cf0000>Don yourself with all. Devour without restraint.</color>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-narration-floor-3-b.js.zh: <color=#cf0000>渴求。依汝渴求之量，耗尽一切。</color>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-narration-floor-3-b.js.en: <color=#cf0000>Desiderate. And to the measure of your desideration, deplete all.</color>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-narration-floor-3-b.js.zh: <color=#7d7d7d>纵汝可得满足，亦不可为。纵汝可纵情享用，亦当克制。</color>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-narration-floor-3-b.js.en: <color=#7d7d7d>Though thou canst sate thyself, thou shalt not. Though thou canst indulge, thou shalt refrain.</color>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-narration-floor-3-b.js.zh: <color=#7d7d7d>汝当戒绝过量。汝当遵循秩序之诫命。</color>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-narration-floor-3-b.js.en: <color=#7d7d7d>Thou shalt refrain from excess. Thou shalt abide by the commandments of order.</color>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-narration-floor-3-b.js.zh: <color=#7d7d7d>汝不可违逆规则。汝受苦的每一刻，皆由西西弗亲自铭刻并铭记。</color>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-narration-floor-3-b.js.en: <color=#7d7d7d>Thou shalt not defy the rules. Every moment of thy suffering is etched into and remembered by Sisyphe itself.</color>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 价签上写着“肌肉衰减重量”
标签上写的是[季节性服饰]。虽说“季节”这种东西，在这儿其实毫无意义。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: The label calls it [Seasonal Apparel]. Not that "seasons" mean anything.
Still looks like a lump of dough.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: [68'签名系列。对67'系列所秉持的复古主义哲学的彻底否定，是红派骨子里那份解构气质的集大成之作。]
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: [68' Signature Collection. An unequivocal rejection of the revivalist philosophy that underlined the 67' Collection, and a consummation of the deconstructive quality that is quintessentially Rouge.]

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 如今看来，已经没那么蓬松柔软了。

[坠落之微分 第1号：“辛西娅”
这件装置描绘的，是坠落于西西弗百货中的第一具人台——辛西娅——坠落的过程。它是本系列中唯一的大型装置，也是唯一一件以精细笔触描绘出她坠落之初那一刻的作品，因而在系列中独树一帜。]
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en:
[Differential of Falling Series 1: "Cynthia"
This installation depicts the fall of Cynthia, the first Mannequin to fall in the Grand Magasin. The only large-scale installation in the series, it sets itself apart from the rest of the series by being the only piece to depict the precise moment her fall began in painstaking detail.]

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: <咦，这么一看……这地方还有些“装置艺术”，未必都是商品呢。>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: <Huh, now that I'm looking at it... this place has "installations," that aren't necessarily products.>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: <你觉得环指……在这里也有活动吗？>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: <Do you think the Ring... has any presence here?>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 并非所有艺术创作，都与环指的活动有关。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: Not all artistic endeavors are associated with the Ring's activities.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 不过，这些东西倒是让我想起了在环指父辈的画廊里看到的那些东西。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: Still, these remind me of the things we saw back at the Ring Nursefather's gallery.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: <说不定有张说明卡片，解释这一切都是什么意思。如果那卡片还留着的话……>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: <Maybe there's a note explaining what all this means. Assuming that the note survived...>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 这一带看来的确还有其他“坠落之微分”系列……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: There indeed seem to be other "Differential of Falling" series in this area...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: <嗯，他们特意标注了“第1号”，那么合理推测应该还有“第2号”。留意一下，说不定能找到什么派得上用场的东西。>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: <Well, they went out of their way to call it "Series 1," so it seems reasonable to assume that there's a "Series 2." Let's keep an eye out for it in case they have anything that might come in handy.>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 几件用类似骨头的东西装饰的衣物。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: Articles of clothing adorned with what appear to be bones.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh:
[“群鸟”实验系列。]
下方的说明写着，灵感来自一只鸟。它从上到下都裹着一层厚厚的羽毛——这些羽毛究竟是从哪儿弄来的？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en:
["Les Oiseaux" Experimental Collection.]
The caption below reads that it was inspired by a bird. It is plastered from top to bottom with a thick coating of feathers—where did they even get the feathers?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 这扇门上挂着一层厚重的帘幕。似乎进不去。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: There's a heavy curtain draped over this door. Can't seem to enter.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 一条从某人身上——或者某物身上——断下来的巨大手臂。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: A gargantuan arm separated from somebody. Or something.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 一顶勉强能称得上“普通”的宽檐帽。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: A brimmed hat that one might dare call "average."

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 五颜六色的各种线团沿墙排列。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: A sundry of colorful threads line this wall.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 刃口非常锋利。与其说是剪刀，倒更像是镰刀的刃。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: The edge is very sharp. Almost like a scythe's edge rather than a scissor blade's.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 一把生锈的剪刀。看样子有段时间没人用过了。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: A rusty pair of scissors. These haven't been used in a while.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 另一侧被一层厚厚的布料遮住了。那后面似乎有什么东西在闪烁。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: The other side is hidden behind a thick layer of fabric. There's something twinkling there.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 另一侧被一层厚厚的布料遮住了。掀开布料，但这次，后面什么都没有。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: The other side is hidden behind a thick layer of fabric. Uncovered the fabric, but this time, there isn't anything behind.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 另一侧被一层厚厚的布料遮住了。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: The other side is hidden behind a thick layer of fabric.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 这里有许多孔洞。或许是用来插东西的。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: There are numerous holes here. Possibly for plugging something in.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 这些已经有一阵子没连接过了。插孔里积满了灰尘。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: These haven't been connected in a while. The sockets are full of dust.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 每个孔洞上都贴着一张标签。上面原本似乎写了些什么，但如今已经褪色，无法辨认了。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: Each hole has a tag taped on top of it. There used to be something written on the tags, but now they're faded and illegible.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 听起来像是远处人群的嘈杂声。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: Sounds like the hubbub of a distant crowd.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 很安静。想必是听错了别的什么声音。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: It's quiet. Must've mistaken some other sound.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh:
这台装置看起来像个通风扇。
里面积满了灰尘……想必已经坏了有一阵子了。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en:
This device looks like a ventilation fan. 
It's so dusty inside... Must have been out of order for a while.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 长长的缝隙里，铺着一层……灰尘。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: There's a dusting of... dust inside the long gap.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 坍塌的碎石挡住了去路。既无法翻越，也无法绕行。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: Fallen debris is blocking the way. There's no way over or around it.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 不知道有哪种游戏会用到这些骰子。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: Don't know any games that use these dice.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 各面上杂乱无章地散布着随机的点数和字母。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: Random pips and letters are scattered on its sides without rhyme or reason.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 一颗没什么用的沉重骰子。
咦，这是什么呢？某种广播装置吗？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: Huh, wonder what this is? Somd kind of broadcast device?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: ……执行经理，您过去接触过这类装置吗？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: ... Have you had access to one of these devices in the past, Executive Manager?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: <呃……没有，我就是以前在一本小册子上读到过。>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: <Uh... No, I just read about it in a pamphlet once.>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: ……不愧是我们的执行经理！您这与日俱增的求知热忱，实在令人钦佩。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: ... As expected of our Executive Manager! Your rising passion for learning is most admirable indeed.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 奥提斯似乎在思索着什么。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: Outis seems to consider something for a moment.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 这些管子沿墙排列的样子，让我想起了一台巨大的管风琴。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: The way these tubes are lining the wall reminds me of a massive pipe organ.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 虽然不知道这是用来收听还是用来传声的，不过……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: Though I don't know if it's for listening or relaying but...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: ……一想到或许有人在偷听我说的每一句话，在我看不见的地方对我下达指令……胃里便涌起一阵莫名的不安。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: ... imagining that someone might be listening in on my every word, giving me commands from where I can't see... a strange trepidation gurgles from the pit of my stomach.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 看来，视线并不受限于视觉的界限。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: The gaze is not beholden to the limitations of the sight, it seems.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 几只鸟躺在一根长长的、喇叭状管子下方。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: Several birds lie beneath a long, trumpet-shaped tube.
<color=#cf0000>No... don't understand it... you mustn't understand...</color>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 捡起其中一只鸟时，那声音便戛然而止。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: When I pick up one of the birds, the voice cuts off.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 一道光斑在几缕日光之间闪动。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: Something glints between the shafts of sunlight.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 默尔索取出了那件闪光的物品。是一台老式录音机。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: Meursault pulled out the glinting object. It's an old recorder.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: ……是我的错觉吗，这件外套是不是在缩水？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: ... Is it just me, or is this coat shrinking?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 那是在四楼顾客中相当受欢迎的一种袜子。只需穿上，便能直接套上身的那种。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: Those are socks that have become quite popular among the customers on the fourth floor. The kind you can put on simply by wearing them.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 袜、袜子？这明明是件外套啊！
功能性袜子。无需费力弯腰，直接套上即可。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: Functional socks. One merely slips them on without having to go through the trouble of bending over.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 唔，有意思。执行经理，我们不如把它带上吧？反正它已经不属于任何人了。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: Hm, fascinating. Why don't we bring this along, Executive Manager? It doesn't belong to anyone anymore.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 上面写着[千纸鹤系列 92号，5份中的第3份。某人的坠落，升华为叠加态的时间。]
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: It says [Origami CollectioN° 92, 3 of 5. Someone's fall sublimated into superpositioned time.]

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: <我记得我们在一楼看过这个系列的“5份中的第1份”。>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: <I think we saw the "1 of 5" of the series on the first floor.>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 哦，对了……！我记得学过，有些版画和雕塑在创作时就打算制作多份一模一样的复本，只用不同的编号给每份“版次”做区分。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: Oh, right...! I remember learning about how some prints and sculptures are made with creating multiple identical copies in mind, only giving a different number to each "iteration" to distinguish them.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 而且，即便每一份几乎难以区分彼此，它们的价值也可能会因编号而有所不同。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: And even though each piece is pretty much indistinguishable from one another, their value might vary depending on the number they're given.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 那么……一楼那份，想必就是第一份复本了。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: Then... the one on the first floor must be the first copy.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 寻常之辈大概会对此视而不见、径直走过……您的观察力竟如此敏锐！不愧是我们的执行经理，果然名不虚传！
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: Most unremarkable rabble would've walked past it without a second thought... What impeccable perception you have! I expected no less of our Executive Manager!

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh:
上面写着[季末商品／成衣]。
仍在出售。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en:
It says [Off-Season / Prêt-à-porter].
Still on sale.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh:
上面写着[季末商品／成衣]。
仍在出售。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en:
It says [Off-Season / Prêt-à-porter].
Still on sale.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 咦，这些衣服怎么比其他的贵这么多。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: Huh, these clothes are more expensive than the others.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 那是因为您看的这批陈列，是本季的成衣商品。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: That is because the display you are looking at is for this season's Prêt-à-porter items.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 成衣。指的是预先制作、可直接穿着的现货服饰，尤指品质与档次较高的那一类。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: Prêt-à-porter. It refers to made-to-stock, ready-to-wear items; those of higher quality and prestige, in particular.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 这张沙发亮得有些吓人。没必要试着坐上去瘫一下。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: This couch is disturbingly shiny. No need to try slumping down on it.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: ……不想再费力翻找缝隙里的东西了。决定绕过去继续前进。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: ... Don't feel like dredging through the gaps anymore. Decided to move on past it.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: <color=#ebcaa2>噗……你至于为了几个零钱这么拼吗？你不是有钱到根本不用在意那几颗眼球？</color>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: <color=#ebcaa2>Pff... Do you really have to try so hard for loose change? Aren't you rich enough to ignore a handful of eyeballs?</color>
<... I can always afford to be richer, can't I?>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 经理回答说，他总能再有钱一点。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: The manager replies that they can always afford to be richer.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 拿走了深藏其中的一些眼球。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: Took some eyeballs lodged deep inside.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 咦，看看这些标签。这些衣服比其他的便宜。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: Huh, look at the tags. These clothes are cheaper than the others.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 缠绕在人偶上的布带，发出一阵微弱的绷紧声。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: Cloth straps wrapped around the figure make a faint straining noise.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: ……它刚才是不是笑了？大概只是看错了……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: ... Did it just smile? Probably just seeing things...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh:
这看起来像是件拘束衣，但其实不是。
是一件正装。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en:
This might look like a straitjacket, but it's not.
It's a formal suit.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 穿着这个真能看得见外面吗？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: Can they even see out of this thing?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 等等，表情变了……一股说不清道不明的恐惧从脊背爬了上来。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: Wait, the expression changed... A nameless terror crawls up my spine.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 如今看着，只觉得闷得慌。

这套服装名为[初次叠影]。
想必在黑派中相当受欢迎。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en:
This outfit is called [La Première Superposition].
Must be pretty popular among the Noirs.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 布料后面似乎有什么东西在呼吸。令人不适。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: Something's breathing from behind the fabric. Uncomfortable.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 收银台的黑派身上穿的，跟这套服装有几分相似。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: The Noirs at the checkout counter are wearing something similar to this outfit.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh:
[三重叠影。
将斗篷、双排扣长外套与夹克巧妙融合成一体的迷人之作。本季系列中的至尊之选。
如需咨询价格与预订，请前往前台。]
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en:
[La Troisieme Superposition. 
A fascinating blend of cape, frock coat, and jacket in a all-in-one integration. Highest prestige in this Season's collection.
Please visit the reception desk for pricing and reservations.]

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 说不定现在我们也买得起了……？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: Maybe we can afford it now...?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh:
[三重叠影。
将斗篷、双排扣长外套与夹克巧妙融合成一体的迷人之作。本季系列中的至尊之选。
如需咨询价格与预订，请前往前台。]
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en:
[La Troisieme Superposition. 
A fascinating blend of cape, frock coat, and jacket in a all-in-one integration. Highest prestige in this Season's collection.
Please visit the reception desk for pricing and reservations.]

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: [成衣。黄金纱线含量为上季的150%！]
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: [Prêt-à-porter. Contains 150% of the Golden Yarn compared to the Last Season's!]

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 仔细一看才发现，所谓的“黄金纱线”含量其实只有0.00015%。这点分量，实在不值得写进广告词里。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: Upon closer inspection, I notice that it contains only 0.00015% of the so-called "Golden Yarn." Doesn't seem anywhere near significant enough to warrant putting that on the advertisement.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 这么说，上一季的产品岂不是只有0.0001%的黄金纱线……？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: Doesn't this mean that the last season's products had only 0.0001% Golden Yarn...?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: ……我敢打赌，U公司鲸鱼薯片里的鲸鱼含量，都比这上面的黄金纱线含量高。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: ... I'm willing to bet that Whale chips from U Corp. have more Whale in them than this has Golden Yarn.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 一个摆满眼镜的展示柜。不过不太清楚该怎么戴上它们。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: A display case full of glasses. Not sure how I'd go about wearing them, however.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: ……这确实是眼镜，对吧……？展示牌上写的的确是“眼镜”……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: ... These are glasses, right...? The label above the display does say "glasses"...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 展示着几副眼镜和太阳镜。其中一些戴在格里高尔身上，说不定挺好看。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: On display are pairs of glasses and sunglasses. Some of these'll look good on Gregor.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 几副看起来出奇普通的眼镜和太阳镜，在这里显得格格不入。平凡得近乎诡异。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: Bizarrely normal-looking pairs of glasses and sunglasses that look out of place here. Surprisingly mundane, almost.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 一件凳子与抽屉柜的结合体……凳屉柜。不过看起来两边都没做好。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: A combination of a stool and a drawer... A strawer. Looks like it fails at being either, though.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 一件凳子与抽屉柜的结合体……凳屉柜。在抽屉里找到了几颗被人遗忘的眼球。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: A combination of a stool and a drawer... A strawer. Found a handful of eyeballs in its drawer that somebody forgot.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 一件凳子与抽屉柜的结合体……凳屉柜。在抽屉里找到了几颗被人遗忘的眼球……并没有。钟总归还是可以抱抱希望的。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: A combination of a stool and a drawer... A strawer. Found a handful of eyeballs in its drawer that somebody forgot... not. A clock can hope, though.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 做好了。这块黄金面料，连同它的光辉，都归你了。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: It's done. You may take this Golden Fabric and its brilliance with you.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 轻而易举地从那具已经不再动弹的红派身上扯下了脊骨。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: Easily ripped the spine off the Rouge who'd stopped moving.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 啊……我明白了你的意愿，愿全心全意地遵从。今日，我将再度对自己坦诚……放纵我的欲望。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: Ah... I see your will and abide by it wholeheartedly. Today, once again, I will be honest with myself... and indulge in my desires.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 我将与一切阻挡我们的力量抗争到底，愿有朝一日，你的声音也能传到我这里……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: I shall stand against all that seeks to stop us, that one day your Voice might reach me, too...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: ……可是听到新顾客的声音了？我总爱对初来这层楼的客人说这样一句话：您会发现，这里陈列的服饰所含的黄金皮革，比楼下那些店铺要慷慨得多——他们不过是掺了那么一星半点，就敢自称在卖黄金皮革混纺的布料。请尽管伸手触摸这些衣物——我相信您那双识货的手，一定能感受出品质上的差别。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: ... Do I hear new customers? First thing I like to tell the first-timers on our floor is this: you'll find the apparel displayed here to have a much more generous proportion of the Golden Hide than the shops below us, who only include trace amounts just so they can technically claim to be selling Golden Hide-infused fabric. Please, don't hesitate to touch the garment—I'm sure your discerning hands will notice the difference in quality.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 虽然那位商贩面朝着我们，但我看到的，本该是眼睛的地方，却只有两个空洞的眼窝。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: Though the vendor was facing us, I only saw empty sockets where her eyes should've been.
She's also been... nailed to the ground.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: <color=#cf0000>……煽动你的欲望吧……披上的越多……你的自我便升华得越高……</color>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: <color=#cf0000>... Fan your desires... The more you are donned... the higher shall your self ascend...</color>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 我明白了……这些微薄的布块——
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: I understand... These meager patches of—

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 我……听见你了。你回应了我。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: I... heard you. You answered me.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 你在哪儿？你是从哪里说话的？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: Where are you? Where are you speaking from?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 那位商贩挣扎着，朝我们伸出手，却因钉住她的尖钉而动弹不得。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: The vendor thrashed around and reached out toward us, unable to move with the nails that fixed her in place.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 这道声音，不会像拉长的磁带那样拖沓……不会结巴……不会没完没了地重复同样的话……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: This Voice doesn't drag like stretched tape... doesn't stutter... doesn't endlessly speak the same words over and over again...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 不，是它在对我说话……它在对我说话啊……！
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: No, they are speaking to me... they speak to me...!

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 可是……我们谁都没说话吧？她这是怎么了？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: But... none of us said anything, did we? What's wrong with her?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 你……你是从哪儿来的？那引领我们的声音……那指引我们的声音……啊啊，它对我说得如此清晰。这正是我穷尽一生寻觅的那道声音……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: Where... where did you come from? The Voice to lead us on... the Voice to guide us... ohh, it speaks to me so clearly. This is the Voice I've been searching for my whole life...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 那些沉默的日日夜夜……如今我才明白。原来都是在等候这美丽的一天。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: All those days of silence... I see now. They were in anticipation of this beautiful day.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-3-b.json#Q.zh: 前往3层
不出所料，2层再次进入“翻修”状态。前往3层吧。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-3-b.json#Q.en: As expected, 2F is under "renovation" again. Let's make our way to 3F.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-3-b.json#Q.zh: 搭乘前往3层的自动扶梯
循着咔嚓声前进
我们抵达了3层，果然又听见了剪刀声。前往改衣室寻找安妮特。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-3-b.json#Q.en: We've reached the 3F, and sure enough, the sound of scissors is back. Head to the Alteration Shop and find Annette.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-3-b.json#Q.zh: 前往改衣室
前往红派精品店
不出所料，两件套再次挡住了走廊。右侧的店铺无法抵达，先去左侧的红派精品店吧。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-3-b.json#Q.en: As expected, the Two-piece is blocking the corridor again. The store on the right is out of reach. Head to Boutique du Rouge on the left instead.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-3-b.json#Q.zh: 前往红派精品店
与不可动摇者交谈
红派精品店再次充斥着红派巨人——默尔索母亲的声音。上次听不见声音令精品店的商贩万分苦恼，这次恐怕也不会有所不同。先和她谈谈吧。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-3-b.json#Q.en: Once again, the Boutique is filled with the Voice of Le Rouge's Giant—Meursault's mother. The Boutique's vendor was deeply distressed that she couldn't hear the Voice last time, and this time will likely be no different. Let's talk to her first.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-3-b.json#Q.zh: 与不可动摇者交谈
前往走廊
先前只能饱受折磨的精品店商贩说，她又能听见声音了。这或许与我们携带的血肉碎片有关。这一次，她希望我们杀死改衣室里的安妮特。我们还没决定该怎么做，于是暂且决定前往右侧的黑派品牌世家。也许那场“会议”现在已经结束了……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-3-b.json#Q.en: The Boutique's vendor, who could do little but suffer before, says she can hear the Voice again. It may have something to do with the piece of flesh we're carrying. This time, she wants us to kill Annette in the Alteration Shop. We're not sure what to do yet, so for now, we decided to head to Maison du Noir on the right. Maybe the "meeting" is over by now...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-3-b.json#Q.zh: 前往走廊
绕路前往黑派品牌世家
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-3-b.json#Q.en: Take a detour to Maison du Noir

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-3-b.json#Q.zh: 两件套再次挡住了走廊，而且似乎注意到了我们携带的血肉碎片。从红派精品店的广播室绕行，寻找另一条通往黑派品牌世家的路。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-3-b.json#Q.en: Two-piece is blocking the corridor again, and they seem to have noticed the piece of flesh we're carrying. Find another way to Maison du Noir by going around through the Public Address Room in Boutique du Rouge.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-3-b.json#Q.zh: 绕路前往黑派品牌世家
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-3-b.json#Q.en: Take a detour to Maison du Noir

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-3-b.json#Q.zh: 杀死黑派品牌世家中的法兰绒与毛毡
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-3-b.json#Q.en: Kill Flannel and Felt at Maison du Noir

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-3-b.json#Q.zh: 返回改衣室
据让娜所说，西西弗百货的结局早已注定，做出其他选择也不会改变任何事。但我们不能就这样袖手旁观。若要做出不同的选择，就必须返回改衣室。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-3-b.json#Q.en: According to Jeanne, the Grand Magasin's ending is already set, and making other choices won't change a thing. But we can't just twiddle our thumbs and do nothing. If we're going to make a different choice, we need to head back to the Alteration Shop.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-3-b.json#Q.zh: 返回改衣室
杀死安妮特
返回不可动摇者处
我们击败了安妮特，但她在死前警告我们，我们已经不可挽回地成为了黑派的敌人。也许这项选择会在这一次导向不同的结局。返回红派精品店的商贩处吧。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-3-b.json#Q.en: We defeated Annette, but not before she warned us that we had irrevocably made ourselves enemies of Le Noir. Maybe this choice will lead to a different ending this time. We should return to the vendor at Boutique du Rouge.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-3-b.json#Q.zh: 返回不可动摇者处
返回2层
精品店的女店主欣喜若狂，要我们前往2层的奢侈品馆。她说声音正在那里呼唤我们。要是上次没有强行把那东西从茧里弄出来，也许结果会有所不同。返回2层吧。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-3-b.json#Q.en: The Boutique's proprietress was overjoyed and told us to head for the Luxury Hall on 2F. She says the Voice is calling us there. Maybe things would have turned out differently if we hadn't forced that thing out of the cocoon last time. We should return to 2F.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-3-b.json#Q.zh: 返回2层
前往走廊
与上次不同，安妮特拒绝交出剪刀。没有剪刀，恐怕很难处理挡住走廊的人台。我们得确认这次两件套是否仍守在那里。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-3-b.json#Q.en: Unlike last time, Annette refused to hand over the scissors. Without them, dealing with the Mannequin blocking the corridor may prove difficult. We need to check whether Two-piece is still guarding the way this time.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-3-b.json#Q.zh: 前往走廊
前往3层
这一次，我们选择站在红派一边，因此必须采取相应行动。前往3层红派精品店的商贩处，她一直在苦苦等待再次听见声音。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-3-b.json#Q.en: This time, we've chosen to side with Le Rouge, so we'll have to act accordingly. We should go to Boutique du Rouge's vendor on 3F, who has been waiting desperately to hear the Voice again.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-3-b.json#Q.zh: 前往3层
让不可动摇者看看孩子
我们抵达了3层。让红派精品店的商贩看看这个孩子吧。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-3-b.json#Q.en: We've arrived at 3F. Let's show the child to Boutique du Rouge's vendor.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-3-b.json#Q.zh: 让不可动摇者看看孩子
检查不可动摇者的遗骸
精品店的女店主递给孩子一条手帕，就在孩子接过它的瞬间，她在我们眼前爆裂开来。搜索遗骸，寻找能用作尖钉的东西。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-3-b.json#Q.en: The proprietress of the Boutique handed the child a handkerchief, and the moment it was accepted, she burst apart before our eyes. Search the remains for something we can use as a Nail.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-3-b.json#Q.zh: 检查不可动摇者的遗骸

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 谢谢你……谢谢你将他们带到这卑微的地方来……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: Thank you... Thank you for bringing them to this humble place...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 我们没听见什么“声音”，除非你说的是你店里循环播放的这段录音。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: We don't hear any "voice," unless you're referring to this voice track playing on a loop through your store.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 你们听不见也是当然。这声音只对听过它召唤的人诉说……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: Of course you'd be deaf to it. The Voice speaks only to those who have heard its calling...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 那位商贩缓缓转过身，用那空洞的眼窝扫视着我们每一个人……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: The vendor turned slowly, her empty eye sockets scanning through each of us...
... until they came to rest on Meursault.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 他们就在那儿沉睡，安卧在你的怀中。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: There they sleep, nestled in your bosom.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 是的。他们如是说——那曾引领我们的声音已如落日般沉没……但我们不必哀悼，因为一道新的声音将升起，来引领羊群。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: Yes. They have spoken thus—the Voice that once shepherded us has fallen like the setting sun... Mourn we must not, for a new Voice shall rise to lead the flock.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 新的声音，正安然沉睡在那由万千丝线织成的摇篮中，被从所有人身上取走的丝线解开……对他们而言，外面的世界，既是新奇，也是……恐惧……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: The new Voice slumbers soundly in the Cradle of all threads, its strands undone and taken from all... To them, the world outside is at once a curiosity... and horror...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 当他们从睡梦中苏醒之时，我们将——啊，我已能看见了……我们将披上从西西弗百货每一处裂缝中取来的黄金皮革……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: When they awaken from their sleep, we will—oh, I can see it... We shall be wreathed in Golden Hide, taken from every fracture of the Grand Magasin...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 唉，我们必须尽好本分，为他们的苏醒做好准备。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: Alas, we must do our due diligence preparing for their awakening.
... And what might that due diligence entail?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 这层楼有一间改衣室。据说，那位改衣师的剪刀，锋利到能剪穿西西弗百货里的任何织物……她的双手灵巧到能将任何丝线织成布料。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: On this floor is an Alterationist's shop. It is said that her scissors are sharp enough to slice through any textile within the Grand Magasin... and her hands dextrous enough to weave any string into fabric.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 那么……那把犀利而精准的剪刀，终有一日会轻轻剪入摇篮，
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: Then... those keen, precise scissors will one day cut gently into the Cradle,

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 而她那双巧手织出的布料，将守护那些即将亵渎摇篮的黑派之手……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: and the fabric woven from her adroit hands will protect the Noirs whose hands shall desecrate the Cradle...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 这位改衣师的宿命，便是成为我们祸患的根源。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: The Alterationist's destiny is to be the root of our bane.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 在战争爆发之前，就从源头切断敌人的补给线？这……是个稳妥的战术。甚至可以说，相当出色。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: Cutting off the enemy's supply line at its source before the war even starts? That is... tactically sound. Fantastic, even.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 呃……可她根本不属于黑派啊。至少据我所知是这样的。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: Um... But she's not even a part of Le Noir. As far as I know, at least.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 你说得没错。她不过是个谦卑、诚实的改衣师，只是剪断丝线，再将其织成布料罢了。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: You are correct. She is but a humble, honest Alterationist who merely cuts threads to weave them into fabric.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 既然新的声音已在地平线上升起……那么，一切挡在它前路上的，都必须……被收割。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: Now that a new Voice has risen on the horizon... all that stands in their way must be... reaped.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: ……你打算怎么进行这场“收割”？你已经被钉在地上了。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: ... And how do you intend to do that "reaping"? You're nailed to the ground.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 我在这里的日子里，收集了不少眼球。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: I have collected many eyeballs during my time here.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 斩断这位改衣师，那一切……便都归你所有。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: Sever the Alterationist, and... all of that will be yours.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: <……先不排除这个选项。等听完另一边黑派的说法后，我们还有时间再做决定。>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: <... Let's not rule it out as an option. We'll have time to decide after we hear out the Noirs on the other side.>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: <color=#cf0000>煽动你的欲望吧……披上的越多……便越加……</color>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: <color=#cf0000>Fan your desires... The more you are donned... the higher...</color>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 默尔索母亲的声音，印刻在一盘磁带平坦的表面上，从这间店铺的墙后一遍又一遍地重复着她的留言。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: The voice of Meursault's mother, imprinted on the flat surface of an audiotape, repeats and repeats her message from behind the wall of this shop.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 然而，在那位商贩的世界里，它或许早已不复存在——她不再像从前那样转向它，往后也永远不会了。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: But it may as well no longer exist in the vendor's world—she does not turn toward it as she once had, and never will.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 那恼人的咔嚓咔嚓声总算停了……看来，你们已经照我所求做了？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: That irritating snip-snip has finally stopped... I understand that you have done as I asked?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 是的，我们做到了。希望你也能信守你那部分的约定。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: Yes, we have. And I'm hoping you'll hold up your end of the bargain.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 当然，当然。来吧……拿走我收集的这些眼球。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: Of course, of course. Here... take the eyeballs I have gathered.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: ……而且……他们中有几个，一直躲在里面……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: ... And... some of them have been holed up inside the whole time...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: ……是啊，看来西西弗百货的崩溃，也不过是时间问题了。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: ... Right, I suppose it's only a matter of time before the Grand Magasin falls, now.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 他们本来就没多清醒，可如今是一天比一天更疯癫了。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: They were never sane to begin with, but now they're growing more and more deranged by the day.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 不过你说，这会是真的吗？万一他们……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: Do you think it's true, though? What if they...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 正如品牌经理所说的那样。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: It really is as the Brand Manager has said.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 被那疯狂驱使，那些被声音抛弃的人，已经开始密谋一场最邪恶的计划了……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: Driven by madness, those abandoned by the Voice have begun to scheme a plan most wicked...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: ……而且，他们还将与刚抵达西西弗百货的这些异乡人携手合作。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: ... and they shall join hands with the strangers who have just arrived at the Grand Magasin.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 并没有什么携手合作。让我把话说清楚：我们既不隶属红派，也不隶属黑派——比起卷入一场与我们毫无干系的战争，我们更愿意置身事外。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: There wasn't any joining of hands. Let me clarify now that we are not affiliated with either Le Rouge or Le Noir—we'd much rather keep to ourselves than get involved in a war we have no stake in.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 那道声音，早已预言了你们的到来，异乡人们。说你们会在接受了铲除改衣师的委托之后，来到这里。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: The Voice has prophesied your coming, strangers. That you would come here, after receiving a request to eliminate the Alterationist.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 若你们胆敢伤害她，从今往后，我们便会宣布你们为黑派之敌。像如今这般危机时刻，她织出的布料，是我们绝不能舍弃的东西。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: Should you bring her harm, we will henceforth declare you enemies of Le Noir. We cannot dispense with the fabric she weaves in times of crisis like the present.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 这位改衣师的重要性，无论怎么强调都不为过。就连品牌经理本人，也曾无数次靠她织的布料渡过难关。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: The Alterationist's importance cannot be overstated. Even the Brand Manager has had to use her fabric to overcome countless trials.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 品牌经理还向我们透露了不少关于你们计划的事。你们手上，握着一件对红派那阴险图谋不可或缺的神器，是不是？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: The Brand Manager has also told us much about your plans. You possess an artifact that is integral to the Rouges' insidious plot, don't you?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 我们现在就给你们一个机会，就在此地此刻，证明你们真正的立场。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: We'll give you a chance to prove your true allegiance right now, right here.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 交出那件神器……我们便以顾客之礼相待，而非敌人。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: Hand over that artifact... and we will greet you as customers, not enemies.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: <他们……比第一次遇到时敌意重多了。>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: <They're... a lot more hostile than they were the first time.>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: ……很可能是引导黑派的那位巨人，在背后做了什么手脚。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: ... It is likely that the Giant who guides Le Noir has done something behind the scenes.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: <哦，对了。让娜记得循环之前发生的事……那么黑派的巨人，想必也和她一样不受“清仓”影响。>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: <Oh, yeah. Jeanne remembers the events prior to the loop... then the Noir's Giant must be just as immune to the Liquidation as she is.>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 那、那我们该怎么办？我不太清楚他们到底想要什么，但是……我觉得，他们是想向你要点什么，默尔索……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: Wh-what do we do? I don't know exactly what they're looking for, but... I think they want something from you, Meursault...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 把默尔索的神器交出去，肯定能博得黑派的好感。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: Handing over Meursault's artifact will definitely get us into the Noirs' good graces.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 然后他们会给我们鉴定报告，我们再拿着它去找那位单脚人——等等，不对。这样一来，我们又会被锁死在跟之前一样的路线上。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: Then they'll give us the Authenticity Certificate, and we'll bring that to the One-leg on the—wait, no. That'll just lock us into the same route as before.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 我们……不会把任何东西交给你们。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: We... will not hand anything over to you.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 那么，你们就是我们的敌人了。
异乡人，看来你们还不明白红派的真面目，让我来告诉你们，一旦放任他们，会引来怎样的恐怖后果。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: Strangers, you don't seem to understand the Rouges' true nature, so let me fill you in on just what kind of horror you'd be unleashing.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 能让西西弗百货免于崩塌的，唯有那些生长在裂缝之上的黄金松脂斑块。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: The only thing keeping the Grand Magasin from collapse are the patches of the Golden Resin that have grown over its cracks.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 而那些红色的家伙……一直在从墙上刮取那神圣的松脂，只为把它披在身上，满足自己那虚荣的饥饿。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: And those red ones... they've been scraping that holy resin from the walls just to wear it as clothes and sate their vain hunger.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 他们早就该被毁灭了！你们知道我们等了多久，就为了看他们的贪婪反噬自己吗？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: Their destruction's been long overdue! Do you have any idea how long we've waited for their own greed to come back and bite them?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 如果你们仍然不肯交出来，那……你们跟他们就没什么两样了。这意味着，我们只能用武力从你们手中夺走它。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: If you still won't hand it over, then... you're no different from them. Which means we'll have to take it from you by force.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 那、那我们真的要杀了改衣师小姐吗？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: S-so, are we really going to kill Miss Alterationist?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 她对我们一点敌意都没有，不像这两位……再说，我们也没理由非要照着那位红派女士说的做啊。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: She wasn't hostile toward us at all, not like these two... Besides, we don't have any reason to do as the Rouge lady asked.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 我们同样也没理由不照她说的做。别忘了：她承诺过，只要我们除掉改衣师，就给我们一大笔眼球作为回报。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: And we don't have any reason not to do as she asked. Remember: she promised us quite a significant sum of eyeballs in return for slaying the Alterationist.

_mech/Enemies-a1c10p2.json#1502#name.en: One Who Emerged from the Earth

_mech/PanicInfo-a1c10p2.json#1109#flavor.zh: ……很疼。他们把我撕得四分五裂。但现在他们会保护我。真奇怪。我现在喜欢这样。可我还是害怕他们会再次伤害我……
_mech/PanicInfo-a1c10p2.json#1109#flavor.en: ... It hurt. They tore me apart. But now they protect me. It's weird. I like it now. I'm still scared they'll hurt me again, though...

_mech/PanicInfo-a1c10p2.json#1113#flavor.zh:
它狂怒、哀恸、号哭，但这些情感正是它的业报。诞生必然连着死亡；它将卵抱在怀中，却不知道令某物降生，也意味着接受更为沉重的失去。
其中无所谓善恶，唯有愚行。
_mech/PanicInfo-a1c10p2.json#1113#flavor.en:
It rages, grieves, and howls, but these emotions are its karma. Birth is bound to death, and it cradled the egg without knowing that to bring something forth is to accept the weight of a greater loss.
There is neither good nor evil in this, but only folly.

_mech/Bufs-a1c10p2.json#TangleBlackYarn#.zh: - 最大层数：30 - 每有1层，受到的伤害+1% - 每有10层，基础威力-1 - 回合结束：每有3层，下回合获得1层束缚（最多10层） - 使用防御技能时，失去一半层数（向上取整）
_mech/Bufs-a1c10p2.json#TangleBlackYarn#.en: - Max Stack: 30 - Take +1% damage for every Stack - Base Power -1 for every 10 Stacks - Turn End: Gain 1 Bind next turn for every 3 Stacks (max 10) - On Defense Skill Use, lose half of the Stacks (rounded up)

_mech/Bufs-a1c10p2.json#TangleBlackYarn#.zh: 百货商场是一个由针线缝合而成的世界。即便是来自大海的事物，如今躯体也化作了丝线，黑水纠缠成了黑之丝。
_mech/Bufs-a1c10p2.json#TangleBlackYarn#.en: The department store is a world of sewing, bound together by thread and needle. Even that which came from the sea now finds its body turned to thread, black water tangling into black yarn.

_mech/Bufs-a1c10p2.json#SickBlackYarn#de.zh:
- 最大层数：50
- 每有1层，受到的伤害+1%
- 回合开始：每有25层，获得1层易损
_mech/Bufs-a1c10p2.json#SickBlackYarn#de.en:
- Max Stack: 50
- Take +1% damage for every Stack
- Turn Start: Gain 1 Fragile for every 25 Stacks

_mech/Bufs-a1c10p2.json#SickBlackYarn#fl.zh: 每当一缕散线从黑之丝中迸裂而出，便会带来眼泪的咸涩气息……莫名令人怀念。
_mech/Bufs-a1c10p2.json#SickBlackYarn#fl.en: Each time a loose strand bursts from the black yarn, it carries the briny scent of tears... strangely nostalgic despite itself.

_mech/Bufs-a1c10p2.json#HeavyBlackYarn#d.zh:
- 最大层数：5
- 获得等同于层数的槽位加权值（每个部位分别计算）
- 每有1层，受到的伤害+10%
_mech/Bufs-a1c10p2.json#HeavyBlackYarn#d.en:
- Max Stack: 5
- Gain Slot Weight equal to Stack (per Part)
- Take +10% damage for every Stack

_mech/Bufs-a1c10p2.json#HeavyBlackYarn#f.zh: 黑色是死亡与质量的意象。正如黑色海水会因其中承载之物而愈发沉重，黑线也会在结成一团时增添重量。它将一切聚入自身，紧紧打结、下沉，继而停滞。
_mech/Bufs-a1c10p2.json#HeavyBlackYarn#f.en: Black is an image of death and mass. Just as black seawater grows heavy with what it holds, black thread gains weight as it clumps together. It gathers everything into itself, knots tight, sinks, and stops.

_mech/Bufs-a1c10p2.json#HideBlackYarn#de.zh: - 最大威力：6 - 最大层数：2 - 受到攻击时，失去1点威力（每个技能1次） - 回合结束：失去1层 - 威力或层数降至0时失效 - 不会陷入混乱 - 单方面攻击时，造成的伤害+100% - 受到的伤害-100%
_mech/Bufs-a1c10p2.json#HideBlackYarn#de.en: - Max Potency: 6 - Max Count: 2 - When hit, lose 1 Potency (once per Skill) - Turn End: Lose 1 Count - Expires if Potency or Count reaches 0 - Cannot be Staggered - On Unopposed Attack, deal +100% damage - Take -100% damage

_mech/Bufs-a1c10p2.json#HideBlackYarn#fl.zh: 如今这里既非大海，也非水族箱，只是一潭死水。然而沉积于此的深切思慕蕴含着足以暂时藏匿躯干的悲伤。
_mech/Bufs-a1c10p2.json#HideBlackYarn#fl.en: It is neither sea nor aquarium now, only a stagnant pond. Yet the great longing that has settled there holds enough sorrow to momentarily hide the body.

_mech/Bufs-a1c10p2.json#AngryBlackYarn#d.zh:
- 每有1个持有本效果的部位，所有部位的拼点威力+2
- 目标每有3层缠结，造成的伤害+5%（最多50%）
- 回合结束时失效
_mech/Bufs-a1c10p2.json#AngryBlackYarn#d.en:
- All Parts gain Clash Power +2 for every Part that has this effect
- Deal +5% damage for every 3 Tangling Stacks on target (max 50%)
- Expires at Turn End

_mech/Bufs-a1c10p2.json#AngryBlackYarn#n.en: Instinct of the Predator of Eld

_mech/Bufs-a1c10p2.json#AngryBlackYarn#f.zh: 每座水族箱都有自己的捕食者，就像百货商场里的楼层经理。如今捕食者以鱼的形态现身，但在更早的西西弗系统中，水族箱里并不存在鱼形生物。生活在那里的人，内心或许是鱼，外形却是人。
_mech/Bufs-a1c10p2.json#AngryBlackYarn#f.en: Every aquarium had its predator, much like a Floor Manager in the department store. The predator now wears the shape of a fish, but in an earlier Sisyphe System, there were no fish-shaped beings in the Aquarium. The minds of those who lived there may have been fish, but their forms were human.

_mech/Bufs-a1c10p2.json#BlackYarn_LowMor.zh:
- 士气低落
- 使用技能时，若布布为主要目标，则拼点威力+3、基础威力+2
- 受到攻击时，施加1层缠结（每个技能3次）
_mech/Bufs-a1c10p2.json#BlackYarn_LowMor.en:
- Low Morale
- On Skill Use, if Pwie is the main target, Clash Power +3, Base Power +2
- When hit, inflict 1 Tangling (3 times per Skill)

_mech/Bufs-a1c10p2.json#BlackYarn_Panic#.zh:
- 恐慌
- 所有攻击均以布布为目标
- 使用技能时，若布布为主要目标，则拼点威力+6、基础威力+4
- 战斗开始：将所有技能硬币转化为不可摧毁的硬币
- 受到攻击时，施加1层缠结（每个技能6次）
_mech/Bufs-a1c10p2.json#BlackYarn_Panic#.en:
- Panic
- All Attacks target Pwie
- On Skill Use, if Pwie is the main target, Clash Power +6, Base Power +4
- Combat Start: Convert all Skill Coins into Unbreakable Coins
- When hit, inflict 1 Tangling (6 times per Skill)

_mech/Bufs-a1c10p2.json#FlowerLaurelWrea.zh: - 移除所有混乱区间 - 拼点威力+2 - 因沉沦受到的精神力伤害-50%（向下取整） - 回合结束：回复10点精神力，并于下回合获得5层迅捷 - 拼点胜利：包括自身与援护单位在内的所有友方回复5点精神力
_mech/Bufs-a1c10p2.json#FlowerLaurelWrea.en: - Remove all Stagger Thresholds - Clash Power +2 - Take -50% SP damage from Sinking (rounded down) - Turn End: Heal 10 SP and gain 5 Haste next turn - Clash Win: Heal 5 SP for all allies including this unit and Assist Units

_mech/Bufs-a1c10p2.json#FlowerLaurelWrea.zh: 让它对罪孽的告解，在花香之下绽放。
_mech/Bufs-a1c10p2.json#FlowerLaurelWrea.en: Let the confession of its sins bloom beneath the fragrance of flowers.

_mech/Bufs-a1c10p2.json#AlriuneSillage#d.zh:
- 最大层数：30
- 回合结束：受到等同于层数的精神力伤害
- 若本单位受到沉沦伤害，获得1层
- 震颤引爆时，对其他3名随机友方施加1~2层余香
- 层数达到上限时：
 · 获得2点震颤，并对自身触发震颤引爆
 · 受到等同于自身沉沦的忧郁伤害
 · 余香失效
 · 本回合内无法再次获得
- 死亡时，将本单位一半的余香层数随机分配给友方（向下取整）
_mech/Bufs-a1c10p2.json#AlriuneSillage#d.en:
- Max Stack: 30
- Turn End: Take SP damage equal to Stack
- If this unit took Sinking damage, gain 1 Stack
- On Tremor Burst, apply 1 ~ 2 Faint Aroma on 3 other random allies
- At max Stack:
 · Gain 2 Tremor and trigger Tremor Burst on self
 · Take Gloom damage equal to Sinking on self
 · Faint Aroma expires
 · Cannot gain for the rest of the turn
- On death, apply half of this unit's Faint Aroma Stack randomly between this unit's allies (rounded down)

_mech/Bufs-a1c10p2.json#AlriuneSillage#f.zh: 芬芳孕育思慕，而思慕又化作渴望。
_mech/Bufs-a1c10p2.json#AlriuneSillage#f.en: Fragrance begets longing. Longing, in turn, becomes yearning.

_mech/Bufs-a1c10p2.json#AlriunePetal#des.zh: 最大层数：3 - 达到3层时，于该回合使用强力技能 - 对陷入混乱的目标造成的伤害+（自身花瓣层数×10）% - 回合结束：获得1层
_mech/Bufs-a1c10p2.json#AlriunePetal#des.en: Max Stack: 3 - At 3 Stacks, use a powerful Skill that turn - Deal +(Petals Stack on self x 10)% damage to Staggered targets - Turn End: Gain 1 Stack

_mech/Bufs-a1c10p2.json#AlriunePetal#fla.zh: 一片花瓣，两片花瓣……然后，是第三片。
_mech/Bufs-a1c10p2.json#AlriunePetal#fla.en: One petal, two petals... and then, three.

_mech/Bufs-a1c10p2.json#ThreadDye#desc.zh: - 最大层数：3 - 持有本效果时无法获得迅捷 - 回合结束：移除将在下回合获得的迅捷 - 回合结束：下回合获得等同于威力的束缚，并失去1层 - 层数达到上限时，本回合与下回合获得无法行动；随后本效果失效
_mech/Bufs-a1c10p2.json#ThreadDye#desc.en: - Max Stack: 3 - Cannot gain Haste while having this effect - Turn End: Remove Haste that will be applied next turn - Turn End: Gain Bind next turn equal to Potency and lose 1 Stack - At max Stack, gain Immobilize this turn and next turn; then, this effect expires

_mech/Bufs-a1c10p2.json#ThreadDye#flavor.zh: 丝线会像尖钉一样将你牢牢拘束，而那拘束的色彩早已注定。
_mech/Bufs-a1c10p2.json#ThreadDye#flavor.en: Like nails, threads will hold you fast, the color of its binds predetermined.

_mech/Bufs-a1c10p2.json#SpreadingDye#des.zh:
- 若目标持有束缚，额外施加1点流血威力与1层流血
- 使用技能时，若主要目标持有染色丝线或焦油染料，则该技能最终威力+1，造成的伤害+20%
