_mech/Bufs-a1c10p2.json#SpreadingDye#des.en:
- If target has Bind, inflict 1 more Bleed Potency and Bleed Count
- On Skill Use, if the main target has Dyed Thread or Tar Dye, the said Skill gains Final Power +1 and deals +20% damage

_mech/Bufs-a1c10p2.json#SpreadingDye#fla.zh:
大多数染料都应当具有色彩。
但这种染料没有。

当它以粗糙而不均的笔触涂抹开来，仅凭纯粹光线的反射与折射，便能显现出斑斓光谱。
_mech/Bufs-a1c10p2.json#SpreadingDye#fla.en:
Most dyes are meant to have a color.
But this one's dye has none.

Applied in rough, uneven strokes, it reveals a spectrum of colors through nothing but the reflection and refraction of pure light.

_mech/Bufs-a1c10p2.json#StickyDye#desc.zh:
- 最大层数：1
- 速度最小值与最大值-1（最低为1）

_mech/Bufs-a1c10p2.json#StickyDye#flavor.zh: 染料紧紧黏附，令每一步都愈发艰难。
_mech/Bufs-a1c10p2.json#StickyDye#flavor.en: The dye clings, making every step harder to take.

_mech/Bufs-a1c10p2.json#ChargeKhaki#desc.zh:
- 特殊充能
- 最大层数：20
- 本效果强度与层数的增减同样受普通充能 影响
- 回合结束时，本效果的层数减少1层
_mech/Bufs-a1c10p2.json#ChargeKhaki#desc.en:
- Unique Charge
- Max Count: 20
- Interacts the same way as normal Charge does to effects that raise or reduce Charge Potency and Count
- Turn End: Lose 1 Count

_mech/Bufs-a1c10p2.json#ChargeKhaki#flav.zh: 如浮标般随潮漂流之人或许无力改变事态的走向，却仍能助长浪潮，并在其中贯彻自己的行动。
_mech/Bufs-a1c10p2.json#ChargeKhaki#flav.en: Those who are carried by the tide like buoys may not be able to change the flow of things, but they can still bolster the tide and commit to their acts within.

_mech/Bufs-a1c10p2.json#FinishedFabric#d.zh:
- 最大层数：30
- 获得或消耗充能层数（包括特殊充能）的技能造成的伤害+（层数）%（最多30%）
- 回合结束：失去5层
  · 若本回合护盾被击破，则改为失去10层
_mech/Bufs-a1c10p2.json#FinishedFabric#d.en:
- Max Stack: 30
- Skills that gain or consume Charge Count (including Unique Charge) deal +(Stack)% damage (max 30%)
- Turn End: Lose 5 Stacks
  · If Shield was broken this turn, lose 10 Stacks instead

_mech/Bufs-a1c10p2.json#FinishedFabric#f.zh: 拥有自身功能的布料，唯有经过妥善裁剪，方能发挥其用途。
_mech/Bufs-a1c10p2.json#FinishedFabric#f.en: Fabrics with functions of their own can only serve their purpose when properly cut.

_mech/Bufs-a1c10p2.json#LargeTailoringSh.zh:
- 最大层数：3
- 对罪人造成的伤害+（5+层数×5）%（最多20%）
- 对改衣对象罪人使用技能时，获得等同于层数的拼点威力
_mech/Bufs-a1c10p2.json#LargeTailoringSh.en:
- Max Stack: 3
- Deal +(5 + Stack x 5)% damage against Sinners (max 20%)
- On Skill Use against Alteration Target Sinners, gain Clash Power equal to Stack

_mech/Bufs-a1c10p2.json#LargeTailoringSh.zh: 用于剪断地下产出的原初材料之剪，比寻常剪刀更加巨大而奇异。它曾反复裁剪世上最初织就的布料。花朵从中绽放也是理所当然，毕竟它向来从根部剪断万物。
_mech/Bufs-a1c10p2.json#LargeTailoringSh.en: The scissors used to sever the primordial materials produced underground are larger and more extraordinary still. These scissors have cut and recut the very first cloth ever woven. That flowers should bloom from them is only natural, for they have always cut things at their very roots.

_mech/Bufs-a1c10p2.json#TailoringTarget#.zh:
- 速度最小值与最大值+5
- 本回合首次使用的技能拼点威力+3
- 战斗开始：若本单位装备了防御技能，则受到改衣师安妮特造成的伤害-80%
- 回合结束：失去1层
_mech/Bufs-a1c10p2.json#TailoringTarget#.en:
- Min & Max Speed +5
- This turn's first-used Skill gains Clash Power +3
- Combat Start: If this unit has an equipped Defense Skill, take -80% damage from Annette the Alterationist
- Turn End: Lose 1 Stack

_mech/Bufs-a1c10p2.json#TailoringTarget#.zh: 她并非修改衣服以贴合穿着者，而是修改穿着者以贴合衣服。在这里，是衣服定义了穿着者；保全衣物并修改人体，才是维护价值、服务顾客的方式。
_mech/Bufs-a1c10p2.json#TailoringTarget#.en: Rather than altering the clothes to fit the person, she alters the person to fit the clothes. Here, clothes are what define the wearer; preserving the garment and altering the person is how worth is protected and how the customer is served.

_mech/Bufs-a1c10p2.json#ScissorsMark#des.zh:
- 最大层数：9
- 防御等级降低等同于层数的数值
_mech/Bufs-a1c10p2.json#ScissorsMark#des.en:
- Max Stack: 9
- Lose Defense Level equal to Stack

_mech/Bufs-a1c10p2.json#ScissorsMark#fla.zh: 为将布料与其他材料裁至所需尺寸而留下的裁切标记。
_mech/Bufs-a1c10p2.json#ScissorsMark#fla.en: A cutting mark used to trim fabric and other materials to the required measurements.

_mech/Bufs-a1c10p2.json#DamagedFabric#de.zh:
- 最大层数：30
- 回合开始：每有6层，获得1层体力回复效率减少（最多5层）
- 与“纸样裁剪”或“链式锁边”拼点时，拼点威力降低等同于层数的数值
_mech/Bufs-a1c10p2.json#DamagedFabric#de.en:
- Max Stack: 30
- Turn Start : Gain 1 HP Healing Down for every 6 Stacks (max 5)
- Upon Clashing against "Patterning" or "Surfile à la Chaîne", lose Clash Power equal to Stack

_mech/Bufs-a1c10p2.json#DamagedFabric#fl.zh: 布料一旦被剪碎，将碎片重新缝合也只能成为拼布。它再也无法恢复为由原本丝线织成的完整布料。
_mech/Bufs-a1c10p2.json#DamagedFabric#fl.en: Once the fabric has been cut apart, sewing the scraps back together only makes patchwork. It can never return to a single fabric woven from its original threads.

_mech/Bufs-a1c10p2.json#ThirdTailor_LowM.zh:
- 士气低落
- 受到的伤害+7.5%
- 每次受到攻击时，震颤层数+1（每个技能1次，每回合最多5层）
_mech/Bufs-a1c10p2.json#ThirdTailor_LowM.en:
- Low Morale
- Take +7.5% damage
- Every time this unit is hit, gain +1 Tremor Count (once per Skill, max 5 per turn)

_mech/Bufs-a1c10p2.json#ThirdTailor_LowM.zh: 我的手开始发抖，连剪刀都握不稳了……这样就没法再裁纸样了……
_mech/Bufs-a1c10p2.json#ThirdTailor_LowM.en: My hands are starting to shake, and even the scissors won't stay steady... I won't be able to cut the pattern anymore...

_mech/Bufs-a1c10p2.json#ThirdTailor_Pani.zh:
- 恐慌
- 受到的伤害+15%
- 每次受到攻击时，获得1点震颤威力且震颤层数+1（每个技能1次，每回合最多5层）
_mech/Bufs-a1c10p2.json#ThirdTailor_Pani.en:
- Panic
- Take +15% damage
- Every time this unit is hit, gain 1 Tremor Potency and +1 Tremor Count (once per Skill, max 5 per turn)

_mech/Bufs-a1c10p2.json#ThirdTailor_Pani.zh: 我的手开始发抖，连剪刀都握不稳了……这样就没法再裁纸样了……
_mech/Bufs-a1c10p2.json#ThirdTailor_Pani.en: My hands are starting to shake, and even the scissors won't stay steady... I won't be able to cut the pattern anymore...

_mech/Bufs-a1c10p2.json#GoldenLeatherEnh.zh: 目标每有3层针钉，技能最终威力+1（最多+3）
_mech/Bufs-a1c10p2.json#GoldenLeatherEnh.en: Skill Final Power +1 for every 3 Naildle on the target (max 3)

_mech/Bufs-a1c10p2.json#GoldenLeatherEnh.zh: 刺目阳光之雨[针线之王]
_mech/Bufs-a1c10p2.json#GoldenLeatherEnh.en: Shower of Stinging Sunshine [King of Needleworks]

_mech/Bufs-a1c10p2.json#GoldenLeatherEnh.zh: “你不必再倾听了。只要让自己什么都听不见就好。想做什么便去做吧。不要否定自己。”
_mech/Bufs-a1c10p2.json#GoldenLeatherEnh.en: "You don't have to listen anymore. You only have to make it so you cannot hear them. Simply do what you want. Don't deny yourself."

_mech/Bufs-a1c10p2.json#NoirShieldUp#des.zh:
- 最大威力：999
- 基础层数：2
- 不会陷入混乱
- 回合开始：该部位获得等同于层数的护盾
- 本效果视为“护盾管理”效果
- 失去护盾时失去相应层数
- 回合结束：失去1层
_mech/Bufs-a1c10p2.json#NoirShieldUp#des.en:
- Max Potency: 999
- Base Count: 2
- Cannot be Staggered
- Turn Start: The Part gains Shield equal to Stack
- This effect counts as a "Shield Management" effect
- Lose Stack when losing Shield
- Turn End: Lose 1 Count

_mech/Bufs-a1c10p2.json#NoirShieldUp#fla.zh: 黑曜神。黑曜巨人。铁锤的司祭。执掌保存之力的百货商场黑曜神，会通过直接接触赐下祝福。铁锤坚硬无比，其漆黑色泽吞没万物，令一切停滞……恰如死亡本身。
_mech/Bufs-a1c10p2.json#NoirShieldUp#fla.en: The Obsidian God. The Obsidian Giant. The Chaplain of the Hammer. The Obsidian God of the Grand Magasin, whose domain is the power of preservation, grants his blessing through direct contact. The hammer is hard, and its black hue absorbs all things and brings them to a halt... much like death itself.

_mech/Bufs-a1c10p2.json#NoirShieldPiece#.zh:
- 最大层数：2
- 受到的伤害-10%
- 达到2层时，最终威力-2
_mech/Bufs-a1c10p2.json#NoirShieldPiece#.en:
- Max Stack: 2
- Take -10% damage
- At 2 Stacks, Final Power -2

_mech/Bufs-a1c10p2.json#NoirShieldPiece#.zh: 仿佛有一块虚构的质量碎片压在躯体之上——那是对巨人惩罚的粗劣仿制。依照契约，攀向更高之处，就如背负巨石，在沉默中向上爬行。
_mech/Bufs-a1c10p2.json#NoirShieldPiece#.en: It feels as though a fragment of imaginary mass is pressing down upon the body—a crude imitation of a Giant's punishment. According to the covenant, ascending to a higher place is akin to bearing a heavy boulder and climbing in silence.

_mech/Bufs-a1c10p2.json#VibrationResonan.zh:
- 最大层数：2
- 受到的震颤引爆伤害-90%；混乱区间前移量-90%
- 造成的伤害+20%
- 回合结束：失去1层
_mech/Bufs-a1c10p2.json#VibrationResonan.en:
- Max Stack: 2
- Take -90% damage from Tremor Burst; -90% to Stagger Threshold raised
- Deal +20% damage
- Turn End: Lose 1 Stack

_mech/Bufs-a1c10p2.json#VibrationResonan.zh: 与一切追求保存的运动相对抗的逆波，撼动并瓦解保存本身，使其无法立足。
_mech/Bufs-a1c10p2.json#VibrationResonan.en: A counterwave set against every motion that seeks preservation shakes preservation itself apart, preventing it from taking hold.

_mech/Bufs-a1c10p2.json#NoirField#desc.zh:
- 最大层数：2
- 回合开始：每损失20%体力，获得1层威力强化与1层伤害量强化（各最多3层）
- 回合开始：所有“黑色”友方的技能获得等同于层数的最终威力

- 回合开始：层数达到1以上时，对包括自身在内的所有“黑色”友方施加以下效果：
 · 精神力+10
 · 攻击威力+2
 · 防御等级+2

- 回合开始：层数达到2以上时，对所有非“黑色”敌人施加以下效果：
 · 速度最大值-1
 · 攻击等级-6
 · 防御等级-2
_mech/Bufs-a1c10p2.json#NoirField#desc.en:
- Max Stack: 2
- Turn Start: Gain 1 Power Up and 1 Damage Up for every 20% missing HP (max 3 respectively)
- Turn Start: All "Le Noir" allies' Skills gain Final Power equal to Stack

- Turn Start: At 1+ Stack, apply the following effects to all "Le Noir" allies, including this unit:
 · SP +10
 · Attack Power +2
 · Defense Level +2

- Turn Start: At 2+ Stacks, apply the following effects to all non-"Le Noir" enemies:
 · Max Speed -1
 · Offense Level -6
 · Defense Level -2

_mech/Bufs-a1c10p2.json#NoirField#flavor.zh: 保存“黑色”所追求之保存价值的圣域。在其中，黑色一众的保存行动得以留存，并反过来惠及他们。这是永恒保存的领域——一个激起无限趋近死亡之冲动的场所。
_mech/Bufs-a1c10p2.json#NoirField#flavor.en: A sanctuary in which the value of conservation pursued by Le Noir is preserved. Within it, the Noirs' preservative actions are retained to their benefit. It is a realm of eternal conservation—a place that stirs the drive to infinitely approach death.

_mech/Bufs-a1c10p2.json#NoirSquareCollap.zh:
- 最大层数：10
- 防御等级降低等同于层数的数值
_mech/Bufs-a1c10p2.json#NoirSquareCollap.en:
- Max Stack: 10
- Lose Defense Level equal to Stack

_mech/Bufs-a1c10p2.json#NoirSquareCollap.zh: 当每个人都会尽职履行所分配职责的信念开始崩塌，怀疑便会在裂缝中扎根。
_mech/Bufs-a1c10p2.json#NoirSquareCollap.en: When faith—the faith that each will dutifully carry out their assigned role—begins to crumble, doubt takes root in the cracks.

_mech/Bufs-a1c10p2.json#NoirNail#desc.zh:
- 最大层数：3
- 本单位触发震颤引爆时：
 · 受到等同于自身震颤威力的怠惰伤害
 · 获得1层易损
 · 失去1层
_mech/Bufs-a1c10p2.json#NoirNail#desc.en:
- Max Stack: 3
- When Tremor Burst is triggered on this unit,
 · Take Sloth damage equal to Tremor Potency on self
 · Gain 1 Fragile
 · Lose 1 Stack

_mech/Bufs-a1c10p2.json#NoirNail#flavor.zh: 约定之锤受约定所缚，必须将钉子砸下。因此每当铁锤落下，那里便必须存在一枚钉子……即使原本并不存在。
_mech/Bufs-a1c10p2.json#NoirNail#flavor.en: The promised hammer is bound by promise to drive in a nail. Therefore, whenever the hammer falls, a nail must exist there... even if none was there before.

_mech/Bufs-a1c10p2.json#BuffetField#desc.zh:
- 进入遭遇战后，每2回合的回合开始时，呕吐之影响便会扩张
· 阶段1：布布
· 阶段2：所有友方罪人
· 阶段3：所有目标
_mech/Bufs-a1c10p2.json#BuffetField#desc.en:
- After entering the Encounter, Le Vomissement's influence expands at Turn Start every 2 turns
· Stage 1: Pwie
· Stage 2: All allied Sinners
· Stage 3: All targets

_mech/Bufs-a1c10p2.json#BuffetField#flav.zh:
为了生存、为了成长而吞下的事物，会将外界之物纳入自我。随后它又被排出，曾属于自我的事物便成为外界的一部分。

这是循环、扩张与吞噬。
_mech/Bufs-a1c10p2.json#BuffetField#flav.en:
What is devoured for survival, for growth, incorporates what was outside into what is mine. Then it is expelled once more, and what was mine becomes part of the outside.

It is cyclical, expansive, and consumptive.

_mech/Bufs-a1c10p2.json#BuffetField_0#de.zh: - 进入遭遇战后，每2回合的回合开始时，呕吐之影响便会扩张
_mech/Bufs-a1c10p2.json#BuffetField_0#de.en: - After entering the Encounter, Le Vomissement's influence expands at Turn Start every 2 turns

_mech/Bufs-a1c10p2.json#GourmandiseAlly#.zh:
- 基础威力+1，将所有技能的全部硬币转化为不可摧毁的硬币
- 自身每有3层流血，造成的伤害+5%（最多30%）；对目标的体力回复量+10%（最多100%，向下取整）
- 不会陷入混乱；受到的流血伤害-90%（强制混乱除外）
- 回合结束：失去1层
_mech/Bufs-a1c10p2.json#GourmandiseAlly#.en:
- Base Power +1, convert all Coins on all Skills into Unbreakable Coins
- Deal +5% damage for every 3 Bleed on self (max 30%); heal +10% more HP on target (max 100%, rounded down)
- Cannot be Staggered; take -90% damage from Bleed (excluding forced Staggers)
- Turn End: Lose 1 Stack

_mech/Bufs-a1c10p2.json#BloodyMucusAlly#.zh:
- 最大层数：3
- 使用攻击技能时，获得等同于层数的流血层数（每个技能1次）
- 使用防御技能时，失去1层
- 回合结束：失去1层
_mech/Bufs-a1c10p2.json#BloodyMucusAlly#.en:
- Max Stack: 3
- On Attack Skill Use, gain Bleed Count equal to Stack (once per Skill)
- On Defense Skill Use, lose 1 Stack
- Turn End: Lose 1 Stack

_mech/Bufs-a1c10p2.json#BuffetGold#desc.zh:
- 速度最大值：5
- 每有1层，受到的伤害+5%
- 层数达到上限时，若本单位持有流血，则受到的伤害+10%
_mech/Bufs-a1c10p2.json#BuffetGold#desc.en:
- Max Speed: 5
- Take +5% damage for every Stack
- At max Stack, take +10% damage if this unit has Bleed

_mech/Bufs-a1c10p2.json#BuffetGold#flavo.zh: 金色光芒指引孩子下一次该去伤害谁。即使受到那光芒的引导，孩子仍相信判断完全出自自己。
_mech/Bufs-a1c10p2.json#BuffetGold#flavo.en: The golden light guides the child toward whom they should harm next. Even under that guidance, the child believes the judgment to be entirely their own.

_mech/Bufs-a1c10p2.json#BuffetShoes#flav.zh: 谢谢……你送的鞋。穿上它，我就能去任何地方吗？我想……和你一起旅行。
_mech/Bufs-a1c10p2.json#BuffetShoes#flav.en: Thanks... for the shoes. Can I go anywhere if I put these on? I wanna... travel with you.

_mech/Bufs-a1c10p2.json#BuffetGoldenClot.zh:
- 防御等级+10
- 回合结束：若本单位陷入混乱，则解除混乱并回复50%体力（每场遭遇战1次）
_mech/Bufs-a1c10p2.json#BuffetGoldenClot.en:
- Defense Level +10
- Turn End: If this unit is Staggered, recover from Stagger and heal 50% HP (once per Encounter)

_mech/Bufs-a1c10p2.json#BuffetGoldenClot.zh: 孩子穿上了大人的衣服。那并非寻常衣物，而是以他者之死制成的皮衣。于是，孩子又向成年迈近了一步。
_mech/Bufs-a1c10p2.json#BuffetGoldenClot.en: The child has donned the clothes of an adult. Not just any clothes, but a hide garment made from another's death. And so, the child takes one step closer to adulthood.

_mech/Bufs-a1c10p2.json#Buffet_LowMorale.zh:
- 士气低落
- 获得3层守护

_mech/Bufs-a1c10p2.json#RestrictMob#desc.zh:
- 战斗开始：晒革囚犯成为攻击技能的目标时，本效果失效，且攻击者获得1层制革厂违规
- 回合结束：本效果失效
_mech/Bufs-a1c10p2.json#RestrictMob#desc.en:
- Combat Start: When Tanned Prisoner is targeted with an Attack Skill, this effect expires, and the attacker gains 1 Tannery Rule Violation
- Turn End: This effect expires

_mech/Bufs-a1c10p2.json#RestrictBoss#des.zh:
- 战斗开始：监工成为攻击技能的目标时，本效果失效，且攻击者获得1层制革厂违规
- 回合结束：本效果失效
_mech/Bufs-a1c10p2.json#RestrictBoss#des.en:
- Combat Start: When the Overseer is targeted with an Attack Skill, this effect expires, and the attacker gains 1 Tannery Rule Violation
- Turn End: This effect expires

_mech/Bufs-a1c10p2.json#RestrictTier1#de.zh:
- 战斗开始：装备攻击技能时，本效果失效并获得1层制革厂违规（E.G.O技能除外）
- 回合结束：本效果失效
_mech/Bufs-a1c10p2.json#RestrictTier1#de.en:
- Combat Start: When an Attack Skill is equipped, this effect expires and gain 1 Tannery Rule Violation (excluding E.G.O Skills)
- Turn End: This effect expires

_mech/Bufs-a1c10p2.json#RestrictDef#desc.zh:
- 战斗开始：装备防御技能时，本效果失效并获得1层制革厂违规
- 回合结束：本效果失效
_mech/Bufs-a1c10p2.json#RestrictDef#desc.en:
- Combat Start: When a Defense Skill is equipped, this effect expires and gain 1 Tannery Rule Violation
- Turn End: This effect expires

_mech/Bufs-a1c10p2.json#RestrictDenied#d.zh:
- 最大层数：1
- 受到监工造成的伤害+30%
- 本单位攻击结束时，监工对本单位使用“惩戒性打磨收尾”；随后本效果失效
_mech/Bufs-a1c10p2.json#RestrictDenied#d.en:
- Max Stack: 1
- Take +30% damage from the Overseer
- At this unit's Attack End, the Overseer uses the "Punishing Burnishing Finishing" Skill on this unit; then, this effect expires

_mech/Bufs-a1c10p2.json#RestrictDenied#f.zh: 目标是违反维系这个世界之规则的僭越者。
_mech/Bufs-a1c10p2.json#RestrictDenied#f.en: The target is a transgressor who has violated the rules by which this world is bound.

_mech/Bufs-a1c10p2.json#B3FreshMob#desc.zh:
- 最大层数：1
- 回合开始：获得20点护盾
- 回合结束：获得2层守护
- 回合结束时失效
_mech/Bufs-a1c10p2.json#B3FreshMob#desc.en:
- Max Stack: 1
- Turn Start: Gain 20 Shield
- Turn End: Gain 2 Protection
- Expires at Turn End

_mech/Bufs-a1c10p2.json#B3FreshMob#flavo.zh: 请小心处理。试穿皮衣时若弯曲过度，就会留下褶皱……那会降低它的价值。
_mech/Bufs-a1c10p2.json#B3FreshMob#flavo.en: Please handle with care. If you try on a hide garment and bend too much, it will crease... and that lowers its worth.

_mech/Bufs-a1c10p2.json#RestrictFailed#d.zh:
- 攻击等级+3
- 防御等级-3

_mech/Bufs-a1c10p2.json#RestrictFailed#f.zh: 你知道规则与法律有何区别吗？
_mech/Bufs-a1c10p2.json#RestrictFailed#f.en: Do you know the difference between a rule and a law?

_mech/Bufs-a1c10p2.json#targetDye_LowMor.zh: 技能对速度低于本单位的目标造成的伤害-5%
_mech/Bufs-a1c10p2.json#targetDye_LowMor.en: Skills deal -5% damage against targets with slower Speed than this unit's

_mech/Bufs-a1c10p2.json#targetDye_Panic#.zh: 技能对速度低于本单位的目标造成的伤害-10%
_mech/Bufs-a1c10p2.json#targetDye_Panic#.en: Skills deal -10% damage against targets with slower Speed than this unit's

_mech/Bufs-a1c10p2.json#targetDye_Panic#.zh: 比自己运动得更快之物，当真能够被固定住吗？
_mech/Bufs-a1c10p2.json#targetDye_Panic#.en: Can that which moves faster than oneself truly be fixed in place?

_mech/Bufs-a1c10p2.json#RouteBOneLeg#des.zh:
- 基础攻击等级+25
- 基础防御等级+25
_mech/Bufs-a1c10p2.json#RouteBOneLeg#des.en:
- Base Offense Level +25
- Base Defense Level +25

_mech/Bufs-a1c10p2.json#SapsareeGold#des.zh:
- 使用技能时，目标每有1层“灼舌辣酱”，最终威力+1（最多+3）
- 使用本单位的技能杀死友方时，回复15点精神力
_mech/Bufs-a1c10p2.json#SapsareeGold#des.en:
- On Skill Use, Final Power +1 for every "Fiery, Tongue-scorching Sauce" on target (max 3)
- Gain 15 SP upon killing an ally with this unit's Skill

_mech/Bufs-a1c10p2.json#SapsareeGold#nam.zh: 刺痛不已的阳光之雨[副厨]

_mech/Bufs-a1c10p2.json#SapsareeGold#fla.zh: “副厨的心既温暖又热诚，听见了吗？副厨心里装满了自信，听见了吗？！”
_mech/Bufs-a1c10p2.json#SapsareeGold#fla.en: "Sous-chef has a warm, hearty heart, you hear? Sous-chef is stuffed full of confidence, you hear?!"

_mech/Bufs-a1c10p2.json#GoldenManager#de.zh:
- 目标每有1层戒备森严，造成的伤害+5%（最多50%）
- 对精神力为0以下的目标使用技能时，基础威力+3
_mech/Bufs-a1c10p2.json#GoldenManager#de.en:
- Deal +5% damage for every Guarded Caution on target (max 50%)
- Base Power +3 On Skill Use against target that has 0 or less SP

_mech/Bufs-a1c10p2.json#GoldenManager#na.zh: 刺痛不已的阳光之雨[3F楼层经理]
_mech/Bufs-a1c10p2.json#GoldenManager#na.en: Shower of Stinging Sunshine [3F Floor Manager]

_mech/Bufs-a1c10p2.json#GoldenManager#fl.zh: 阳光灼热，却无法抛下布匹，心灵只能缩进毯子下面……钻得更深、更深……
_mech/Bufs-a1c10p2.json#GoldenManager#fl.en: The sunshine burns hot, yet the cloth cannot be cast aside, and the heart retreats beneath the blankets... deeper beneath the blankets...

_mech/Bufs-a1c10p2.json#SisyphusSapphire.zh:
- 技能对敌人额外施加1点烧伤、流血、震颤、破裂与沉沦威力
- 获得充能层数与呼吸层数时，额外获得2层
- 获得本效果时，获得10层充能（每场遭遇战1次）
- 拼点威力+1
- 最终威力+1
_mech/Bufs-a1c10p2.json#SisyphusSapphire.en:
- Skills inflict 1 more Burn, Bleed, Tremor, Rupture, and Sinking Potency against enemies
- Gain +2 more Count when gaining Charge Count and Poise Count
- Gain +10 Charge Count when gaining this effect (once per Encounter)
- Clash Power +1
- Final Power +1

_mech/Bufs-a1c10p2.json#SisyphusOnyx#des.zh:
- 技能对敌人额外施加1点烧伤、流血、震颤、破裂与沉沦威力
- 获得充能层数与呼吸层数时，额外获得2层
- 获得本效果时，获得10层充能（每场遭遇战1次）
- 拼点威力+2
- 最终威力+1
_mech/Bufs-a1c10p2.json#SisyphusOnyx#des.en:
- Skills inflict 1 more Burn, Bleed, Tremor, Rupture, and Sinking Potency against enemies
- Gain +2 more Count when gaining Charge Count and Poise Count
- Gain +10 Charge Count when gaining this effect (once per Encounter)
- Clash Power +2
- Final Power +1

_mech/Bufs-a1c10p2.json#SisyphusDiamond#.zh:
- 技能对敌人额外施加1点烧伤、流血、震颤、破裂与沉沦威力
- 获得充能层数与呼吸层数时，额外获得2层
- 获得本效果时，获得10层充能（每场遭遇战1次）
- 拼点威力+2
- 最终威力+1
- 造成的伤害+10%
_mech/Bufs-a1c10p2.json#SisyphusDiamond#.en:
- Skills inflict 1 more Burn, Bleed, Tremor, Rupture, and Sinking Potency against enemies
- Gain +2 more Count when gaining Charge Count and Poise Count
- Gain +10 Charge Count when gaining this effect (once per Encounter)
- Clash Power +2
- Final Power +1
- Deal +10% damage

_mech/Bufs-a1c10p2.json#OutOfControl_Low.zh:
- 士气低落
- 技能最终威力+1
- 回合开始：对其他所有友方施加1层攻击威力减少
_mech/Bufs-a1c10p2.json#OutOfControl_Low.en:
- Low Morale
- Skill Final Power +1
- Turn Start: Apply 1 Attack Power Down to all other allies

_mech/Bufs-a1c10p2.json#OutOfControl_Pan.zh:
- 恐慌
- 技能最终威力+1
- 回合开始：对其他所有友方施加1层攻击威力减少与1层伤害量减少
_mech/Bufs-a1c10p2.json#OutOfControl_Pan.en:
- Panic
- Skill Final Power +1
- Turn Start: Apply 1 Attack Power Down and 1 Damage Down to all other allies

_mech/Bufs-a1c10p2.json#LaNoirSuperior_L.zh:
- 士气低落
- 攻击等级-2
- 防御等级+2
_mech/Bufs-a1c10p2.json#LaNoirSuperior_L.en:
- Low Morale
- Offense Level -2
- Defense Level +2

_mech/Bufs-a1c10p2.json#LaNoirSuperior_P.zh:

_mech/Passives_Assist-a1c10p2.json#40004.zh: 尽管孩子感觉自己的手臂、双腿乃至整个身体都如此陌生，核心处微弱的搏动很快便会开始疯狂脉动。
_mech/Passives_Assist-a1c10p2.json#40004.en: Though the arms, legs, and everything else about their body feels alien to the child, the faint beating from their core will soon begin its mad pulsation.

_mech/Passives_Assist-a1c10p2.json#40004.zh: 他们说，想要刺穿皮革进行缝制，就需要一枚粗壮结实的钉子。如果一次不行，那就再试一次……！
_mech/Passives_Assist-a1c10p2.json#40004.en: They said I needed a thick, sturdy nail to punch through leather for sewing. If that didn't work, I just need to try again...!

_mech/Passives_Assist-a1c10p2.json#40004.zh: 人可以迷失方向，误入歧途，但“它”不允许任何人有意反抗或偏离潮流。

_mech/Passives_Assist-a1c10p2.json#40004.zh: 黏稠秽物
_mech/Passives_Assist-a1c10p2.json#40004.en: Le Visqueux-Abject

_mech/Passives_Assist-a1c10p2.json#40004.zh:
在无尽的盛宴中，绯红神明不断吞食；被吞下之物经消化后排出，化作环绕其身的黏液之地。
这是吞噬的结果，自我与他者的界线在此模糊。这团黏痰般的排泄物究竟是我的一部分，还是属于他者？在这道边界之内，属于我的一切都在脉动，不属于我的一切则会瓦解。

因为我畏惧边界之外的事物。
_mech/Passives_Assist-a1c10p2.json#40004.en:
In an endless feast, the Crimson God consumes and consumes; what is devoured is then digested and excreted as a field of mucus around them.
This is the outcome of consumption, where the distinction between self and other blurs. Is this phlegmatic discharge a part of me, or is it of another? Within this boundary, all that is mine pulsates, while all that is not disintegrates.

For I am afraid of what lies outside the periphery.

_mech/Passives_Assist-a1c10p2.json#40004.zh: 童年终结
_mech/Passives_Assist-a1c10p2.json#40004.en: La Fin de l'Enfance

_mech/Passives_Assist-a1c10p2.json#40004.zh:
谁来决定童年何时结束？

绯红之子在冒险中渐渐长大，经历塑造了他们，他们也在旅途终点勾勒着自己的未来——至少他们曾如此以为。童年戛然而止，冒险也随之终结；那从来都不是他们能够自行决定如何结束的事。

童年的终结，是外部世界的现实突然而猛烈地闯入。与其说那是一场约定好的仪式，不如说是一纸强硬的通知：“你已经不是孩子了。”
_mech/Passives_Assist-a1c10p2.json#40004.en:
Who determines the childhood's end?

The crimson child matured throughout the adventure, shaped by their experiences and sketching their own future at the end of the journey—or so they thought. Their childhood came to a sudden halt, and so too did the adventure; it was never something they could've ended on their own terms.

Childhood's end is a sudden, violent intrusion of reality from the world outside, more a forceful notice than a promised ritual: "You're not a child anymore."

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.en: <... back to the restroom, you two... I guess?>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.zh: 哎，你都没试过，怎么就知道不行？先别急着认输嘛。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.en: Oi, how do ya know that without givin' it a try? Don't go throwin' in the towel already.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.zh: 希斯克利夫，但丁说这话，与其说是绝望，不如说——
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.en: Heathcliff, what Dante said is less out of despair and more—

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.zh: 行了行了，随便啦。咱们至少先去看看这儿是咋回事吧。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.en: Yeah, whatever. Let's at least see what's goin' on here.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.zh: 一堵由血肉与骨骼构成的墙挡住了去路。墙后的地上，横七竖八躺着几具黑派的尸体。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.en: A wall made of flesh and bone blocks the way. There are bodies of dead Noirs splayed around the floor past the wall.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.zh: 这个方向暂时还去不了，经理。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.en: We cannot go in this direction yet, Manager.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.zh: ……我们本该……为这次袭击做更充分的准备的……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.en: ... We should've... been better prepared for our assault...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.zh: 早知道……早知道我们能……把消息传得更快点……没来得及……集结起来……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.en: If only... if only we could've... spread the news faster... Didn't have time... to assemble...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.zh: 该死……该死的……！不能让红派占了这层大厅……他们会……他们会……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.en: Dammit... Damn it all...! We can't let the Rouges take the hall... They'll—they'll...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.zh: 她安静地躺在那里，脸上却挂着一抹平静的微笑——那种只有在成功完成使命、坚持到最后一刻的人脸上，才能见到的微笑。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.en: She lies dead still, but is wearing a peaceful smile—the same kind of smile only seen on the faces of those who know they have successfully carried out their duty to the end.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.zh: 拜托……剩下的……就交给你们了……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.en: Please... I leave the rest... in your hands...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.zh: <不知道到了那儿会发生什么，不过……我们先试着找路上五楼吧。>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.en: <I don't know what'll happen when we get there, but... Let's try to find a way up to the fifth floor.>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.zh: <不管红派想让我们做什么，我们的目标始终是抵达这栋楼的最高层。>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.en: <Regardless of what the Rouges want us to do, our goal is to get to the top floor of this building.>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.zh: 换句话说，你还没到过五楼以上。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.en: In other words, you haven't yet reached the fifth floor and beyond.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.zh: 那么，但丁，你接下来的行动，应该是去四楼，从那里寻找通路。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.en: Then your subsequent course of action should be to visit the fourth floor and seek a passage from there, Dante.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.zh: <嗯，是啊……不过在那之前，我该先去趟三楼。>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.en: <Hm, yeah... But I should stop by the third floor before we do.>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.zh: 三楼？你不是已经去过了吗？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.en: The third floor? Haven't you been there already?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.zh: ……这次我们已经决定帮红派了。索性一不做二不休，好好讨他们欢心吧。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.en: ... We've already decided to help the Rouges this time around. Might as well go all in and get on their good side.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.zh: <那层楼有位店员，一直很想见见这……孩子。我想着，让他们见一面，说不定挺好的。>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.en: <One of the employees on that floor really wanted to meet this... child. I thought it might be nice to have them meet.>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.zh: 嗯，去吧去吧。……哦对了。趁现在赶紧教教这孩子规矩，钟！不然以后可就没机会了，懂吧？记住喽！
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.en: Yeah, you do that. ... Oh, yeah. Better teach the kid manners now when you can, Clock! Else you'll never get the chance later, yeah? Remember that!

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.zh: 在希斯克利夫继续大谈早期教育有多重要的唠叨声中，我们前往了三楼。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.en: We proceeded to the third floor as Heathcliff continued to lecture us about the importance of early education.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.zh: 呃，希望这不会把里头什么可怕的东西给唤醒……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.en: Ugh, I hope this doesn't awaken somethin' horrid in there...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.zh: 摇篮微微颤动。半透明的血管如同植物的卷须根系般四散延伸，不规则地摇晃震颤着。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.en: The Cradle quivers. Translucent blood vessels, radiating like the tendril roots of a plant, tremble in an irregular sway.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.zh: 它看起来几乎像是……在呼吸。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.en: It almost looked like it was... breathing.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.zh: 默尔索把那块血肉喂进了茧中。它猛地活动起来，晃动的样子，仿佛一直在等待着这份投喂。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.en: Meursault fed the piece of flesh into the cocoon. It suddenly jerked alive, jostling as though it had been waiting to receive it.
It appears that the membrane has... grown thinner.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.zh: <里面有什么东西在拼命挣扎……是想孵化出来吗？>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.en: <Something's flailing wildly in there... Is it trying to hatch?>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.zh: 唔……虽然已经成功戳破了薄膜的一小部分，但目前看来，破膜而出的可能性并不大。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.en: Mm... though it has successfully punctured a small part of the membrane, emergence seems highly unlikely at this point.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.zh: 等等，别帮它——顺其自然吧。我听说小孩子都得靠自己出来——
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.en: Hang on, don't help it—let nature do its thing. I heard babies got to save themselves—

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.zh: 就在希斯克利夫提议放任它自生自灭时，茧中的动静渐渐平息了下来。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.en: Just as Heathcliff suggested that we leave it to fend for itself, the movement within the cocoon slowly began to subside.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.zh: 哦，见鬼。喂，谁有尖的东西？！得帮帮忙，这孩子快没劲了！
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.en: Oh, bollocks. Oi, got anything sharp?! We gotta help, kid's startin' to go weak!

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.zh: 或许可以用在改衣室拿到的那把剪刀。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.en: Perhaps we could use the pair of scissors obtained at the Alteration Shop.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.zh: <哦，有道理。我们试着剪开它吧。>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.en: <Oh, you're right. Let's try cutting it open.>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.zh: 经理，自我们踏上这层楼起，这块血肉便一直发出类似心跳的节律。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.en: Manager, the piece of flesh has been emitting a rhythm akin to heartbeat ever since we first entered this floor.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.zh: <我们越靠近摇篮，它就越强吗？>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.en: <Has it been getting stronger the closer we've gotten to the Cradle?>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.zh: 是的。看来是某种逐渐增强的共鸣现象。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.en: Yes. It appears to be a gradually intensifying resonance phenomenon of sorts.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.zh: 那块血肉……跟这个茧蛋玩意儿，感觉挺像的，不是吗？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.en: That piece of flesh... It's got a similar feel to this cocoon-egg-thing, don't it?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.zh: 瞧，那是张嘴，对吧？我看咱们得把这东西喂给那颗蛋。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.en: Look, that's a mouth, innit? I think we're gonna have to feed this thing to that egg.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.zh: 你的猜想有道理。浮士德也赞同这个做法。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.en: Your hypothesis carries merit. Faust concurs with that course of action.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.zh: 拜托……你们必须……那个……珍爱之人……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.en: Please... You must... the... cherished one...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.zh: 这位……就是曾经给我唱歌的那个人吗？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.en: Was this the one... who sang to me?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.zh: 呃……她是这么跟我们说的。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.en: Well... That's what she told us.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.zh: 不知道……也许就算快死了，她心里也高兴得不得了吧。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.en: Dunno... Maybe she were bloody over the moon, even with one foot in the grave.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.zh: 她……曾期盼着你的出生，满怀期待地等待着。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.en: She... wished for your birth and waited for it with anticipation.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.zh: 所以，见到你，或许正是那抹幸福微笑的来由，布布。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.en: Therefore, seeing you likely produced that happy smile, Pwie.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.zh: 我不明白。我不认识她。她也……并不真的认识我……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.en: I don't understand. I didn't know her. She didn't... really know me either...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.zh: ……你这学会说话之后，可真是越来越难缠了……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.en: ... You're a right pain in the arse now you've learned how to talk...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.zh: 有些事就是这样，没道理可讲。是大人的事，小孩子不懂的……嗯，就是大人的事。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.en: Some things just are. Grown-up stuff kids don't get.... Yeah, grown-up stuff.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.zh: 所以……在长大之前，我想多知道一些事。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.en: So... I want to know more before I grow.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-choice-floor-.zh: 好吧，我们会帮人台前往出口。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-choice-floor-.en: Fine, we'll help the Mannequins to the exit.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-choice-floor-.zh: 我们需要一些时间考虑。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-choice-floor-.en: We need some time to think.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.zh: 学习新东西的时候……寒冷就会退去。我能彻底忘记那种空落落的感觉……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.en: When I'm learning new stuff... the cold goes away. I get to completely forget the empty something...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.zh: 所以……我想知道。我想知道，她为什么能在死后还面带微笑……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.en: That's why... I want to know. I want to know why she can smile even after dying...
... Instinct may lie at the root.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.zh: 红派拥有一种本能：找到一道新的声音并追随它，能填补内心的空缺。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.en: The Rouges possess an instinct through which finding a new voice and following it fills an internal deficit.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.zh: 那是一种无需教导便具备的能力或行为。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.en: It's a capacity or behavior that does not require instruction.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.zh: 从意识产生的那一刻起，就自发引导着主体的一种倾向。某种意义上，就是与生俱来的本性。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.en: An inclination that directs the subject of its own accord from the moment consciousness begins. One's nature, in some ways.
That is... unknown to us as well.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.zh: 许多人走到生命尽头……都未能真正理解自己本质的模样……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.en: Many reach the end of life... without attaining a definitive understanding of their own essential nature...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.zh: 她嘴角挂着一抹淡淡的、满足的微笑。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.en: A faint, contented smile hangs from her lips.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.zh: 为他人、为另一个人而死……究竟是怎样的情感、经历与记忆，才能将一个人塑造成如此轻易便能做出这种抉择的人？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.en: To die in service of others, of another... What kinds of emotions, experiences, and memories are capable of shaping a person into someone who so readily makes such a decision?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.zh: 我们必须带走品牌总监的黄金皮革。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.en: We must bring the Brand Director's Golden Hide.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.zh: 柱子底部藏着一块布料和一张黑派留下的字条。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.en: There's a piece of cloth and a Noir's note hidden by the base of the pillar.
<Hey, there's something written on this piece of cloth.>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.zh: 上面写着：“贪婪的红派终于疯了。那守护着西西弗百货的珍贵黄金皮革——他们——”
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.en: It says "The covetous Rouges have finally gone mad. The precious Golden Hide that preserves the Grand Magasin—they've—"

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.zh: 写这个的人，看来没来得及写完。像是匆忙间把它藏了起来……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.en: Whoever wrote it didn't get to finish their message. Looks like they had to hide it in a hurry...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.zh: 我朝墙那边正在发生的惨剧匆匆瞥了一眼，随即把目光收回到手中的纸片上。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.en: I stole a quick glance at the carnage being perpetrated on the other side of the wall before looking back at the piece of paper.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.zh: <……先带上它吧，万一以后用得着。>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.en: <... Let's take this with us, just in case it becomes relevant.>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.zh: 嗯？又回这层楼了？喂，弄了不少眼球回来啊？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.en: Eh? Back on this floor? Oi, bring in many eyeballs?
Ooh... Not a bad pull, CH!
<... She totally rubbed off on you, didn't she?>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.zh: 唔。门口的守卫似乎已经离开了。看来那场“室内装潢翻新”已经结束了。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.en: Mm. The guardian at the gate seems to have left. It is likely that the "interior design renovation" has ended.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.zh: <情况好像跟上次有点不一样……>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.en: <Things seem a little different from last time...>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.zh: 咦……是那个守门口的大块头姑娘。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.en: Huh... It's that big lass who was guarding the entrance.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.zh: 就是你……那位沉睡者……一直让我等候的……就是你……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.en: It was you... whom the Slumbering One... has asked me to hold out for...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.zh: 身为品牌总监……我被赋予了……守护那位尊贵沉睡者的责任。身为品牌总监……我一直坚守着这座大厅……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.en: As the Brand Director... I was bestowed with the responsibility... to protect the noble Slumbering One. As the Brand Director... I held down this hall...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.zh: 你身后的那个存在，想必就是声音的来源。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.en: The entity behind you must be the source of the Voice.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.zh: 是的。这里就是摇篮……我们不懈耕耘的园地。在这里，沉睡者正孕育新生，将要在整座西西弗百货绽放他们的花朵……以此回报我们——那全部的自己——所献上的供奉。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.en: Yes. This is the Cradle... the garden of our ceaseless tending. In this place, the Slumbering One stirs to nascency, to blossom their flowers throughout the Grand Magasin... in return for the offering that is all that we are.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.zh: 是的……那位在我们的声音缺席时，会来照料红派的存在。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.en: Yes... The one who shall tend to the Rouges in the absence of our Voice.
<They haven't been awakened yet, it seems.>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.zh: 我一直在哼唱着西西弗百货中最美妙的摇篮曲。为那位尊贵之人建造摇篮——我的毕生杰作——一针一线地编织，以我的信念作为武器，对抗这份永不满足的饥饿……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.en: I've been humming the most wonderful of lullabies in all of the Grand Magasin. Building the Cradle for the noble one—my magnum opus—weaving it thread by thread, my conviction a weapon against this insatiable hunger...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.zh: 所以说，你就是……那玩意儿的保姆呗，我猜。而且它反正也快醒了，是吧？它把咱们叫来是要干嘛？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.en: So, you're like... What, that thing's nanny, I assume. And it's about to wake soon anyway, innit? What'd it call us here for?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.zh: 我的职责，是成为那位尊贵沉睡者的一床暖毯。如今我的职责已经结束……我很快就要迎来终结了。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.en: My role was to be a warm blanket for the Slumbering One. Now that my duty has ended... I will soon meet my end.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.zh: 他们苏醒之时将会十分虚弱。当那位沉睡者醒来，西西弗百货中最温柔的微风，对他们的肌肤而言也会如刀割般凛冽，而黑派，被无知与恐惧所驱使，将会试图把这位尊贵之人埋葬在裂缝之中。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.en: They will be weak upon waking. When the Slumbering One awakens, the gentlest breeze of the Grand Magasin will be as harsh as cutting winds to their skin, while the Noirs, driven by their ignorance and fear, will seek to bury the noble one within the fractures.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.zh: 我们需要你们的帮助，异乡人。
不久之后，他们的声音便会在西西弗百货的墙壁间回荡……陪伴在他们身边……直到他们能以自己的全身，引领我们所有人，明白我们该如何去渴望……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.en: Soon, their voice shall resonate between the walls of the Grand Magasin... Stay with them... until they can guide us all, with the whole of their body, on how we are to desire...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.zh: 等等，你他妈等一下。你这是要把那个婴儿甩给我们吧？还指望我们给个刚出生的玩意儿当保姆？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.en: Hang on a bloody second. You're offloadin' that baby on us, ain't ya? And we're just 'sposed to play nannies for a newborn?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.zh: 喂，我可不确定这行不行……咱们得弄更多眼球、找路上到顶楼、护着你那颗钟表脑袋、还得逃出这鬼地方——咱们可养不起这么个孩子，伙计。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.en: Oi, I don't know about this... We need to get more eyeballs, find our way to the top floor, keep your clock head safe, and escape this hole—we can't take care of a child like that, mate.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.zh: 你为何决定要来这里，但丁？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.en: Why have you decided to come here, Dante?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.zh: ……是否有什么我尚不知晓的——……你是否知道某种我无从触及的知识？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.en: ... Is there something I am unaware— ... Are you aware of a piece of knowledge that I am not allowed access?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.zh: 那答案，是否就藏在这个选择所铺就的道路尽头？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.en: Does the answer lie... at the terminus of the road this choice will pave?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.zh: ……你这行事方式，倒是与浮士德的一贯作风颇为相似。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.en: ... It is quite like how Faust operates, your behavior.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.zh: 明明不知道这是否是正确的道路，你却依然……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.en: Despite not knowing whether this is the right path, you...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.zh: 明白了。浮士德没有更多疑问了。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.en: Understood. Faust has no further queries.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.zh: 快点啊，你这么小心翼翼的干嘛？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.en: Hurry up, what're you bein' so careful for?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.zh: 用改衣师的那把剪刀，干净利落地剪了一刀。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.en: Made a clean cut using the Alterationist's pair of scissors.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.zh: <color=#ebcaa2>你还真想看看这事最后会怎样啊？我猜这也算是种打发时间的方式吧。不过无所谓；不管你最后选哪个选项，我们都能稳定地拿到经验糊。</color>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.en: <color=#ebcaa2>You really want to see where this goes, huh? I guess that's one way to kill time. Doesn't matter; whichever option you end up going with, we'll get a steady supply of Experience Batter.</color>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.zh: <……听起来她好像不太乐意我们做出不一样的选择。>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.en: <... Sounds like she's not so happy we're making a different choice.>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.zh: ……经理说，“听起来她好像不太乐意我们做出不一样的选择”。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.en: ... "Sounds like she's not so happy we're making a different choice," said the Manager.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.zh: <color=#ebcaa2>不知道你还记不记得——我这问的什么废话，你当然记得——不过我常常反复品味那出罐头戏剧。我曾把同一出罐头戏剧看了足足78遍。</color>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.en: <color=#ebcaa2>I don't know if you recall—who am I kidding? Of course you do—but I often repeat-taste the Canned Stageplay over and over again. I once watched the same Canned Stageplay over 78 times.</color>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.zh: <color=#ebcaa2>同样的动作，一字不差的台词，在我早已烂熟于心的那些瞬间准时出现的、可预料的表情……还有那看过十几遍的相同结局，紧接着是熟悉得如同回家一般的谢幕。这一切都令我心安。安心到，每当某个演员照例第N次忘词时，我都会有种冲上台去替他念台词的冲动。</color>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.en: <color=#ebcaa2>Same actions, identical line reads, predictable expressions coming in at moments I'd grown intimately acquainted with... and the same ending I'd watched over a dozen times, followed by a curtain call so familiar it felt like home. All of that soothed my heart. So much so that, when an actor inevitably forgets his line for the nth time, I feel like I have to rush up to the stage and read the line for him.</color>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.zh: ……我知道你说的是哪出戏。它从头到尾都充斥着明显的前后矛盾，其中心主题与作者意图，与那毫无逻辑的情节一样令人费解。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.en: ... I know what stageplay you are referring to. Riddled with blatant inconsistencies in all of its aspects, its central theme and authorial intent were just as incomprehensible as its nonsensical plot.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.zh: <color=#ebcaa2>就是那出。预算低到连一个职业演员都请不起，找来的那些业余演员，也照例贡献了我见过最尴尬的表演之一。不管怎么说，那都是一出糟糕透顶的罐头戏剧。</color>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.en: <color=#ebcaa2>That's the one. It was so low-budget that they couldn't afford even a single professional thespian on stage, and the amateurs they hired predictably put out some of the most awkward performances I'd ever seen. It was a terrible Canned Stageplay, by all accounts.</color>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.zh: <color=#ebcaa2>但是……说来也怪，每次看那出戏，我都会感到一种莫名的慰藉。</color>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.en: <color=#ebcaa2>But... strangely enough, I found myself comforted as I experienced that play.</color>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.zh: <color=#ebcaa2>没人能理解我为什么会这么做……除了你，小可爱。</color>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.en: <color=#ebcaa2>No one could understand why I would do such a thing... except you, ma puce.</color>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.zh: 从那道声音消失的地方，
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.en: From where the Voice had disappeared,

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.zh: 从被剖开的摇篮中……爬出了某个东西……形似一个孩子。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.en: from the Cradle sectioned open... something crawled out... in the form of a child.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.zh: 那孩子朝我们瞥了一眼，像是在警惕地扫视。接着，他们小心地站起身，摇摇晃晃地走向品牌总监，把手放在了她的身躯上。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.en: The child glanced at us in what appeared to be a wary scan. They then carefully lifted themselves, waddled up to the Brand Director, and placed their hand on her body.
Ah... the Slumbering One has awakened.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.zh: 品牌总监开口说话，她的双眼从那如死亡般的沉睡中睁开。孩子从她身边猛地跳开，就像先前躲开我们那样。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.en: The Brand Director spoke, her eyes opening from a deathlike slumber. The child jumped away from her, just as they had from us earlier.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.zh: 看来，我们并不是这孩子唯一惧怕的对象；他们对一切人和事都在畏缩退避。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.en: It seemed we weren't the only ones the child was afraid of; they shrank away from everyone and everything.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.zh: 许多人……都在等待……你的降临……
我们红派已倾尽全力……只为等候你的到来。而我们献给你的……是如今的一切……与未来的一切……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.en: We Rouges have given our all... in anticipation of your arrival. And we offer you... what is... and what will be...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.zh: 请把他们带去五楼的餐厅，异乡人。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.en: Bring them to the Restaurant on the fifth floor, strangers.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.zh: 要发出真正的声音……要长大成熟……这位新生儿必须抵达……那层楼……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.en: To speak the true Voice... to mature... the newborn must reach... that floor...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.zh: 拜托了……为了……我们所有人……
看来，她已经咽下了最后一口气。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.en: She has drawn her final breath, it seems.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.zh: 孩子……你说的话我一个字都听不懂。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.en: Kid... I can't understand a word of what you're sayin'.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.zh: 虽然那孩子严格说来算不上在说话，但他们的动作与那份无言的请求，让我隐约明白了他们想要什么。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.en: Though the child wasn't really speaking per se, their gestures and the unspoken request gave me a vague sense of what they wanted.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.zh: 那孩子捡起了我们先前剪下的那块摇篮碎片，举到了眼前……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.en: The child picked up the piece of the Cradle we had cut off earlier, lifted it to eye level...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.zh: 什……什么，他们在干嘛？想拿它当武器？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.en: Wha... wha' are they doin'? Tryin' to make a weapon out of it?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.zh: 或许只是出于好奇心的驱使，想仔细看看它。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.en: Perhaps they are merely drawn to observe it, by a spark of curiosity.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.zh: ……张开了嘴。大得令人不太自在。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.en: ... and opened their mouth. It was uncomfortably wide.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.zh: <呃，我觉得他们是想……把它吃掉？>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.en: <Um, I think they're trying to... eat it?>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.zh: 喂、喂，快停下！扔掉，孩子！那玩意儿脏，懂吗？脏！
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.en: O-oi, stop that! Drop it, kid! It's yucky, you got that? Yucky!

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.zh: 这是你最后一次从地上捡不明血肉了！给我！
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.en: That's the last random piece of flesh you're pickin' up from the ground! Give it!

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.zh: 希斯克利夫粗暴地从孩子手中夺走了那块剪下的薄膜。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.en: Heathcliff roughly snatched the cut piece of membrane out of the child's hand.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.zh: <我觉得你把这孩子惹生气了。而且不知怎么，同时还把他们吓着了。>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.en: <I think you made the kid angry. And scared them at the same time, somehow.>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.zh: <照这样下去，他们恐怕不会跟我们走……>
恐慌的起因，或许可以直接追溯到希斯克利夫抢走那孩子“零食”这件事上。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.en: Perhaps the cause of alarm can be traced directly back to Heathcliff's theft of the child's "snack."

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.zh: 那我该怎么办，眼睁睁看着这孩子把那块生血肉大口咬下去？喂，我说得对不对？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.en: What was I supposed to do, just watch the kid take a big bite out of that chunk of raw flesh? Oi, am I right or what?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.zh: 哇噢。不是吧，伙计？我也不是想带你一起走啊。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.en: Wooow. Really, mate? It ain't like I want to bring you along.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.zh: <……希斯克利夫，你干嘛跟一个连话都不会说的孩子吵架……？>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.en: <... Heathcliff, why are you arguing with a kid who can't even speak...?>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.zh: 这种行为，是成年后依旧幼稚的表现。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.en: Such behavior is a sign of immaturity manifest in adulthood.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.zh: 希斯克利夫瞪大了眼睛，一脸难以置信。他气呼呼地哼了一声，在我们和孩子之间来回瞪视。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.en: Heathcliff's eyes went wide with bewilderment. He huffed angrily, glaring back and forth between us and the child.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.zh: 行吧，行吧，随便了。那咱们该怎么办？找点甜食把这孩子哄过来？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.en: Alright, fine. Whatever. What're we doin', then? Find some sweets to lure the kid into comin' with us?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.zh: <我们确实答应过要照看这孩子，所以……用甜食哄骗行不行我不知道，但我们总得做点什么来安抚他们，让他们愿意跟我们走。>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.en: something to appease them so that they'll follow us willingly.>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.zh: 安抚这孩子？告诉你们一件事，你们这群人好像都不明白：想让这种犟脾气的孩子跟着你，光靠哄是不管用的。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.en: Appease the kid? Here's somethin' you lot don't seem to understand: if you want stubborn kids like 'em to follow you, appeasement ain't gonna cut it.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.zh: 你……这是在讲你少年时期的亲身经历吗？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.en: Might you be... speaking from your own experiences as a youth?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.zh: <我就大胆猜一下，那个“犟脾气的孩子”说的就是你自己吧。>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.en: <I'm gonna go out on a limb and assume that the "stubborn kid" was yourself.>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.zh: 你俩闭嘴。重点是，你们得让他们明白，不能整天哭哭啼啼指望世界事事顺着他们来。我看咱们不如假装丢下这孩子，他们自然就懂了要跟上来。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.en: Shut it, you two. Point is, you've got to teach 'em a lesson that you can't just whinge your way through the world and expect everything to go your way forever. I say we pretend to leave the kid behind, and they'll know to come with.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.zh: 没有良秀在场，在座的没一个真正带过孩子。所以……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.en: Without Ryōshū, none of those present were particularly experienced in child-rearing. So...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.zh: ……我们唯一能做的，就是把心中的疑虑和可能的争论都咬在牙关后头，让希斯克利夫试试能不能说服这孩子跟我们走。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.en: ... the only option we had was to hold our doubts and potential arguments behind our teeth and let Heathcliff try his hand at convincing this child to come with us.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.zh: 好嘞，孩子。我们这就要出发了。留下也行，跟来也行——随你便，我才不管。我们是真的要走了！
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.en: Right-o, kid. We're about to head out. Stay here or come with—you do whatever you want, I don't care. We're really leavin' now!

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.zh: 希斯克利夫猛地转身，气冲冲地跺脚走出了摇篮，那孩子显然大吃一惊。孩子转向我们——虽然看不见他们的眼睛，但那份困惑与惊愕的神情却是毋庸置疑的。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.en: Heathcliff wheeled around and stomped out of the Cradle, much to the child's apparent surprise. The child turned to us—though I couldn't see their eyes, it was unmistakably a look of confused astonishment.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.zh: 摇篮外一片昏暗，只有几缕阳光透了进来。从我们站的地方看去，希斯克利夫真像是彻底把我们丢下了。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.en: It was dark outside the Cradle save for a few rays of sunlight that peeked through. From where we stood, it really looked as though Heathcliff had left us for good.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.zh: 你们几个磨蹭什么呢？快点跟上！
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.en: What're you lot faffin' around for? On the double!

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.zh: 在希斯克利夫的催促下，我们也匆匆走出了摇篮……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.en: We hurried out of the Cradle as well at Heathcliff's insistence...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.zh: 到了外面，我们偷偷从帘幕缝隙间张望，只见那孩子正惊慌地四下张望。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.en: Once outside, we peeked surreptitiously between the curtains as the child looked around frantically.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.zh: 喂！我们要走了，孩子！我可没在闹着玩！你想哭想闹随你便，我可不会回去了！
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.en: Oi! We're leavin', kid! I ain't playin' around! Cry and throw a tantrum all ya want, I ain't comin' back!

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.zh: 那孩子惊恐地呜咽了一阵，仿佛惧怕着渐渐逼近的黑暗……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.en: The child babbled fearfully for a moment, as though they were afraid of the creeping darkness...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.zh: ……随即急急忙忙地摇摇晃晃朝我们走来，把摇篮抛在了身后。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.en: ... then hurriedly toddled toward us, leaving the Cradle behind.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.zh: 瞧见没？带孩子就得这么带。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.en: See? That's how you deal with kids.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.zh: ……我们和那孩子之间，仍隔着一段距离。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.en: ... There is still some distance between us and the child.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.zh: 看起来，他们并不觉得跟着我们能有安全感……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.en: Doesn't seem like they're feeling safe sticking with us...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.zh: ……可他们又明显不想被独自丢下。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.en: ... even though it's pretty obvious that they don't want to be left alone.
<... So we're just walking around like this, I guess?>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.zh: 一具红派的尸体。那双刀刃状的手臂已经完全折断，躯体瘫倒在地上。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.en: The corpse of a Rouge. The bladed arms have all been snapped apart, leaving the body sprawled across the floor.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.zh: 一具红派的尸体。整具躯体都被沉重的锤子砸得稀烂，面目全非。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.en: The corpse of a Rouge. The entire body has been crushed beneath a heavy hammer, mangled beyond recognition.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.zh: 大多数尸体似乎都是黑派的，经理。这场战斗恐怕正朝着有利于红派的方向收尾。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.en: The majority of corpses appear to be of the Noirs, Manager. The battle is most likely winding down in the Rouges' favor.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.zh: ……我怎么没看出这地方哪里“奢侈”了。是挺亮闪闪的，可也没那么高档吧。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.en: ... I ain't seein' what's so "luxury" about this place. Sure, it's a bit shiny, but it ain't that posh.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.zh: 这里的物品，比其他楼层的更明显地泛着金光。就连那些不发光的，也都装饰得极其精致，一看便知是用心打造的。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.en: These items seem to have a more obvious golden glow to them than the items on the other floors. Even the ones that aren't glowing are meticulously decorated, obviously crafted with great care.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.zh: ……这里的商品所需的眼球数量，似乎比其他楼层的要高出不少。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.en: ... The items here appear to cost significantly more eyeballs than those available on other floors.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.zh: 光带够眼球还不够。购买这些商品前，潜在顾客的评级也会受到严格审查。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.en: Carrying sufficient eyeballs is not enough. The Prestige Tier of the prospective client is also strictly screened before they are permitted to purchase these items.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.zh: ……算了。我，嗯。我有股不祥的预感。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.en: ... Nah. I, hm. I've a bad feelin' about it.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.zh: 唔……反正都来了，我在想——不如咱们直接把这些拿走，拿去其他楼层卖了？反正也没人盯着咱们……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.en: Well... seein' as we're here anyway, I'm thinkin'—why don't we just take these and sell 'em on other floors? It ain't like there's anyone watchin' us...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.zh: 行了行了，我懂！就随口一说而已，没别的意思。可不想再出那种头发抵用券事件那样的破事了。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.en: I get it, I get it! I was just floatin' the idea, nothin' more. Don't need another shite like that hair coupon incident happenin' again.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.zh: 可我正打算跟他说，这主意其实挺不错的……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.en: But I was just about to tell him that was a really good idea...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.zh:
啊，算了。反正这些展示柜的材质看着也挺耐用的。
我们决定继续前进。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.en:
Ah, well. The display cases seem to be made from pretty durable material anyway.
We decided to move on.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.zh: 布料层之间，可以看到密密缝合的黄金皮革。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.en: Densely backstitched Golden Hide is visible between layers of fabric.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.zh: 一个展示柜。上面覆盖着……看起来像是一层血肉帘幕的东西。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.en: A display case. Covered in... what appear to be a curtain of flesh.
Oi, oi... you... is your head alright?!

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.zh: <我们手上有不少东西说不定能派上用场，不过……现在还太早，暂时不适合跟它硬碰硬，我猜。>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.en: <We've got plenty of stuff that might come in helpful, but... still too early to even try to fight it, I guess.>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.zh: 几缕金色的光芒，从那根黑曜石柱子的裂缝中透出。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.en: Thin rays of golden light shine from the cracks of the obsidian pillar.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.zh: 黑派把红派的服饰塞进了红派挖走黄金皮革后留下的缝隙里。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.en: The Noirs have stuffed Le Rouge apparel into the gaps where the Rouges have carved out the Golden Hides.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.zh: 那根柱子已被深红色的血肉完全吞没，原本的形状已难以辨认。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.en: The pillar is completely swallowed up beneath crimson flesh. Its original shape is difficult to discern.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.zh: [黑派精选——初木工坊：品牌经理亲自甄选的六件套系列]
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.en: [Sélection du Noir - Atelier du Premier Arbre: A collection of six articles, hand-nominated by the Brand Manager herself]

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.zh: 这是一根柱子，底部藏着一块布料和一张黑派留下的字条。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-2-b.jso.en: It's a pillar where a piece of cloth and a Noir's note are hidden by its base.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 我们杀死了地下二层的楼层经理，并从他们手中拿走了彩色绞线。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: We killed B2F's Floor Manager and took the Colorful Skein from their hands.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 唉……这队伍怎么还不见短。一步都没挪。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: Ugh... this line isn't getting shorter. Hasn't budged an inch.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 走不过去了……漆黑的衣服挡在那里，不让任何人通过。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: Can't go any farther... the black clothes are standing there and won't let anybody through.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 必须安安-安静。他们说：“闭嘴，等着就行，蠢针族！”
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: Have to be quiety-quiet. They said, "Shut up and just wait, stupid Needlekin!"

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 我闻到烟味……这里不许抽烟，好吗？！
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: I smell ciggy smoke... No smokey-smoke here, okay?!

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 这里暂时由我们管控。保持安静，耐心等待。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: This area is under temporary control. Keep quiet and wait patiently.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 这一层的所有人都在监视之下。别做蠢事。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: Everyone on this floor is being watched. Don't try anything stupid.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 经理，我们应该先处理挡住去路的漆黑者。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: We should deal with the Noirs blocking our path first, Manager.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 经理，我们现在还过不去。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: We cannot go through yet, Manager.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 经理，我建议先处理另一件事。看来还有更优先的事情尚未解决。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: I recommend that we attend to another matter first, Manager. There appears to be something of greater priority remaining.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 你好。你最喜欢什么颜色？
陌生人，你们带着欲望而来。正如那声音所说，要忠于自己的欲望。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: You have brought desire with you, strangers. As the Voice says, be true to your desires.
The Floor Manager is... in the Skein Nest.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: ……！原来你们就是一直鬼鬼祟祟在这里活动的亵渎者？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: ...! So you're the blasphemous strangers who've been skulking around here?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 就咬一口，在齿间嚼一嚼……然后我就能再次……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: Juuust a bite, chew between the teeth... and again, I can...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 这些分配规则似乎不合常理，执行经理。我开始怀疑，洗手间里的女人是不是搞错了指挥链。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: These assignment rules seem irrational, Executive Manager. I am beginning to suspect that the woman in the restroom has made an error regarding the chain of command.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 她让这个家伙永远跟着你，却让像我这样能力卓越的士兵不是永远坐冷板凳，就是和那些贡献……实在可疑的罪人搭档……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: She keeps this one permanently attached to your service, while keeping an exceptionally competent soldier such as myself either eternally benched or paired with Sinners whose contributions are... questionable...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 而这个存在……我看它也还跟在队伍里。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: And this entity... remains in tow yet, I see.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 良秀默默打量着布布，随后从嘴里取下香烟，在墙上碾灭。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: Ryoshu studied Pwie in silence, then took the cigarette from her mouth and ground it against the wall.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 她随手将碾碎的烟头弹向附近正在劳作的针族。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: She casually flicked the crushed stub at a Needlekin working nearby.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 抗议声被清楚地说出口后，眼前这一幕显得更加奇怪。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: Hearing the protest spoken aloud made the entire sight feel even stranger.
You're trying to get your clothes made.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 仅仅给这个存在穿上衣服，就能确保我们通往第五层的通行权……我必须承认，这实在相当可疑！
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: The idea that having this entity dressed will secure passage to the fifth floor is... I must admit, quite suspect!

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: ……不过，格里高尔说没有可行的替代方案……看来也没办法了。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: ... However, Gregor reports no viable alternative... I suppose there is no helping it.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: <默尔索，我们上次走得最远……是地下二层吧？就是这一层。>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: <Meursault, the farthest we made it last time... was B2 right? This same floor.>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: <而且布布的衣服必须在地下最底层做好……>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: <And Pwie's clothes have to be made at the very bottom of the underground levels...>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: <……也就是说，我们下面至少还有一层。>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: <... Which means there must be at least one more floor below us.>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: <那我想，我们可以先在这一层逛逛……>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: <Then I think we can first look around this floor...>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 好了……你们所有人排成一列。我们要从衣摆一直搜到衣领，一个都不放过！
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: All right... All of you, form a single line. We're searching each and every one of you from hem to collar!

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 前面发生了骚动。执行经理，肯定出了什么事。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: Commotion up ahead. Something must've happened, Executive Manager.
<... Pretty sure it wasn't like this last time.>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 我需要那种金色染料……真是见鬼。没想到会在这里被堵住……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: I need that Golden Dye... Damn it all. Didn't expect to be stalled here...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 嘘！安安-安静！发出声音会挨骂。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: Shh! Quiety-quiet! Make noise, get scolded.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 闭嘴，你这个只会在地下爬的下等人。
<那不是正在寻找稀有染料的人吗……？>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: <Isn't that the one who was looking for rare dyes...?>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 是“裸者”……漆黑者的一员，经理。
<要是让裸者看到布布，事态可能会彻底失控。>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: <The whole situation could blow up if we let Naked see Pwie.>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 游戏……？我从来没玩过。那是什么？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: Games...? I've never played one. What is it?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 就是一群人定下规则，然后一起玩的东西。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: It's where a group of people set rules and play together.
Do you... need rules for that?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 规则就像骨架，用自由填充起来。这样更有趣。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: Rules are like bones you flesh out with freedom. More fun that way.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: <让布布玩那个游戏真的没问题吗？>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: <You sure it's okay for Pwie to play that game?>
"It's for an Audience of All Ages, obviously," Manager.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 规则只有一条：说话的人输。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: There is only one rule: you talk, you lose.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 是的，我们是。我们是从楼下上来的。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: Yes, we are. We came up from the floors below.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 从……你们是从楼下来的……？那么，你们会不会就是大家都在私下议论的那些顾客……那些不受楼层束缚的顾客……？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: From the— You're from downstairs...? Then might you be the customers everyone is whispering about...? The customers who are unbound to the floors...?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 嗯。我们可以不受限制地在楼层间往来。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: Mm. We can travel between floors without restriction.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 我……明白了。传言竟是真的。这座百货商店的各楼层之间，本该只有传言才能穿行，所以我们从来都不知道那些传言究竟是真是假。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: I... see. The rumors were true. Only rumors are allowed to travel between each floor of this department store, so we never know whether they're true or false.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 那么……能否请你们替我确认另一则传言的真伪？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: Then... could you confirm the veracity of another rumor for me?
Hm, what rumor would that be?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 以前，西西弗百货的顾客倒下之后，还能在楼下重新站起来。无论倒下多少次，他们都能从头再来一遍。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: It used to be that the customers of the Grand Magasin who collapsed could rise again on the lower floors. However many times they collapsed, they could begin anew from the very start.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 可是自从墙上出现裂缝那天起……我听说，倒下的顾客再也无法起身了——不只是这里，楼下也是如此。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: Yet ever since the day the cracks formed on the walls... I hear that collapsed customers no longer rise—not just here, but on the lower floors, too.
Is there any... grain of truth to that?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 是真的。这里已经无法复活了。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: It is true. Revival is no longer possible here.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 可以再站起来的。没人想……最后就那样躺在冰冷的地上。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: You can get up again. No one wantsta... just lie on a cold floor in the end.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 倒下之后……还能再醒过来的。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: You can wake up again... after you collapse.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 这听起来近乎一个倔强孩子的坚持，可是……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: It almost came off as a stubborn child's insistence, but...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: ……布布的语气中，带着一种说不清来由的笃定，仿佛祂确信这一切终将成真。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: ... there was a nameless confidence in Pwie's voice, as though they were certain that it would come true.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 啊……那么……我还能像往常一样，在地下一层重新醒来吗……？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: Ah... Then... will I awaken again on B1, as we always have...?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 我一直对单脚人们……满怀敬仰，敬仰他们仅凭一条腿的力量顶天立地的雄姿，将整个存在都凝聚于那一个点上。可无论我如何努力，那始终是我够不到的境界。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: I've always had so much admiration for the One-legs... and their magnificent stance as they pushed themselves against the earth with but the strength of a single leg, the whole of their existence concentrated upon a singular point. But it was always out of my reach, no matter how hard I labored.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 那么……我想从头再来一次。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: Then... I want to start from the beginning again.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 你的声音听起来……可怕又诡异，跟一直对我说话的那道声音不一样。可是……你一定是个强大而尊贵的存在……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: Your voice feels... terrifying and uncanny, unlike the Voice that speaks to me. But... you must be someone strong and prestigious...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: ……那么，让我倒下吧，好吗？好让我从头开始，重新来过……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: ... So collapse me, won't you? So I can start anew, from the beginning...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 等我醒来……我会再次看见……那片蓝天……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: When I wake... I'll see the... blue skies... again...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 你刚才跟他说的是真话吗？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: Were you telling him the truth?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: ……不知道。可是……我希望那是真的。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: ... I dunno. But... I want it to be true.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: <color=#ebcaa2>没想到，那个小家伙说的竟然是真话。</color>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: <color=#ebcaa2>Surprisingly enough, that little thing is telling the truth.</color>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: <color=#ebcaa2>自从它诞生的那一刻起，曾从西西弗百货消失的那个宏大循环……便又回来了。</color>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: <color=#ebcaa2>Ever since it was born, the great cycle that had once disappeared from the Grand Magasin... has returned.</color>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: <color=#ebcaa2>我猜地下一层又会重新住满空壳了吧。装着那些柔软娇嫩的存在的空壳。</color>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: <color=#ebcaa2>I suppose B1 will be filled with shells again. Shells housing soft, supple beings.</color>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 喔……这是小默尔索的恋人，让娜小姐的声音？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: Ooh... this be the voice of young Meursault's lover, Lady Jeanne?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: <color=#ebcaa2>呼呼，是我没错。准确说是前恋人。喂，小可爱……只要你哪天回心转意，我也不必永远当你的“前任”嘛。</color>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: <color=#ebcaa2>Fuhu, that's me. Ex-lover, to clarify. Hey, ma puce... I don't always have to be your ex-something, if you ever change your mind.</color>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 毕竟，我们还没真正好好做个了断呢，嗯？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: After all, we haven't had real closure yet, hm?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 乘坐自动扶梯抵达。罕见现象。
有何贵干？我很期待。检测到废物处理例外情况。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: What business? Looking forward to it. WASTE DISPOSAL EXCEPTION FLAGGED.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 声音的主人身形庞大，我们只能把脖子仰到极限，才勉强看清他的脸。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: The owner of the voice was so enormous that we had to crane our necks to their limit merely to find his face.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 你们属于异常。抵达这一层的物体通常不会乘坐自动扶梯。超出范围的实体。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: You are anomalous. Objects reaching this floor don't normally arrive on an escalator. OUT-OF-RANGE ENTITIES.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 不符合常识。需要进行身份确认。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: Not consistent with common sense. IDENTIFICATION REQUIRED.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 我本以为以实玛利会说些什么来解释何谓常识、何谓非常识，但她保持了沉默。我想，她走到这一步见过太多，已经懒得再纠结语义了。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: I expected Ishmael to come back with something about what counted as common sense and what didn't, but she stayed quiet. I suppose she had seen too much by this point to split hairs over semantics.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 那存在突然俯下庞大的身躯，直到与以实玛利四目相对。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: The being suddenly bent his massive body down until it was eye to eye with Ishmael.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 请保持冷静。目前没有敌意。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: Please remain calm. NO HOSTILE INTENT AT PRESENT.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 它巨大的甲壳上布满了孔洞，每个孔洞里都嵌着一张圆脸，直勾勾地盯着我们。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: Its massive carapace was riddled with holes, each one holding something like a round face that stared straight at us.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 那些脸在甲壳内部各自转动，向四面八方窥视。眼前的景象唤起了一种我既无法命名、也无法摆脱的恐惧。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: The faces swiveled independently within the shell, peering every which way. The sight stirred a dread I could neither name nor shake.
... It reminds me of a Whale.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: <……你这么一说，孔手之鲸身上确实有个部位看起来和这个存在的甲壳很像……>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: <... Now that you mention it, the Whale of the Porous Hand had a part that looked like this entity's carapace...>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 现在……似乎还没有让恐惧扎根的理由。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: There seems... little cause to let terror take root just yet.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 它或许只是在满足自己的好奇心。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: It may merely be indulging its curiosity.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 逻辑认知优先于欲望。不太可能属于人台分类。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: Logical cognition taking priority over desire. MANNEQUIN CLASSIFICATION UNLIKELY.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: ……你要我解释鲸鱼？有一小时速成课，还有十二小时强化讲座，如果你胆子够大的话……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: ... You want me to explain Whales? There's the 1-hour crash course, or the 12-hour crash lecture if you're feeling brave...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 那是开玩笑的。下次我会从头到尾给你讲一遍。下次……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: That was a joke. I'll give you chapter and verse another time. Another time...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 百货商场里没有鲸鱼吗？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: Are there no Whales here in the department store?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 理解。确认理解。观察结束。
你身上带着……香气。那是高声望顾客的气味……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: You carry... a fragrance. The scent of a customer of high Prestige...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: <也许只是闻到了肥厚的钱包味……>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: <Maybe it just smells a fat wallet...>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 在寻找特定的皮革吗？一路来到“底层”，说明你们很急，对吧？加急订单。需要支付附加费。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: Looking for a particular hide? Coming all the way down to the "bottom" means you're in a rush, yes? RUSH ORDER. SURCHARGE REQUIRED.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 明白了。你们需要定制服装。
那存在继续向下弯曲，将脸凑到与布布齐平，而不是与我们任何一个人齐平。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: The being bent lower still, bringing its face level not with any of us... but with Pwie.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: <color=#ebcaa2>没错，我就是一道声音。完美而完整，跟你不一样。</color>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: <color=#ebcaa2>Oh yes, I am a Voice. Perfect and complete, unlike you.</color>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: <color=#ebcaa2>红派好像对你寄予厚望呢，不过……我可说不准。</color>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: <color=#ebcaa2>The Rouges seem to have high hopes for you, but... I don't know.</color>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: <color=#ebcaa2>恐怕你这个小不点，撑不起这栋摇摇欲坠的百货商店。就连金枝，都快撑不住它了。</color>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: <color=#ebcaa2>I'm afraid you're way too tiny to hold up this crumbling department store. Even the Golden Bough's barely keeping it standing.</color>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: <color=#ebcaa2>虽然我怀疑那个小东西能不能改变这一切的结局就是了。</color>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: <color=#ebcaa2>Though I doubt that little thing could change how this ends.</color>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: ……所以，据让娜小姐所说……金枝是维系西西弗百货不散的最后一样东西。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: ... So, according to Miss Jeanne... the Golden Bough is the last thing holding the Grand Magasin together.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 那么……如果我们把它拿走，这地方会变成什么样？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: Then... what would happen to this place if we removed it?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 唔……诚然，封住裂缝的那层“树脂”便会消失……继而，这座百货商店必将随之崩塌……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: Hm... Verily, the "resin" sealing the fissures would disappear... whereupon the collapse of the department store would surely follow...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 喔……如此一来，被囚禁的N公司住民岂不是有望获得解放了？！那可真是一桩幸事！
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: Hoh... Would not the liberation of incarcerated N Corp. residents be within reach, then?! 'Twould be a most fortuitous outcome!

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: ……愚蠢又无知的死法……倒是很符合一个四脚人的做派。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: ... A foolish, ignorant death... Perfectly befitting a Four-legs.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 它从未理解主宰制鞋馆的自然法则。那循环之中，四脚人卑贱存在的唯一目的，便是将我们单脚人托举至受人敬仰的高位。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: It never understood the natural order that governs the Footwear Hall. The cycle in which the sole purpose of the Four-legs' base existence is to elevate us One-legs to be revered.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 为什么就因为你腿少，大家就得敬仰你？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: Why do they revere you just 'cuz you have fewer legs?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 因为唯有我这样的单脚人，才能达到那仅凭一条腿的力量顶天立地的雄姿。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: Because only a One-leg such as myself can achieve the magnificent stance where I push myself against the earth with but the strength of a single leg.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 布布抬起一条腿离地，盯着单脚人看。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: Pwie lifted a leg off the ground and stared at One-leg.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 我有两条腿。可我现在用一条腿站着。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: I have two legs. But I'm standing on one leg.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 那……那才不叫雄姿。是残缺。
她一时语塞——你八成戳中她痛处了，布布。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: She doesn't know what to say—you must've hit a nerve, Pwie.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 我们腿的数目，是制鞋馆中神圣旨意的象征，是我们自远古以来一直遵循的自然法则。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: The number of our legs is a symbol of divine providence in the Footwear Hall, and a natural law by which we have abided since time immemorial.
