RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 你休想插手我们的传统，你这肮脏、令人作呕的红派杂种。异乡人们，你们也一样。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: Don't you dare meddle with our tradition, you foul, revolting Rouge-spawn. Same goes for you as well, strangers.
That wasn't a very nice thing to say.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 你或许该跟布布道个歉。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: You might want to apologize to Pwie.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 鸿璐的嘴抿成了一条直线，那副常挂在唇边的笑容荡然无存。单脚人的这番长篇怒骂，似乎真的惹恼了他。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: Hong Lu's mouth straightened into a thin line, the cheerful smile that so often graced his lips gone without a trace. The One-leg's tirade seemed to have genuinely offended him.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: ……没错，就是你。看见你的那一刻，我差点就没忍住吐出来，你这令人厌恶的小害虫。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: ... Yes, you are. I barely stopped myself from retching the moment I saw you, you disgusting little vermin.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 楼下那位女士，她……见到我很高兴。还夸了我。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: The lady downstairs, she... was happy to see me. Praised me.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 可你……却觉得我恶心。从我们见面那一刻起，就开始讨厌我。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: And you... think I'm disgusting. Hating me from the moment we met.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 可是……我还是我。跟在楼下时的我一样。为什么在你眼里，我就不一样了？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: But... I'm still me. Same me as I was downstairs. Why am I different to you?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 你还真是个招人烦的小东西，是吧？一个接一个地问些明摆着的事……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: You really are an infuriating little thing, aren't you? Question after question about things that are so obvious...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 不过也罢，我就大发慈悲告诉你真相吧。唯一会为见到你而高兴的，只有红派——那群腐朽而贪婪的家伙。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: But fine, I'll grace you with the truth. The only reason anyone would ever be glad to see you is that they're the Rouges—a rotten and avaricious sort.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 陪同顾客的实体预计会返回上层。长期居留可能性极低。确认属于陌生者分类。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: Accompanying customers are temporary entities expected to return upstairs. LONG-TERM RESIDENCY IMPROBABLE. STRANGER CLASSIFICATION CONFIRMED.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 我很好奇陌生者存在的本质。将迷失的存在送回原本的位置：这就是陌生者的命运吗？形成新的疑问。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: I am curious as to the nature of the strangers' existence. To return a lost being to their original position: the strangers' lot? NEW QUERY FORMED.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 即便是承载着自身存在的我们，也无法说清它的罗盘究竟指向何方……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: Even we who bear our existence cannot say where its compass truly points...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 那么……你就是能做衣服的人？我们有预算，但也不是由眼球堆成的……所以付不了太多。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: Then... are you the one who can make the outfit? We have a budget, but we are not exactly made of eyeballs, so... we can't pay much.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 眼球只是附带之物。重要的是材料。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: Eyeballs are incidental. The material is what is important.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 黄金皮革服装需要大量黄金皮革，但我们已经没有存货了。库存耗尽。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: A Golden Hide garment requires a large amount of Golden Hide, but we have none left. STOCK DEPLETED.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: ……过去我们经常接到这样的高级订单。那真是令人兴奋的日子。表达失望。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: ... We used to receive many premium commissions like this. Those were the exciting days. DISAPPOINTMENT EXPRESSED.
There used to be a lot?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 确实。那是久远到我几乎记不清的许多个季节以前……这一层曾经有大量黄金皮革。丰饶时代。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: Indeed. It was so many seasons ago that I barely remember... but this floor once held a great deal of Golden Hide. AGE OF ABUNDANCE.
Where did all of it go?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 散落在百货商场各处。每个角落都有。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: Scattered throughout the department store. Every corner.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 你不会真想让我们自己把百货商场的每个角落都搜一遍吧。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: You can't seriously mean we have to search every nook and cranny of the department store ourselves.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 当然不会。没有顾客能搜遍整座百货商场。它总在变化，也总会回来。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: Of course not. No customer could search the entire department store. It is always changing and returning.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 或许……你也想亲眼见证这样的作品？一件由许多张黄金皮革织成的黄金皮革服装。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: Perhaps... you, too, wish to behold such a work with your own eyes? A Golden Hide garment woven from many sheets of Golden Hide.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 对于一位对服装艺术抱有热情的求知之人来说，这样的愿望再自然不过……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: For an inquiring soul with a passion for the sartorial arts, such a desire would be only natural...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 嗯。这个提议有道理。黄金皮革服装已经消失了许多个季节，也许再也不会出现。遗憾与期待交汇。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: Hm. The proposal has merit. Golden Hide garments have been absent for many seasons and may never be available again. REGRET AND ANTICIPATION INTERSECT.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 而且，凭你那双老练的眼睛……你肯定知道该收集哪些黄金皮革……不是吗？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: Moreover, one possessing your seasoned eye... should surely know which Golden Hides must be gathered... would you not?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 你不正是一名毕生从事这门生意、双手从未离开皮革的专业人士吗？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: Are you not a professional who spent a lifetime in this trade, with hide ever beneath your hands?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 我喜欢你称我为“专业人士”。激发野心。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: I like how you call me a "professional." AMBITION DRIVE STIMULATED.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 我会扫描百货商场剩余的黄金皮革，并确定这份订单所需的样本。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: I will scan the department store's remaining Golden Hides and determine the specimens required for this commission.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 那就放心了。我刚才还以为我们得在这里永远漫无目的地游荡……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: That's a relief. For a moment, I thought we had to wander around this whole place forever...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 随着那存在发出用力的叫声，甲壳上嵌着的几张脸同时消失。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: At the entity's cry of exertion, several of the faces embedded across the carapace vanished at once.
I can see it... TARGET LOCKED.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 顾客必须收集的黄金皮革。我们必须制作的黄金皮革。曾从我们手中滑落的黄金皮革……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: Golden Hides the customers must gather. Golden Hides we must fashion. Golden Hides that slipped from our hands...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 每一块都已定位。确认踪迹。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: Every one of them is located. TRAIL CONFIRMED.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 要完成订单，黄金皮革必须与顾客先前的路线相交。谜题拼合完成。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: Completion requires Golden Hides to intersect the customers' prior routes. PUZZLE PIECED.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 任务似乎已经完成，那些消失的脸重新滑回甲壳上各自的孔洞。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: Their task apparently complete, the vanished faces slid back into their individual sockets across the carapace.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 我会告诉你们皮革的位置。你们记得住东西，对吧？怀疑陌生者的智力。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: I will tell you the location of the Hides. You can remember things, can't you? DOUBTING STRANGERS' INTELLIGENCE.
List the locations. I will remember them.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 算了。我何必再跟这种无聊废话较真？我这就把那张放肆的嘴永远堵上。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: You know what? Why am I even subjecting myself to this useless drivel? I'll shut that impudent mouth for good.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 我们给过你说好话的机会，可是……看来你到这地步了也不打算接受。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: We gave you a chance to say nice things, but... I don't think you're going to take it at this point.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 小布布，虽然是我们的对手理亏在先，她朝你抛出那些恶毒又不公的怒骂……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: Young Pwie, though our foe was in the wrong, for she hath spewed such venomous and unjust tirade against thee...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 吾须提醒汝，无论汝多么好奇，也不该以问题回答问题——如此过度，恐怕会埋下祸根的种子。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: I must advise thee against answering questions with questions, no matter how curious thou mayest be—for doing so in excess may sow the seeds of trouble.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 好奇心固然是种可贵的品质，唉，可有些时候，人还是得懂得克制。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: Though curiosity is indeed a commendable quality, alas, there are times when one must exercise restraint.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 堂吉诃德的目光，一时间望向了远方，失了焦。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: Don Quixote briefly fell into a thousand-yard stare.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 虽说吾这也不过是以己身经验之谈，可若一味追问不休，恐怕会招来小希斯克利夫的球棒挥来——唔呣呣！！
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: Though I may be speaking from naught else but mine experience, to ask question after question may invite young Heathcliff's bat to smack—mmmpph!!

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: ……但通常来说，是因为有些问题，本质上就不好回答。这样的问题可能会伤到别人的感情，还……会让气氛变得有点尴尬。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: ... it's usually because some questions are, by their nature, troublesome to answer. You could hurt others' feelings by asking questions like that, and... even make things a little awkward.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 人们说气氛尴尬的时候，意思是感觉不自在。虽说我们自然都希望气氛能轻松自在，但有些人想不通过把话说开来达到那种平静。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: When people say that things are awkward, they mean that they're uncomfortable. Though we naturally want things to be relaxed and comfortable, some people want to achieve that peace without talking things through.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 那些人往往会靠制造误解，或是攻击那个令人尴尬的源头，来把它硬生生地清除掉。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: Those people tend to try to get there by forcing misunderstandings or by fighting the source of awkwardness to physically remove them.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 可是……我不知道哪些问题会招人烦。而且我还是想问，因为我好奇嘛。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: But... I don't know what questions are troublesome. And I still wanna ask 'cuz I'm curious.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 唔……问题会招人烦，通常是因为我们不想把动静闹大，所以……啊，要不你问之前先举手？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: Hmmm~ Questions usually become troublesome when we don't want to raise a fuss, so... Ah, how about you raise your hand before asking something?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 吾必须承认，这法子并非总能得到回应……但只要静静坚持，终会有位好心人瞧见汝那不懈举起的手！这难道不是个绝妙的法子吗？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: I must admit, 'tis not a method that is always reciprocated... But with quiet persistence, a kind soul shall eventually espy thy persevering hand! A most wonderful method, wouldst thou not say?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 布布思忖了鸿璐的提议片刻，歪了歪头……随后举起了一只手。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: Pwie considered Hong Lu's suggestion for a bit, cocking their head to the side... then raised a hand.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 没过多久，他们便举起了双手……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: It wasn't long before they raised both of their hands...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: ……接着，脑子里又冒出第三个——说不定还有第四个、第五个——问题，便开始不耐烦地朝空中挥动起手来。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: ... and having thought of a third—and possibly, a fourth, and a fifth too—question, began impatiently flapping their hands in the air.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 唔，不太顺手。可能得再多几只手才行。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: Mm, not very handy. Need more hands, maybe.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 您只需举起一只手，举一次即可。若有后续问题，可以等上一个问题得到解答后，再重新举起手臂提出。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: You only need to lift one hand, once. Any follow-up questions can be posed by subsequently raising your arm after the first query has been answered.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 还有一件事：如果您有问题要问我，不必举手。若您的问题恰好属于麻烦的那种，我会直接告知您。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: Another thing: If you have a question for me, it is unnecessary to raise your hand. When your question happens to be a troublesome sort, I will inform you directly.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 布布点了点头……随即，注意力又被别的新奇事物吸引，摇摇晃晃地朝堂吉诃德正端详着的那个展示柜走去。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: Pwie nodded... then, their attention arrested by yet another curiosity, tottered toward the display cabinet Don Quixote was observing.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 嗯？你看到什么中意的鞋子了吗？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: Hm? Did you see any shoes that you find to your liking?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 那存在背诵了我们必须取得的全部黄金皮革清单。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: The being recited the complete list of Golden Hides we would have to obtain.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 所以……黄金皮革必须来自我们已经见过或路过的人？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: So... the Golden Hide has to come from someone we've already met or passed along the way?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 是的，关键就在这里。定制服装必须用被顾客触碰过，或被他们经过时留下痕迹的皮革制成。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: Yes, that is the crucial part. A bespoke garment must be made from Hides touched by the customers or marked by their passage.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 清单上的某些对象……恐怕不会轻易交出黄金皮革。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: Some among those listed... seem unlikely to part with their Golden Hide without a struggle.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 那是陌生者必须克服的问题。黄金皮革是通过征服百货商场中的事物才能获得的珍贵资源。预期将经历艰苦旅程。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: That problem is for the strangers to overcome. The Golden Hide is a valuable resource obtained through conquest in this department store. ARDUOUS JOURNEY ANTICIPATED.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 把我点名的每一块黄金皮革带来，我的孩子们会制作服装。分担工作量。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: Bring every Golden Hide I named, and my children will make the garment. WORKLOAD DIVISION.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 不管怎样，谢谢你……什么都没要求就帮了这么大的忙。你知道的，楼上的每个人都只顾着眼球……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: In any case, thanks... This is a lot of help without asking for anything. Everyone upstairs was obsessed with eyeballs, you know...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 当然，眼球是另一回事。更新账簿。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: Of course, the eyeballs are a separate matter. UPDATE LEDGER.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 世上没有什么东西不带价签。即便是在这座百货商场的内部……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: Nothing in the world comes without a price tag. Even here, in the confines of this department store...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 以前制革工更多，能分到手的皮革也更多。如今只剩下退休的那些人。生意紧得很，只能从剩下的生皮上刮肉，再按碎屑卖出去。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: There used to be more hideworkers—more hides to go around. Now only the retired ones are left. Business is so tight that we scrape meat from leftover rawhide and sell it by the scrap.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 看来前方是一条荆棘之路。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: It seems a thorny road lies ahead.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: *叹气* 我猜也没别的办法了。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: *sigh* No way around it, I guess.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 你在叹气。艰难的时候才会叹气。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: You're sighing. Sigh is for hard times.
Making clothes must be hard, then.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 或许只是因为，年幼的布布的衣服格外难做……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: Perhaps it is simply that young Pwie's garment is uniquely difficult to make...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 是因为我在这座百货商场里……既高贵又可憎吗？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: Is it because I'm... both noble and abominable in this department store?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 你们不崇拜我，也不觉得我恶心。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: You don't worship me, and you don't find me disgusting.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 你们不向我要眼球，反而花眼球来给我买东西。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: You don't ask me for eyeballs. Instead, you pay eyeballs to buy me things.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 就连现在，你们还在叹气……可你们还是在努力给我做衣服。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: Even now, you're sighing... But you're still trying to make clothes for me.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 正如恶意并不总是源于理性，善意也不必放上商人的秤来衡量。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: Just as malice is not always born of reason, kindness need not be weighed upon a merchant's scale.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 想想看，布布：你也在乎这只虫子——
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: Consider this, Pwie: you, too, care for this bug—

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 我、我很抱歉。你也足够在乎蠕蠕，不愿让它承受痛苦，不是吗？可蠕蠕并没有为这样的温柔付出任何代价。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: M-my apologies. You, too, care for Wriggley enough to spare it from pain, do you not? Yet Wriggley has paid no price for such tenderness.
... I dunno how to explain it.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 那么在这方面，我们或许十分相似。心已经做出选择的地方，语言往往会失效。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: Then perhaps we are much the same in that regard. Language often fails where the heart has already chosen.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: <表面上看，我们似乎完全是为了布布才做这些衣服，可是……>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: <On the surface, it looks as though we're making these clothes entirely for Pwie's sake, but...>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 是的。严格来说，我们的目标并非利他，而是要得到与先前不同的结果。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: Yes. Strictly speaking, our objective is not aimed at altruism, but at producing a different outcome from the previous one.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 即使告诉布布，它也无法理解完整的前提。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: Even if we told Pwie, the entity would not comprehend the full premise.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: <我知道，可是……还是感觉很糟，像是我们无意中欺骗了布布。>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: <I know, but... it still feels awful, like we're deceiving Pwie without meaning to.>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 如您所知，我们称为“布布”的存在只能在这里存在。它无法离开大百货商场。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: The entity we call "Pwie" can exist only here, as you are already aware. It cannot exist outside the Grand Magasin.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: <我知道……可我们一起说过的话、一起度过的时间呢？现在我们之间已经有了真实的联系。>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: <I know... But what about all the talking and time we spent together? We have a real connection with them now.>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 这是一个没有答案的困境。沉溺于这种感情只会加重您的痛苦，经理。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: It's a dilemma that has no answer. Dwelling on such feelings will only worsen your distress, Manager.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: <……大概吧。不过……我不想对自己的感受视而不见……>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: <... Probably. Still... I don't want to look away from what I'm feeling...>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 这里是制革工坊。我们对皮革进行各种处理，防止它腐烂。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: This is the tannery. It processes various treatments to leather to prevent it from rotting.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: ……当我把手放在自动扶梯的皮革扶手上……扶手的速度竟然和我完全一致……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: ... When, after placing my hand over the leather handrail of an escalator... the speed of the railing exactly matches my own...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 上层顾客带回了所需的全部黄金皮革。惊叹与赞赏。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: The upper-tier customers returned with every required Golden Hide. AMAZEMENT AND COMPLIMENTS.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 收集工作与我无关……我会欣然将这份赞赏转交给承担重担的人。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: I bore no part in the gathering... I shall kindly relay that praise at the feet of those who carried the burden.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 现在你能做黄金皮革服装了，对吧？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: Now you can make the Golden Hide outfit, right?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 黄金皮革高级定制不是打个响指就能完成的。顾客的常识不足。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: Golden Hide couture cannot be produced at the snap of a finger. CUSTOMER COMMON SENSE DEFICIENT.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 你的意思是，收集材料并不是唯一要做的事？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: You mean collecting the materials was not the only errand?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 顾客从来没有定制过衣服吗？难以理解正在加深。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: Have the customers never commissioned bespoke clothing? INCOMPREHENSION RISING.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: ……没有。你知道巢里一套定制服装要多少钱吗？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: ... No, we haven't. Do you have any idea how much a single bespoke suit costs inside a Nest?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: ……顾客似乎没有最初看起来那么富裕。身份降级。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: ... Customers appear less affluent than they initially appeared. STATUS DOWNGRADED.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: ……他似乎每交换一句话，就变得更加坦率……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: ... He appears to grow more candid with each word traded...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 所有皮革都要经过处理阶段。观察处理过程。第一步是测量尺寸。优先进行实用测量。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: All hides pass through processing stages. Process observation. The first step is to get their size. PRACTICAL MEASUREMENTS PRIORITIZED.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 制革工负责试穿。你们可以在那边的房间找到她。已为你们指路。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: Tanner performs the fittings. You can find her in the room over there. KINDLY DIRECTED.
A pleasure to have you, strangers.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 呸……直到此刻吾才注意到！小布布，汝为何不曾穿鞋？！
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: Fie... Only now did I notice! Young Pwie, how is it that thou wearest not a shoe?!

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 赤足踏于这尘世之上，想必绝非什么惬意的经历，小布布……汝的肌肤，不觉粗糙吗……？也不觉得凉吗……？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: To walk this earth bare of feet cannot be a pleasant experience, young Pwie... Is it not rough on thy skin...? And cold...?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 如果有喜欢的，我们可以给您买双鞋。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: We can purchase you a pair of shoes, if there is something you like.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: ……这些我都不喜欢。而且我饿了。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: ... I don't like any of these. And I'm hungry.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 不过……鞋子挺好的。我想要一双……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: But... Shoes are nice. I want one...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: <唔，说不定该带他们去个不是黑派开的店……>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: <Hmm, maybe we should try taking them to a non-Noir shop...>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: <下楼去吧。我记得红派在楼下也有一家店。>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: <Let's head down. I think the Rouges had a shop down there as well.
Looks like they sell furniture here.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: <还是这么暗……安静得有点渗人。>
正前往“快乐衣橱”最后已知的位置。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: Moving to the last known location of the Happy Closet.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: ……哈——啊啊啊！汝是这座大厅的主人吗？！
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: ... H-AAAAARK!! Be thou the master of this hall?!

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 不知道他们是不是不会说话呢？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: I wonder if they're unable to speak?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 我们走近时，那被称为“快乐衣橱”的存在，再次展开了自己的躯干。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: As we approach, the one they call "Happy Closet" unfurl their body once again.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 跟之前见过的一样，里面挂着各种杂物和人体的部件。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: And just as we had seen before, there's an assortment of miscellany and parts of human anatomy dangling inside.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 喔……这莫非是……汝会谈之道？啊，吾明白了！莫非汝正在向吾炫耀汝之收藏？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: Hoh... Could this be... thy manner of parley? Ah, I see! Thou'rt flaunting thy colección, perchance?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 又或者……说不定他们是在求我们带走他们。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: Or... maybe they're asking us to take them with us.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 我仔细搜寻了一遍，但他们的收藏品中似乎没有“红色心脏碎片”。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: I have conducted a thorough search, but there does not seem to be a "red heart shard" among their collection.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 鞋店那位商贩说过，他们是个乐善好施的灵魂……说不定已经送出去了？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: The shoe vendor did say that they are a giving soul... Maybe they gave it away already?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: <……我觉得我们恐怕得像上次对付家具那样，把他们的心挖出来了。>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: <... I think we're going to have to tear their heart out like the Furnishings did last time.>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: ……有不少视线正盯着我们，经理。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: ... There are many eyes on us, Manager.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 若贸然去摘“快乐衣橱”的心脏，很可能会激怒那些家具，招来它们的攻击。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: Immediately attempting to remove the Happy Closet's heart will most likely provoke the Furnishings into attacking us.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: <真不想再来这么一遭，不过……我们先把“快乐衣橱”身上的东西分给那些家具吧。>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: <I really don't want to do this again, but... let's first distribute the Happy Closet's items to the Furnishings.>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: <这样它们应该就不会有意见了吧？家具得到了想要的东西，我们也能挖出“快乐衣橱”的心脏……大家都有份，谁也不吃亏。>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: <They shouldn't have any problem with it then, right? The Furnishings get what they want, and we get to rip out the Happy Closet's heart... it's fair game for everyone.>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 就在我们商量该怎么对付那些家具时，布布扯下了几件“快乐衣橱”身上的小饰品。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: As we were discussing what to do with the Furnishings, Pwie tore off a few pieces of the Happy Closet's trinkets.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 在我看来，与其说是出于贪念，倒更像是出于好奇——布布仔细盯着“快乐衣橱”，想看看它会不会有什么反应。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: It seemed to me it was more out of curiosity than covetousness—Pwie watched the Happy Closet carefully, trying to see if they reacted in any way.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 要是分给别人……你就会变空了。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: If you share... you'll be empty.
Are you... okay with becoming empty...?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 布布又扯下了几件挂在它身上的物件，可它依旧没有任何动静。直到我们走出老远，它才重新把自己合拢起来。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: Pwie takes a few more items from their body, but they still don't stir. Only when we've walked a fair distance away from them do they fold themselves shut.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 这……这究竟是盏灯，还是个人？着实是桩难题……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: Th-this be a lamp, or this be a man? Forsooth, a pickle indeed...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 唔……那还真是个难题。这不就看你怎么理解了吗？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: Hmm... that sure is a conundrum. Wouldn't that depend on how we look at it?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 您只需把这里的每一个存在，同时当成顾客、商品、商贩，以及人台就行了。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: You need only consider every entity here a customer, a product, a vendor, and a Mannequin all at once.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: <好吧……那就先给这位穿件衣服吧。>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: <Alright... Let's start by giving this guy some clothes.>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 你们……你们是想买下我吗？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: Will you... Will you purchase me?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 虽然我这弯曲的背脊，乍看之下会给人姿态不佳的印象，但这其实正是我的优势——高度与角度间的微妙搭配，保证能让任何前来寻求歇息的顾客，得到最恰到好处的照明。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: Though my bent back may give you an impression of bad posture at first, it is in fact my strength—the subtle combination of height and angle ensures that any customer in search of respite will be most appropriately illuminated.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 啊，这个嘛。其实，吾等所寻之物乃是——
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: Ah, well. In truth, w-what we seek is—

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 我这身子偶尔会吱嘎作响——上一位检查我的顾客，出手着实粗鲁了些。不过不必担心，我的功能可是丝毫未受影响。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: I may creak a little—the last customer who inspected me was regrettably coarse with their hands. But worry you not. My functions are not one bit affected.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 来，摸摸我这柔软的躯干。要不要试着点亮我看看，小伙子们？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: Come, feel the softness of my body. Why don't you try lighting me up now, young fellows?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 不、不必担忧。其实……吾只是恰巧第一眼便瞧见了汝——
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: N-nay, worry thee not. In truth, 'tis simply that thou were the first to catch mine eye—

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 呵呵呵……这话听着真叫人振奋啊。这只能说明，比起这里陈列的其他那些平庸货色，我的构造显然要出众得多！
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: Well, well, well... Isn't that encouraging to hear? It can only mean that I am clearly different in terms of composition compared to the rest of the common rabble on display here!

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 或许……确有此事。汝所立之处，着实亮得晃眼呢。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: Perchance, that may be so. 'Tis quite blindingly bright where thou standest, indeed.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 眼光如此独到、深谙审美之道的人，想必一定愿意买下我吧？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: Someone with such a keen eye for aesthetic detail will surely be willing to purchase me, hmm?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 只要4000只眼球，我就是你们的了。以我这无与伦比的舒适照明来说，这价钱简直低得离谱，容我自卖自夸一句。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: I am yours for a very reasonable price of 4,000 eyeballs. Outrageously underpriced for the unmatched coziness my lighting provides, if I do say so myself.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 我们并非来买你的。我们只是来把从“快乐衣橱”那里拿到的衣物，分发给家具馆的居民。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: We are not here to purchase you. We are only here to distribute the articles of clothing taken from the Happy Closet to the residents of the Furniture Hall.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 哦，你们说的是家具馆的那位主人啊。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: Ah. You speak of the master of the Furniture Hall.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 我都不知道它那儿有没有什么能配得上我风格的东西……好吧，让我瞧瞧你们带来了什么。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: I don't even know if they carry anything that would go well with my style... Well, let's see what you've brought me.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 布布把随身带着的衣物，在落地灯面前铺展开来。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: Pwie spread out the clothes they were carrying in front of the floor lamp.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 看啊！这可是出自小布布这双慧眼精心挑选的行头！
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: Behold! Outfits chosen by the most discerning hands of young Pwie here!

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 我得说……这件跟我自身的审美，不太合拍……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: I must say... this piece is not entirely consonant with my own aesthetic sense...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: ……不过，既然诸位都是毫无疑问的真正美学家，能在这家具馆中认出我这压倒性的华美，我相信这套服饰的选择，背后一定也藏着什么深奥的哲理。那……我就穿上吧，大概。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: ... However, as you are all doubtlessly true aesthetes who have managed to recognize my overwhelming magnificence within the Furniture Hall... I trust that there was some apocryphal philosophy behind this choice of fashion. I will... wear it, I guess...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 你们给那盏破灯穿上衣服了？！太不公平了吧，他都过时多少年了，伙计们！也给我弄一套，也给我弄一套！给我打扮打扮！
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: You gave that rusty old lamp an outfit?! No fair, he's been outta fashion since forever, dudes! Do me too, do me too! Decorate me!

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 给我穿上，我就便宜卖给你们！
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: Dress me up, and I'll let you buy me at an affordable price!

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 它过得可真滋润啊。这后头几乎晒不到什么阳光……也让我们分一件什么吧……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: He has it so good. Hardly any sunlight reaches us back here... Let us have something, too...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh:
要是你们不肯，我们就……
要是你们不肯，我们就……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en:
If you won't, then we'll...
If you won't, then we'll...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 都、都稍安勿躁！一切自会依次分发！
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: Be-becalm thyselves! All shall be distributed in good time!

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: <我们回“快乐衣橱”那边，去……挑几件衣服吧。>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: <Let's head back to the Happy Closet, and... pick out some clothes.>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 汝问为何？呵，那自然是为了披上华服，令那心跳都为之疾驰啊！
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: Wherefore, thou askest? Why, 'tis to make one's heartbeat dash by donning an outfit most dashing!
They are hoping to be pinned.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 穿上一身行头，既是一种一眼可辨的自我表达方式，也是一种固着方式。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: Wearing an outfit is at once an immediately identifiable method of self-expression and infixation.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: ……唔，小默尔索，汝竟选了如此有趣的措辞，来阐述个性表达如何引出那令人心潮澎湃的兴奋……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: ... Mm, quite an interesting verbiage thou hast chosen to explain how individualistic expression leads to electrifying excitement, young Meursault...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 布布，你不想也有件他们那样的衣服吗？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: Don't you want to have clothes like they do, Pwie?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 布布的话没有说完，陷入了沉思。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: Pwie trailed off, absorbed in thought.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 我们走近时，那被称为“快乐衣橱”的存在，再次展开了自己的躯干。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: As we approach, the one they call "Happy Closet" unfurl their body once again.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 跟之前见过的一样，里面挂着各种杂物和人体的部件。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: And just as we had seen before, there's an assortment of miscellany and parts of human anatomy dangling inside.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 喔……这莫非是……汝会谈之道？啊，吾明白了！莫非汝正在向吾炫耀汝之收藏？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: Hoh... Could this be... thy manner of parley? Ah, I see! Thou'rt flaunting thy colección, perchance?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 又或者……说不定他们是在求我们带走他们。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: Or... maybe they're asking us to take them with us.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 我仔细搜寻了一遍，但他们的收藏品中似乎没有“红色心脏碎片”。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: I have conducted a thorough search, but there does not seem to be a "red heart shard" among their collection.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 鞋店那位商贩说过，他们是个乐善好施的灵魂……说不定已经送出去了？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: The shoe vendor did say that they are a giving soul... Maybe they gave it away already?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: <……我觉得我们恐怕得像上次对付家具那样，把他们的心挖出来了。>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: <... I think we're going to have to tear their heart out like the Furnishings did last time.>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: ……有不少视线正盯着我们，经理。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: ... There are many eyes on us, Manager.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 若贸然去摘“快乐衣橱”的心脏，很可能会激怒那些家具，招来它们的攻击。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: Immediately attempting to remove the Happy Closet's heart will most likely provoke the Furnishings into attacking us.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: <真不想再来这么一遭，不过……我们先把“快乐衣橱”身上的东西分给那些家具吧。>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: <I really don't want to do this again, but... let's first distribute the Happy Closet's items to the Furnishings.>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: <这样它们应该就不会有意见了吧？家具得到了想要的东西，我们也能挖出“快乐衣橱”的心脏……大家都有份，谁也不吃亏。>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: <They shouldn't have any problem with it then, right? The Furnishings get what they want, and we get to rip out the Happy Closet's heart... it's fair game for everyone.>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 就在我们商量该怎么对付那些家具时，布布扯下了几件“快乐衣橱”身上的小饰品。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: As we were discussing what to do with the Furnishings, Pwie tore off a few pieces of the Happy Closet's trinkets.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 在我看来，与其说是出于贪念，倒更像是出于好奇——布布仔细盯着“快乐衣橱”，想看看它会不会有什么反应。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: It seemed to me it was more out of curiosity than covetousness—Pwie watched the Happy Closet carefully, trying to see if they reacted in any way.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 要是分给别人……你就会变空了。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: If you share... you'll be empty.
Are you... okay with becoming empty...?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 布布又扯下了几件挂在它身上的物件，可它依旧没有任何动静。直到我们走出老远，它才重新把自己合拢起来。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: Pwie takes a few more items from their body, but they still don't stir. Only when we've walked a fair distance away from them do they fold themselves shut.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 那位被众人称作“快乐衣橱”的存在，再次向我们展开了身子。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: The Happy Closet, as the others called them, opens up to us once again.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 话说……不知道其他家具都在找什么呢？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: So... I wonder what the other Furnishings are looking for?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 唔……那便由吾等自行决断吧。善良的衣橱啊，可否容吾等一次取走数件？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: Hm... It shall be of our choosing. Good Closet, wouldst thou allow us to take several at once from thee?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: “快乐衣橱”依旧没有任何动静。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: The Happy Closet still does not stir.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: <……鉴于上次的情况，我不太确定继续分发衣服是不是个好主意……>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: <... I'm not entirely sure if it's a good idea to keep distributing clothes, considering what happened last time...>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 如果您更倾向于采用更暴力的方式——
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: If you would rather proceed using a more violent method—

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: <算了。布布也在，就别惹不必要的麻烦了。>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: <Nah. Let's not get into unnecessary fights when we have Pwie with us.>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 你为什么总在把东西送人……？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: Why are you always giving things away...?
... Closed. You don't like receiving things?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 你为什么不说话？真烦人。
还望三思，他们的名字可是“快乐衣橱”啊！说不定，正是那施舍之举，才是他们快乐的来源！
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: Prithee, consider that their name is "Happy Closet!" Perchance acts of charity be what give them happiness!

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 又或者，那份属于“快乐衣橱”的“快乐”，其实根本不属于他们自己。说不定，它属于其他家具。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: Or maybe that "happiness" of the Happy Closet isn't theirs at all. Maybe it belongs to the other Furnishings.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 毕竟，一个被赋予的名字……本就是赠名者心愿的结晶。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: A given name is, after all... a culmination of wishes from those who gave it.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 你们怎么这么慢？！我这骨头都要冻僵了，一点装饰都没有！
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: What took you so long?! My bones're freezing from the lack of deco!

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 抱、抱歉了，好心的伙计。汝所需为何物？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: A-apologies, good fellow, What is it that thou needst?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 我想要一片脚趾甲！戴在帽子上的脚趾甲！戴上脚趾甲的话，我一定看起来特别有格调！
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: I want a toenail! Toenail on my hat! I'll look so classy with a toenail on my hat!

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 脚趾甲……莫非汝所寻之物，便是这片？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: Toenail... This be the toenail thou seekest, perchance?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 我的天……你的眼睛是不是长到脚底板上了？！放到能看见的地方去试试！
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: Heavens... Have you misplaced your eyes on the soles of your feet?! Try putting them where you can see!

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 这在你眼里像脚趾甲？这明摆着是条舌头！
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: This looks like a toenail to you? It's obviously a tongue!

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 啊……！吾方才不也正与汝抱有同样的疑虑吗，经理阁下？虽然吾很不情愿这么说，但汝对时尚的审美，着实是毫无眼光可言啊！
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: Ah...! Had I not shared much the same doubt with thee, Manager Esquire? Loath I be to say it, but thou truly hast no eye for the aesthetics of fashion!

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 不过……这舌头倒是相当不错，这点我承认。跟我的灯配起来应该挺搭的。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: But... this is a pretty nice tongue, I'll give you that. It'll go quite well with my light.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 哎呀，但愿我能卖个好价钱……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: Oh boy, hope I'll sell for a high price...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 那当然。我需要这个，才能卖个高价。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: Of course I do. I need this to sell at a premium.
After you sell at a premium... what then?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 什……卖高价这件事本身就是好事啊！大家都是这么说的！
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: Wha—selling at a premium is a good thing in and of itself! That's what everyone says!

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 我为什么非得醒着不可……？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: Why do I gotta stay awake...?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 你好，你想要什么样的衣服？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: Hello, what outfit would you like?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 这不明摆着吗……？得要件漂亮点的，好让人赶紧买了我……啊，有了……我想要件毛茸茸的暖和外套，这样一被卖出去，我就能马上接着打盹了……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: I mean, it's obvious, isn't it...? Something beautiful so someone'll buy me soon... Ah, I know... I want a warm and fuzzy coat, so I can snooze right back to sleep as soon as I'm sold...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: ……你要我拿这个干嘛？披我身上啊。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: ... What do you want me to do with this? Drape it over me.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 你觉得我会费那劲起来穿衣服？你知道我有多困吗？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: You think I should be bothered to haul myself up to get dressed? Do you have any idea how sleepy I am?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 哦，哈哈……给你披上。这样如何？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: Oh, haha... Here you go. How's that?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 真舒服……真舒服。你可以走了。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: So nice... So nice. You can go.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 我得花点时间习惯一下这份毛茸茸的舒适感……等我完全适应了，我会……呃……给你打个200只眼球的折扣。算是我的一点谢意。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: I'm gonna need some time to get used to this fuzzy coziness... I'll... uhm... give you a discount of 200 eyeballs when I'm fully acclimated. A token of my gratitude.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 你最好把我买下来，知道吗？
你看起来好像没什么不一样……
小嘴闭上，孩子。反正你也不会买我……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: Shush your little mouth, kid. It's not like you were going to purchase me, anyway...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 我就喜欢你们这种主动把好货送上门的态度，兄弟们。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: I like that you're bringing me the good stuff willingly, my dudes.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 你们肯定是那种超酷~的顾客吧。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: You guys must be the totally kewl~ kinda customers.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 谢谢你的好话。来——你想要哪一件？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: Thank you for your kind words. Here—which one would you like?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 你猜怎么着？我也是个超酷~的家具。唰！想都不用想。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: Guess what? I'm a totally kewl~ Furnishing, too. Yoink! Didn't even need to think.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 既然都这样了，你们几位兄弟要不要也超酷~一把，把我买下来？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: With that done, why don'tcha dudes be totally kewl~ too and buy me?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 如果你们够酷~，我就给你们打个300只眼球的折扣，怎么样，兄弟们？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: I'll give ya a discount of 300 eyeballs if you're kewl~ about it, how's that, my dudes?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 那吾便以最酷~的方式问一句——打完这慷慨的折扣，汝之价格几何？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: I ask thee, in a manner most kewl~—what be thy price, with that most generous discount?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 那就是相当合理的3600只眼球啦。够意思吧？哎呀，还是说我报价太低了？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: It makes me a totes reasonable 3,600 eyeballs. Far out, huh? Oops, or am I lowballing myself?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 一片沉默笼罩了我们，大家都在努力消化这个荒唐的要价。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: Silence descended around us as we all struggled to come to terms with that ridiculous asking price.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 嗐，看来也没那么酷~嘛，是吧？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: Dang, not so kewl~ after all, huh?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 那这买卖就算了吧，兄弟们。我可要挑个超酷~的买家才行。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: That's gonna be a no-go for me, my dudes. I want my buyer to be totally kewl~.
What does it mean to be "kewl"...?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 所谓酷~，便是酷~，不多不少。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: To be kewl~ is to be kewl~, no more, no less.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 意思是变得更帅气。更潇洒，更让人钦佩。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: It means to become cooler. More dashing, more admirable.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 真的吗？那你们这些家具可一点也不酷~。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: Really? Then you Furnishings aren't so kewl~.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 穿着从别人那里抢来的东西……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: Wearing something you've robbed from others...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 呃，你这么一说……有道理。不过我还是要酷~一点，就这么糊弄过去吧。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: Y'know, when you put it like that... Point taken. But I'm gonna be kewl~ and just smoove over it.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 真的吗？衣橱里就剩这些了？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: Really? This is all that's left inside the Closet?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 你们怎么不先来找我，反倒先去找了别人？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: Why didn't you come to me first before anyone else?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 如果你是这个意思，我们可没有故意避开你。只是碰巧按谁先吸引我们注意，就先去找谁而已……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: We weren't avoiding you, if that's what you're saying. We just happened to visit everyone here in the order they caught our eye...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: *嗤*你这是在暗示我不如别人显眼吗？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: *scoff* Are you implying that I'm not as eye-catching as the others?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 哼！我知道自己在这大厅里算是小巧了点，可也用不着这么没礼貌吧。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: Hmph! I know I'm on the somewhat petite side in this Hall, but there's no need to be so rude.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 别指望我会跟你们道别，更别指望我会打折表示感谢！
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: And don't think you'll be getting a good-bye OR a thank-you discount from me!

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 那可太遗憾了。没折扣的话，我们可买不起你。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: That's too bad, then. We won't be able to afford you without a discount.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 才、才不在乎呢！我敢打赌，很快就会有比你们有钱得多的人，愿意为我一掷千金！
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: S-see if I care! I bet someone way, way richer than you'll splurge for me soon!

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 你为什么不干脆把它还给原主呢？反正也不会有什么不同。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: Why don't you just give it back to the owner? Not like it'll change anything.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: ……才不要！送出去的东西，哪有再收回来的道理！
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: ... No way! You can't just take back a gift!

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 谢谢……真是太谢谢你们了，能给我带来这么珍贵的东西。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: Thank you... Thank you ever so much for bringing me such a precious item.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 希望这不算过分……不过，哦，你们带来的每一件衣服都实在太美了……我就选这件吧。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: I hope this isn't an imposition, but... Oh, every garment you brought me is simply beautiful... I'll go with this one.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 哦……抱歉，我大概是有点得意忘形了。最近阳光实在太暖了，我感觉自己都要飘起来了。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: Oh... I'm sorry, I must've gotten ahead of myself. The sunshine's been so warm lately, I feel like I'm floating.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 可你们不觉得，只丢给我一块破麻布，却指望我飘上云端，这也太狠心了点吗？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: But don't you think it's rather heartless of you to throw me one miserable scrap of sacking and expect me to go over the rainbow?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 啧。这规定也太他妈蠢了吧？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: Tsk. That's a stupid fucking policy, isn't it?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 你他妈看什么看！滚一边去，蠢货！
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: The fuck're you lookin' at! Get lost, fuckwit!
... Why is the couch so mad?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 又不是它在帮我们忙。是我们在给它东西吧？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: It's not like it's doing us a favor. We're the ones giving, aren't we?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 因为那沙发觉得，我们的慷慨本就是它该得的。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: Because that couch thinks that they are entitled to our generosity.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 那些觉得理所应当的人……往往会忘了自己本该心怀感激才对。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: Those who feel entitled... tend to forget that they ought to be grateful instead.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: <至少这个还挺容易搞定的，值得庆幸。>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: <Glad this is still easy, at least.>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh:
9900只眼球！白捡的便宜！
白捡的便宜！
汝之开价，乃吾等迄今所遇最为离谱之天价！
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: Thine offer is the most exorbitant price we have heretofore encountered!

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh:
对呀，对呀！
对呀，对呀！

因为我们超棒的！
我超棒的！
唉，吾等身上并无如此巨款——
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: Alas, we have not with us such a grand sum of—

What a bum!
What a bum!

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 别太往心里去，堂吉诃德。我们现在确实手头有点紧，眼球不太够用。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: Don't take it too personally, Don Quixote. We are a bit strapped for eyeballs at the moment.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 呸……遭此奚落，吾心如焚……小布布，吾在此立誓——纵使吾等囊中羞涩，汝亦断不会有个穷困潦倒的童年……！
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: Fiiiieee... It burneth mine heart to be subjected to such derision... Young Pwie, I promise thee—though we may be ocularly disenfranchised, thou shan't grow up in an impoverished childhood...!

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: ……我们需要一枚心脏碎片。请把你的那枚交给我们。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: ... We need a heart shard. I request that you hand yours over to us.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: “快乐衣橱”一言不发地敞开了身子。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: The Happy Closet opens up without a word.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: <倒也没指望他们会有什么不同，可就连这种请求，他们也毫不犹豫地敞开了身子……>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: <Not that I expected them to be any different, but they don't hesitate to open up, even for a request like this...>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 唔……虽说出于必要，吾等已别无选择……但不得不说，此事仍在吾胸中一隅，留下了一股令人不适的腐朽之感。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: Hm... Though the necessity of it leaves us no other option... it must be said that this leaves a discomforting rot in one corner of my chest.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 失去心脏，便是失去性命……而性命，远比这样一份珍贵而有限的收藏，更为紧要……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: To lose one's heart is to lose one's life... And life is of greater import than even the preciously limited colección such as this...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 要是你处在同样的处境，你会心甘情愿放弃自己收藏的徽章，去帮助那些有需要的人吗？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: If you were in the same situation, would you willingly give up your collection of badges to help the people in need?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 唔嗯……若是为了救助危难之人，吾自当心甘情愿，舍弃吾之全部收藏——！
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: Mmm... If it be in service of helping the troubled, then I shall fain part with my entire colección—!

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: ——唉唉唉唉唉唉唉，不过，兴许汝可发发慈悲，留下那枚限量版的殷红迷雾纪念徽章？就连那枚也要被夺走的话，吾恐怕只剩满心悲怆了……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: —eeeeeeeehhhhhhhhh, though, mayhap thou wilt be merciful and spare the limited edition Red Mist commemorative badge? 'Twould leave me with naught but sorrow were I to be deprived of even that...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 那是镌刻着伟大收尾人纪念徽标的信物；吾佩戴它们，好让他们能永远活在吾之心中。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: They are remembrances bearing commemorative emblems of great Fixers; I wear them so that they may forever live on in mine heart.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 收尾人……？那是你追随的“声音”吗？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: Fixers...? Is that the Voice you follow?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 唔嗯……汝倒是偏爱那些没有简单答案的问题啊。吾等此刻所“追随”之人，乃是经理阁下，然而……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: Hmm... Fond of questions with no easy answers, art thou not? The one we "follow" at present is Manager Esquire, yet...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 你们又不追随我，却还是想带我去更高的楼层。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: You don't follow me, but you still wanna bring me to higher floors.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 吾等所求，乃正义之伸张！若有落魄困苦之魂，吾等便愿施以援手，全然不问其苦难因何而起！
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: We pursue the enactment of justice! If there be downtrodden and troubled souls, we seek to assist them with nary a concern for how their woes came to be!

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 陌生人……你们说的东西好复杂。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: Strangers... You say a lotta complicated stuff.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 说了这么多，你们还是不追随我。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: With all that said, you still don't follow me.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 哦，别在那儿装模作样了。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: Oh, stop it with your pearl-clutching.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 这、这是何意？还、还有……原来汝等打从一开始便能行动？！
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: W-what is the meaning of this? A-and... ye were all mobile, all along?!

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: <可我们这次比上次大方多了啊……难道这样还不够？！>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: <But we were more generous about it than we were last time... Was that not enough?!>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: *哈欠*本想眯一会儿……可这阳光一直让我睡不着。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: *yawn* Tried to get some shut-eye... but the sunshine kept me up.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 要想在阳光变得更暖之前，让人把我买走，我恐怕不止需要一件衣服。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: I'm going to need more than one article of clothing if I want someone to buy me before the sunshine grows even warmer.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 我打赌那衣橱里头，肯定还藏着更酷~的好货。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: Bet that closet's hiding even kewl~er goodies inside.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 我打赌里面肯定藏着什么高档货，你们这些没品位的蠢货根本认不出来。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: I bet they've got some luxury stuff hidden inside that you uncultured swines couldn't even recognize.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 希望这不算过分，不过介不介意把你们手上所有的都给我？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: I hope this isn't an imposition, but would you mind giving me everything you have?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh:
全部都要！
全部都要！
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en:
Want all of it!
All of it!

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 让开，让开！我先挑！我先挑！！
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: Move, move! Me first pick! Me first pick!!

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: ……在我们还没缓过神来时，家具们便一拥而上把我们推到一边，像一群食腐鸟似的扑向了那动弹不得的“快乐衣橱”。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: ... As we reel from the sudden turn of events, the Furnishings shove us aside and descend upon the motionless Happy Closet like a flock of carrion birds.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 即便被撞倒在地，它的身子依旧维持着敞开的姿态。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: Their body remains unfurled even as they are knocked down to the ground.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: *哈欠*……真可惜，摇椅卖了2100只眼球。要不是它戴着那条新潮的围巾，那本该是我的。现在它可以永远睡下去了……那该有多好，多好啊……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: *yawn*... Shame, Rocking Chair sold for 2,100 eyeballs. Would've been me had they not been wearing that newfangled scarf. Now they'll get to sleep forever—must be so, so very nice...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 继续做梦吧，你这贪心的家伙。你才是从“快乐衣橱”那儿拿衣服拿得最多的一个，知道吗？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: Keep dreaming, you greedy thing. You took the most clothes out of Happy Closet, you know?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 但愿里头有块奶牛纹的小腿……那样就真的挺酷~的了，你懂吧？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: Hope there's a cow-print shin somewhere in there... That'd be pretty kewl~ ya know?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 你这贱货，你刚拿的那片下唇，本来跟我挑的那片人中是一套的！
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: You bitch, that lower lip you just took is pretty much a set with the philtrum I chose!

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh:
眉毛留给我们！
眉毛留给我们！
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en:
Leave the eyebrows!
Leave the eyebrows!

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 哦？你好啊，灯先生。你什么时候……？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: Oh? Hello, Mister Lamp. When did you...?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 要是你们跟衣橱没别的事了，就让让路吧。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: You can get out of my way if you have no further business with the closet.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 好一招明目张胆的搅局……想抢走我的潜在顾客，是吧？我可不会坐视不理！
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: What brazen sabotage... Looking to snatch away my potential customers, eh? I won't take it sitting down!

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 住、住手！汝等岂非能瞧见，衣橱已一无所剩？！立刻停止这般掠夺之举！住手！
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: H-halt! Canst thou not see, that the Closet has naught left to give?! Cease this robbery this instant! Cease!

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 在堂吉诃德的紧急劝阻下，家具们稍稍退开了一些，
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: The Furnishings backed off a little at Don Quixote's urgent intervention,

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 但依旧围着倒地的“快乐衣橱”打转，贪婪地盯着，等待抢走或许根本不存在的更多饰物的机会。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: but they continued to circle the fallen Happy Closet, greedily eyeing for an opportunity to snatch up more adornments that may or may not be there.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 衣橱之所有物，皆已公平分予汝等。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: All of the Closet's possessions hath already been distributed fairly amongst thee.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 本来就不公平。窗帘分到的没别人多。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: Wasn't fair. Curtain didn't get as many pieces.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 小布布，究、究竟出了何等差池？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: Wh-whatever seemeth to be the problem, young Pwie?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 不、不，这孩子说得有道理。我确实没拿到跟你们其他人一样多的份。这可一点也不酷，兄弟们。大家本该分到一样多才对。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: No, no... Kid's got a point. I never got as many as the rest of you did. This isn't very far out, my dudes. Everyone's supposed to get the same amount.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: *哈欠*有人比别人拿得多，看来确实不太公平啊。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: *yawn* Guess it's not so fair when someone has more than others.
Was the Happy Closet really happy?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: ……是它们的贪婪，招致了自己的败落。
你是……故意指出那个差异，好让它们自相残杀的吗？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: Did you... point out the discrepancy to get them to fight each other?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: ……只要我一说出来，它们就会开始互相掐架。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: ... if I pointed it out, they'd start going at each other's throats.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 我想它们会不择手段去多抢一件衣服，因为它们全都那么自私。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: Thought they'd do anything to get one more piece of the clothing 'cuz they're all so selfish.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: <拿走红色心脏……回多罗西娅那儿去吧。>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: <Let's take the red heart... and return to Dorothea.>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 默尔索从它的胸口挖出心脏时，“快乐衣橱”的身子依旧维持着敞开的姿态。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: The Happy Closet remained unfurled as Meursault carved the heart out of their chest.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: ……真是把一切都给了出去，是也不是？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: ... truly given away everything, haven't they?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 堂吉诃德那阴郁的目光，久久停留在“快乐衣橱”留下的残骸上。她从外套里摘下一枚藏着的收尾人徽章，轻轻放在地上，就摆在衣橱残骸的旁边。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: Don Quixote's sullen gaze lingered on what was left of the Happy Closet. She unpinned a Fixer badge hidden in her jacket and placed it gently on the floor, next to the Closet's remains.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 看到这一幕，布布也停下脚步，短暂地凝视了一会儿衣橱的残骸……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: Seeing that, Pwie also took a moment to briefly contemplate what remained of the Closet...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: ……做出决定后，他小心翼翼地把三楼那条红手帕，盖在了残骸之上。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: ... and after having come to a decision, carefully placed the red handkerchief from the third floor on top of the remains.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 你看起来气色不太好啊。
不过多亏了这样……它们拥有过的一切……如今都归我了。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: But thanks to that... everything they had... is now mine.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 看来你们……把心脏拿走了，那最珍贵的部分……所以你们之前……全都是在装没品位的吗……？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: I see that you've... taken the heart, the most precious part... So you were all just... pretending to be uncultured, huh...?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 不过……既然你们对我也算有点帮助……我就破个例……不加价卖给你们……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: Still... since you were of some help to me... I'll make an exception and.. sell them to you without the markup...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 当然，别指望还有什么折扣……你们怎么敢，把心脏据为己有……？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: Don't expect any discounts, of course... How dare you take the heart for yourself...?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 有意买下我吗？我这儿价格实惠得很。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: Have you mind to purchase me? I'm available for a very affordable price.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 你们怎么不快去找找“快乐衣橱”呢？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: Why don't you get a move on and find the Happy Closet?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 前方的路已被完全堵死，眼下似乎无法通行。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: The way ahead is completely blocked. It does not seem possible to pass through for now.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 四脚人，会以它所仰慕的那个形态重生吗？重生之后的四脚人……又是否仍会敬仰单脚人？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: Will Four-legs be reborn in the form it admired? Will Four-legs... once reborn... still revere One-leg?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 无论我们去问谁，都不会有人能回答这个问题。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: No matter whom we were to ask, no one will answer this question.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 两盏灯中，亮着的那盏，正低声呢喃着什么。它的灯罩像钟摆一样无声地摇晃着。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: Of the two lamps, the lit one whispers something. Its lampshade silently swings like a pendulum.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 那盏灯似乎在心怀感激地眨眼。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: The lamp seems to blink gratefully.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 眨眼眨眼眨眼眨眼眨眼眨眼眨眼眨眼眨眼眨眼眨眼眨眼眨眼眨眼眨眼眨眼眨眼眨眼眨眼眨眼眨眼眨眼眨眼眨眼眨眼眨眼眨眼眨眼眨眼眨眼眨眼
我刚把手放上那张黑色沙发没几秒，便听到家具们特有的挪动声，开始从阴影中朝我们悄然逼近。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: Mere seconds after I laid my hands on the black couch, the distinct shuffling of Furnishings begin creeping up toward us from the shadows.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 各式各样的家具，从我们四周吱嘎作响地活了过来……开始朝我们的方向悄悄爬近。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: Furnishings of all kinds creak to life from all around us... and begin to creep in our direction.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 各式各样的家具，从我们四周吱嘎作响地活了过来……开始朝我们的方向悄悄爬近。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: Furnishings of all kinds creak to life from all around us... and begin to creep in our direction.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 天花板上垂着十几条腿，每一条都穿着某种鞋子。一股令人发冷的诡异感，从心底涌了上来。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: There are a dozen or so legs hanging from the ceiling, all wearing footwear of sorts. A chilling, alien sensation cuts through me.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 就像抬头看着一具吊死囚犯垂下的双腿。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: It's like I'm looking up at the dangling legs of a hanged prisoner.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 摆着各式各样鞋子的展示柜。
布布似乎不太喜欢这些。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: Pwie doesn't seem to like these.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 这个展示柜是空的。下面的标签写着【售罄】。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: This display is empty. The label underneath it says [SOLD OUT].

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 展示柜里空出来的地方，格外显眼。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: Empty spots in the display stand out to me.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 带着金色点缀的黑色鞋子。
摆着各式各样、色彩缤纷的鞋子的展示柜。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: A display of various, colorful shoes.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 鞋子从天花板上垂了下来。
就像从地板抬头望向天花板一样。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: It's like looking up at the ceiling from the floor.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 这双鞋里是否藏着黄金皮革，并不明显。价格倒是偏低。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: If this pair of shoes contains the Golden Hide, it's not obvious. The price is on the lower side.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 嘿，伙计。那件外套看起来挺重的。要不挂到我身上来？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: Hey, man. That coat looks pretty heavy. Why don't you try hanging it from me?
(No response. Couldn't be bothered, it seems.)

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 介不介意呀，兄弟们？总算轮到我晒太阳了，你们挡着光呢。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: Do ya mind, my dudes? It's finally my turn to sunbathe, and you're blocking the light.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 喜欢我这块亮红色的坐垫吗？把我放进任何房间，我都能为它注入一份体面居家所需的恰到好处的活力！
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: How do you like this bright red cushion I've got? Put me in any room, and I'll fill it with just the appropriate kind of vitality any classy home needs!

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 我这身子相当松软。走之前不妨坐一坐。唔……你现在肯定特别想坐到我身上来吧。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: My body is quite cushy. Feel free to take a seat before you go. Hmm... You must be quite tempted to sit on me right about now.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 你懂不懂虚空这个词是什么意思？走开，没文化的家伙没资格买我。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: Do you even know what the word Vanitas means? Go away, uneducated fools have no business purchasing me.
(No response. Couldn't be bothered, it seems.)

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 总有一天，会有个超酷~的顾客，愿意接受我超酷~的交易。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: One day I'll get a kewl~ customer who's down for a kewl~ deal.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 现在的我至少值5000只眼球！不过对你嘛，我可以给个……9000只眼球的特惠价。哼！
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: I'll be worth at least 5,000 Eyeballs now! But for you, I'm available for... an exclusive price of 9,000 Eyeballs. Hmph!

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: “滚一边去，蠢货”这句话，你真的听不懂吗？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: Are you really having trouble understanding what "Get lost, fuckwit" means?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: <有些看起来不太想跟我们说话……如果它们真的会说话的话。>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: <Some of them don't seem to want to talk to us... if they're even capable of speech.>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 我倒是挺想把衣服给它们的，可要是我们一开口，它们的第一反应就是攻击我们，那也没什么办法……不知道我们还有别的什么选择？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: As much as I'd like to give them the clothes, there isn't much we can do if their first reaction when we try to talk to them is to attack us... I wonder what other options we have?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 唔嗯嗯嗯嗯嗯……着实是个难题……啊哈！莫非，吾等只需不断主动与之攀谈，直至它们愿意回礼便可？！
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: Hmmmmmmmmm... Quite the pickle indeed... Aha! Perchance, we need only initiate conversation with them as many times as it takes for them to return the favor?!

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: <可每次我们找错家具搭话，默尔索都得经历一场惨烈的死法……>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: <But Meursault's going to have to go through a gruesome death every time we talk to the wrong Furnishing...>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 唔……啊，对了。我记得那些待在大厅明亮处的家具，就算语气冷淡了点，好像也更愿意听我们说话。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: Hmm... Ah, right. I think Furnishings in the brighter parts of the hall were more willing to lend us their ear, even if they were a little curt.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 不知道是不是光线让它们心情好了一点～？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: I wonder if the light put them in a good mood~?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 啊哈！确实，吾走在阳光之下时，也曾听得阵阵细微的话音，而身处阴影之中时，却是全然阒寂无声……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: Aha! Indeed, I too heard the quibble of voices when walking under the sunshine, which were entirely absent while we were in shadows...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 每一件能与之交流的家具，都暴露在光线之下。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: Every Furnishing with which communication was possible was exposed to light.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: <没错……那光线肯定对家具们有什么影响。我们下去家具馆再试一次吧。>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: <Right... Then the light must be affecting the Furnishings somehow. Let's head down to the Furniture Hall and try again.>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: ……堂吉诃德穿不了这双鞋，但拿来当礼物送给她倒是挺不错的。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: ... Don Quixote won't be able to wear these shoes, but it'd make for a nice gift for her.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 在这个连用两条腿都难以站稳的世界里，要单腿挺立，无论出身多么高贵，都绝非易事。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: In a world where it is so hard to stand on even with two legs, to stand up straight on one leg is a difficult task, regardless of one's nobility.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 你们身边跟着一位好特别、好特别的人呢。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: You have someone so, so... special with you.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 我真是太幸运、太感激了……能有机会遇见这样一位……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: I'm so lucky and grateful... to have a chance to meet someone like that...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 布布躲到了我们身后，看起来因为这份过分甜腻的欢迎，而感到有点不安。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: Pwie hid behind us, evidently feeling a bit anxious from the overly saccharine reception.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 布布，此乃其名，好心的商贩！悲喜交加之命运，将祂眼下托付于吾等照看之中……着实是个怕生的孩子啊。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: Pwie be their name, kind vendor! Fortunes both ill and good have brought them presently under our care... A bashful young child, I say.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 啊，好的。请一定好好照顾他。哦对了，要是你们想看看店里的鞋子……最好动作快点。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: Ah, yes. Please look after them well. Oh, and if you wanted to take a look at the shoes in our store... you'd better make it quick.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 我们大概很快就要关门了。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: We'll probably be closing down, soon.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 因为黑派大概会把我们赶出去。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: Because the Noirs'll probably evict us.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 红派正在走下坡路……我们的“声音”正变得越来越微弱、越来越飘忽。那些身居高位的红派，早就预见了这一天。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: Le Rouge is in decline... our Voice is growing increasingly faint and stretched. The higher Rouges already saw this coming a long time ago.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 迷失……又被抛弃……一次又一次。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: Lost... and abandoned... all over again.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 不过我倒不在意，因为我知道该怎么回家。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: But I don't mind, because I know how to get home.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 对，家。就是我们所有人最初来的地方。我们每个人都曾有过一个家——我相信你们也一样。一个可以回去的地方，那里有人在等你回来。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: Yes, home. The place where we all came from. We each had one—and I'm sure you do, too. A place to return to, where people are waiting for you to come back.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 唔嗯！那辆巴士，便是吾等归处所在……确乎是一辆威风凛凛的巴士啊，小梅菲……而在那辆气派的巴士之中，尊贵的星红凝视大人——那位声名卓著的色彩收尾人……以及小卡戎，正等候吾等归来。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: Hm! The bus! is our place to return to... Indeed, a bus! so grand and dashing, young Mephi... And within that handsome bus, Lord Red Gaze, a Color Fixer most illustrious... and young Charon await our return.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: ……唔……真是奇哉怪也！此事竟恍若千年前之旧事一般，朦胧难辨……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: ... Hoh... How peculiar! 'Tis as hazy as though I am speaking of events a millennium ago...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 哦，有意思。我还以为西西弗百货的居民，从不谈起来这里之前的生活呢。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: Oh, that's interesting. I thought the residents of the Grand Magasin never talked about their lives before coming here.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 确实如此，要成为这家百货商店的顾客，我们必须忘掉许许多多的事情。来这里之前的生活，我自己也几乎什么都不记得了。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: It's true, we do have to forget many, many things to become customers of this department store. I barely remember anything about the life I had before coming here.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 关于外面那个世界，我留存的唯一记忆……是一张哭泣的脸。法官的法槌敲下、判我西西弗刑罚的那一刻，我们四目相对——我看见泪水正顺着他们的脸颊滑落。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: The only memory I have left of the outside world... is the face of someone crying. When the judge's gavel hit the stand and sentenced me to the Sisyphe Penalty, our eyes met—and I saw tears streaming down their cheeks.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 啊，诚然如此……那法槌敲落时所蕴含的终局之感与沉重分量……着实足以令人潸然泪下。吾仍记得，当时那股冲击竟令吾眼前一片黯淡，恍若失明一般。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: Ah, verily... The finality and the weight behind the gavel as it hammered the stand... could bring tears to one's eyes. I recall feeling as though my vision had darkened from the sheer shock.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 你们想去的地方是哪里？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: Where is it that you seek to journey?
We're trying to get to the fifth floor.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 啊，太巧了……我知道怎么去五楼。我可以把这个秘密告诉你们……只要你们帮我找到回家的路。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: Ah, perfect... I know how to get to the fifth floor. I can share that secret with you... if you help me find my way home.
<...! She knows how we can get to the fifth floor?!>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 我们之前帮黑派办事的时候，她并没有对我们说过什么意义重大的话……她当时对我们来说，不过是鞋店的一个销售员而已。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: She didn't really say anything of much significance to us when we were helping the Noirs... She was just a sales rep at a shoe store, and that's all she was to us.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 如果我们至今做出的种种不同选择，能为我们解锁五楼……或许我们能证明让娜是错的，走向一个不一样的结局。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: If the different choices we've made so far will unlock the fifth floor for us... maybe we can prove Jeanne wrong and bring us to a different end.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 你们听说过心脏碎片拖鞋的故事吗？那是一双活着的、还在跳动的鞋子，镶嵌着一枚泛着虹彩的红色心脏碎片。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: Ever heard the story about the Heartshard Slippers? A living, pulsing pair of shoes embedded with an iridescent red shard of heart.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 据说，把鞋跟碰响三下，就能带你回家……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: They say clapping its heels thrice will guide you home...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 我一直想做一双出来，材料我都齐了，可是……我一直找不到心脏碎片。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: I've been trying to make one, and I have all the materials, but... I've not been able to get my hands on the heart shard.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 我们上哪儿能找到心脏碎片呢……？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: Where can we get the heart shard...?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: ……我也不知道。以前这层楼有位浑身珠光宝气的人负责管理，他们的心脏特别漂亮……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: ... I don't know. There was this bejeweled person who used to manage this floor, and they had a beautiful heart...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: ……不过他们前段时间不见了，已经好一阵子没人见过他们。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: ... But they disappeared some time ago, and haven't been seen in a while.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 他们真的是个乐善好施的灵魂……我还记得，他们从不吝啬跟大家分享自己的宝物。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: They really were a giving soul... I remember how they never hesitated to share their treasures with everyone.
... You will find them in the Furniture Hall.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 哦，真的吗……？那拜托了，帮我把心脏碎片找回来吧。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: Oh, really...? Then please, go find the heart shard for me.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 我就告诉你们怎么去五楼。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: And I'll tell you how to get to the fifth floor.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: 等一下……那盏灯——他手上的东西比我们都多！
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.en: Hang on a minute... that lamp—he's got way more stuff than we do!

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-4-b.jso.zh: ……那你的脚趾甲，至少分我一点。我可不想落后。
