RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: <我也确信这不会是最后一次。>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: <I'm sure it won't be our last, either.>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: <……又或者，我只是选择不相信让娜的话罢了。她说无论我们做什么，结局都不会改变，可是……我们还没试过，不是吗？>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: <... Or maybe I'm just choosing not to believe Jeanne. She said the end won't change no matter what we do, but... we haven't tried it yet, have we?>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 是啊。回顾我们这一路的旅程，充斥着的，往往正是这种不合常理的荒谬之事。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: Yeah. More often than not, our journey so far has been full of unreasonable absurdities like these.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 所以我认定，指望解决之道会有人恭恭敬敬地捧到我们面前，本身就是一种不合理的期待。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: I decided that, therefore, it was unreasonable of me to expect that the solution would be delivered to us on a silver platter.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 那么……我们究竟能做些什么？
大概，就只是继续走下去而已吧。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: Just keep on keeping on, I guess.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: <这次我们试试用不一样的方式来做吧。>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: <Let's try doing things differently this time.>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: <我知道我们最后可能只是证明了让娜说得对，说不定跟上次的结果比起来，什么都不会改变。但那座桥，等我们走到跟前再过也不迟。>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: <I know we might just end up proving Jeanne right, and maybe nothing will change from our last attempt. But we can cross that bridge when we get to it.>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: ……若这是您对此事的判断，经理，那我便依令行事。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: ... If that is how you have judged this situation, Manager, then I will do as ordered.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 欢迎回来，肩缝下垂的异乡人们。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: Welcome back, strangers with drooping shoulder seams.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: ……不过，你们这次不是来修补东西的，对吧？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: ... But you're not here to have something mended, are you?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 伸手来抚摸丝线的手，和伸手来割断丝线的手，触碰我门把手时发出的声音，是不一样的。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: The hand that comes to caress the string and the hand that comes to sever it make different sounds on contact with my doorknob.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 这一次，你们的来意是……要看我被割断。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: This time, your visit is to... see me severed.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: ……你还真是敏锐……没错，正是如此……我们不会否认。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: ... You're quick to notice... Yes, it is... We won't deny it.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: ……原来如此，异乡人们选择了站在红派这一边。看来他们已经找到了不止一条救赎之路。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: ... So, the strangers have chosen to stand with the Rouges. It seems they have found themselves more than one salvation.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 不必担心，异乡人们。你们正在做的事，跟改衣的工作，其实没什么两样。当你选定了用来修补衣装的那一半布料，剩下的另一半，便会归入废料堆。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: Not to worry, strangers. There is little difference between what you are doing and alteration work. When you have chosen the part of the fabric to mend the attire with, the remaining half joins the scrap pile.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 不过话说回来，公平起见。要是你们想把我剪掉……最好也做好自己被剪掉的准备。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: But let's be fair. If you would like to cut me away... you'd better have come prepared to be snipped away yourselves.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 我能看出你们眼中那份想要咔嚓咔嚓的渴望。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: I can see the desire to go snip-snip! in your eyes.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 跟上次不一样……这次我或许能让这场会议休会。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: Unlike our last attempt... I may be able to adjourn the meeting.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 打扰会议，你就会变成两件。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: Disturb the meeting, and you'll become two.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 这条路，如今已经……锁定了。无论红派此后选择编织出何等存在，都已无法挽回。你们已不可逆转地，把自己变成了黑派的敌人。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: The path is now... locked. Whatever the Rouges choose to weave into existence now, it cannot be undone. You have irrevocably made yourselves enemies of the Noirs.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 剪刀……并非只有剪断这一个用途……有时候……剪刀也是……解开一团缠成死结的丝线的……唯一办法……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: Cutting... is not the sole purpose of scissors... Sometimes... scissors are the only means... to untangle a knotted mess of strings...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 带上我的剪刀走吧……异乡人们……肩缝下垂的异乡人们……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: Take my scissors with you... strangers... with drooping shoulder seams...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 你们已经见过这脉动了……我相信……你们会……好好利用它的……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: You have beheld the pulse... I'm sure... you'll make... good use of it...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: <我们拿上她的剪刀，回去找那位红派商贩吧。>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: <Let's take her pair of scissors and return to the Rouge vendor.>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 我们从改衣师的躯干上，扯下了那把剪刀——如今仔细看去，那甚至可能就是她的骨架。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: We ripped the pair of scissors—which might even have been her skeleton, now that I'm getting a better look—off the Alterationist's torso.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 一旦取走那把剪刀，改衣师身体的其余部分，便如同从衣架上取下的衣物一般，簌簌垮塌了下去。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: Once we removed the pair of scissors, the rest of the Alterationist's body crumbled like an article of clothing removed from its hanging rack.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 打扰会议，你就会变成两件。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: Disturb the meeting, and you'll become two.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 打扰会议，你就会变成两件。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: Disturb the meeting, and you'll become two.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 我能打补丁，也能缝补。你想要哪一种？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: I can patch, and I can mend. Which would you like?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 我们走进一间圆形房间，墙边整齐排列着五颜六色的线轴和一卷卷裁好的布料。房间中央站着一道身影，正以精心把控的节奏，双臂上下摆动着缝纫什么东西。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: We emerged into a round room whose walls were lined with multicolored spools of thread and swaths of cut fabric. At the center stood a figure, her arms moving up and down as she stitched something together in a carefully regulated rhythm.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 肩缝垂得有点低……袖口的边也短了一截。这一位，要改的地方可不少。那么，你想改点什么？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: Shoulder seams hanging a touch too low... hems of the arm a span too short. Much work to be done, this one. So, what would you like to have altered?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 我们想要购置一把剪刀。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: We would like to procure a pair of scissors.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: ……我的剪刀，不是挂在货架上叫卖的工具。你瞧，我可不会随便把我的刀刃，交给什么人。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: ... My scissors are not tools to be hung and sold from the product racks. I do not part with my blades for just anyone, you see.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 它们只留给眼中闪烁着咔嚓咔嚓渴望的顾客。就像黑派那样，我的老主顾们——他们总是来找我，请我为他们织布。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: They're reserved for customers whose eyes twinkle with the desire to go snip-snip. Like the Noirs, my longtime customers—they always visit me to have me weave fabric for them.
Are you... well-acquainted with the Noirs?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 我已经定期为他们供应布料好一阵子了，所以也可以说，我们算是合作伙伴。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: I've been regularly supplying them with fabric for a while now, so one could say that we are partners.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 黑派最近一直挺忙的——四处散播、打探消息，怀疑那些红色的家伙在打什么坏主意。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: The Noirs have been quite busy as of late—spreading and fishing tales, suspicious that the red ones are up to no good.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 我在你们身上，可看不出那样热切的渴望。不过，我这儿也有其他商品可供购买。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: I simply do not see that same passionate desire in you. I do have other items available for purchase, however.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: <看来直截了当这一招，在她这儿行不通啊……跟上次不一样。>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: <Looks like getting straight to the point won't work on her... This isn't what happened last time.>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 经理，或许……我们可以等下次机会再来购置这把剪刀。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: Perhaps... we could procure the pair of scissors at our next opportunity, Manager.
<Don't think we have any other choice.>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 话说……我们为什么需要一把剪刀来着？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: So... why did we need a pair of scissors, again?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 剪刀一旦被磨到极致，便是件出色的武器。你现在还不明白吗，执行经理的每一步行动，背后都有着完全合理的解释？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: Scissors, when honed to perfection, make excellent weapons. Haven't you come to understand by now that every action the Executive Manager takes is backed up by perfectly reasonable explanations?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 执行经理，看来它们唯一的回应，就是没完没了地重复“我们在开会”。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: Executive Manager, it appears that their only response will be to repeat "we're in a meeting" ad nauseam.
... Yeah, no need to talk to them.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: <唔……我不知道能跟这位谈什么条件。>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: <Hmm... I don't know what deal we can offer this one.>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 试图与这个存在沟通，恐怕是徒劳的。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: Attempts to communicate with this being may be futile.
Doooonnnn... The more you are Doooonnneed...
<Don't think we have any business with them...>
The Floor Manager speaks no more.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 啊……看来这层楼是你和我一组啊，奥提斯。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: Ah... Looks like it's you and me for this floor, Outis.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 感觉有点奇怪，不是吗？每层楼都要跟不同的人搭档。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: Feels a bit strange, doesn't it? Having to go around with a different group on every floor.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 不过，这层楼能跟你搭档，我还挺开心的。最近我们合作起来，好像顺手多了，所以……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: Still, I'm glad to be partnered up with you for this floor. It's been easier for us to work together lately, so...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 什么？不，我跟谁都没有什么“顺手”可言，尤其是你们这些罪人。荒唐。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: What? No, I'm not "easy" with anyone, least of all you Sinners. Ridiculous.
Hey. I need to ask you something.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 奥提斯向默尔索投去疑惑的目光——按理说，眼前的一切对他来说，应该像对新生儿看待这个世界一样陌生，可他却显得毫不动摇。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: Outis fixed a quizzical look toward Meursault, who looked completely unfazed by everything that should be, for all intents and purposes, as unfamiliar as the world is to a newborn.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 不，我以前没来过这里。是西西弗百货里一位担任管理职务的人，告诉我这个地方的。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: No, I have not been in here before. I was told about this place by someone in a managerial position within the Grand Magasin Sisyphe.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 默尔索简洁的回答，几乎与奥提斯开口提问同时脱口而出，却已经回答了她正要问的一切。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: Meursault's succinct reply came almost simultaneously as Outis had begun her query, but it answered everything she was about to ask.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 被默尔索回答的速度打了个措手不及，她愣了一下，结结巴巴了片刻，才清了清嗓子，继续问出下一个问题。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: Whiplashed by the speed with which Meursault answered, she stumbled over her words for a moment before clearing her throat and continuing with her next question.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 你和那个人之间，是什么样的关系？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: What was the nature of your relationship with that individual?
<color=#ebcaa2>Pfft... Still got that excellent memory, huh?</color>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 那道声音传来得十分清晰，却带着一丝哀伤。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: The voice came through with clarity, but it carried a note of sadness.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 而……我早已对说话之人的名字，熟悉到不能再熟悉了。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: And... I'd come to be intimately acquainted with the name of the speaker.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: <color=#ebcaa2>啊，又来了。该自我介绍一下了。</color>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: <color=#ebcaa2>Ah, here we go again. Time to introduce myself.</color>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: <color=#ebcaa2>我的名字是……让娜。这一次，我也大发慈悲，把这个名字分享给了你们，那便是我这个“声音”的名字。</color>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: <color=#ebcaa2>My name is... Jeanne. That's the name of the Voice I've so graciously chosen to share with you this time as well.</color>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 咦，看起来它们把路给堵住了。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: Huh, looks like they're blocking the way through.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: <……跟那些东西说话大概也没什么用，不过……>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: <... Talking to those things'll probably achieve nothing, but...>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 打扰一下，能不能让我们进去你们身后的那家店？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: Excuse me, would you let us into the store behind you?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 所以不能进。没有别的空间了。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: So no entry. No room for anything else.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 咸，好咸。咸得像眼泪。咸得没人咽得下去。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: Salty, so salty. Salty like tears. Too salty for anyone to swallow.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 会议不会结束。吞下会议才能结束争论。但咽不下去。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: Meeting won't end. Swallow meeting to end debate. But can't swallow.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: ……那么，这场会议到底在讨论什么？
议题一：谁是面料，谁是里衬？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: Agenda 1: Who is the outer fabric, and who is the lining?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 议题二：谁是右手，谁是左手？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: Agenda 2: Who is the right hand, and who is the left hand?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 嗯，嗯。好议题。都写进会议记录。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: Mmm, mmm. Good agendas. Let's write them both in the minutes.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 靠近它们可能会有危险……我们要不要过会儿再回来？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: Approaching them might be dangerous... Should we come back here later?
<Don't think we have any other choice.>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 咦？它们刚才不是在走廊那头吗？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: Huh? Weren't they further down the other side of the corridor earlier?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: <是啊。它们什么时候到这儿来的？>
议题：温暖的香气。生命的香气。是谁的？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: Agenda: Warm aroma. Aroma of life. Whose is it?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 所以我们悄悄爬。慢慢逼近。悄悄爬。缩小距离。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: So we creepy-creep. Encroaching. Creepy-creep. Narrowing the gap.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: <喂，默尔索……我觉得它们可能是……>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: <Hey, Meursault... I think they might be...>
<... after that piece of flesh you're carrying.>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 这似乎是最有可能的解释。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: That appears to be the likely explanation.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 啧……执行经理，我们得绕过那个怪物才能到对面去了。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: Tsk... We're going to have to circumnavigate that monster to reach the other side, Executive Manager.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: <红派那家店南边有条路。或许可以走那条路到对面去。>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: <There's a way south of the Rouge shop. Maybe we can take that route to the other side.>
Huh? That didn't take very long.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 一如既往地高效啊，执行经理——嗯？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: As expedient as always, Executive Manager—hm?
... What is that thing behind you?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: <……红派们一直在说的那个新“声音”的……真身。大概是吧。>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: <The... true form of the new "Voice" the Rouges have been talking about. I think.>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: <有个红派拜托我们照顾他，所以……我们就决定让这孩子跟着我们一阵子。>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: <One of the Rouges asked us to look after them, so... we decided to let the kid tag along for a while.>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 原来如此……那他为什么离我们站得这么远？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: I see... So why are they standing so far away from us?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 这孩子看起来对我们的存在心存戒备。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: The child appears to be apprehensive of our presence.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 唔……眼下看起来不会对我们构成什么威胁……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: Hmm... Doesn't appear to pose us any threats at the moment...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: ……不过您也不会想让意图不明的存在跟在身后吧，执行经理——恳请您保持警惕。跟您那忠心耿耿、值得信赖的奥提斯不同，这种未知因素，永远潜藏着背刺的威胁。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: ... but you don't want to have entities of dubitable intent following from behind, Executive Manager—I implore you to remain vigilant. Unlike your ever-so-faithful and trustworthy Outis, there is always a threat of backstabbing from such unknown factors.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: <总之，既然我们是要带这孩子去见那位红派商贩，那就去她的店吧。>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: <Anyway, since we're here to show the kid to the Rouge vendor, let's head to her shop.>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 啊……啊啊……你们把他带来给我了……我真是蒙受了莫大的恩宠……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: Ah... Ahh... You have brought them to me... I am truly blessed...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 哦，亲爱的“声音”啊，愿您的降临受人敬仰……我早已备下一份薄礼，恭候您承诺已久的降临……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: Oh, dearest Voice, revered be your presence... I have prepared a humble gift in anticipation of your promised advent...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 那位商贩取出了一条红手帕——显然是她自己制作的——小心翼翼地放到了那孩子的手上。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: The vendor produced a red handkerchief—clearly of her make—and carefully placed it on the child's hands.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 她带着明显的敬畏后退了几步，看到孩子握着自己的作品，开始像一枚即将引爆的炸弹一样颤抖起来。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: She withdrew with visible reverence, and seeing the child hold her creation, began to tremble like she was a bomb about to go off.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 啊啊啊……他接受了！他接受了我的作品……！
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: Aaaaah... They accepted it! They accepted my creation...!

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 再没有什么，能比这更让我幸福了……哦，我的天……我已再无所求……收下我吧，我是您的了……！
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: Nothing could ever make me happier than this... Oh, my God... I have no more needs... Take me, I am yours...!

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 怎么回——……！找掩护，执行经理！
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: What's happ— ...! Take cover, Executive Manager!

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 您没事吧？那些污秽有没有——
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: Are you unhurt? Has any of that filth—

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: ……看来您之前没遇到过这种事。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: ... So you haven't experienced this before.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 我抬头一看，那孩子已经躲到了他认为对我们来说足够安全的距离之外……不知为何，这让我的心里隐隐作痛。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: When I looked up, the child had already scurried off to a distance it seemed to have determined safe from us... Something about that made my heart ache a little.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: <不知道红派的脊髓这次会不会又派上用场？>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: <I wonder if the Rouge's spinal cord will be important again?>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 这尚不能确定。不过，建议我们把任何可能有用的物品都随身携带。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: That cannot be said for certain. However, it is recommended that we bring with us any object that may potentially be useful.
<... Yeah, let's take that with us and head right upstairs.>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 一具黑派的尸体。即便是他引以为傲的布料，也没能救他一命。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: The corpse of a Noir. Even the fabric they took such pride in couldn't save them from this fate.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh:
【坠落的微分 第一辑：“辛西娅”
这件装置作品，描绘了西西弗百货中第一个坠落的人台——辛西娅——坠落的过程。这是该系列中唯一一件大型装置，也是整个系列中，唯一一件以细致入微的手法，描绘出她坠落瞬间精确姿态的作品，因而在系列中独树一帜。】
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en:
[Differential of Falling Series 1: "Cynthia"
This installation depicts the fall of Cynthia, the first Mannequin to fall in the Grand Magasin. The only large-scale installation in the series, it sets itself apart from the rest of the series by being the only piece to depict the precise moment her fall began in painstaking detail.]
Dooooo noooot griiiieeeeve... Dooooo noooot griiiieeeeve...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 一旦设定的声音……便如坠落的太阳……永不复返……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: A voice once set... like the fallen sun... will never return...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 当太多东西纠缠在一起时，唯一的办法便是将其斩断。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: When too much has become tangled together, the only choice is to sever them.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 就在默尔索把那堆宛如小山的眼球，一股脑舀进我们的袋子时，那位一直朝着虚空静静点头的商贩，转过身来望向了我们。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: As Meursault scooped the veritable hillock of eyeballs into our sack, the vendor, who had been quietly nodding away into the ether, turned toward us.
Ah... of course. Anything you say.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: “声音”正在召唤你们……他们正把异乡人们召往奢侈品馆。那个承诺已久的苏醒之刻，已然临近……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: The Voice summons you... They are summoning the strangers there to the Luxury Hall. The promised hour of awakening is nigh...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 我们连你说的那个“声音”都听不见。它有没有说过，找我们想要做什么？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: We can't even hear that "Voice" of yours. Did they say anything about what they want with us?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 是啊，这也挺奇怪的。不该是召唤其他红派，而不是我们吗？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: Yeah, that's kinda weird. Shouldn't they be summoning the rest of the Rouges, not us?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 我们受西西弗百货的规则所束缚。唯有在特殊场合，我们才被允许自由地往来于各层楼之间。唯有真正的异乡人——那受“泉”所欢迎的存在——才能自由地上楼与下楼。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: We are bound by the rules of the Grand Magasin. Only on special occasions are we permitted to freely traverse between its floors. Only true strangers, whose presence the Fount welcomes, are free to rise and descend.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 你们身上，带着我们珍爱之人的碎片。一旦你们凑齐最后一块，他便会苏醒。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: You carry the shard of our cherished one within you. Once you assemble the final piece, they will awaken.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 啊啊……这正是我牺牲双眼……甘愿被钉在地上的缘由……一切，都是为了这一天……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: Ahh... This is what I sacrificed my eyes for... and let myself be nailed to the ground... All in service of this day...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 能以永世被钉之身，向那承诺已久的异乡人们传达“声音”之意志，是何等的恩宠……啊，多么欢喜的一天啊……多么欢喜的一天啊……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: Blessed with an eternity of nailed existence to convey the Voice's will to the promised strangers... Ah, what a joyous day... What a joyous day...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 假设我们照这个“声音”说的做。这个“奢侈品馆”，我们该去哪儿找？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: Suppose we are to do as this "Voice" asks. Where would we find this "Luxury Hall"?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: <我知道在哪儿。我们之前在二楼路过它的入口。>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: <I know where it is. We stopped by the entrance on the second floor earlier.>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 那“声音”的真身，肯定就在那儿等着我们了。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: Then the true form of the Voice must be waiting for us there.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: <那里有个……红派一直在照料的茧。>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: <There was a... cocoon the Rouges were caring for.>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 我们用一根钉子把它撕开，杀死了从里面爬出来的东西。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: We ripped it open with a nail and killed the thing that crawled out of it.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: <是啊。然后……黑派接管了西西弗百货……触发了“清仓”进程。也就是说……>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: <Yeah. Then... the Noirs took over the Grand Magasin... triggering the Liquidation process. Which means...>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 我们亲眼目睹的西西弗百货之终局，是彻底的“停滞”。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: The end of the Grand Magasin we witnessed was ultimate "stagnation."

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 这家百货商店内的所有生命，都被统合成了一个单一的目的：成为维系其存续的支柱……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: All lives within the department store were consolidated into a single purpose: to become pillars to perpetuate its existence...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 永恒在西西弗百货内流逝而过，其间毫无任何变化——就连购物也不例外。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: Eternity passed within the Grand Magasin, devoid of any change—even shopping.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 而随着永恒的来去，万物都被整合了起来，与西西弗百货的墙壁浑然一体，再无隔阂。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: And as eternity came and went, everything became integrated, seamlessly assimilated with the walls of the Grand Magasin.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 到最后，就连最微弱的一丝波动，也不复存在。一切都被熔铸成了同一个整体，融入了彼此之中……我们也不例外。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: In the end, not even the smallest stir survived. All was melded into everything and everyone... including us.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 要是我当初没有撕开那个茧，把那东西扯出来就好了……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: If only I hadn't ripped open and torn that thing out of the cocoon...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 您打算与红派结盟，作为攀登西西弗百货的手段。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: You intend to ally with the Rouges as a means of climbing the Grand Magasin.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: <是啊。原因有点难以解释，不过……我有种预感，这次我必须这么做。>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: <Yeah. It's kinda hard to explain why, but... I have a feeling that that's what I must do this time.>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 那种难以言喻的直觉，正是一名指挥官不可或缺的品质。缺乏这种品质的人……哪怕其他能力再出色，也无法在那场战争中长久存活。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: That inexplicable sort of intuition is an indispensable quality in a commander. Those without it... did not survive the War for long, no matter how excellent their other abilities were.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 看来我们该在这儿分头了。大家辛苦了。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: Looks like this is where we get off. Good work, everyone.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: ……据我的经验，执行经理，认清命运之手的存在，并不意味着就能挣脱它的掌控。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: ... In my experience, recognizing the hand of fate doesn't necessarily mean that one can break free from its grip, Executive Manager.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 啊。抱歉，我说得过头了。我见过、听过太多类似性质的故事，以至于……眼下的处境，大概让我陷入了沉思的情绪。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: Ah. Apologies, I overstepped. I'd witnessed and heard far too many tales of a similar nature that... the present circumstance must've put me in a contemplative mood.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 啧。我倒更愿意时时刻刻侍奉在您身边，执行经理……可惜这次我做不到了，实在遗憾。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: Tsk. I would much rather serve you by your side at all times, Executive Manager... It is regrettable that I won't be able to.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 奥提斯曾告诉过我，这是一台通讯总机。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: Outis once told me that it's a communication switchboard.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 上面写着【折纸系列……92号，共5件中的第2件。某人的坠落，被升华凝结进了叠加的时间之中。】
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: It says [Origami CollectioN° 92, 2 of 5. Someone's fall sublimated into superpositioned time.]

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 你他妈看什么看！滚一边去，蠢货！
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: The fuck're you lookin' at! Get lost, fuckwit!

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: <……原来如此。这张沙发是从家具馆来的。>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: <... I see. This couch came from the Furniture Hall.>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 他们说了，会议必须继续下去！
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: The meeting must go on, they said!

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 喔……“声音”啊……！救救我……您终于大发慈悲降临于我，难道我此刻就必须承受死亡的苦痛吗？！
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: Ooh... Voice...! Help me... Must I suffer death now, when you have finally come to grace me?!

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 那个敌人在好几方面都棘手……速度是一方面，可它还有种诡异的能力，能在最后一刻转向，追上默尔索的闪避轨迹。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: That enemy presents difficulties on multiple fronts... Its speed is one thing, but it has the uncanny ability to swerve at the last minute to follow Meursault's attempt to evade.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 我建议利用周围的环境障碍物，或采取更难以预测的闪避方式。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: I recommend using the environmental obstacles or employing more unpredictable evasive maneuvers.
<... Of course. Let's try this again.>
<Can't get a good grasp on when it'll explode...>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 只要它一开始颤抖，我们就得立刻撤离。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: We'll have to move away as soon as it begins to tremble.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 下次尽量保持更高的警觉。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: Try to stay more alert next time.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 以它的体型来说，速度相当快啊。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: It is quite fast for its size.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 默尔索该怎么躲开它的冲撞呢……？也许有办法能精准卡时机格挡，可我觉得那不容易。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: How should Meursault dodge its charge...? Maybe there's a way to perfectly time a block, but I don't think that'll be easy.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 虽然看起来似乎没有空间能好好躲开它的冲撞，不过房间两端有些小凹槽——说不定可以藏到那里？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: While it may seem as though there is no room to properly evade its charge, there were small indents at both ends of the room—perhaps you could hide there?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: <哦，对哦。我觉得它应该够不到那么远。>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: <Oh, right. I don't think it can reach that far.>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 至于剩下的战术……更沉稳一点的打法会更有效，执行经理。慢慢应付移动装置的攻势，一点点耗尽主要敌人的耐力。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: As for the rest of the battle strategy... A more deliberate approach will be effective, Executive Manager. Take your time fending off the onslaught of Mobiles and slowly wear down the primary foe.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: ……啧。我知道这是你的“回合”，但这肯定还是相当吃力的。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: ... Tsk. I know it's your "turn," but this must still be incredibly taxing.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 等我们回去，我一定会把打扫的活儿，分给那些成天在休息室里偷懒的家伙。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: Once we return, I'll be sure to assign the cleaning duties to the ones lounging around in the restroom.
So... hold on just a little longer.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: ……那玩意儿在接触的一瞬间，就把他撕成了两半。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: ... That thing ripped him in half the moment they came into contact.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 执行经理，我们大概得等到他们的“会议”休会才行。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: We may have to wait until their "meeting" is adjourned, Executive Manager.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 老实说，那些议题听起来也没那么重要……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: Honestly, those agendas didn't really seem all that important...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: <不管怎样，在我们找到绕过去的办法之前，先离那玩意儿远点吧。>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: <Either way, let's steer clear of that thing until we find a way around it.>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 经理，我仔细查看了装置下方的地面，没有发现任何东西。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: A close observation the floor beneath the installation has revealed nothing, Manager.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 唔……我猜这些“人台”，其实也都曾是人吧。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: Nngh... I assume all these "Mannequins" are just people, too.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 辛克莱面带明显的不适，仔细打量着这件“艺术品”……随后，仿佛认出了什么，朝它抬起了一根手指。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: Sinclair scrutinized the "artwork" with discomfort clear in his face... then, as if he'd recognized something, raised a finger toward it.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 咦？你们看见那边那个了吗？看起来像枚戒指。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: Huh? Do you see that over there? It looks like a ring.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 一枚单圈的戒指……那想必曾属于一位环指学徒。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: A single-coiled ring... It must've belonged to a Student of the Ring.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: <啊……不过位置太高了，我们够不着。>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: <Ah... it's too high for us to reach, though.>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 几只鸟静静躺在一根长长的、喇叭状的管子底下。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: Several birds lie beneath a long, trumpet-shaped tube.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 经理，我仔细查看了装置下方的地面，没有发现任何东西。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: A close observation the floor beneath the installation has revealed nothing, Manager.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 唔……我猜这些“人台”，其实也都曾是人吧。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: Nngh... I assume all these "Mannequins" are just people, too.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 辛克莱面带明显的不适，仔细打量着这件“艺术品”……随后，仿佛认出了什么，朝它抬起了一根手指。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: Sinclair scrutinized the "artwork" with discomfort clear in his face... then, as if he'd recognized something, raised a finger toward it.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 咦？你们看见那边那个了吗？看起来像枚戒指。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: Huh? Do you see that over there? It looks like a ring.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 一枚单圈的戒指……那想必曾属于一位环指学徒。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: A single-coiled ring... It must've belonged to a Student of the Ring.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: <啊……不过位置太高了，我们够不着。>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: <Ah... it's too high for us to reach, though.>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh:
【坠落的微分 第三辑：“斯托克曼”
这件装置作品，灵感来源于一具人台坠落穿越西西弗百货的过程。其意象唤起的，正是时间坠落般延续不断的连续性。
相较于第一辑的装置，此件雕塑的尺寸更为小巧。】
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en:
[Differential of Falling Series 3: "Stockmann"
This installation was inspired by a Mannequin's fall through the Grand Magasin. The imagery evokes the falling continuity of time.
Sculpted in a smaller size relative to the Series 1 installation.]

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: <我猜这是这个系列的最后一件了……>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: <This is the last one in the series, I think...>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 啊……！这块皮革上，写着些东西。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: Ah...! There's something written on the leather here.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 【……用人体来制造廉价的震撼效果，这种艺术手法，在如今的时代思潮里早已过时。】
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: [... Artworks made from human corpus for cheap shock value are now long outmoded in the current zeitgeist.]

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 【可是……这家百货商店似乎还没收到这个消息。】
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: [But... this department store doesn't seem to have gotten the news.]

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 【我的素材快用光了。灵感也快枯竭了。这里没有一个人真正懂得欣赏我的艺术——他们满脑子只有衣服，除此之外别无他物。所以……】
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: [I'm running out of material. Running out of inspiration. No one here really appreciates my art—they're all obsessed with clothes and nothing more. Then...]

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 【……可这些东西卖得挺好。红派似乎多少还挺看重这些……说是艺术品都有点勉强的东西，外面的世界大概只会当它们是批量生产的垃圾……】
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: [... But these sell well. Le Rouge seems to somewhat value these... sorry excuse for artwork that the world outside regards as nothing more than mass-produced garbage...]

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 【要是它们在他们眼里值点什么，我就能卖掉这些，赚点钱——眼球。然后我就能买更好的衣服，然后我就能……】
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: [If they're worth something to them, I can sell these, make money—eyeballs. Then I'll buy better clothes, then I'll—]

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: <还有更多这样的装置作品，不过那些都没有附上标题。>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: <There are more installations like this one, but those didn't have any titles attached to them.>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: 也许是他们太过羞于在这些作品上署名，但更有可能的解释，其实很简单……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: Perhaps they were too ashamed to attach their name to these artworks, but the more likely explanation is simply that...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.zh: ……他们已经忘了自己当初想创作的是什么样的艺术品，甚至忘了那本该是艺术品这件事本身。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-3-b.jso.en: ... they've forgotten what artwork they were trying to create, or the fact that it was artwork at all.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 你们是来定制黄金之皮的服装，对吧？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: You have come to commission a bespoke garment of Golden Hide, yes?
May I ask who will be wearing it?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 我们会以身体本身为基础制作服装，修正每一处缺陷，让每一项优点都得到展现。成衣不过是批量裁剪出来的妥协品。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: We build the garment around the body itself, correcting every flaw and letting every strength take the stage. Ready-to-wear is merely a compromise cut by the dozen.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 那么，您喜欢哪种翻领？平驳领？戗驳领？半戗驳领？还是鱼嘴领？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: Now, which type of lapel suits your preference? Notched? Peak? Semi-peak? Or perhaps fish mouth?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: <不不不！暂停！照这个速度下去要耗上一整天。跳过讲解，直接开始制作吧。>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: <Nope, nope! Time out! It's gonna take all day at this rate. Let's skip the lecture and get to crafting.>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 自行判断即可。交给您了。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: Use your judgment. We'll leave it to you.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: ……！我的判断……！也就是说……量身定制……！
很好。我会将所拥有的每一分才能都倾注于针尖，不遗漏任何细节。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: Very well. I will put every talent I possess to the needle and leave no detail wanting.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 现在来量尺寸。请往这边走。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: Now, the measurements. This way, please.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 制革工以一连串眼花缭乱的动作，让软尺绕着布布飞旋起来，开始为其测量尺寸。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: With a series of dazzling flourishes, the Tanner sent the measuring tape spinning around Pwie and began taking their measurements.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: ……我明白了。亲爱的顾客，看来您剩下的事情就是……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: ... I understand now. It would seem, dear customer, all that's left for you...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: ……长成这件衣服的模样……并超越它。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: ... is to grow into the garment... and beyond.
You will have your hands full from here on.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 每当如此珍贵的皮革进入加工环节……粗鲁的边角料商便会聚集而来，希望从中迅速赚上一笔。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: Whenever hide this valuable enters processing... rude scraps gather, hoping to make a quick fortune out of it.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 那些从未被妥善鞣制的皮革边角料……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: Offcuts from hides that were never properly tanned...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 请阻止他们哪怕碰到作品的一根手指。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: Keep them from laying so much as a finger on the work, please.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: <默尔索！敌人正从四面八方包围过来！>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: <Meursault! We've got company closing in from every direction!>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 今天来试衣的人还真多。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: Quite a crowd gathered for today's fitting.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 我们不过是跟在后面……人群的拥挤却仿佛夺走了我们的呼吸。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: Though we did naught but follow behind... the press of bodies seemed to steal the breath from us.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 我们不必在制作的每一个阶段都做这种事吧？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: We don't have to do this for every single stage of the process, do we?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 图样已经完成。穿针缝制，再裁剪一番，这件衣服就做好了。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: The pattern is complete. One pass beneath the needle, with some stitching and cutting, and the garment will be finished.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 前往裁剪室，启动机器。还要留意那些觊觎皮革的顾客。他们可能会……有点暴力。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: Head to the Cutting Room and start up the machine. And keep an eye out for customers who are after the hide. They can get... a bit violent.

_root/BattleSpeechBubbleDlg-a1c10p2.json.en: I don't want you to get hurt.

_root/BattleSpeechBubbleDlg-a1c10p2.json.zh: 互相伤害……真的只有这一条路吗？
_root/BattleSpeechBubbleDlg-a1c10p2.json.en: Is hurting each other... really the only way?

_root/BattleSpeechBubbleDlg-a1c10p2.json.zh: 苏打……看来我再也喝不到了……
_root/BattleSpeechBubbleDlg-a1c10p2.json.en: The soda... I guess I can't have it anymore...

_root/BattleSpeechBubbleDlg-a1c10p2.json.zh: ……满眼贪欲。这个不是我的信徒。
_root/BattleSpeechBubbleDlg-a1c10p2.json.en: ... Eyes full of greed. This one isn't my follower.

_root/BattleSpeechBubbleDlg-a1c10p2.json.zh: 你是在为我哭吗……？因为我……伤害了蠕蠕……？
_root/BattleSpeechBubbleDlg-a1c10p2.json.en: Are you crying because of me...? Because I... hurt Wriggley...?

_root/BattleSpeechBubbleDlg-a1c10p2.json.zh: 啊……我不会再让楼层经理的职责妨碍我的贪欲了。欲望实现。
_root/BattleSpeechBubbleDlg-a1c10p2.json.en: Ah... Won't let the responsibilities of the Floor Manager hinder my greed anymore. DESIRE ACTUALIZING.

_root/BattleSpeechBubbleDlg-a1c10p2.json.zh: 是时候释放全部库存了。加速工作速度。
_root/BattleSpeechBubbleDlg-a1c10p2.json.en: Time to release the full stock. ACCELERATING WORK SPEED.

_root/BattleSpeechBubbleDlg-a1c10p2.json.zh: 该开始工作了。分配俘虏。
_root/BattleSpeechBubbleDlg-a1c10p2.json.en: Time to get to work. PRISONERS ASSIGNED.

_root/BattleSpeechBubbleDlg-a1c10p2.json.zh: 前任所有者的心脏已经停止跳动。转移所有权。
_root/BattleSpeechBubbleDlg-a1c10p2.json.en: The previous owner's heart has ceased beating. OWNERSHIP TRANSFERRED.

_root/BattleSpeechBubbleDlg-a1c10p2.json.zh: 我要揭开遮蔽红派伪神的面纱。
_root/BattleSpeechBubbleDlg-a1c10p2.json.en: I shall draw back the veil that shroudeth the Rouges' false idol.

_root/BattleSpeechBubbleDlg-a1c10p2.json.zh: 看啊，我宣布这片土地为神圣圣所。愿其绽放光辉。
_root/BattleSpeechBubbleDlg-a1c10p2.json.en: Behold, I proclaim this land a hallowed sanctum. Radiant shall it shine.

_root/BattleSpeechBubbleDlg-a1c10p2.json.zh: 汝仍要支持那令人憎恶的改变吗？
_root/BattleSpeechBubbleDlg-a1c10p2.json.en: Thou wouldst still lend thy support to that abhorrent change?

_root/BattleSpeechBubbleDlg-a1c10p2.json.zh:
汝当维护法则。
汝当履行誓言。
_root/BattleSpeechBubbleDlg-a1c10p2.json.en:
Thou shalt uphold the rule.
Thou shalt fulfill thy oath.

_root/BattleSpeechBubbleDlg-a1c10p2.json.zh:
凭黑曜神之意志，
我将把祂的报复降于汝身！
_root/BattleSpeechBubbleDlg-a1c10p2.json.en:
By the will of the Obsidian God,
I shall bring His vengeance upon thee!

_root/BattleSpeechBubbleDlg-a1c10p2.json.zh: 每一次重击，我都将斩断汝的降临！
_root/BattleSpeechBubbleDlg-a1c10p2.json.en: With each smite, I sever thine advent!
I shall set the nail upright.

_root/BattleSpeechBubbleDlg-a1c10p2.json.zh: 终于，不再有任何诞生，也不再有任何消耗。永恒将降临……百货商场。
_root/BattleSpeechBubbleDlg-a1c10p2.json.en: At last, naught shall be born, nor aught be depleted. Eternity shall come... unto the department store.

_root/BattleSpeechBubbleDlg-a1c10p2.json.zh: 把纠缠之物带到我面前，
我会把它们全部缝合起来。
_root/BattleSpeechBubbleDlg-a1c10p2.json.en: and I'll sew them all up.
the lines of the selvage edge.

_root/BattleSpeechBubbleDlg-a1c10p2.json.zh: ……你们燃烧着欲望的双眼剪下去。
这里只是修改和修剪衣服的地方。
_root/BattleSpeechBubbleDlg-a1c10p2.json.en: This is simply where clothes are altered and trimmed.

_root/BattleSpeechBubbleDlg-a1c10p2.json.zh: 什么都可以。我只是想剪剪剪……
_root/BattleSpeechBubbleDlg-a1c10p2.json.en: It can be anything. I'd just like to go snip-snip...

_root/BattleSpeechBubbleDlg-a1c10p2.json.zh: 把纠缠之物带到我面前，
把纠缠之物带到我面前，
我会把它们全部缝合起来。
_root/BattleSpeechBubbleDlg-a1c10p2.json.en: and I'll sew them all up.

_root/BattleSpeechBubbleDlg-a1c10p2.json.zh: 我会把它们全部缝合起来。
_root/BattleSpeechBubbleDlg-a1c10p2.json.en: and I'll sew them all up.
the lines of the selvage edge!

_root/BattleSpeechBubbleDlg-a1c10p2.json.zh: 我的剪刀会沿着你们燃烧着欲望的双眼剪下去。
_root/BattleSpeechBubbleDlg-a1c10p2.json.en: My scissors will snip around your burning eyes of desire.
