_mech/Skills_Assist-a1c10p2.json#4000420.zh:
正在成长为神者无法避免的成长之痛。

这种感觉有许多形态：眩晕、恶心、癫痫、自欺……对某些人而言，还有拒绝。对他们来说，世界充满恐怖与疏离的混乱。为了忍受恶心，为了保护尚属于自己的存在，以及那些尚未变得多余的存在，新生的神呕吐了。
_mech/Skills_Assist-a1c10p2.json#4000420.en:
The inevitable growing pains for those who are maturing into gods.

This sensation takes many forms: vertigo, nausea, seizure, self-deception... and to some, refusal. To them, the world is full of terror and alienating chaos. To endure the nausea, to protect those that are yet their own and those that are yet to become superfluous, the nascent god vomits.

_mech/Skills_Assist-a1c10p2.json#4000420.zh:
这是一处赤红色的空洞。
尽管它已经闭合，无尽的饥饿仍然徘徊，渴望着不可能到来的饱足。

因为其他人期待这个存在成为如此模样。因为它正是为此而生。
_mech/Skills_Assist-a1c10p2.json#4000420.en:
This is a crimson hollow.
Though it is closed, the endless hunger lingers, desiring the impossible satiation.

For that is what the others expect this being to be. For that is the purpose for which this being was born.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 等所有皮料都裁好了，就拿到外面，让培育者把它们缝起来。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: Once all the pieces are cut, take them outside and have the Nurturer stitch them up.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 黄金……黄金……黄金皮革……想要……皮革……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: Gold... Gold... Golden Hide... Want... the Hide...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 它们似乎觊觎我们正在加工的黄金皮革……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: They appear to covet the Golden Hide we are processing...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: <机器加工完之前，别让它们靠近。>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: <Let's keep them away until the machine's done with the processing.>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 听说黄金皮革衣服可以在这里缝制……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: We were told the Golden Hide garment could be sewn here...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: ……布料送进滚烫缝纫机时那尖锐又刺激的声音。把新买的东西上的薄膜一口气撕下来时的感觉。收据恰好沿虚线整齐撕开时，那干净利落的一扯……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: ... The sharp thrilling sound when cloth goes into a hot sewing machine. The feeling of peeling the film off a new purchase in one long riiiiip. The satisfying clean pull when a receipt tears exactly along the dotted line...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: ……我们现在又是在玩什么游戏？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: ... What sort of game are we playing now?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 我在列举那些光是想一想，就能让心里舒服得直哼哼的事情……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: I'm listing thoughts that make the mind purr just by imagining them...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 每次摸到蠕蠕时，那种湿湿滑滑的感觉。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: The damp, slippery feeling whenever I touch Wriggley.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 朝前看，知道有人可以让我跟着。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: Looking ahead and knowing there is someone I can follow.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 那个锁链叮当响的人回头看我有没有跟上时，我心里的感觉。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: What I feel when the one whose chains rattle looks back to check that I'm still following.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 看着大家叹气抱怨……可还是因为衣服是给我的，就去收集材料。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: Watching everyone sigh and complain... then still gather materials because the clothes are for me.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 嗯……对。都是些让人心情愉快的念头，你说的这些。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: Mmm... yes. All feel-good thoughts, yours.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 想到这些，我也觉得很舒服。趁这感觉还在，我来把黄金皮革缝进你的衣服里。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: Thinking about them makes me feel good. I'll sew the Golden Hide into your clothes while it lasts.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 以实玛利女士，每个人……不，每位百货公司的员工，想必都有自己缝纫的手法……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: Miss Ishmael, every person... nay, every employee of this department store must have their own technique of sewing...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 又有东西来了。它们想要我的衣服。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: More are coming. They want my clothes.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 被阳光晃瞎了眼的红派。
究竟是什么迷住了它们，让它们连自己想要奉为至高存在的对象都要攻击？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: What has so enthralled them that they would assail even the being they intend to exalt?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 失明令它们无法辨明该做什么。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: Their blindness keeps them from discerning what must be done.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 好了……快完成了。再加最后一样材料，就大功告成。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: There... almost done. One final material and it will be complete.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 你知道我们为了这些材料，在百货公司里来回跑了多少趟吗？虽然不是每一趟我都在，但也……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: Do you have any idea how many laps we've made around this department store for materials? I wasn't there for every run, sure, but still...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 哎呀……你这么一说，我心情都变差了……不过你们已经有……需要的材料了……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: Aw... My mood's worsened now... But you already have... the material you need...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 哦，我们有？那你怎么不早说——
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: Oh, we do? Well, why didn't you start with that—

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 得把黄金之茧拧出汁液，涂在衣服上。好好拧上八圈，里面的东西差不多就全挤出来了。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: The Golden Cocoon must be wrung for its extract, which will be used to paint over the garment. Eight good twists should squeeze out nearly everything inside.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 那么蠕蠕——不，那只茧会变成什么样？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: Then what becomes of Wrigg—no, the cocoon?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 它作为茧的使命便完成了，只剩下一副空壳。不过，空壳摸起来应该也挺舒服，嘿嘿……软软塌塌的……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: Its work as a cocoon will be finished, and only the husk will remain. Still, an empty shell should feel pleasant to touch, heh heh... Soft and limp...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 肯定还有别的办法。比如替代材料，或者换一种工序……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: There has to be another way. A substitute material, maybe, or another process...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 只要能把茧用进衣服里，什么办法都行……和衣服融为一体也可以。也就是说，穿衣服的人只要……把它一口吞下去。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: Anything, as long as the Cocoon can be included in the outfit... Becoming one with it should work, too. Meaning, the wearer can simply... gulp it down.
Then... I don't want it anymore.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 哎呀……可就差最后一步了。现在停下来，大家心里都不会好受的。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: Oh no... We only have the last step to go through, though. No one will feel good if you stop now.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 布布猛地扑上前，从默尔索肩头上方抓走了漂浮的茧。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: Pwie lunged forward and snatched the cocoon floating above Meursault's shoulder.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 布布双手护着蠕蠕，瞪着培育者，仿佛他下一刻就会来抢走那只茧。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: They cradled Wriggley in both hands and glared at the Nurturer as though he were about to come for the cocoon.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 如果你真的不想要衣服，没人能强迫你……但要进五楼，你需要那件衣服，对吧？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: Nobody can force you if you really don't want the clothes... But you need the garment to enter the fifth floor, don't you?
Are you all right with not going up?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 如果我不上去……大家会失望的。我的声音就传不出去……我也没法继续往前走……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: If I don't go up... I'll let everyone down. I won't be able to make my voice heard... I won't be able to move forward...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 我出生的目的……我应该成为的东西……大家对我的期待……那些因为我而熄灭的人……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: The purpose I was born for... the thing I'm supposed to be... what everyone expects from me... everyone who got extinguished because of me...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: ……你一定很苦恼。这条岔路对任何孩子来说，都太残酷了。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: ... You must be deeply troubled. This fork in the road is far too cruel for any child to choose.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: <……我们回地下一楼吧。去海岸里找，也许像大海捞针，但说不定还能找到一只活着的、带着茧的幼虫。>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: <... Let's return to B1. Scouring through the Shore may be a needle-in-a-haystack job, but we might be able to find another living larva that still has its cocoon.>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 可是布布那么在乎它。我也说不清，让一个孩子杀死它，实在……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: But Pwie cares for it so much. I don't know, asking a child to kill it is just...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 也许很罕见，但某个地方一定还有一只。我们可以继续找。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: It may be rare, but there has to be one more somewhere. We can keep looking.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 那就这么办。布布，我们回楼上吧。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: All right, then. Let's head back up, Pwie.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: ……不，我不能留在楼下。我……我出生是因为……我应该……我……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: ... No, I can't stay downstairs. I'm... I was born because... I'm supposed to... I...
I can't put this off anymore.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 必须填满。空的。一开始就是空的……不够。什么都没有。必须填满。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: Have to fill. Empty. Began empty... Not enough. There's nothing. Have to fill.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 布布，你在说什么？我听不明白。你是不是哪里不舒服，还是……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: Pwie, what are you saying? You're not making sense. Are you not feeling well or...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 布布蜷缩起身体，贴着地面剧烈颤抖。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: Pwie folded in on themselves, trembling violently against the floor.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 布布发出的声音，同样透着恐惧与迷醉，仿佛被什么东西附了身。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: The voice that escaped them sounded equally terrified and entranced, as though they'd been possessed by something.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 那反应，那沾满赤裸欲望的颤抖……很像……我曾透过堂吉诃德感受到的那股不加掩饰的食欲。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: That reaction, that trembling slick with naked desire... It's a lot like... that raw, unfiltered appetite I'd felt through Don Quixote.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: <布布，等等。先把蠕蠕还给默尔索……！>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: <Pwie, wait. Give Wriggley back to Meursault first...!>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 布布被前所未有的饥饿与贪欲吞没，
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: Overtaken by the hunger and greed they must've never felt before,

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 撕开曾经珍爱的茧，在任何人来得及阻止之前，疯狂地大口吞了下去。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: Pwie tore into the cocoon they had cherished, swallowing it in frantic mouthfuls before anyone could intervene.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 我们所能做的……只有站在那里看着。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: All we could do... was stand there and watch.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 喂……我们以前见过这场面，对吧？就是那种对……的渴求。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: Hey... We've seen this before, haven't we? It's that same craving for...
... There might have been warning signs.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 红派不断吞噬百货公司，几乎要将其耗尽。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: The Rouges have been consuming the department store to the point of depletion.
<And Pwie... kept saying they were hungry.>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: <难道布布一直在抵抗这种冲动……？>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: <Were they fighting it this entire time...?>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 布布呆呆望着手指间垂落的、湿漉漉的蠕蠕碎片，仿佛刚刚恢复神智。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: Pwie stared blankly at the wet pieces of Wriggley dangling between their fingers as if they'd just come back to their senses.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 就像回头望见自己做过的事，才发现悔意已在那里等着。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: As though looking back at what they had done and finding regret waiting there.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 顾客把茧吃了！现在可以把黄金皮革做成衣服了。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: The customer ate the cocoon! Now we can finish making a garment out of the Golden Hide.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 我……我以为自己是那个不会伤害蠕蠕的人。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: I... I thought I was the one who wouldn't hurt Wriggley.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: ……可眼前的一切都变红了。我太饿了……也太孤独了……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: ... but everything turned red. I was so hungry... and so lonely...
... I'll never see Wriggley again, will I?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: ……布布，若你愿意……我们可以在这里找一只和蠕蠕模样相同的茧。可是……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: ... Pwie, should you wish it... We could scour this place for another cocoon identical in form to Wriggley. Yet...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 那也不是蠕蠕……只会是另一只茧。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: It would not be Wriggley... but merely another cocoon.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 好了……可以了。黄金皮革衣服缝好啦~嘻嘻。等楼层经理做完最终检验，就算彻底完成了。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: There... Good to go. The Golden Hide garment is sewn~ Hee hee. Once the Floor Manager gives it a final inspection, it'll finally be completed.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 做得不错……我的愉快回忆清单上又能添一件事了。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: It turned out well... Another thing to go on my list of pleasant memories.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: ……看来我的孩子们已经做好了黄金皮革衣服。光泽诱人。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: ... I see my children have completed the Golden Hide garment. APPEALING SHEEN.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 必须在此进行最终检验。请稍候。动机上升。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: Final inspection must be performed here. Please wait. MOTIVATION RISING.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: ……啊，原来是这种手感。纹理保留得真漂亮。时隔这么多个季度，黄金高级定制终于再次出现……我的面孔都在悸动。缝线检验完成。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: ... Ah, so this is what it feels like. The grain is beautifully preserved. Golden haute couture, after so many seasons... my faces are throbbing. STITCHING INSPECTION COMPLETE.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 检验完了，可以还给我们了吗？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: Can we have it back if you're done?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 稍等……最后再检查一次，有没有线头、污渍或污染……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: One moment... one final check for loose threads, stains, or contamination...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 当然不会有任何瑕疵。我们的工序天衣无缝……贪欲超出安全水平。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: Naturally, no defect will exist. Our process is flawless... GREED EXCEEDING SAFE LEVELS.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 他每呼吸一次，似乎就把衣服攥得更紧……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: He appears to clutch the garment more tightly with every passing breath...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 还给我们。你想要多少眼球，我们都付……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: Give it back. We'll pay however many eyeballs you want...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 你明知道，光靠眼球还不够……不足以成为黄金皮革的主人。事实修正。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: You know that eyeballs are not enough... to become the owner of Golden Hide. FACT REVISED.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 给陌生人太可惜了。这是黄金高级定制，是我们最出色的杰作。谁也别想拿走……开始攻击。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: Much too good for strangers. This is the Golden Haute Couture, our finest masterpiece. No one can have it... COMMENCING ATTACK.
No need to activate the machine again.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 直到杀死监工，我们才终于夺回了做好的黄金皮革衣服。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: Only after killing the Overseer could we finally take the completed Golden Hide garment back.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 多么完美的黄金高级定制……不能交给你们这些陌生人。所有面孔的贪欲均已达到最高等级。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: What a perfectly crafted Haute Couture of gold... Can't let you strangers have it. ALL FACES MAXIMUM GREED LEVEL REACHED.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 又来了个我不认识的人。
搞什么……这是怎么回事？希斯克利夫一直念叨着要带孩子，我还当他又在照例抱怨，结果……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: What the... What is all this? Heathcliff kept going on and on about babysitting, so I just took it as his usual grumbling, and turns out...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: <……说来话长。默尔索，你能向她解释一下发生了什么吗？>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: <... It's a long story. Meursault, can you explain to her what happened?>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 默尔索向以实玛利说明了事情经过。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: Meursault caught Ishmael up to speed.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 与此同时，这里是最后一层地下楼层。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: This place, meanwhile, was the final underground floor.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 默尔索和我以前都没有到过这里。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: Neither Meursault nor I had reached this place before.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 我们必须在这里为布布制作黄金裹布——一件用黄金皮革做的衣服。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: This is where we have to fashion Pwie's Golden Shroud—an outfit made from Golden Hide.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 布布穿着它进入五楼后会发生什么，谁也说不准。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: What would happen if Pwie entered the fifth floor wearing it was anyone's guess.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 但我们要的正是这份未知。我们需要一个机会，让任何一件事出现不同的结果。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: But that uncertainty was the point. We needed the chance to make something, anything, turn out differently.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 正是如此，进入五楼的关键，就是让那个孩子穿上黄金皮革制成的衣服……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: Indeed, the key to the fifth floor is that the child be arrayed in clothing fashioned from Golden Hide...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 这里每个人似乎都急着把黄金皮革据为己有，想做好这件衣服恐怕不轻松。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: And since everyone here seems desperate to own Golden Hide, making the outfit is not going to be a walk in the park.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 我们的眼球还够吗？趁别人开出天价之前，最好先算一算……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: Do we still have enough eyeballs? We should do the math before anyone starts asking for prices through the roof...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 以实玛利看起来恨不得把账本核对到最后一颗眼球。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: Ishmael looked ready to balance a ledger down to the last eyeball.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 等等。我们花了那么多眼球……就为了这一件东西？唉。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: Wait. We paid through the nose in eyeballs... for this one item? *sigh*

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: <我是说……那是我们当时最好的选择……>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: <I mean, it was the best option we had at the time...>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 钱已付过。除了好好利用买来的东西，恐怕也别无他法……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: The price has already been paid. There is little recourse but to put the purchase to good use...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 缝线全都崩开了，只剩下一团破碎不堪的残骸。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: The stitches have all burst, leaving it a shredded mess.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 架子上挂着几块剖得很薄的皮革。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: Several pieces of thinly split leather are hanging on the rack.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 它们薄得能透见另一面。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: They've been split so thinly that the other side is visible.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 它还在流血，浸透了下方的地面。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: It's still bleeding, soaking the ground beneath it.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 厚实的全粒面皮革。看起来很有分量。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: Thick, full grain leather. Looks pretty weighty.
This piece of leather is moist to the touch.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 这块皮革已经干缩，皱成一团。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: This piece of leather has been desiccated and shrunk into a wrinkly mess.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 这块皮革的切面仿佛是被极锋利的刀刃切开的。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: The cross-section of this cut of leather looks as though it's been cut by an incredibly keen blade.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 这块皮革的切面——如果还能称之为切面的话——显然是被钝刀撕开的。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: The cross-section of this cut of leather—if it can be called that—clearly communicates that it's been ripped by a dull knife.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 这块皮革上有好几个……脓疱。散发出骇人的恶臭。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: There are multiple... pustules on this cut of leather. It emits a horrible stench.
Human leather that's been laid out to dry.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 里面有发黑的血珠，明显已经变了色。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: There are blackened beads of blood with clear signs of discoloration inside.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 下颌部位有几处奇怪的孔洞，让人想起鱼鳃。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: There are strange holes reminiscent of gills on the jaw area.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 这些皮革还泛着红色，想必刚剥下来不久。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: These pieces of leather still retain their reddish hue. Must've been flayed recently.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 只掀起一个小角，就有一股令人作呕的恶臭扑面而来。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: Lifting a small corner of it immediately releases a rush of revolting stench.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 里面有几块绿色的皮革。大概已经腐烂了。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: There are green patches of leather inside. Must be rotten.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 只掀起一个小角，就有一股令人作呕的恶臭扑面而来。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: Lifting a small corner of it immediately releases a rush of revolting stench.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 这些也许是弃置的皮革，就像一楼角落里那堆被丢弃的衣服……？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: Maybe these are discarded leather, like those piles of clothes discarded in corners of the first floor...?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 皮革边角料。应该是留着做补丁用的。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: Scraps of leather. Must've been saving these to be used as extra patches.
Pieces of leather haphazardly strewn about.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 暗红的干涸血迹黏住了几缕头发。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: Dark-red patches of dried blood have caught some strands of hair.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 里面塞满了浸烂的皮革。
看来有一阵子没用了。有些部件已经生锈。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: Must've been a while since this was used. Parts of it has rusted.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 与其说是皮革，更像是标本。
这块皮革简直油光发亮。看起来比外面晾晒的那些品质更好。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: This piece of leather is practically glistening. It looks to be of a higher quality than the ones drying outside.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 这块……脸皮上的表情还挺愉悦。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: It's got a pleasant expression, this... patch of face skin.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 闻不到任何气味。应该经过了某种处理。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: Doesn't smell like anything. Must've gone through some sort of treatment process.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 每一缕头发都闪着生命力的光泽，看起来生机勃勃。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: Each strand of hair is glistening with vitality. Looks lively.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 这块皮革仍然相当湿润。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: This piece of leather is still quite moist.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 这些皮革都是从哪里来的？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: Where do all these pieces of leather come from?
Human leather that's been laid out to dry.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 他们仿佛把人体像多面体的平面展开图一样，展开了……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: It is as though they have unfolded the body, akin to the planar figure of a polyhedron, only human...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 这景象实在不适合让孩子看见。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: This is a sight most inapt for the eyes of children.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 李箱小心地挪到一旁，挡住布布，不让布布看那块皮革。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: Yi Sang carefully moved to the side, blocking Pwie from looking at the piece of leather.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 可想到我们身在何处……这么做恐怕也没多大用。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: Considering where we are, however... I don't think it'll do much good.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 呃……这味道……比鲸鱼的气味还难闻。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: Ugh... That smell... It's even worse than Whale odor.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 嗯。闻起来香喷喷的，味道很浓。
他们把它闻成那样，倒也并不奇怪。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: It is not so out of the ordinary for them to perceive it as such.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 食物脱水是一道工序，能更鲜明地呈现食材独有的风味。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: Food dehydration is a process by which the ingredient's unique flavors may be more vividly conveyed.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 默尔索，你也觉得它闻起来好吃吗？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: Does it smell tasty to you too, Meursault?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 如果这是肉干，而非皮革……我想我也会觉得香。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: Had this been jerky rather than leather... I imagine it would have smelled good to me, too.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 布布的问题一个接一个，默尔索耐心地一一回答。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: Meursault patiently answered Pwie's questions as they kept coming.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 一股气流从皮革堆里喷出，发出嘶——的一声。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: Air rushes out of the pile of leather with a shhh.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: <……里面怎么了？默尔索，我们看看。>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: <... What's going on in there? Meursault, let's take a look.>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 默尔索掀起皮革堆。气体逸出的声音在我们耳中渐渐变成了喘息。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: Meursault lifts the pile of leather, and the sound of escaping air slowly turns into wheezing to our ears.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 找了一阵后，我们终于找到了发出声音的那块皮革。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: After some searching, we managed to find the piece of leather that was making the noise.
... The words "Disgusting turncoat," is inscribed here, Manager.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 默尔索展开那块皮革，露出了它的全貌。那张……“嘴”一开一合，似乎想说些什么。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: Meursault unrolled the piece of leather. Its full form now visible. the... "mouth" opened and closed, trying to communicate something.
<Is it... saying something? What is it saying?>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 默尔索扯住那块皮革，慢慢将它撕成两半。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: Meursault pulls on the piece of leather, slowly tearing it in half.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 皮肤被缓缓撕开时，那块皮革露出了狂喜的笑容。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: The leather smiles ecstatically as its skin is slowly ripped apart.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 看起来像一件……被剥去皮肤组织的装置艺术。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: Looks like an... installation with its skin tissue removed.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 我能感觉到极微弱的气息从它口中逸出。它还活着。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: I can feel the smallest hint of air escaping its mouth. It's still alive.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 一块被拉成双翼形状的剥下来的皮革。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: Flayed leather that has been pulled into the shape of a pair of wings.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 融化的皮肤组织和地板黏成了一体。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: Melted skin tissue has merged to the floor.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 这块皮革大概刚从加工工序中取出，摸起来还有些温热。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: This piece of leather must've been just removed from processing. It's still quite warm to the touch.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 漆黑的桶里有什么，很难看清。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: It's hard to see what's inside the dark barrel.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 听起来几乎像在痛苦呻吟。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: Almost sounds like it's groaning in pain.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 这是一口大缸……或者说，一只能大量加工皮革的桶。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: It's a big vat... or a barrel capable of bulk-processing a large amount of leather.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 它被剖成了许多许多薄层，已经很难猜出原来的模样。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: It's been split into many, many thin layers, making it difficult to guess its original form.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 浸泡过化学药剂的皮革上，一簇簇头发正液化脱落。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: Patches of hair are liquefying and melting off from the chemical-soaked leather.
A sharp stench stings the nose.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 化学液体在里面晃荡。碰到它，显然会对皮肤造成……不良影响。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: Chemical fluid is swishing inside. Touching it will clearly have... adverse effects for the skin.
These patches of leather are pulled taut.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 它们是在接受某种特殊处理吗？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: Are they going through some sort of special treatment process?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 一缸液体，血中混着各种半融化的残渣。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: A vat of fluid, with various half-melted dregs mixed into blood.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 黏稠的液体里，气泡懒洋洋地浮上来，然后破裂。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: Bubbles lazily float up the viscous fluid before popping.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 我注意到油腻的液体中漂着一层白色脂肪。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: I notice a white layer of fat floating among the greasy fluid.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 无法辨认的肉块漂浮在液体中。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: Unrecognizable bits of flesh are floating about the fluid.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 这分明是多种剧毒化学药剂调成的混合液。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: This is clearly a cocktail of highly toxic chemicals.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: ……瞥见一大团白色的东西，上面还长着头发。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: ... Caught the briefest glimpse of a large, white glob with hair growing out of it.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 你是顾客吗？在这儿等着，我去拿账本。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: Are you a customer? Wait here, let me get my ledger.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 闻到了高评级顾客的香气。有钱的陌生人总是受欢迎。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: Getting a whiff of a high-Prestige customer's fragrance. Loaded strangers are always welcome.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 黏稠的黑血从它的每一个毛孔里渗出。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: Viscous, black blood wells up in each of its pores.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 胡乱缝补的皮革上露出几块肉。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: There are bits of meat sticking out of the haphazardly patched-up leather.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 头骨像西瓜一样被砸碎，上面还连着几小撮头发。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: A skull smashed in like a watermelon. There are small patches of hair still attached to it.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 遭到那位工匠袭击，着实出乎意料。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: It was a most unexpected development to fall under the assault of the artisan.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 好吧，它晃动身体的时候，呃……会有人从它的洞里爬出来。它的行为出人意料地像穴掌鲸，只不过这里不是大湖，不是它平常栖息的地方。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: Okay, so when it shakes its body, uh... people crawl out of its hole. Its behavior is surprisingly similar to the Whale of the Porous hand, just not in its usual habitat of the Great Lake.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: <至少那些小人鱼还被束缚在鲸鱼身上……>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: <At least those tiny Mermaids were bound to the Whale...>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: <它准备向我们冲过来时，多加小心。>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: <Let's try to watch out when it's getting ready to charge at us.>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: <还有……对，尽快解决从它背上爬出来的手下。>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: <And... yeah, quickly dispatch its minions that crawled out of its back.>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 这么久没碰到这种珍贵皮革，能加工它是我的荣幸。好好爱惜它。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: It was an honor to work on such precious leather after such a long drought of it. Take good care of it.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 手掌向内蜷着，仿佛还攥着什么东西。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: The palm is curled inward, as though still clutching something.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: <我们得快走。我想它听见了茧临死前的叫声……正循着声音朝我们追来。>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: <We need to get away. I think it caught the cocoon's death cry... and now it's following the sound straight back to us.>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 想跑？除非“声音”送你们一阵顺风，否则甩不掉哀嚎者。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: Trying to run? You won't shake the Wailer unless the Voice puts wind at your back.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: <它快到了。不管会到洗手间还是楼上，我们现在就得走。默尔索！动手！>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: now. Meursault! Do your thing!>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: ……空气里弥漫着浓重的油味，一点也勾不起食欲。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: ...A strong oily smell hangs in the air. There's nothing appetizing about it.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 浸透油的皮革正在晾干。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: The oil-soaked leather is drying out.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 浑浊、颜色古怪的油噼啪作响，四处飞溅，仿佛马上就要沸腾溢出。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: Murky, strange-colored oil crackles and spits as though on the verge of boiling over.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 掠过的影子之间传来交谈声。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: Voices can be heard among the passing shadows.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 就为了这么一块破皮，你打算折腾到什么时候？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: How far are you gonna go over one lousy hide?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 快换季了，我们也该往上走了……随便拿块皮革不行吗？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: The season's gonna change soon and we're due to move up anyway... can't we just bring any old leather?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 皮革穿得越久……就越贴合你的身体。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: The more you break leather in... the more it molds itself to you.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 颜色、褶皱，甚至活动起来的样子……都会越来越像我！
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: The color, the creases, even the way it moves... it all starts to take after me!

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 那边的皮革……还没穿得和我贴合。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: Those leathers over there... they haven't been broken in to me.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 一位顾客的模糊身影始终徘徊在原地。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: A hazy figure of a customer keeps lingering in the same spot.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: ……空气里弥漫着浓重的油味，一点也勾不起食欲。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: ...A strong oily smell hangs in the air. There's nothing appetizing about it.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 在肉块之间挖出了几颗眼球。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: Found some eyeballs buried between chunks of meat.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 浸透油的皮革正在晾干。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: The oil-soaked leather is drying out.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.zh: 浑浊、颜色古怪的油噼啪作响，四处飞溅，仿佛马上就要沸腾溢出。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b3-b.js.en: Murky, strange-colored oil crackles and spits as though on the verge of boiling over.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-b3-b.json#.zh: 监工要求我们交出8块皮革，才肯制作黄金裹布。我们得收集散落在西西弗百货各处的皮革。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-b3-b.json#.en: The Overseer requested 8 pieces of hide in return for making the Golden Shroud. We need to gather the hides scattered across the Grand Magasin.
Collect the Pieces of Golden Hide

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-b3-b.json#.zh: 我们在地下三楼遇到了监工。他说，要用黄金皮革制作衣服，得先去我们至今到过的各处收集皮革碎片。他把确切地点也告诉了我们。现在去把黄金皮革取来交给监工吧。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-b3-b.json#.en: We encountered the Overseer on B3F. The Overseer said that in order to make clothing from the Golden Hide, we need to collect the pieces from all the location we've visited so far. The exact locations were given to us. Now we need to go fetch the Golden Hide for the Overseer.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-b3-b.json#.zh: 收集帕莱特的黄金树脂
收集地下二楼楼层经理的黄金皮革
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-b3-b.json#.en: Collect B2F Floor Manager's Golden Hide

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-b3-b.json#.zh: 收集针线之王的黄金皮革
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-b3-b.json#.en: Collect the King of Needlework's Golden Hide

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-b3-b.json#.zh: 收集副主厨的黄金皮革
从一楼尸堆收集黄金皮革
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-b3-b.json#.en: Collect the Golden Hide from 1F's corpse pile

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-b3-b.json#.zh: 从四楼的墙上收集黄金皮革
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-b3-b.json#.en: Collect the Golden Hide from the wall on 4F

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-b3-b.json#.zh: 监工索要的八块皮革中，有一块在地下一楼。得从副主厨身上把它剥下来。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-b3-b.json#.en: One of the eight pieces of hide demanded by the Overseer can be found on B1F. It has to be flayed off the Sous Chef.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-b3-b.json#.zh: 前往地下一楼美食广场
监工索要的八块皮革中，有一块在一楼。它应该就在尸堆里的某处。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-b3-b.json#.en: One of the eight pieces of hide demanded by the Overseer can be found on 1F. It should be somewhere in the corpse pile.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-b3-b.json#.zh: 寻找藏在尸堆中的黄金皮革（5/8）
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-b3-b.json#.en: Find the Golden Hide hidden in the corpse pile (5/8)

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-b3-b.json#.zh: 监工索要的八块皮革中，有一块在二楼。得从品牌总监身上把它剥下来。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-b3-b.json#.en: One of the eight pieces of hide demanded by the Overseer can be found on 2F. It has to be flayed off the Brand Director.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-b3-b.json#.zh: 取走品牌总监的黄金皮革（7/8）
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-b3-b.json#.en: Take the Brand Director's Golden Hide (7/8)

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-b3-b.json#.zh: 监工索要的八块皮革中，有一块在三楼。得从楼层经理身上把它剥下来。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-b3-b.json#.en: One of the eight pieces of hide demanded by the Overseer can be found on 3F. It has to be flayed off the Floor Manager.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-b3-b.json#.zh: 前往三楼楼层经理的房间
三楼楼层经理的黄金皮革（8/8）
监工索要的八块皮革中，有一块在四楼。我们应该去解构者留下的混凝土废墟里找找。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-b3-b.json#.en: One of the eight pieces of hide demanded by the Overseer can be found on 4F. We should search through the concrete rubble left behind by the Deconstructionists.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-b3-b.json#.zh: 取出塞在墙缝里的黄金皮革（6/8）
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-b3-b.json#.en: Pick up the Golden Hide stuffed inside the crack in the wall (6/8)

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-b3-b.json#.zh: 已从墙缝取得黄金皮革（6/8）
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-b3-b.json#.en: Obtained Golden Hide from the crack in the wall (6/8)

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-b3-b.json#.zh: 我们终于收齐了八块黄金皮革。回地下三楼，把收集到的皮革交给监工，让他用黄金皮革为布布制作衣服。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-b3-b.json#.en: We've finally procured all eight pieces of the Golden Hide. Let's return to the Overseer on B3F and hand over what we've collected so he can craft Pwie an outfit out of the Golden Hide.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-b3-b.json#.zh:
八块黄金皮革都带来了，但我们的奔波还没有结束。监工说，要量身制作衣服，布布得先去制革工坊量尺寸。
去制革工坊见见那位……制革工吧。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-b3-b.json#.en:
We've brought all eight pieces of the Golden Hide, but our journey didn't end there. To make bespoke garment, said the Overseer, Pwie should first head to the Tannery and get their size measured.
Let's head to the Tannery and meet the... Tanner.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-b3-b.json#.zh: 坚守阵地，抵御敌人猛攻，直到制版工序完成。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-b3-b.json#.en: Hold the position against the onslaught of enemies until the patterning process is completed.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-b3-b.json#.zh:
布布已经量好尺寸，纸样也做好了。现在该裁剪、缝制了。

前往裁剪室吧。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-b3-b.json#.en:
Pwie's size has been measured, and patterns have been patterned. Now, it's time for cutting and sewing.

Let's head to the Cutting Room.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-b3-b.json#.zh: 坚守阵地，抵御敌人猛攻，直到裁剪工序完成。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-b3-b.json#.en: Hold the position against the onslaught of enemies until the cutting process is completed.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-b3-b.json#.zh: 裁剪已经完成。等培育者缝好，黄金皮革衣服应该就做成了。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-b3-b.json#.en: The cutting is complete. Once the Nurturer handles the stitching, the Golden Hide garment should be finished.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-b3-b.json#.zh: 抵御来袭敌人，直到培育者缝制完成。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-b3-b.json#.en: Hold off the incoming enemies until the Nurturer finishes stitching

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-b3-b.json#.zh: 从监工处领取黄金裹布
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-b3-b.json#.en: Receive the Golden Shroud from the Overseer

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-b3-b.json#.zh: 看来所有工序都完成了。我们该去监工那里领取做好的衣服。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-b3-b.json#.en: Looks like the whole process is complete. We should collect the finished garment from the Overseer.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-b3-b.json#.zh: 从监工处领取黄金裹布
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-b3-b.json#.en: Receive the Golden Shroud from the Overseer

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-b3-b.json#.zh: 监工做好了黄金皮革衣服，却似乎舍不得交出来，反而向我们发起攻击。打倒监工，夺回做好的衣服。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-b3-b.json#.en: The Overseer finished the Golden Hide garment, but apparently couldn't bear to hand it over and turned on us instead. We should defeat the Overseer and claim the finished garment.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-b3-b.json#.zh:
监工做好了黄金皮革衣服，布布终于能穿上它。然而，吞下蠕蠕后，布布看起来一点也不高兴。
……该前往五楼了。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-b3-b.json#.en:
The Overseer completed the Golden Hide, allowing Pwie to don clothing made from it. Pwie, however, doesn't seem glad at all after devouring Wriggley.
... It's time to head to 5F.
See the tanning process through to completion
The Process at the Cutting Room
See the cutting process through to completion
The Process at the Outdoor Plaza

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-b3-b.json#.zh: 见证室外广场的工序完成
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-b3-b.json#.en: See the process at the Outdoor Plaza through to completion

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-b3-b.json#.zh: 交出手臂的代价太惨重了。回地下一楼美食广场，再向副主厨提出另一笔交易。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-b3-b.json#.en: The consequence of giving up the arm was too dire. Let's return to Sous Chef on B1F's Food Court and offer her another trade.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.en: Gregor

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.zh: 呼……总算到了，可是……呃，我们连入口能不能进去都说不准。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.en: Phew... we made it here, but... huh. I can't say if we can even get through the entrance.
Yi Sang

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.zh: 入口似乎被某种极不寻常的东西挡住了……我恐怕蛮力不会奏效。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.en: The entrance appears obstructed by something decidedly unusual... I much doubt brute force shall avail us.
Pwie

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.zh: 布布默默将一只手按在通往五楼的入口上，
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.en: Pwie silently placed a hand against the entrance to the fifth floor,

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.zh: 随后摇摇头，把手放了下来。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.en: only to lower it again with a shake of the head.
Pwie
... We can't go in. Both you and me.
Pwie
We don't have... enough virtue yet...
Dante
<"Virtue"...?>
Kromer

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.zh: 答对了。那个小不点的美德可差得远呢……离这里这种高雅地方要求的精致程度还早得很。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.en: Bingo. That little runt is just waaay too lacking in virtue... Still nowhere near refined enough for a highbrow place like this.
Yi Sang
Kromer...!

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.zh: 一具黑派的尸体。血渗进黑色西装，染成了深红色。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.en: The corpse of a Noir. Blood seeps into the black suit, turning it dark crimson.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.zh: 一具红派的尸体。原本鼓胀的衣服吸饱了血，沉甸甸地垂了下来。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.en: The corpse of a Rouge. Its once-swollen outfit has sagged, weighed down by blood soaking it.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.zh: 我把手放在帘幕上，它便像被碰到的水面一样泛起涟漪。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.en: Laid my hands on the curtain, and it began to ripple as though I'd just touched the surface of water.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.zh: 这时，布布从其他人身旁挤过去，走到帘幕前。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.en: That's when Pwie pushed past the others and walked up to the curtain.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.zh: 布布伸出小小的手，探向帘幕……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.en: Their tiny hand reaches out toward the curtain...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.zh: 帘幕轻轻荡起涟漪。路开了。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.en: The curtain ripples gently. The way is now open.
Dante
<I think we can get inside now.>
Pwie
I... keep yawning.
Pwie
I'm sleepy... My eyes feel so heavy...
Pwie
... like... I'm about to fall asleep again...
Yi Sang

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.zh: 方才一战确实艰苦。稍作休息也无妨。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.en: The battle was arduous indeed. There is no harm in stealing a brief rest.
Pwie

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.zh: 也许……不会只是稍作休息……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.en: Maybe... it won't be too brief after all...
Yi Sang
Be that as it may, it is well.
Dante
<Yeah... We should take a moment to get a breather, too.>
Pwie
Pwie
I hope you'll still be here...
Pwie
... when I wake up.
Pwie

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.zh: 就像以前那样……也像现在这样。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.en: Like you were before... Like you are now.
Meursault
... We will do so.
Meursault
Rest your worries and sleep.
Pwie
... Mhm.
Yi Sang
Dream of sweetness, Pwie.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.zh: 不久，轻柔而有节奏的睡眠呼吸声充满四周，深红的褶皱开始在布布身边狂乱地打结。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.en: Soon, the soft rhythm of sleeping breath filled the air, and crimson folds began knotting themselves wildly around Pwie.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.zh: 然后，就像我们之前见过的那只茧……一层红色薄膜覆住了孩子。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.en: Then, just like the cocoon we had encountered before... a red membrane closed over the child.
Gregor
They became a cocoon...
Yi Sang

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.zh: 有些生灵……必须经历蜕变，褪去旧形才能成熟。我故乡的蝴蝶便是如此。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.en: Certain creatures... must shed their former shape through metamorphosis afore they mature. The butterflies of my homeland behaved thus.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-choice-floor-.en: We don't have anything to give.
We'll give you lots of eyeballs.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.en: Gregor
Like a chrysalis, huh...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.zh: 格里高尔的脸僵了一瞬，仿佛有什么不好的回忆浮上心头……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.en: Gregor's face stiffened for a moment as though a bad memory had surfaced...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.zh: 随后他摇摇头，恢复了平时的镇定。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.en: Then he shook his head and returned to his usual composure.
Gregor

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.zh: 哎呀……这照顾寄养孩子的事，我们可陷得够深了，对吧？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.en: Boy... We're in deep with this foster-care business now, huh?
Yi Sang

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.zh: 若无人留下保护沉睡的孩子……其必将遭受苦难。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.en: If none remain to protect the slumbering child... they will surely suffer.
Gregor

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.zh: 说到底，是布布带我们一路到了五楼。现在装作没看见，也说不过去。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.en: Well, Pwie did get us all the way to the fifth floor. Wouldn't sit right to turn a blind eye now.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.zh: 不久，末端长着嘴的触须突然从茧中破出，迅速吞掉了桌上摆放的食物。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.en: Soon, tendrils with mouths at their ends suddenly burst out of the cocoon, quickly devouring the food set on the table.
Meursault
They appear to be... sating their hunger.
Dante
<... The Noirs will descend on us soon.>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.zh: <color=#7d7d7d>泉边的异乡人将血肉迎入歌声。于是，他们成了枯竭的见证者。</color>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.en: <color=#7d7d7d>The strangers of the Fount have welcomed flesh and blood into the song. Thus have they made themselves witnesses to depletion.</color>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.zh: <color=#7d7d7d>我忠诚的孩子，我的勇士。挥动汝的锤，击碎那新生之物，送它赴死；一切诞生终归于死亡，此乃正道。唯有如此，汝才能以西西弗之名，永远屹立。</color>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.en: <color=#7d7d7d>My faithful child, champion of mine. Smite with thy hammer the nascency and deliver it to death, for it is good that all births end in death. Only then shalt thou stand eternal beneath the name of Sisyphe.</color>
Le Noir's Brand Manager

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.zh: “声音”如此言道：诚然，宿敌就在此处，贪婪与挥霍、饥饿与干渴的温床。它重生的尽头，唯有虚无。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.en: Thus spake the Voice: verily, here lieth the archenemy, seedbed of avarice and excess, hunger and thirst. Only void shall exist at the uttermost end of its rebirth.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.zh: 那道巨大的身影手持大锤，缓缓踏向我们——踏向布布的茧。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.en: With a great hammer in her hands, the giant figure slowly stomps toward us—toward Pwie's cocoon.
Gregor

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.zh: 真走运啊……偏偏在孩子连跑都跑不了的时候被堵住……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.en: Just our luck... Cornered at the one time the kid can't even run...
Yi Sang

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.zh: 从此刻响起的“声音”判断……它或许一直等到小布布睡着，才选定此时出手。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.en: Judging by the Voice now resounding... it may have bided its hour until young Pwie fell aslumber.
Yi Sang
... Is it over?
Gregor

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.zh: 呼……打了一整天，真把人累坏了。还是该说，累的是我的脑子？毕竟这是个模拟世界……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.en: Oof... Fighting all day really takes it out of you. Or am I supposed to say my mind's the part running on fumes? It's a simulated world, after all...
Dante

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.zh: <……我想不会再有黑派能闯到这里了。>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.en: <... I don't think any more Le Noirs will make it this far.>
Dante
<Is Pwie all right...?>
Meursault

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.zh: 没有受伤。而且……应该快醒了。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.en: Unharmed. And... likely to awaken soon.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.zh: 层层深红褶皱一起一伏，像某个庞大的器官在沉睡中呼吸……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.en: The layered crimson folds swelled and sank like some enormous organ breathing in its sleep...
Gregor

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.zh: 呼……人靠衣装，孩子也一样啊。现在能进餐厅了吗？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.en: Whew... Clothes really do make the kid, huh? So, can we get into the restaurant now?
Pwie
... Mhm.
Yi Sang

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.zh: 嗯……你的声音很低沉，肩也耷拉着……心里还惦记着蠕蠕吗？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.en: Hm... Your voice is mellow and your shoulders hang low... Does your mind yet linger with Wriggley?
Pwie
Gregor

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.zh: 蠕蠕？哦……就是那个飘在默尔索肩头，每次都“吱”一声的小家伙？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.en: Wriggley? Oh... that little screecher floating over Meursault's shoulder going "scree" every time?
Gregor
What exactly happened down there...?
Dante

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.zh: <布布……吃掉了蠕蠕。布布明明那么在乎它……>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.en: <Pwie... ate Wriggley. And they'd cared so much for it, too...>
Gregor

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.zh: 吃、吃了？呃……按这地方古怪的常识，这算正常吗？那孩子不是爱它爱得不得了吗？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.en: A-ate it? Huh... Is that supposed to be normal in the weird common sense of this place? Didn't the kid love that thing to bits?
Yi Sang

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.zh: ……身后有一股强烈的震动正在逼近……还有那哀嚎声。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.en: ... A powerful tremor approaches from behind us... and that wailing, too.
Meursault
This tremor...
Meursault

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.zh: 经理。看来那“古老的存在……”很快就会到这里。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.en: Manager. It seems the "being of eld..." will be here shortly.
Pwie
When...?
Meursault
In approximately 3 seconds.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-choice-floor-.zh: 我们给你格里高尔的手臂。
我们给你熬汤用的骨头。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-choice-floor-.en: We'll give you bone for the broth.
We'll give you lots of eyeballs.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.en: Pwie
Blackthread
Gwoooooorgh!!!!
Meursault

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.zh: 经理，我们必须先解决追来的古老存在。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.en: We must first deal with the being of eld in pursuit, Manager.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.zh:
<color=#7d7d7d>那些不着衣衫，却敢无惧凝视者……播下了贪欲孕生的灾厄。
听我号令，我的孩子们！我以神圣权柄，驱逐阻挡汝等崛起的时间！现在，向敌手施以应得的报偿。</color>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.en:
<color=#7d7d7d>The unclothed ones who dare stand unafraid before the gaze... have sown a calamity born of avarice. 
Hearken to me, my children! By my divine authority, I banish the obstruction of time to thy rising! Now visit upon the Adversary their due.</color>
Gregor

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.zh: 等等。刚才那广播……只有我觉得警钟大作吗？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.en: Hold on. That announcement just now... Am I the only one whose alarm bells are ringing?
Yi Sang

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.zh: ……我们最好立刻做好战斗准备。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.en: ... We would be wise to prepare for battle at once.
Le Noir Guard

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.zh: 在那里！我看见那些陌生人了！
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.en: There! I see the strangers!
Dante
<Meursault. Don't stop—keep moving forward.>
Meursault
... Understood, Manager.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.zh: 难以理解的悲伤从黑色丝线之间渗出。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.en: Sorrow beyond understanding is leaching out from between the black threads.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.zh: 漆黑的波流绕着我们的脚踝交织，想把我们卷走。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.en: Currents of dark, black waves weave around our ankles, trying to sweep us away.
Dante

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.zh: <我们已经爬到这么高了……希望他们追不到更远的地方。>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.en: <We've climbed this far... Hopefully they won't be able to chase us further.>
Yi Sang

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.zh: 看来……我们来到了餐桌上方。希望我们的到来没有过分打扰他们用餐……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.en: It seems... we have emerged atop a dining table. I hope our arrival has not unduly intruded upon their meal...
Gregor

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.zh: 呃，我们现在也顾不上餐桌礼仪了。至少终于能喘口气……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.en: Well, we're not exactly in a position to mind our table manners. At least now we can finally catch our breath...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.zh: <color=#7d7d7d>不知高贵为何物的孩子们，听我说：汝等每一步落下，都将钉入一枚钉子；纵使汝等奋力上升，也注定要在每一层止步。</color>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.en: <color=#7d7d7d>O children who know not nobility, I say to thee: thine every fall of foot shall bore a nail; rise thou might, yet thine shall be the lot to halt at every floor.</color>
Gregor
Yup. Me and my fat mouth...
Pwie
Why is your mouth fat?
Gregor

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.zh: *呼* 这么说吧……有时候就是得把嘴闭上。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.en: *huff* Let's just say... sometimes you need to keep your mouth shut.
Dante
<... We're going to have to protect the cocoon.>
Le Noir's Brand Manager

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.zh: ……陌生人。来自泉边、不受楼层束缚而行的汝等……步步向上的汝等。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.en: ... Strangers. Ye of the Fount, whose steps are bound not by the floors... Ye whose footfalls ever point upward.
Le Noir's Brand Manager

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.zh: 汝等的消息，早在脚步抵达前便传入我耳中。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.en: Word of ye hath reached me long before your feet did.
Le Noir's Brand Manager

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.zh: 听闻汝等斩杀了这一代改衣师，我曾把织造衣料之事托付于她。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.en: Heard have I that ye have hewn the Alterationist of the present generation, to whom I have trusted the weaving of my fabric.
Le Noir's Brand Manager

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.zh: 上一代改衣师亲手造出这副甲胄，早已踏上她的走秀之旅……因此，我只得将就使用来自下方楼层的织物。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.en: The Alterationist of the previous generation, whose hands created this armor, embarked on a runway venture long ago... And so I must bear with the weaving of fabrics that springeth from the realms below.
Dante
Le Noir's Brand Manager

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.zh: 汝等庇护的那孽物……终有一日会将这座百货公司啃食得连骨头都不剩。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.en: The abomination ye shelter... shall one day devour this department store down to its very bones.
Le Noir's Brand Manager

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.zh: 此事早有预言……那是如命运般注定的未来。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.en: Foretold it hath been... 'tis a future as fixed as fate.
Le Noir's Brand Manager

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.zh: 汝等难道不知，这生物的本质就是虚假？让开路，我便不将罪责归于汝等。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.en: Know ye not that the very essence of this creature lieth in falsity? Give me the way, and the blame shall not be laid at thy feet.
Yi Sang

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.zh: ……在我眼里，布布只是个满怀疑问的孩子，夹在本性和意志之间。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.en: ... To my eyes, Pwie is merely a child full of questions, caught between nature and volition.
Yi Sang

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.zh: 而且……我们不是许下了约定吗？约好在布布醒来时再见。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.en: And... did we not make a promise? A promise to meet them again at the time of their waking.
Gregor

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.zh: 对，约好了。所以说啊，承诺这种话可不能随便讲……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.en: Yup, we did. This is why you don't throw promises around lightly...
Le Noir's Brand Manager

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.zh: 汝等愚昧，已被那亵渎之物蛊惑。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.en: In thy folly, thou hast been bewitched by that profane creature.
Dante
Dante

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.zh: <如果她说的是真的，西西弗百货就会被耗尽……而我们又会走向同一个结局。>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.en: <If she's telling the truth, then Grand Magasin Sisyphe will be depleted... and we'll wind up at the same ending all over again.>
Dante

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-b1-b.json#.zh: 看来，我们的“美德”仍不足以进入5层。布布说，祂得披上黄金裹布，而地下楼层的某处有能加工皮革的人。去找那个人吧。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-b1-b.json#.en: Apparently, we're still lacking in "virtue" to enter 5F. Pwie said they need to wear a Golden Shroud, and that somewhere down on the underground floors, there's someone who can process hides. Let's head there.
Find the Ruminations of the Prey

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-b1-b.json#.zh: 要得到黄金之茧，我们得把猎物反刍肉带给地下1层的楼层经理屠夫。它应该就在附近。赶紧找到它吧。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-b1-b.json#.en: To obtain the Golden Cocoon, we need to bring the Ruminations of the Prey to Boucher, B1F's Floor Manager. It should be somewhere nearby. Let's find it quickly.
Find the Ruminations of the Prey

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-b1-b.json#.zh:
我们带着猎物反刍肉回到了美食广场。副主厨闻了布布几下后，突然向我们发动了攻击……

先制服副主厨。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-b1-b.json#.en:
We returned to the Food Court with the Ruminations of the Prey. After sniffing Pwie a few times, Sous Chef suddenly began attacking us...

First, let's subdue Sous Chef.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-b1-b.json#.zh: 与地下1层的楼层经理交谈

副主厨闻了布布几下后突然向我们发动了攻击，但听说我们带来了猎物反刍肉，她就冷静下来，并答应带我们见地下1层的楼层经理屠夫。

去和屠夫谈谈吧。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-b1-b.json#.en:
Sous Chef suddenly attacked us after sniffing Pwie a few times, but calmed down once she heard that we'd brought Ruminations of the Prey with us, and agreed to introduce us to Boucher, the Floor Manager at B1F.

Let's talk to Boucher.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-b1-b.json#.zh: 与地下1层的楼层经理交谈
将猎物反刍肉交给地下1层的楼层经理
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-b1-b.json#.en: Give the Ruminations of the Prey to B1F's Floor Manager

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-b1-b.json#.zh: 副主厨慌张地告诉我们，储藏室里的幼虫逃走了。它应该就在鱼市那头的岸边。别无他法，我们决定去那里找一只活幼虫。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-b1-b.json#.en: The Sous Chef, panicking, told us that the larva kept in the storage had escaped. It should be on the Shore just beyond the Fish Market. With no other options, we decided to head there and look for a living larva.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-b1-b.json#.zh: 我们到了岸边，无数幼虫正漂向大海。其中一只还在动。上前看看吧。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-b1-b.json#.en: We've reached the Shore, where countless larvae are drifting toward the sea. One of them is still moving. We should approach it.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-b1-b.json#.zh: 我们找到了一只还活着的幼虫。把它带回美食广场，交给副主厨。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-b1-b.json#.en: We found one that's still breathing. Take it back to the Food Court and hand it over to the Sous Chef.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-b1-b.json#.zh: 和上次一样，我们得到了黄金之茧……或者说，“蠕蠕”。下一站是布满自动扶梯的大厅。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-b1-b.json#.en: Just like last time, we've got ourselves a Golden Cocoon... or rather, "Wriggley". Next stop: the Escalator Hall packed with escalators.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-b1-b.json#.zh: 我们让布布挑了祂喜欢的自动扶梯。现在，来确认祂选的是哪一部。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-b1-b.json#.en: We let Pwie pick whichever escalator they liked. Now to define the escalator they chose.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-b1-b.json#.zh: 前往地下2层的自动扶梯
乘地下2层的自动扶梯下去吧。
前往地下2层的自动扶梯

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.zh: <这就意味着……我们做的一切都白费了。>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.en: <Which means... everything we've done will have been for nothing.>
Dante

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.zh: <……即便如此，而且……我说不清为什么，可我……我还是想保护布布。>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.en: <... Even still, and... I can't explain why, but I... I want to protect Pwie.>
Dante

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.zh: <因为现在……我的直觉，我的心，一直在催我这么做。>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.en: <Because right now... my gut, my heart—keeps telling me to.>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.zh: 持锤者全速向我们冲来，炽烈的光环灼痛了我们的双眼。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.en: The bearer of the hammer charged us at full speed, her blazing halo searing our eyes.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.zh: 就在同一瞬间，一个问题涌到了我那并不存在的嘴边。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.en: And in that same instant, a question rose to my proverbial mouth.
Dante
<Meursault?>
Meursault
Yes, Manager.
Dante
<Will I... will we come to regret this choice?>
Meursault
Meursault

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.zh: 会。我们后悔的概率很高。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.en: Yes. There is a high probability that we will.
Meursault
However... the important thing is—

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.zh: 一声雷鸣般的撞击淹没了默尔索后面的话。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.en: A thunderous impact drowned out the rest of Meursault's answer.
Gregor

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.zh: 所以……让我捋捋。我在洗手间听过大概情况，可我们基本上就是一路护送这个布——呃，布布这孩子上来。没错吧？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.en: So... lemme get this straight. I heard the rough version back in the restroom, but we've basically been playing chaperone for this P—uh, Pwie kid all the way up here. Is that about right?
Dante
<That's about right.>
Yi Sang

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.zh: 为迷路的孩子指引前路……乃是善举。百货公司毕竟最容易使人迷失方向……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.en: To have guided a lost child upon their way... was a kindly deed. Department stores are places most apt to swallow one's bearings, after all...
Gregor

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.zh: 不过这走廊也太他妈长了……看来前面还有得走。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.en: This corridor's pretty damn long, though... Looks like we've still got a hike ahead of us.
Light cascades in through the tall window.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.zh:
玻璃窗外的水中，鱼群悠然游过。

Schools of fish are swimming gently through the water beyond the glass window.
A large crowd is walking between the glass walls, exploring the aquatic life.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.zh: <……这些似乎是这座百货公司的历史。>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.en: <... These seem to be the history of this department store.>

Can't see anything.
Can't see anything.
Can't see anything.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.zh: 能看见一个模糊的形状。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.en: A blurry shape can be seen.
[Those Who Topple]
Light cascades in through the tall window.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.zh: [昔日高高升起之物，注定沉落。]
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.en: [What once rose high are fated to sink.]
Light cascades in through the tall window.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.zh: [奢华百货最深处的洼地。令人作呕、污秽不堪的沉渣。]
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.en: [The deepest basin of the extravagant department store. Nauseating, foul sediments.]
Light cascades in through the tall window.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.zh: [沿着线团的丝线走向出口，终点却只等来一截断线。]
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.en: [Though the clew's thread was followed to the exit, only the severed tip of string waited at the end.]
Light cascades in through the tall window.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.zh: [无法上升，无法放弃，丝线无休无止地纠缠。]
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.en: [Unable to rise, unable to forfeit, endlessly twining threads.]
Light cascades in through the tall window.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.zh: [一只手托着胀大的肚腹，另一只手托着饥渴的心。]
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.en: [One hand cradles the swollen belly; the other, the hungering mind.]
Light cascades in through the tall window.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.zh: [曾经尝过的滋味，再也无法寻回。]
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.en: [The flavor once reached, yet never to be found again.]
Light cascades in through the tall window.
[What are fleeting and passing are fragile things.]
Light cascades in through the tall window.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.zh: [在褪色的角落，等待归来的那一刻。]
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.en: [In a faded corner, waiting for the moment to return.]
Light cascades in through the tall window.
[Authority follows constriction by equal measure.]
Light cascades in through the tall window.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.zh: [目光纠缠得越紧，他们便跟随得越深。]
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.en: [The more the gaze entangles, the more do they follow along.]
Light cascades in through the tall window.
[Everyone needs faith.]
Light cascades in through the tall window.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.zh: [敬畏之心，往往留给那些死而犹生者。]
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.en: [The sense of awe is often reserved for those who are dead but living.]
Light cascades in through the tall window.
[None shall scorn those who have collapsed.]
Light cascades in through the tall window.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.zh: [至少，倒下是他们自己的选择。]
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.en: [At least, the decision to collapse was theirs.]
Light cascades in through the tall window.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.zh: [纵使一只手托着饥饿的肚腹，心灵依旧丰盈。]
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.en: [Though one hand may cradle the hungering belly, the mind prospers.]
Light cascades in through the tall window.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.zh: [饥饿无法被填满；它驱使人去寻找可以填补之物。]
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.en: [Hunger isn't filled; it is what one seeks out to fill.]
Light cascades in through the tall window.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.zh: [每走一步，便将一枚钉子钉入自己。]
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.en: [Nailing oneself with every step.]
Light cascades in through the tall window.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.zh: [朝圣的尽头，只剩下被众人的钉子钉住的那一个。]
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.en: [At the pilgrimage's end, only the one who has been pinned by the nails of the multitude remains.]
Light cascades in through the tall window.
[For what does one climb?]
Light cascades in through the tall window.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.zh: [明知等待自己的只有注定的坠落。]
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.en: [Knowing that only the fated descent awaits.]
Light cascades in through the tall window.
Light cascades in through the tall window.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.zh: 我盯着它看了一会儿，图案便开始舞动、荡漾。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.en: After fixing it in my gaze for a while, the patterns begin to dance and ripple.
Dante
<... This is...?>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.zh: 本不该看见的东西渐渐显露出来。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.en: Things that should not be visible begin to unveil themselves.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 五小时规则嘛……这还是能吃的……谁捡到归谁……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: 5 hour rule, man... It's still food... Finders keepers...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 他似乎正忙着整理布料。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: They appear occupied with arranging the fabric.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 哦。你们带来了一件极为珍贵的东西。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: Oh. You have brought a most precious thing indeed.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 愿你们下行一路顺利，陌生人。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: May your descent be untroubled, Strangers.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 愿你们下行一路顺利，陌生人。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: May your descent be untroubled, Strangers.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 早知道就多带一双手来了……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: Should've brought another pair of hands...
Who the hell are you people?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 我们很好奇，你在这里等什么。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: We are curious as to what you are awaiting here.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 得去地下3层剥下那些皮，搬回来。不知道怎么回事，最近补给一直没送到——
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: Need to strip the Hides from B3 and haul 'em back. Don't know why, but supplies haven't been coming through lately—

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: ……！等等。嘘……我又听见那个声音了！
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: ...! Wait. Shh... I can hear the Voice again!

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 红派搬运工从我们身边挤过去，贴在墙上，露出陶醉的笑容。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: The Rouge porter shoved past us, pressed themself against the wall, and broke into a blissful grin.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 其贴着墙，脸上带着陶醉的笑容。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: They are pressed against the wall with a blissful grin.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 我还以为走运了，轻轻松松过了五层就能歇会儿……看来没这回事啊。唉，算了。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: Felt lucky for a minute there; thought I'd get to rest after breezing through the fifth floor... So much for that, huh? Ah, well.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 我们离开没多久就回到休息室，大伙儿可闹翻了。说什么工作量不均、楼层抽签之类的……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: Everyone raised hell when we popped right back into the restroom so soon after leaving. Something about uneven workload, floor lottery, and all that...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 与此同时，李箱还因为觉得自己没出多少力，愁眉苦脸的。哈。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: And meanwhile, Yi Sang was looking downright glum because he felt he hadn't done enough. Hah.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 跟往常一样吧。堂吉诃德正给大家讲她的伟大冒险……也把这里的布布讲了个遍……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: Same as ever, I'd say. Don Quixote's regaling everyone with her grand adventures... telling them all about Pwie here, too...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 与我们初次遇见时相比，布布已经变得……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: Compared to when we first encountered them, Pwie has become...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-b2-b.json#.zh: 我们到达了地下2层。顾客们挤成一条长龙，等着购买黄金染料。去和上次跟我们交易过的裸体谈谈吧。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-b2-b.json#.en: We've arrived on B2F. A tightly packed line of customers is waiting for Golden Dye. Let's speak with Naked, the one we traded with before last time.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-b2-b.json#.zh: 我们到达了地下2层。顾客们挤成一条长龙，等着购买黄金染料。去和上次跟我们交易过的裸体谈谈吧。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-b2-b.json#.en: We've arrived on B2F. A tightly packed line of customers is waiting for Golden Dye. Let's speak with Naked, the one we traded with before last time.
Fight off the Le Noir assault
Get your bearings after the battle

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-b2-b.json#.zh: 黑派开始追杀我们了。眼下得找条路去更深的地下。去染色室问问调色板该怎么下去吧。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-b2-b.json#.en: The Noirs have started coming after us. For now, we need to find a way farther underground. Let's ask Palette in the Dyehouse how to get down.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-b2-b.json#.zh: 黑派开始追杀我们了。眼下得找条路去更深的地下。去染色室问问调色板该怎么下去吧。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-b2-b.json#.en: The Noirs have started coming after us. For now, we need to find a way farther underground. Let's ask Palette in the Dyehouse how to get down.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-b2-b.json#.zh: 调色板似乎需要地下2层楼层经理手中的彩色线团。前往线团之巢，完成调色板的委托吧。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-b2-b.json#.en: Palette appears to need the Colorful Skein held by the B2F's Floor Manager. Let's head to the Skein Nest to carry out Palette's request.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-b2-b.json#.zh: 更多黑派成员挡住了去路。清除他们，继续前进。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-b2-b.json#.en: More Noirs stand in the way. We should clear them out and press onward.
Press onward to the Skein Nest

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-b2-b.json#.zh: 挡路的黑派成员已经解决了。动身前往线团之巢吧。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-b2-b.json#.en: The Noirs blocking the way have been dealt with. Let's make for the Skein Nest.
Press onward to the Skein Nest

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-b2-b.json#.zh: 与地下2层楼层经理交谈
我们到了线团之巢。去和地下2层的楼层经理谈谈吧。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-b2-b.json#.en: We've arrived at the Skein Nest. Let's speak with B2F's Floor Manager.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-b2-b.json#.zh: 与地下2层楼层经理交谈
调色板似乎需要地下2层楼层经理手中的彩色线团。前往线团之巢，完成调色板的委托吧。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-b2-b.json#.en: Palette appears to need the Colorful Skein held by the B2F's Floor Manager. Let's head to the Skein Nest to carry out Palette's request.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-b2-b.json#.zh: 前往地下3层的自动扶梯
调色板遵守承诺，告诉了我们通往地下3层的自动扶梯在哪里。去那里继续向下吧。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-b2-b.json#.en: Palette kept her word and told us where to find the escalator to B3F. Let's head there and continue downward.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-b2-b.json#.zh: 前往地下3层的自动扶梯
我们到了自动扶梯。搭乘它前往地下3层吧。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-b2-b.json#.en: We've reached the escalator. Let's take it down to B3F.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 我不确定浮士德说的是我们之间的实际距离，还是所谓的情谊……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: I could not tell whether Faust meant the physical distance between us, or our camaraderie, so to speak...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 行吧……所以这套班底要去地下楼层的某处找皮革大厅，对吧？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: All right, then... So this lineup's supposed to track down the Leather Hall somewhere on the basement floors, huh?
<Right. We need to have clothes made for Pwie...>
<Why are you looking at me like that?>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 您似乎已下定决心，要继续走下去。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: You appear to be proceeding with conviction.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 您确信，唯有采取这条路线，任务才能按计划推进。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: You are confident that this course of action—and no other—is the necessary one for the mission to advance according to plan.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 我不知道自己还能向罪人们隐瞒真相多久……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: I didn't know how much longer I could continue hiding the truth from the Sinners...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 但即便如此，我的判断仍未改变：暂时别告诉他们清算的事更好。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: But even so, my judgment remained unchanged: it was better not to tell them about the Liquidation for the time being.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 有些罪人似乎通过各自的方式察觉到了，但……我想，没人能像默尔索和我一样，把那件事记得如此清楚，如此可怕。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: Some Sinners seemed to have caught on to it in their own ways, but... I'd say none of them could recall it with the same terrible clarity as Meursault and I.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 除了心里挥之不去的不安，还有休息室里那位女士留下的隐晦警告。在彻底弄明白她的意思之前，我没法把这件事告诉其他人。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: Aside from the gnawing unease in my gut, there was also that cryptic warning that the lady in the restroom gave us—until I fully understand what she meant, I can't share this with the rest of the team.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: <我们还需要默尔索再次“定义”自动扶梯，才能下到地下2层。但我觉得事情不会只有这么简单。>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: <We need Meursault to "define" the escalator again to go down to B2. But I doubt that's all there is to it.>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: ……是的，经理。我们还需要那个向中心移动并发出光芒的茧……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: ... No, Manager. We will also require the cocoon... that advanced toward the center and emitted light.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 陷入循环唯一的好处……就是我比平常更快摸清了情况。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: The sole benefit of running in a loop... was that I could get my bearings far more quickly than I would've been able to otherwise.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 对啊，这个“茧”到底是什么意思，经理兄？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: Yeah, what's this "cocoon" supposed to mean, Manager Bud?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: <现在同一个问题还立体声似的传过来了……>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: <Now I'm getting the same question in stereo...>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 那是我们继续向地下行进所需的机关。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: It is the mechanism required for us to continue our descent belowground.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 这样啊……你们是在上面某一层知道的？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: Right... And this is something you learned up on one of the higher floors?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: ……我明白了。可一只虫子跟启动自动扶梯有什么关系？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: ... I see. But what's a bug got to do with getting an escalator running?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: ……不止我一个人在想这个吧？是吧？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: ... I'm not the only one wondering that, am I? Am I?
I know where it is located.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 以我们面前这部自动扶梯的位置为参照，它应该存放在东南方肉铺的储藏区。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: Taking the relative location of the escalator we are facing as our point of reference, it should be stored in the butcher shop's storage area to the southeast.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: ……这、这也太精确了吧？咦，我想连浮士德女士都没给我们报过精确到方位的地点。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: ... Th-that's awfully precise, isn't it? Huh. I don't think even Frau Faust has ever dropped a location on us down to the compass point like that.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 两种方法在本质上不同，因此将此事与浮士德的做法相比并不合理。更准确的描述应当是……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: The two methods are categorically dissimilar, so comparing this to Faust's process is irrational. A more accurate characterization would be...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: <他、他只是把周围的人问了个遍。就这样。>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: <H-he just did a very thorough job asking around. That's all.>
