RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 管它是怎么找到的，路已经明摆着了。走吧。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: Well, whatever got us there, we've got a straight road ahead. Let's take it.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 不！看那个钱包——他们肯定是红派！
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: No! Look at that wallet—they've got to be the Rouges!

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 不管是哪派，他们的阶级显然比我们高……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: Either way, they're clearly in higher tiers than us...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 他、他们看见我们了。要跑吗？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: Th-they saw us. Should we run?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 不用。他们显然很有钱。说不定肯给我们几个眼球……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: No. They're obviously loaded. Maybe they'd be willing to give us a few eyeballs...
Why are they scared of us?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 大概因为我们跟他们长得完全不一样。这里的氛围跟上面几层不同……要说的话，更像后巷……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: Probably because we don't look anything like them. The air down here is different from the upper floors... more like the Backstreets, if I had to make a comparison...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: <照平时的做法，我们会拦住那两个家伙，尽量从他们嘴里套出情报……>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: <Normally, we'd stop those two and squeeze whatever information we could out of them...>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 但这次，我们已经知道茧在哪里了。也就是说……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: But this time, we already know where the cocoon is. Which means...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: <……别管他们了，去拿猎物反刍肉吧。>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: <... Let's leave them alone and collect the Ruminations of the Prey.>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 他们没理我们……太好了……低着头。别给他们回头看的理由……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: They're ignoring us... Good... Keep your eyes down. Don't give them a reason to look back...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.zh: 曾经传达神谕的执事，已逃避了自己的职责。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.en: The deacon who once conveyed God's words has absconded the responsibility.
Meursault
... Pwie is alone.
Meursault

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.zh: 经理，我们必须尽快赶回餐厅。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.en: We must return to the restaurant as quickly as our feet would take us, Manager.
Dante

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.zh: <它追着我们来了。准确地说……它追的是布布。>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.en: <It came after us. It... came after Pwie, to be precise.>
Meursault

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.zh: 它想必是黄金之茧——我们给它起名叫蠕蠕——的亲代。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.en: It must be the Golden Cocoon's—Wriggley, by our designation—parent entity.
Dante

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.zh: <我记得……它循着茧“哼哧哼哧”的声音追来了。>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.en: <I remember... It came after us, having followed its "snuffling".>
Dante
Dante

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.zh: <现在先专心想想怎么打倒它。>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.en: <For now, let's focus only on how we can defeat it.>
Dante
<Pwie's waiting for us.>
Yi Sang

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.zh: 嗯……它的形体在黑暗中消失得无影无踪，过去与现在皆寻不到它的存在……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.en: Mm... Its form disappeared traceless in the dark, its presence in both past and present nowhere to be found...
Gregor

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.zh: 对，接着它又突然冒了出来。更糟的是，能碰到的只有那条像尾巴的东西，想打中它都难。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.en: Yeah, then it popped right back into existence. And to make matters worse, it was hard to get a hit in with the only reachable part of its body that tail-like thing.
Meursault

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.zh: 黑暗不足为惧。保持冷静，我们便能抢占先机。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.en: Darkness is not so significant a deterrent. Remain calm, and we will outmaneuver it.
Dante
<... Good. Let's take this on with a cool head.>
Light cascades in through the tall window.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.zh: [漂流者。他们任由自己随水流而去。]
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.en: [The drifters. They allow themselves to be carried by the currents of the flow.]
Light cascades in through the tall window.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.zh: [停泊者。他们用黑色织物将自己钉在原地。]
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.en: [The anchored. They have pinned themselves down with black fabric.]
Light cascades in through the tall window.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.zh: [固定者。他们将内在钉到外侧，从而固定住自己的外表。]
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.en: [The affixed. They have pinned what lies inside on the outside, thereby affixing their outward appearances.]

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.zh: <color=#cf0000>西西弗百货中的所有人，听我说。</color>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.en: <color=#cf0000>Hear me, all who dwell within the Grand Magasin.</color>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.zh: <color=#cf0000>布菲终于开席了。从今以后，你们谁也不用再刮着空盘子过活……</color>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.en: <color=#cf0000>At long last, the Buffet is served. Let none among you ever scrape an empty plate again...</color>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.zh: <color=#cf0000>……而我们——我——会将这座百货公司从地基到顶端，吞个干净。</color>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.en: <color=#cf0000>... and we—I—shall devour this department store from foundation to apex.</color>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.zh: <color=#cf0000>不必再等。不必再哭。不必再……渴望。</color>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.en: <color=#cf0000>Wait no longer. Weep no longer. Desire... no longer.</color>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.zh: <color=#cf0000>撕开，嚼碎。眼前的一切，一口都别剩。</color>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.en: <color=#cf0000>Tear and chew. Leave not a morsel before your eyes.</color>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.zh: <color=#cf0000>来吧，到五楼加入我。大门会向所有人敞开。那些曾经不给我们吃的美食，我们一同吃个遍。</color>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.en: <color=#cf0000>Come, join me on the fifth floor. The doors will be open for everyone. Let us feast upon every delicacy they kept beyond our reach.</color>
<color=#cf0000>Let the banquet begin!</color>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.zh: <color=#cf0000>黑派、褐派、红派。美妆馆的虚荣，奢侈品馆的大理石装饰。广播室的喇叭，家具馆的聚光灯。美食广场的屠夫，染色室滴落的脓液。搁浅在海岸的东西、被丢弃的皮革，还有塞满每一道墙缝的黄金皮革……</color>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.en: <color=#cf0000>Le Noir, Le Kaki, Le Rouge. The vanities of the Beauty Hall, the marble deco of the Luxury Hall. The trumpets of the Public Address Room and the limelights of the Furniture Hall. Boucher of the Food Court and droplets of pus from the Dyehouse. Beached things of the Shore, discarded hides, and the Golden Hide packed into every crack in the wall...</color>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.zh: <color=#cf0000>全都摆上我的餐桌。让我们一起吃，一起喝。</color>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.en: <color=#cf0000>Let all of it be laid upon my table. Let us eat and drink together.</color>
Meursault
... Do you not feel the need to move forward anymore?
Buffet

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.zh: 这里什么都能填满。饿了就吃，渴得喉咙发烫就喝。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.en: Everything can be filled here. We can eat when we're hungry, and drink when our throats burn with thirst.
Buffet

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.zh: 终有一天……我们会把自己填得满满当当，连想往前走的念头都无处容身。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.en: And in time... we will have filled ourselves to the point where there will be no room left for the wish to move forward.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.zh: 我们找遍了广阔餐桌的每一处，却没找到通往六楼的路。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.en: We searched every reach of the vast tabletop, but found no path to the sixth floor.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.zh: 无处可去，我们便坐到一旁，看布菲大快朵颐。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.en: With nowhere left to go, we sat off to one side and watched as Buffet feasted.
*crunch*

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.zh: 布菲吞下的第一样东西，是待取餐盘里的一片面包。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.en: The first thing Buffet swallowed was a single slice of bread from a waiting plate.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.zh: 接着是一块淌着肉汁的牛排……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.en: Next came a steak slick with running juice...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.zh: 然后，一只装饰得精致无瑕的巨大蛋糕，也在布菲嘴里消失，连一点碎屑都没留下。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.en: Then an enormous cake, decorated with immaculate care, vanished into Buffet's mouth without leaving so much as a crumb.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.zh: 再往后……我们已经分不清布菲在嚼什么，更别说布菲究竟把什么当成了食物。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.en: After that... it became impossible to tell what Buffet was chewing, let alone what Buffet had decided was food.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.zh: 盘子。勺子和刀叉。桌布……不分彼此，全都消失在布菲饥渴的大嘴里。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.en: Plates. Spoons and knives. The tablecloth... everything, without distinction, disappear into Buffet's ravenous mouth.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.zh: 嘴里上一口还没咽下，布菲的手就抓向了下一样东西……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.en: Buffet's hands close around the next thing before they've even finished swallowing whatever was in their mouth before...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.zh: ……仿佛连稍作停顿、品尝滋味，都是饥饿的布菲负担不起的奢侈。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.en: ... as though even the brief pause required to enjoy the flavor and taste were a luxury their hunger could not afford.
Light cascades in through the tall window.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.zh: 一座广场辽阔得几乎望不到边。广场中央立着一栋高楼，楼下人来人往，步履匆忙。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.en: There is a large plaza, so vast that its edges can barely be fathomed. At the center of the plaza stands a tall building, and at its base people come and go in busy strides.
Light cascades in through the tall window.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.zh:
一丝微光穿过幽暗而逼仄的隧道。墙边堆满罐头，使原本狭窄的通道更加局促。
人们在这更像洞穴爬道的通路里爬行。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.en:
Faint ray of light shimmers through the gloom of the stiflingly narrow tunnel. There are mounds of cans sitting along the walls, constricting the already cramped hallway.
People are crawling through the passage that is more like a cavernous crawl space.
Light cascades in through the tall window.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.zh: 人们互相叫喊。听不清他们在喊什么，但……那场面让人想起一场审判。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-5-b.jso.en: People are shouting and hollering at each other. It is hard to make out what it is they are yelling about, but... the sight is reminiscent of a trial.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: J-just hurry up and go away...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 为了省得再被一连串同样的问题轰炸，我压低声音……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: To spare myself another volley of identical questions, I lowered my voice to a whisper...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: ……领着大家径直走过那些在身后嘀咕的居民。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: ... And led everyone straight past the residents muttering in our wake.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 他们都在往嘴里猛塞什么呢？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: What are they all shoveling into their mouths like that?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: ……一种最便宜的食物，仅用于压制饥饿感。它会再现……食用者记忆中的味道。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: ... The cheapest available foodstuff, consumed solely to suppress hunger. It recreates... flavors retained in the consumer's memory.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 随着问号越冒越多，默尔索不知为何显得比平时还疲惫了一点。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: Meursault somehow looked a fraction more tired than usual as the question marks kept on multiplying.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: <也许我们能在下面找到布布真正能吃的东西？>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: <Maybe we can find something down here that Pwie can actually eat?>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: ……你带了陌生人来。怎么了，主厨？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: ... You brought strangers with you. What is it, Head Chef?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 是副主厨，不是主厨，听见没？我上次升职了，听见没？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: It's Sous Chef; not Head Chef, you hear? I got promoted last time, you hear?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: *叹气*……是。你从副主厨升为了主厨。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: *sigh*... Yes. You were promoted from Sous Chef to Head Chef.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 可副主厨听着更气派，听见没？所以我是升职当了副主厨，听见没？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: But Sous Chef sounds fancier, you hear? Which means I was promoted to Sous Chef, you hear?
... Why have you come here, Sous Chef?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 这些陌生人……他们说愿意把……那个……贡献给我们的苏打，听见没？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: These strangers... they said they'd contribute... that... to our soda, you hear?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: ……别再炖句子了，快端上来吧。是什么食材？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: ... Stop braising the sentence and serve it already. What ingredient is it?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 猎物反刍肉！就是屠夫总挂在嘴边的那种食材……听见没？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: Ruminations of the Prey! The ingredient Boucher is always talking about... you hear?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 啊……我记得那块肉。它的味道简直令人陶醉。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: Ah... I remember that cut of meat. Its flavor was nothing short of ecstatic.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: ……陌生人和蠕蠕会觉得被冷落的。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: ... The strangers and Wriggley are gonna feel left out.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 嗯……那就让蠕蠕加入。正好三个。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: Hmm... Then Wriggley can join. That makes three.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 其他蠢货宁可死也不肯闭嘴。他们自有办法应付被落下的恐惧。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: The other fools would rather die than stop talking. They'll survive the fear of missing out in their own way.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 好。那么……游戏现在开始，布布。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: Good. Then... game starts now, Pwie.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 哦？你们这些陌生人是从上面的楼层下来的吧？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: Oh? You strangers came down from the upper floors, didn't you?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 再跟这些拿针的蠢货困在一起一分钟，我也要变成蠢货了。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: Another minute trapped beside these pin-holding idiots and I might end up an idiot, too.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 我本来就不该被扣在这里。我得拿到黄金染料，然后上楼……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: I was never supposed to be held here. I have to get the Golden Dye and head upstairs...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: *叹气*我的意思是……我来说明情况。我们黑派现在全面戒备。既然你们来自地上，肯定也察觉到了。局势……越来越紧张，像是随时会爆发什么。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: *sigh* What I'm saying is... Let me explain the situation. We Noirs are on full alert right now. Surely you've noticed, if you're from above ground. Things are... getting tense, like something's about to blow.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: <他现在倒跟我们套起近乎来了？>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: <He's all buddy-buddy with us now, huh?>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 看来他是根据我们迄今购买和收集的物品，推断出了我们的身份。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: He appears to have inferred our status from the items we have purchased and collected so far.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: <就是说，我们看起来像是有钱挥霍，对吧？>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: <So, basically, we look like we've got money to splurge, is it?>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 要安安静静！针不能停下来不缝。王醒过来，会骂我们的……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: Need to be quiety-quiet! Needles can't stop sewing. King wakey-wake, we'll get scolded...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 我说了闭嘴！外面那些红派在搞什么都不知道，现在还担心针线活有什么用！
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: Shut up, I said! Fat lot of good it'll do worrying about needlework when there's no telling what the Rouges are up to out there!

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 瞧见没？这些蠢货对这层楼以外的事一无所知，却偏偏话多得很。简直能把人逼疯。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: See? For idiots who know nothing about what's going on beyond this floor, they sure like to run their mouth. It's enough to drive a man crazy.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 我要拿到黄金染料，献给我们的大老板，以无可置疑的方式证明我对黑派的忠诚。这样一来，我大概也能获准开一家属于自己的黑派店铺。我连自己品牌的设计都想好了！
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: I'll secure the Golden Dye, present it to our big boss, and prove my loyalty to Le Noir beyond dispute. Once that's done, I'll probably be given the right to open my very own Noir store, too. I already have the designs for my own label in my mind!

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 但首先……我必须找到虚假之声。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: But first... I must locate the False Voice.
... Is that why the entire corridor is under lockdown?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 对。命令是从最高层下来的。有人偷偷潜入这里，藏起并保护那个发出虚假之声的怪物。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: Yeah. Word came down from the very top. Some people snuck in here to hide and protect the abomination that speaks the False Voice.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 我申请不列入搜查名单，但看来为了保险起见，我也得跟所有人一样接受检查。黑派就是这样——坚决而彻底，绝无例外。毕竟，我们为百货商店而存在，也是百货商店允许我们存在。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: I asked to be left off the search list, but it looks like I'm to be checked along with everyone else, just in case. That's Le Noir for you—stalwartly thorough, no exceptions. We exist for the department store, and it is the department store that permits us to exist, after all.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 嗯……他们打算搜查这里的每一个人？那得花上相当长的时间。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: Hm... So they intend to search every last person here? That will take a considerable amount of time.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 对。抓到那些混蛋之前，我们谁也别想离开这里一步。看看那些疯子让我们这些正派人遭了什么罪。连把自己的一切都奉献给维护西西弗百货都做不到……真可耻，对吧？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: Yeah. Until we catch those bastards, none of us are getting so much as a single step out of here. Look at what those lunatics are putting decent people like us through. As if failing to devote every ounce of themselves to preserving the Grand Magasin weren't bad enough... Shame on them, right?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 不过，能遇到你们这样有教养、能说得上话的地上顾客，也算我走运。反正你们和我都被困在这儿……何不趁机聊些高雅的话题？就从黑派的历史说起——
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: Still, at least I've had the good fortune of meeting some cultured above-ground customers I can actually hold a conversation with. Well, you people and I are both stuck here, so... why don't we take the chance to talk about some refined subjects? Let us begin with the history of Le Noir—

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 在那之前……这层下面还有别的楼层吗？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: Before we get to that... are there any more floors beneath this one?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: ……就算有，那也不是我们这种人该去的地方。为什么问这个？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: ... Even if there were, they'd be no place for people like us. Why do you ask?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 那么，说吧，陌生人。你们想换什么？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: So, speak then, strangers. What do you want in exchange?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 我们要求一道用黄金之茧烹制的菜肴——那是一只搁浅在岸边的幼虫。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: We demand a dish cooked with the Golden Cocoon—a larva that has stranded ashore.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 哈。听你这口气，好像早就知道我储藏室里有只活幼虫在蠕动。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: Hah. You speak as though you already know there's a living larva squirming in my storage.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 那边那个火焰头是你们的主厨吗？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: Is the flambé-head over there your Head Chef?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 你们看起来不像会拿食材虚张声势的人。好吧，成交。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: You don't strike me as the sort to bluff about ingredients. Very well—a bargain it is.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 将“猎物反刍肉”交给了屠夫。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: Handed over the "Ruminations of the Prey" to Boucher.
Now that is what I call "downright delectable."

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 有了它，往后好几季，我都能把大伙儿喂到肚皮撑破——说不定还能更撑。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: This should give me something to feed everyone to the point of bursting—and maybe even beyond that—for seasons to come.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 瞧瞧这肉汁，听见没……？看着又香又甜，听见没？能吃上这个，简直像美梦端上了盘子，听见没？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: Look at that meaty juice, you hear...? Looks so yummy, so sweet, you hear? Getting to eat this is like a dream on a plate, you hear?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 副主厨。去储藏室拿一只幼虫给他们。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: Sous Chef. Bring a larva from the storage and give it to them.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 还有，别像上次那样偷尝食材。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: And no secretly sampling any ingredients like last time.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 那只是品控，检查一下它们新不新鲜，听见没？！
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: That was just quality control to check how fresh they were, you hear?!

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 你们在这儿等等，听见没？
出什么事了？怎么愁眉苦脸的？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: Something happen? Why the long face?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 储藏室里唯一活下来的幼虫——它逃走了，听见没……？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: The one and only surviving larva in storage—it's escaped, you hear...?
<This... isn't how things went last time...>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 与之前唯一明显的区别……就是我们这次更早到了地下1层。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: The only obvious difference from before... was that we had reached B1 much sooner.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-5-b.json#Q.zh: 我们终于和布布一起到达了五楼。不知道这一层会遇到什么，继续探索吧。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-5-b.json#Q.en: We finally reached 5F with Pwie. There's no telling what we'll encounter on this floor, but we should keep exploring.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-5-b.json#Q.zh: 看来我们的“美德”还不足以进入五楼。布布说自己需要穿上黄金裹布，而地下楼层的某处，有人能加工皮革。去那里看看吧。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-5-b.json#Q.en: Apparently, we're still lacking in "virtue" to enter 5F. Pwie said they need to wear a Golden Shroud, and that somewhere down on the underground floors, there's someone who can process hides. Let's head there.
Head to the Inner Part of 5F

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-5-b.json#Q.zh:
监工做好了黄金皮革衣服，布布终于能穿上它。然而，吞下蠕蠕后，布布看起来一点也不高兴。
……该前往五楼了。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-5-b.json#Q.en:
The Overseer completed the Golden Hide, allowing Pwie to don clothing made from it. Pwie, however, doesn't seem glad at all after devouring Wriggley.
... It's time to head to 5F.
Head to the Inner Part of 5F
Face the Noir Blocking the Path

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-5-b.json#Q.zh: 我们挡住了五楼敌人的猛攻。现在该往里面走，伸手触碰帘幕了。布布穿着黄金裹布，这次或许会有不同的结果。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-5-b.json#Q.en: We dealt with the onslaught of enemies on 5F. Now it's time to head to the inside and lay our hands on the curtain. With the Golden Shroud on Pwie, things may turn out different this time.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-5-b.json#Q.zh: 挡路的黑派品牌经理必须打倒。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-5-b.json#Q.en: We need to defeat the Le Noir Brand Manager who's standing in the way.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-5-b.json#Q.zh:
茧终于裂开。
看看布菲会变成什么样吧。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-5-b.json#Q.en:
The cocoon finally parted.
Let's see what Buffet will transform into.
Keep Observing Buffet until the End

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-5-b.json#Q.zh: 我们得以穿过此前挡住五楼去路的帘幕。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-5-b.json#Q.en: We were able to venture beyond the curtain that had been blocking our path on 5F.
Protect the Cocoon from the Le Noir Onslaught

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-5-b.json#Q.zh:
布布说自己很累，随后睡着并变成了一只茧。黑派似乎发现了茧的位置，一小支队伍赶来要摧毁它。

保护布布。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-5-b.json#Q.en:
Pwie told us they were feeling tired moments before they fell asleep and became a cocoon. Seemingly having discovered the cocoon's location, a small army of Le Noir have arrived here to destroy it.

Let's protect Pwie.
Protect the Cocoon from the Le Noir Onslaught
We should deal with the Blackthread and open the path.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 不过严格来说，我想也不只这一处区别……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: Well, not the only difference, strictly speaking, I guess...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: ……也许你该把库存盯紧点。你不是在这里工作吗？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: ... Maybe you should've kept a closer eye on your inventory. Don't you work here?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 我……我有好好清点，听见没……？只是有点奇怪，听见没？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: I... I did keep a proper track, you hear...? Something is just strange, you hear?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 怪得能把苏打的气泡都吓跑，听见没……？除非能穿墙，不然储藏室根本没有出口，听见没？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: Strange enough to spook the fizz off the soda, you hear...? There aren't any ways out of the storage unless you can pass through the walls, you hear?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 可是……它确实出去了……难道它能穿墙……？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: But... it did get out... Does that mean it can pass through walls...?
I have no idea, you hear...?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: *呜咽* 要是让屠夫知道……我就要从副主厨降职成副主厨了，听见没？到时候又只能靠最上层撇出来的淡苏打勉强过活，听见没……？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: *whimper* If Boucher ever finds out... I'm going to get demoted to Sous Chef from Sous Chef, you hear? Then I'll be scraping by on watery soda skimmed from the top layer again, you hear...?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 我们去哪里能找到那只幼虫？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: Where can we find the larva?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 逃走的幼虫只会去一个地方，听见没？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: There's only one place an escaped larva would run to, you hear?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 但你们得快点，听见没？那只幼虫去那里，就是想听着海浪声死去，听见没？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: But you must hurry, you hear? That larva's gone there to die while listening to the waves, you hear?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 你是说这地下还有海滩？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: Are you saying there's a beach down here?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 哦，那右边开口漏出来的沙子一定是从那里来的……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: Oh, then that must be where the sand leaking from the opening on the right came from....

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 穿过鱼市就能到岸边，听见没？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: Pass through the fish market to find the Shore, you hear?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 现在去把幼虫带回来，听见没？死幼虫没用，听见没？得让它活着，听见没？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: You go now bring the larva back, you hear? Dead larva is useless, you hear? It has to stay alive, you hear?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 把活幼虫带回来，屠夫就能把它烹得恰到好处，听见没？滋滋作响，咕嘟咕嘟……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: Bring the larva back alive, and Boucher will cook it to perfection, you hear? Sizzle sizzle, simmer simmer...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: <他们……呃……好像是在钓鱼。严格来说。>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: <They're... uh.... fishing, it looks like. Technically.>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 海浪声夹带着腐烂的气味。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: The sound of surf brings with it the smell of putrefaction.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 差点能以假乱真了，是吧？闭上眼，几乎能想象自己在海滨度假……直到那股味道直冲鼻子。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: Almost convincing, isn't it? Shut your eyes, and you could almost imagine yourself at a seaside resort... right up until the smell punches you in the nose.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 你们看起来开心了点。为什么？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: You all look a little happier. Why?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 嗯……说到海滩，人首先会想到度假和旅行吧？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: Well... 'cause vacations and trips are the first things that spring to mind when it comes to beaches, I suppose?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: <不过，这片海滩的水……呃，是黑色的。>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: <The water at this beach is... uh, black, though.>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 这种物质也不符合水的物理特征。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: The substance does not conform to the physical characteristics of water either.
What are those things floating out there?
Larvae trying to sink themselves back into the sea.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 如你们所知，万物都源自大海。幼虫在陆地上活够了，就会渴望回到出生的地方。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: As you may know, everything springs forth from the sea. For larvae, once they've had their fill of living on land, they begin to long to return to the place they came from.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 那些则是等不及了，急着回去的……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: And those are the impatient ones, trying to hurry their return...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-npc-floor-5-b-enemy.js.en: Le Noir Contemporary Hall Sales Associate
Le Noir Contemporary Hall Sales Associate

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 如果那些疯子真的潜入了这里……他们可能会往更深的地下走，以躲过搜查。那么，首要任务就该是封锁下去的通道。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: If those lunatics truly infiltrated this place... they may attempt to evade the search by heading farther underground. In which case, the first priority should be sealing off the route down.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: <这种时候，我真庆幸奥提斯不是我们的敌人。>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: <Times like this, I'm just so relieved that Outis isn't our enemy.>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: ……聪明得吓人。我刚才都起鸡皮疙瘩了！
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: ... frighteningly clever. I actually got chills just now!

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 不过放心。你们找不到去更深地下的路。我听说那条通道很久以前就封了。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: But don't you worry. You won't find any way farther underground. I heard the route was sealed off a long time ago.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 对了……你们一直带着的那个东西。别告诉我，那是黄金之茧？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: By the way... that thing you've been carrying around. Don't tell me that's a Golden Cocoon?
Ooh... now that's a nice feel.
... Cut it out. You're hurting Wriggley.
Enough. Touch it again, and I'll S.Y.N.—
... C.-ed. Not bad at all. Well done, Pwie.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 那个声音……那个样子……你就是虚假之人……！
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: That voice... that form... You're the False One...!

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 等、等等！你们要把我带去哪儿，你们这些低等的——住、住手！
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: W-wait! Where do you think you're taking me, you inferior—s-stop!

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: <我们快离开这里。黑派随时会涌进这条走廊。>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: <Let's make ourselves scarce. The Noirs will be swarming this corridor any second.>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 蠕蠕和我几乎同时出了声。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: Wriggley and I broke silence at nearly the same instant.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 我们已经确认还有更深的地下楼层……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: We have confirmed that more basement levels exist...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 但我们找不到通往那里的路，也不知道黑派会追我们多久……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: But we have no way to reach them, and we do not know how long the Noirs will keep pursuing us...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: <……我知道一个人，她或许愿意帮我们。>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: <... I know someone who might be willing to help us.>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: <唔……要说信任，我也说不准，但她大概不是黑派的人。>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: trusted, but she probably isn't on the Noirs' side.>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 我们在染色室遇见的调色板……不属于任何派系，对我们也没有表现出敌意。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: Palette, whom we had met in the Dyehouse... belonged to no faction and had shown no hostility toward us.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: <她给我的感觉就是……随波逐流。>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: <She seemed like the sort who simply... went with the flow.>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 运气好的话，你们也许还能找到一只命悬一线的。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: Well, with some luck, you may still find one with breath clinging by a thread.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 不过，幼虫究竟是正被冲上岸，还是被带回海里，谁也说不准……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: There's no way to tell, though, if a larva is washing ashore or being carried back out....

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: ……因为它们源自比大百货更古老的东西。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: ... because they come from something that's even older than the Grand Magasin.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 我们走近布布指的幼虫。它正艰难地一口接一口喘着微弱的气。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: We approached the larva Pwie pointed at. It was drawing one thin, desperate breath after another.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 我们找到它的时间比预想中早了许多。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: We located it considerably sooner than expected.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 副主厨没夸张。再晚几分钟，这只也会和水里漂着的那些一样了。我的意思是，它看着就剩一口气……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: Sous Chef wasn't exaggerating. A few minutes later and this one would've joined the rest bobbing out there in the water. I mean, it looks barely alive...
<Yeah... It looks like it's running on fumes.>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 与上次见到它时相比，它的活动范围已显著缩小。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: Its range of movement has decreased markedly since the last time we saw it.
Like how I was last time.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: <布布无意间就能让人内疚起来……>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: <Pwie really knows how to guilt trip without meaning to...>
I don't want to watch things hurting.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 原来如此。你们在海滩上找到一只搁浅的。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: So. You found a stranded one on the beach.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 我还以为没有哪只剩下最后一口气了。可怜的小东西。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: I didn't think any still had breath to lose. Poor thing.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 小心点。岸边到处都是饿疯的居民，为了那份收获，他们会把彼此撕碎。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: Keep your guard up. The Shore is crawling with starved residents who'd tear each other apart for that catch.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 那么……今天会是哪条臭鱼上钩呢……？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: Now then... which stinking fish will take the hook today...?
... What...? That's... a larva... How did you...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 把它交出来……我拿眼球换。什么都行……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: Hand it over... I'll trade you eyeballs. Anything...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 这东西……在这里有那么值钱？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: Is this thing... worth its weight in gold down here?
... We are not considering relinquishing the larva.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 那浓稠的灰色汤汁……我又能尝到了……直接从活的身上榨出汁水……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: That heavy gray broth... I could taste it again... Squeeze the juices straight from a living one...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 剁碎、切丁、翻炒……细碎的肉泥，汁水在齿间迸开……啊……我流口水了。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: Chop, dice, stir-fry... tiny pulps, bursting with juices between my teeth... aah... I'm salivating.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 别让他们带走它。他们会杀了它。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: Don't let them take it. They'll kill it.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 我本来也没打算不打就交出去。嗯？等等。你是在担心这只幼虫？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: Wasn't planning on handing it over without a fight. Hm? Hold on. You're worried about the larva itself?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 那……我们就从你们手里抢……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: Then... we'll take it from you...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 幸好你们及时救下了它，听见没？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: Glad you saved it in time, you hear?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 再晚一点，它就和大海融为一体了，听见没？你们动作比我想的还快，听见没？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: A moment later and it would've become one with the sea, you hear? You were more lickety-split than I thought, you hear?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 现在屠夫会像我说的那样，把它烹得恰到好处，听见没？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: Now, Boucher will cook it to perfection like I said, you hear?
Uh, what's the holdup, you hear?
Uh, Pwie... Aren't you gonna let go?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 如果我松手，它会怎么样？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: What's going to happen to it if I let go?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 看来那只幼虫将接受某种烹饪处理。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: It appears the larva will undergo a form of culinary processing.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 我不知道“处理”是什么意思。我只是不想让它痛。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: I don't know what "processing" means. I just don't want it to hurt.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 这可难办了……感觉像从孩子手里抢娃娃，可它还是活的……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: Now this is awkward... Feels like taking a doll from a baby, except it's alive...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 布布用两只小手抱紧幼虫，护着它贴在胸前。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: Pwie clutched the larva in their two tiny hands, pressing it protectively against their chest.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 默尔索单膝跪下，直到他和布布四目相对。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: Meursault lowered himself onto one knee until he and Pwie were looking directly into one another's eyes.
So I will tell you this:
Nothing bad will happen to it.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: ……你之前伤害过我。你也不会伤害它吗？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: ... You hurt me before. You aren't going to hurt it too?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 得到默尔索的保证后，布布才松开手，小心地把幼虫放进默尔索手中。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: Only after getting Meursault's reassurance did Pwie loosen their grip and carefully place the larva into Meursault's hands.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 你们是跑去找食材了吗？怎么这么久？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: Did you go out foraging for it or something? What took you so long?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 出了点小岔子，不过副主厨收拾得干干净净，听见没？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: There was a minor spill, but Sous Chef took care of it squeaky-clean, you hear?
Bring it here. I'll prepare it.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: ……从鱼市那群人为它发疯的样子来看，这东西可真是好食材啊……谢啦，伙计，肯把它让给我们。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: ... This thing must be quite an ingredient, from the way people went mad for it at the Fish Market... Thanks for letting us have it, pal.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 很多人误以为茧是我们厨师最爱的食材，但真正的厨师不会依赖茧。茧可以模仿任何想象得到的味道……可也仅此而已。只是骗舌头，让它以为那味道是真的。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: Many misunderstand that cocoons are the favorite ingredient of us chefs, but a true practitioner of our vocation doesn't rely on cocoons. Cocoons may imitate any flavor imaginable... but that's it. Just deceiving the tongue into believing that the flavor is real.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 我已经厌倦了吃谎言。我要用最上乘、最真实的食材，做出最上乘、最真实的菜肴。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: I've grown tired of eating a lie. Here's what I'll do: I will take the finest, the most genuine ingredient and make of it the finest, the most genuine dish.
Okay, then... Let's get to it.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 一道猩红的屏风落下，屠夫的剪影在炉火般明亮的火幕之后摇晃。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: A crimson screen dropped into place, leaving only Boucher's silhouette wavering behind a furnace-bright curtain of flame.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 火焰咆哮着蹿得更高。火中的剪影猛烈地抽动、扭曲，震得整面屏风都在颤抖。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: The fire roared higher. Within it, the silhouette jerked and twisted with such violence that the entire screen trembled.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: ……嘿，小家伙。一直盯着只会让你更担心。不如走开一会儿，去看看喷泉？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: ... Hey, champ. Staring at it's only gonna make you worry more. Why don't we step away and check out the fountain for a minute?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 没关系。我想继续看。而且……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: It's all right. I want to keep watching. Besides...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 如果他没有伤害它，我就知道它不会痛。不管看起来是什么样。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: If he's not hurting it, then I know it's not in pain. No matter how it looks.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 没别的事了吧？那就滚。我要干活了。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: No more business here, yes? Then piss off. I've work to do.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 陌生人连一口猎物反刍肉都别想吃到，听见没？*吸溜*
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: Won't let strangers get even a single bite of the Ruminations of the Prey, you hear? *slurp*

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 真是太可惜了。我本来也没想吃就是了……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: What a cryin' shame. Not that I wanted a bite in the first place...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 不，姐姐。这些人不是来偷我的眼泪的。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: No, Big sis. These people are not here to steal my tears.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 我姐姐不是人台。她只是一直都对我保护过头。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: My sister isn't a Mannequin. She's just always been overprotective of me.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 等等，你们在流汗吗？尽量别滴到我的调色板上。盐分会让颜色变浑浊。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: Wait, are you guys sweating? Try not to get any on my palette. The salt makes the colors murky.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: ……我们刚从一场紧急状况中脱身。好在黑派似乎还没踏进这里。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: ... We just escaped a rather urgent situation. Fortunately, it seems that the Noirs are yet to set foot in here.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 外面到底怎么了？顾客也突然不来了……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: What exactly is going on outside? The customers have suddenly stopped visiting as well...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 眼泪得及时挤破。憋得太久，会坏掉的。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: You need to burst those tears in time. Holding them in for too long can make things go bad.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 我们正在寻找通往地下3层的路。你能告诉我们怎么去吗？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: We are looking for a way to B3. Can you give us any information on how to get there?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 以前有路，但我把它堵上了。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: There used to be a way, but I blocked it.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 话说，你们为什么想去更深处？你们下来的地方，肯定比这里更适合生活吧……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: Why do you want to go deeper anyway? Wherever you came down from must be a much better place to live than down here...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 我确认一下……衣服是给孩子做的，不是给你们自己？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: Let me get this straight... You mean the clothes are for the kid, not you?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 嗯。我需要衣服。黄金皮革做的衣服。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: Mhm. I need clothes. Clothes made of Golden Hide.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: ……我见过很多拼命想给自己找衣服穿的人，但想给别人穿衣服的，还真没几个……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: ... I've seen plenty of people desperate to dress themselves, but there's hardly anyone who wants to dress someone else...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 看来你们确实是异乡人。
好吧，那么……我们来做笔交易。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: All right, then... Let's make a deal.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 其实，我也需要给姐姐做衣服。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: The truth is, I need clothes for my sister, too.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 好衣服要用好线……但我不要黄金线团。金色不合我的喜好。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: Good clothes need good thread... but I don't want a Golden Skein. Gold isn't my taste.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 我想要的是……颜色更丰富的东西。一个能好好吸收眼泪的线团。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: What I want is... something more colorful. A skein that can soak up tears well.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 而按照这层楼的规矩，只有楼层经理能拥有那么纯净的线团。偶尔会分几缕给黑派，但也只给黑派。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: And under this floor's rules, only the Floor Manager can have a skein that pure. A few strands are handed out to the Noirs now and then. Only the Noirs.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 这有什么烦人的？在这里……那就是常识。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: What's so annoying about it? Down here... that's just common sense.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 但对我们这些“异乡人”来说，这可不算常识。也就是说，如果我们从那位楼层经理手里夺取——失礼，取回线团……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: And yet, it is hardly common sense to us "strangers." Which means that if we take—excuse me—bring back the skein from that Floor Manager...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 你就会以此作为交换，打开通往下层的路，对吗？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: Then you will open the way down in exchange, is that correct?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: ……你们真的愿意为我这么做，异乡人？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: ... You'd really do that for me, strangers?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 嗯，我想……只要你们能把线团带来……那就行。我保证。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: Well, I suppose... If you can bring me the skein... then yes. I promise.
The Floor Manager is... in the Skein Nest.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: <黑派会挡住去路。得先冲过他们的防线。>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: <The Noirs will be blocking the route. We'll have to punch through them first.>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: ... It's smaller now. Its shape changed.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 幼虫原本所在的位置，一个新形成的茧正蠕动、搏动着。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: In place of the larva, a newly formed cocoon squirmed and pulsed.
You... want to give the bug a name?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 他似乎对它产生了很深的感情。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: They appear to have developed a significant emotional attachment to it.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 嗯。你们叫我“布布”。它也需要名字。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: Mhm. You call me "Pwie." This one needs a name, too.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: ……行吧，你的虫子你做主。挑个你喜欢的名字怎么样？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: ... Well, your bug, your call. How about you pick whatever feels right?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 蠕动蠕动蠕动蠕动蠕动蠕动……它就是这么动的。
简称“蠕蠕”比较合适。连续重复六次“蠕动”效率太低。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: "Wriggly" should be an appropriate compression. Repeating "wriggle" six consecutive times is inefficient.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: ……就这样，我们多了一位名叫蠕蠕的新伙伴。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: ... And just like that, we gained a new companion by the name of Wriggley.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 说是伙伴，它毕竟是一只不会说话、时不时还会莫名其妙尖叫的虫子，不过……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: It was, admittedly, a speechless insect prone to screaming incomprehensibly every once in a while, but...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 布布连这么小的虫子都愿意照顾，心肠真好……嗯，这孩子长大后肯定不一般。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: Pwie's got their heart in the right place, caring for such a tiny thing as a bug, even... Yeah, kid's gonna grow into something special.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 格里高尔对这个结论十分满意……至于原因，只有他自己知道。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: Gregor looked thoroughly pleased with this conclusion... for reasons known only to him.
<Our next stop is the escalator hall.>
<Good. This one it is. Down we go.>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 我想您不打算完整解释这些决定的依据……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: I assume you do not intend to explain the full basis of your decisions...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 不过，您似乎能预知未来，又意外熟悉这里，这些我们都注意到了。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: Nevertheless, your seeming prescience and unexpected familiarity with this place have not gone unnoticed.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 迄今为止，浮士德通常不会公开自己得出结论时所依据的具体推理过程……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: So far, I have generally kept the specific inferential chain behind my conclusions undisclosed...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: ……而浮士德知道，包括您在内，许多罪人都因此感到沮丧。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: ... and I am aware this has become a source of frustration for many of the Sinners—including yourself.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: ……现在，浮士德想自己也稍微理解了那种沮丧。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: ... I believe I now understand a small portion of that frustration.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: <也许总有一天，我们能毫无保留地交谈。>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: <Maybe the day will come when we can both talk to each other with all of our cards on the table.>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 还有……浮士德的行动效用已经很久没有降到如此微不足道的程度了。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: And... it has been some time since Faust's operational utility was reduced to so marginal a degree.
<Faust has already more than pulled Faust's weight.>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: ……我明白了。是的，当然……浮士德……本就会如此。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: ... I see. Yes, certainly... Faust... would have done so.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: <color=#ebcaa2>看来这部自动扶梯终于被彻底定下来了。</color>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: <color=#ebcaa2>So this escalator's finally been nailed down completely.</color>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: <color=#ebcaa2>以后它永远都是一架向下的梯子。</color>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: <color=#ebcaa2>Now it'll forever stay as a ladder going downward.</color>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: <color=#ebcaa2>真可怜。为了你们，它被扔到边缘，只能下，不能上……它却连缘由都永远不会知道。</color>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: <color=#ebcaa2>Poor thing. Thrown over the edge to go down and never up... all for your sake, and it'll never even know why.</color>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 欲望牵引着你们的线，把你们带到了这里。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: Want has tugged your thread here.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 命运之声总在低语：“坦诚面对自己。放纵你的欲望。”
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: The Voice of Fate always whispers. "Be honest with yourself. Indulge in your desires."

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 所以，我们先亮出自己的欲望。然后，你们也要让我们听听你们的欲望。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: And so, we will lay our desire bare first. Then you shall let us hear of yours.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: ……至少你直奔主题。很好。你的要求是什么？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: ... At least you cut to the chase. Good. What are your demands?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 更多金线……更圆的线团……饱含希望、成熟丰盈的金色。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: More golden thread... rounder skeins... ripe gold, fat with promise.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 那只茧里的一切……只要我们的手指合拢，将它绞干，就会汩汩涌出……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: Everything that would ooze and spill from that cocoon... once our fingers closed and wrung it dry...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 我们知道。哦，我们知道那里面会流出何等美丽的东西……它将多么丰沛地滋养一匹华丽布料的诞生。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: We know. Oh, we know what beauty would bleed from it... How splendidly it would feed the birth of a magnificent fabric.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 命运之声斩断了我们旧日的职责。我们不再为别人纺线。如今，丝线要温暖我们自己。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: The Voice of Fate cut our old duty loose. No longer shall we spin for other backs. Now the thread will warm our own.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: <上次他们也很贪婪……但这次简直变本加厉。是因为我们没拿到黑派的鉴定报告吗？>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: <They were greedy last time too... but something has turned the dial all the way up. Is it because we didn't get the Noirs' Authenticity Certificate?>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: ……阳光强度增加，可能导致了他们行为上的变化，经理。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: ... The increased intensity of the sunlight may be causing their altered behavior, Manager.
Now... lay your own desires bare.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 遗憾的是，我们的目标相冲突。我们想要……你手里的线团。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: Our objectives collide, regrettably. We want... the skein in your possession.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 啊。我们的欲望之线交错了。要让两种欲望合而为一，只有一个办法。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: Ahh. Our wants have crossed threads. There is only one way to make two wants lie as one.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 必须吞下其中一种欲望，才能给另一种腾出空间。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: One desire must be swallowed so the other may have room.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 你们真的做到了……没有因为人人都说那是“常识”，就乖乖接受它……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: You really did it... You refused to accept "common sense" just because everyone calls it common sense...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 说实话，我还半信半疑。地下楼层的大多数人……都无法忘掉别人教他们认定的“理所当然”。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: Honestly, I half-doubted you. Most people here on the basement floor... can't unlearn what they were taught to call obvious.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 如果我用这些线做衣服……也许姐姐能找回自己的声音，再跟我说话。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: If I make clothing from this thread... maybe my sister will find her voice and speak to me again.
Now, time to uphold your end of the bargain...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 别急。我说了会做，就一定会做。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: Take it easy. I said I'd do it, and I will.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 下去的路并不远。它一直就在你们眼皮底下。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: The way down isn't far. It was right under your noses all along.
Now, go on... Down you go.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 希望你们能做出那孩子想要的衣服。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: I hope you get to make the clothes the kid wants.
More business to take care of here.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 你们没有东西要给我们吗？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: Don't you have something to give us?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 退后。这层楼目前禁止通行。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: Back off. This floor is currently restricted.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 退后。这层楼目前禁止通行。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: Back off. This floor is currently restricted.
Needlekin need thread! Needlekin need thread!

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 想要线就得等等！要安安静静！
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: Need waity-wait if want thread! Have to quiety-quiet!

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: <color=#ebcaa2>直到……一如既往……大百货迎来终结。</color>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: <color=#ebcaa2>Until... as always... the Grand Magasin reaches its end.</color>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 默尔索的表情没有变化。即便如此……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: Meursault's expression did not change. Even so...
... I would prefer that you refrain from saying such things.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: <color=#ebcaa2>为什么？我说到你母亲的痛处了？</color>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: <color=#ebcaa2>Why? Did I strike too close to your mother?</color>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: <color=#ebcaa2>记住——你母亲来这里的全部原因，还有……我仍留在这里的原因……就是不断钉牢。</color>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: <color=#ebcaa2>Just remember—the entire reason your mother was here, and... the reason I'm still here... is to keep on nailing.</color>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 让让娜的声音在身后回荡，默尔索和我继续向地下2层走去。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: Leaving Jeanne's voice echoing behind us, Meursault and I continued down toward B2.
<... We did spend quite a lot of time down here...>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 经理兄，你怎么一副神游天外的样子？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: What've you got that faraway look for, Manager Bud?
Up, down, up, down... There are so many.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 天啊……就算布布来帮忙，要一部部查完也得花上一整天。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: Man... Checking every last one would take us all day, even with Pwie pitching in.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: <没事。我们已经在另一层学会怎么下去了。>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: <It's fine. We already learned the trick for getting down on the other floor.>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 这是个好消息。我们不必被迫参与在这座大厅里逐部搜索自动扶梯的集体寻宝活动；那样效率低下，方法上也不合理。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: That is fortunate news. We are spared from having to unwillingly partake in an inefficient and methodologically unsound group scavenger hunt through each and every escalator in this chamber.
<... So that's what you were thinking earlier.>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 我们有黄金……更正，我们有蠕蠕……也知道确定目的地所需的定义。下行应该不会再有困难。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: We possess the Golden... correction, we possess Wriggley... And we know the definition required to establish the destination. The descent should present no further difficulty.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: <不如让布布挑一部看着顺眼的自动扶梯。>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: <Maybe we can let Pwie pick whichever escalator catches their eye.>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: ……自动扶梯只是媒介，经理。选哪一部不会影响结果。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: ... The escalator is merely a medium, Manager. The specific unit selected will not affect the result.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: <我知道。我只是觉得，让布布自己选会更有趣。>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: <I know. I just thought having a choice might make the whole thing more fun for Pwie.>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 布布。选一部你最喜欢的自动扶梯。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: Pwie. Select the escalator you like best.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 我最喜欢的？像蠕蠕那样……？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: The one I like best? Like Wriggley...?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 是。选那部你看得最久的。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: Correct. Choose the one you find yourself looking at the longest.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 那么……今天会是哪条臭鱼上钩呢……？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: Now then... which stinking fish will take the hook today...?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 她怎么去了这么久？她只要去储藏室拿幼虫再回来，不是吗？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: What's taking her so long? She just needs to grab the larva from the storage and come back, right?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 你们在下面还有别的事？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: Do you have further business down here?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 他们看起来很忙。还是别靠太近。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: They look busy. Better not get too close.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 陌生人，想问问你们身上有没有眼球，听见没？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: Strangers, wondering if you have eyeballs on you, you hear?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 经理，现在不必去美食广场。我们应该先查看天花板上挂着的肉。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: No need to proceed to the Food Court now, Manager. We should inspect the meat hanging from the ceiling first.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 一块写着“禁止入内”的牌子挡住了向下的路。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: A sign marked "No Entry" blocks the path leading downward.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 我能听见另一边传来隐约的海浪声。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: I can hear the faint sound of waves from the other side.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 前方的道路弥漫着浓重的鱼腥味，还被布料密密麻麻地挡住。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: The path ahead is thick with fishy odor and densely obstructed by fabric.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 眼下似乎没必要强行闯过去。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: For now, there seems to be no reason to force our way through.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 我们查看了天花板上挂着的那块肉。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: We examine the cut of meat hanging from the ceiling.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 肋骨间卡着一小片黄金皮革。剥下来时，它在我手里轻轻颤动。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: A scrap of Golden Hide is lodged between the ribs. When peeled free, it quivers ever so softly in my hand.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: <……去美食广场吧。能省一点时间是一点。>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: <... Let's head to the Food Court. Best we save as much time as we can.>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 一部向上的自动扶梯，看不到尽头。谁也说不准它会通向哪里……我开始头晕了。还是别想了。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: An ascending escalator with no end in sight. There is no telling where it might... My head's starting to spin. I should just stop thinking about it.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 一部向下的自动扶梯，深得无法估量。也许另一头是封死的。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: A descending escalator whose depth is impossible to gauge. Perhaps its far end is sealed.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 一部通向墙壁的自动扶梯。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: An escalator that leads to a blocked wall.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 楼梯、梯子、山坡、鞋子……我试着重复默尔索说的话，可在我眼里，它仍是一部停着不动、哪儿也去不了的自动扶梯。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: A staircase, a ladder, a hill, a shoe... I try repeating what Meursault said, but to me, it remains an inactive escalator going nowhere.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 虽然只削去一小部分，它却已经变成一块发臭的腐肉。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: Though only a small part of it has been trimmed, it's turned into a foul cut of spoiled meat.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 一块牌子挡住了通往更深处的路。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: A sign blocks the path farther in.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 副主厨一动不动地躺在地上。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: Sous Chef lies motionless on the ground.
<... I don't feel good about this.>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 经理，我现在去取黄金皮革。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: I will now collect the Golden Hide, Manager.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 获得副主厨的黄金皮革。
……可惜。我才把她升为副主厨，她就没了。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: ... A shame. I promote her to Sous Chef, and out she goes.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 这下美食广场的苏打有一阵子没那股劲了。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: Now Food Court's Soda won't have the kick it needs for a while.
Who's going to keep an eye on the soda now...?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 嗯，这反应倒也不奇怪。有计划吗，经理兄？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: Well, can't say that's an unreasonable reaction. Got any plans, Manager Bud?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: <如果别的办法都行不通，也许只能动手……但先试着交易吧。>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: <We may have to fight if nothing else works... But let's offer a trade first.>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 经理，您打算拿什么交换？
那……那真是很诱人的提议，听见没？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: That... that is a very tempting offer, you hear?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 我现在就想把它切下来，听见没？黄金皮革也会立刻给你们，听见没？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: I want to cut it off right now, you hear? I'll hand over the Golden Hide right away, too, you hear?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: <……这笔买卖她答应得可真痛快。>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: <... She bit our hand off for that deal.>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: <格里高尔……我不想开这个口……所以我只说“拜托了”。>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: <Gregor... I hate asking this... so I'll just say "please.">

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 没事。要是一条破虫臂能换来黄金皮革，那就换吧。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: It's fine. If one lousy bug arm gets us a Golden Hide, then I say we do it.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 反正它还会长出来……趁我没改主意，快切吧。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: It grows back anyway... Just cut it off before I change my mind.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 太让人兴奋了，听见没？有了这个，我——
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: So exciting, you hear? With this, I—
I wonder what this is, you hear?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 从一名红派员工身上取下的脊椎骨。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: A vertebra taken from a Rouge employee.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 是稀有食材……但还不够稀有，换不了黄金皮革……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: It's a rare ingredient... But not rare enough to trade for the Golden Hide...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 每一节骨头里都有金色的光……还满是渴望——一直腌到骨子里，深——深地渗进骨髓了，听见没？！
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: This golden glow in every joint... And it is bursting with want—marinated to the bone, alllll the way into the marrows, you hear?!

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: ……是你们先提出交易的，听见没？是陌生人先想做这笔买卖的，听见没？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: ... You offered the trade first, you hear? Strangers wanted this deal first, you hear?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 不退款，不退货，绝对不能反悔，听见没？！
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: No refunds, no returns, absolutely no backing out, you hear?!

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 是的，我们听见了。我们无意撤回提议。请拿出黄金皮革交换。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: Yes, we hear. We have no intention of withdrawing the offer. Please present the Golden Hide for exchange.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 副主厨高高兴兴地跳进储藏室，带着黄金皮革回来了。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: The Sous Chef happily hopped into the storage room and came back with the Golden Hide.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-route-b.json#.en: Dante
Dante

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-route-b.json#.zh: <它突然冒出来，杀了默尔索。还堵住出口，让我们逃不了……>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-route-b.json#.en: <It just appeared out of nowhere and killed Meursault. It even blocked off the way out so we couldn't escape...>
Dante

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-route-b.json#.zh: <百货公司里为什么会有那种东西到处游荡……？>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-route-b.json#.en: <Why would something like that even be wandering around a department store...?>
Ishmael
... Sorry, what are we talking about?
Dante

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-route-b.json#.zh: <就是刚才遇到的那个东西，它……>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-route-b.json#.en: <You know, that entity we just encountered, it was...>
... was neither a Distortion nor an Abnormality.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-route-b.json#.zh: 可是……我也不敢肯定，究竟该不该称它为……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-route-b.json#.en: And yet... I couldn't say with any confidence whether I should really call it...
Gregor

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-route-b.json#.zh: 哎，别这样。经理老兄，你把大家的好奇心都勾起来了，可不能说到一半就没下文。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-route-b.json#.en: Oh, come on. You can't get us all curious and then just trail off like that, Manager Bud.
Dante
<... human.>
Dante

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-route-b.json#.zh: <我说的是那个背上钉满钉子的怪物。>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-route-b.json#.en: <I'm talking about that monster with all those nails driven into its back.>
Yi Sang

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-route-b.json#.zh: 在我们来到洗手间之前……我从未见过那样的存在。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-route-b.json#.en: Such a being... had never once entered my sight prior to our arrival at the restroom.
Dante
Rodion

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-route-b.json#.zh: ……但丁，要是没力气了，就再歇会儿嘛。我们已经找到默尔了，所以……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-route-b.json#.en: ...Dante, why don'tcha rest a little longer if you're outta juice? We found Meur already, so...
Dante

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-route-b.json#.zh: 罪人们不停忧心地瞥向我钟表上的指针。等他们终于走开，我便直奔默尔索，问他发生了什么。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-route-b.json#.en: The Sinners kept casting worried glances at the hands of my clock. Once they finally moved away, I went straight to Meursault and asked him what was going on.
Dante

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-route-b.json#.zh: <刚才到底怎么回事，默尔索？你——>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-route-b.json#.en: <What the hell happened just now, Meursault? Do you—>
Meursault
... I do remember, Manager.
Meursault

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-route-b.json#.zh: 回答您的问题：其他罪人不记得发生过的事，是因为我们被“送回”了。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-route-b.json#.en: To answer your question, the reason the other Sinners have no memory of what occurred is because we were "returned."
Dante
<"Returned"...?>
Meursault

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-route-b.json#.zh: 意思是，西西弗百货被重置到了某个选择尚未作出之前。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-route-b.json#.en: It means that the Grand Magasin was reset to a point before a particular choice was made.
Meursault

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-route-b.json#.zh: 大多数人似乎无法察觉这种现象。但您和我，似乎是例外。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-route-b.json#.en: This appears to be a phenomenon that most are incapable of perceiving. You and I, however, appear to be exceptions.
Dante

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-route-b.json#.zh: <好吧，先不说这个……到底是什么引发了重置……？>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-route-b.json#.en: <Okay, fine, putting that aside... what caused the reset in the first place...?>
Meursault

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-route-b.json#.zh: 它大概想让您作出不同的选择。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-route-b.json#.en: It likely wanted you to make a different choice.
Meursault

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-route-b.json#.zh: ……因为您先前作出的选择，并未被锁链束缚。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-route-b.json#.en: ... Because the choice you made before was not bound in chains.
Dante

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-route-b.json#.zh: 出发前，我最好先花点时间理清思绪。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-route-b.json#.en: I should probably take a moment to collect my thoughts before we head out.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-route-b.json#.zh: 那个存在为什么会出现……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-route-b.json#.en: Why did that entity appear...
... and why were we sent back...?
Not... now...
When fate... has fallen into alignment...
The eyes are fixed upon the shoes.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-route-b.json#.zh: 再也听不到悲伤的哭声。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-route-b.json#.en: The sound of sorrowful weeping is heard no more.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-route-b.json#.zh: 破损得太严重，已经缝不回去了。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-route-b.json#.en: Torn too badly to be stitched back together.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-route-b.json#.zh: 一具黑派的尸体。连生前引以为傲的衣料，也没能让这人逃过此劫。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-route-b.json#.en: The corpse of a Noir. Even the fabric they took such pride in couldn't save them from this fate.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-route-b.json#.zh: 一具黑派的尸体。血渗进黑色西装，染成了深红色。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-route-b.json#.en: The corpse of a Noir. Blood seeps into the black suit, turning it dark crimson.
Dante

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-route-b.json#.zh: <呼，看来布布也能跟我们一起进来。>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-route-b.json#.en: <Phew, looks like Pwie's able to come in here with the rest of us.>
Dante

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-route-b.json#.zh: <……是我的错觉，还是布布好像没那么……闹腾了？>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-route-b.json#.en: <... Is it just me, or do they seem somewhat less... hyper?>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-route-b.json#.zh: 自从进入泉，布布那份孩子气的好奇心似乎淡了，取而代之的是些许不安。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-route-b.json#.en: Pwie's childlike curiosity seems to have been dampened and replaced with mild anxiety ever since entering the Fount.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-route-b.json#.zh: 嗯……大概因为这里人太多了。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-route-b.json#.en: Hmm... Must be because it's too crowded in here.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 退后。这层楼目前禁止通行。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: Back off. This floor is currently restricted.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 身份检查。我们接到消息，有异乡人正在窝藏一个亵渎神圣的怪物。报上姓名和所属组织。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: Identity checkpoint. We have information that there are strangers who are sheltering an unholy abomination. State your name and affiliation.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 我是布布！我的所……所属组织是什么？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: I'm Pwie! And my affili... What's affiliation?
Busy-busy! Need to keep winding the thread.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 针族不能休息！排队的时候不能休息……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: Needlekin can't rest! Can't rest while queueing...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 针族们正一本正经地叽叽喳喳。
前面的针族想要通行口令！继续等。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: Needlekin to the front wants pass word! Keep waiting.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 前面的前面的针族想要通行口令！继续等。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: Needlekin to the front's front wants pass word! Keep waiting.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 前面的异乡人问了！我们在等什么？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: Stranger to the front asks! What are we waiting for?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 前面的前面的异乡人问了！我们在等什么？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: Stranger to the front's front asks! What are we waiting for?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 他们在那儿！护送虚假之声幼体的无耻混蛋……！
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: There they are! The shameless wretches escorting the False Voice spawn...!

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 原来他们就是犯人。你的功劳我们记下了。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: So these are the offenders. Your service is noted.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 我一见他们就知道了。本想立刻揪住衣领把他们拖过来，可那虚假之声果然跟红派一样野蛮，竟然毫不留情地想把我撕碎！
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: I knew it the moment I saw them. I'd have grabbed them by the collar and dragged them over at once, but that False Voice, true to its Rouge savagery, tried to tear me apart without mercy!

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 经过一场艰苦而英勇的搏斗，我勇敢地把他们堵在那里，直到……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: And after a grueling and heroic struggle, I courageously kept them pinned there until...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 干得好。接下来交给我们。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: Good work. We'll take it from here.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 你们这些异乡人无知得很。不过，仁慈也是我们的美德之一，所以我们会给你们最后一次机会。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: You strangers are profoundly ignorant. Nevertheless, mercy is among our virtues, so we shall offer you one last chance.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 交出红派的虚假之声，我们就当你们走错了路，准许你们毫发无伤地离开。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: Hand over the Rouge's False Voice, and we will call your conduct a wrong turn and permit you to walk away unscathed.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: ……还是说，你们被红派的虚假之声挟持了？红派造出的污秽之物……完全有能力干出这种事。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: ... Unless the False Voice of the Rouges has taken you hostage? An impurity wrought by Le Rouge... would be more than capable of doing so.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: <呃，良秀……我觉得你不用教布布这种，呃，艺术。>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: <Um, Ryōshū... I don't think you need to teach Pwie the, uh, art.>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 刀鞘轻轻晃了晃，像是在表示赞同。那一刻，我感觉阿赖耶与我交换了一个眼神。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: The scabbard gave a faint, approving sway. For a moment, it felt as though Araya and I were exchanging a look.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 连保护者和人质都分不清？那些没用的眼睛，不如让我挖出来。没了也不碍事吧。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: Can't even tell guardians from hostages? Lemme pluck out those useless eyes—I think you'll be fine without them.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 有了这个……精肉苏打就能重新冒泡了，听见没？浸得这么深的情绪能维持十季……不，二十季……！
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: With this... the Meat Soda will get its fizz back, you hear? Emotion soaked this deeply could last 10 seasons... no, 20...!
Uh... Great. Good for you, huh?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 再见，听见没？你们这些陌生人全是冤大头，听见没？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: Good-bye, you hear? You strangers are all suckers, you hear?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 她似乎非常高兴。我们可能接受了一笔不划算的交易。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: She appears exceptionally pleased. We likely accepted an unfavorable exchange.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: <……我是说，要是双方都满意的话……>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: <... I mean, if both sides walk away happy...>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 眼球只是小意思，听见没？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: Eyeballs are small potatoes, you hear?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 黄金皮革才是真正的重头戏，听见没？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: The Golden Hide is the real meat of the matter, you hear?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 我刚升职当副主厨，听见没？所以我得对美食广场的苏打负责，听见没？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: I just got promoted to Sous Chef, you hear? So I gotta be responsible for the Food Court soda, you hear?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 一部向下的自动扶梯。坐它没用——它只会在某个随机位置停下，不让我们通过。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: A descending escalator. There's no point in taking this—it'll just stop at a random point and not let us through.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 一大块干瘪的肉，怎么看都更像肉干。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: A desiccated slab of meat, closer to jerky than anything else.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 一块肋眼肉，油花像花一样绽开……真的是花。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: A cut of rib eye, the marbling blooming like a flower... quite literally.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 在那里绽放的是腐烂。这还能吃吗？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: What blooms there is the rot. Is it even edible?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 这个嘛……你看，都坏了。吃了会肚子咕噜咕噜的。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: Well, I mean... just look at it, it's spoiled. It'll give you the rumblies.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: ……坏掉的就不能吃吗？肚子咕噜咕噜……不好吗？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: ... We can't eat what's spoiled? Is rumblies... bad?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 得到默尔索的许可，布布大口咬下那块肉。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: With Meursault's permission, Pwie takes a big bite out of the meat.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 等、等等！我知道这里不是什么正常地方，默尔索，可你不能叫这孩子吃一块烂——
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: H-hold on! I get this isn't the most normal place, Meursault, but you can't just tell that kid to eat a rotten piece of—

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 百货商店外的“常识”在此并不适用。这里的那块肉不过是另一件衣物，考虑到布布是大百货的产物……它不太可能造成问题。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: The "common sense" outside the department store does not apply here. That cut of meat is but another article of clothing here, and considering that Pwie is a product of the Grand Magasin... it is unlikely to cause any issues.
I'm done. Don't wanna eat more.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: *叹气* 好吧，看来你说得对。也没规定布布得吃和我们一样的东西，不过……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: *sigh* Fine, guess you're right. There's no rule saying Pwie should eat the same things that we do, but...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 格里高尔神情复杂地看了那块腐肉一会儿……然后转开了视线。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: For a moment, Gregor gave a conflicted look toward the spoiled piece of meat... then turned away.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 它的肉汁冻住了，还变成蓝色。这真是肉汁吧……？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: Its juice has frozen and turned blue. It is meat juice, right...?
The door is open. Should we enter?
