RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 里面的眼球堆得很高。一个似乎是屋主的顾客死在一旁，肚子鼓得像座山。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: There are eyeballs inside, piled up high. A customer who seems to be the owner lies dead nearby, their belly swollen like a mountain.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 鼓胀的肚子爆开，内脏溅满地面。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: The swollen belly has burst, spraying the floor with its innards.
The door is open. Should we enter?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 里面的眼球堆得很高。一个似乎是屋主的顾客死在一旁，肚子鼓得像座山。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: There are eyeballs inside, piled up high. A customer who seems to be the owner lies dead nearby, their belly swollen like a mountain.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 一栋看起来像普通民宅的房子。我们敲了门，却无人应答。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: A house resembling an ordinary private residence. No one responds when we knock.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 窗后有什么东西与我对上了视线。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: Something beyond the windows met my gaze.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 它示意我们安静，随后消失了。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: It gestured us to be silent, then disappeared.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 房子似乎无人居住。屋里堆着肉、皮革等材料，取代了家具。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: The house appears uninhabited. Meat, hides, and similar materials are heaped inside in place of furniture.
The door is open. Should we enter?
The door is open. Should we enter?

StoryData/P10917.json#0#content.en: I always wanted to get rich.

StoryData/P10917.json#2#content.zh: 杜布瓦：呃……发财了要做什么呢……？
StoryData/P10917.json#2#content.en: Uh... what would I do once I got rich...?

StoryData/P10917.json#3#content.zh: 杜布瓦：我……呃，还没想那么远……
StoryData/P10917.json#3#content.en: I, uh... haven't really thought that far ahead...

StoryData/P10917.json#4#content.zh: 杜布瓦：哦对了！我预订的布料！谢谢提醒，我得赶紧过去了！
StoryData/P10917.json#4#content.en: Oh, right! My fabric reservation! Thanks for reminding me. I'd better get going!

StoryData/P10917.json#6#content.zh: 杜布瓦：你好！我是来取我预订的布料的。听说已经准备好了……
StoryData/P10917.json#6#content.en: Hello! I'm here to pick up the fabric I reserved. I was told it would be ready...

StoryData/P10917.json#7#content.zh: 你确定那件外袍不用修补吗？你就这样穿着也满意？
StoryData/P10917.json#7#content.en: Are you sure that shroud of yours doesn't need mending? You're happy leaving it as it is?

StoryData/P10917.json#9#content.en: Sunshine is pouring into the Alteration Shop.

StoryData/P10917.json#10#content.zh: 另一位顾客正在与改衣师小姐说话。他肩上披着一件褪色的金色斗篷。
StoryData/P10917.json#10#content.en: Another customer is there talking to Miss Alterationist. He has a faded golden cloak over his shoulders.

StoryData/P10917.json#11#content.zh: 我想这正是合适的季节前来光顾。但看到前面还有顾客，我担心自己是不是来得太早了。
StoryData/P10917.json#11#content.en: I thought this was exactly the right season to come by. But seeing the customer ahead of me, I wonder if I've shown up a little early.

StoryData/P10917.json#12#content.zh: 我不知道你想拿那把剪刀做什么……
StoryData/P10917.json#12#content.en: I don't know what you want to do with those scissors...

StoryData/P10917.json#13#content.zh: 但你心里确实藏着那份渴望……深到我能看出，总有一天你会回来求我把它剪掉。
StoryData/P10917.json#13#content.en: But you've got that desire in you... enough that I can see you coming back to have me severed someday.

StoryData/P10917.json#14#content.zh: 等那天到来时，你知道该找谁做改衣服务。
StoryData/P10917.json#14#content.en: When that day comes, you know whose alteration services to go with.

StoryData/P10917.json#15#content.zh: 那位顾客一边听改衣师小姐说话一边点头。事情谈妥后，他转身朝我这边走来。
StoryData/P10917.json#15#content.en: The customer nods along as Miss Alterationist speaks. Then, with his business apparently concluded, he turns and walks in my direction.

StoryData/P10917.json#16#content.zh: 他看见我时，惊讶得张大了嘴……随即歪着头，像是在数着什么。
StoryData/P10917.json#16#content.en: When he sees me, his mouth falls open in apparent surprise... Then he tilts his head, like he's counting something.

StoryData/P10917.json#17#content.zh: 我试着回想他是谁。我们以前见过吗？可我怎么都想不起在百货公司哪里见过这种款式的衣服。
StoryData/P10917.json#17#content.en: I try to place him. Did we meet somewhere before? But I can't recall ever seeing that style of clothing anywhere in the department store.

StoryData/P10917.json#18#content.zh: 杜布瓦：哦……呃，你好。很高兴认识你……
StoryData/P10917.json#18#content.en: Oh... uh, hello. Nice to meet you...

StoryData/P10917.json#20#content.zh: 这是个笨拙的打招呼方式，但我想着或许能借此打破僵局……
StoryData/P10917.json#20#content.en: It was a clumsy attempt at a greeting, but I thought it might help break the ice...

StoryData/P10917.json#21#content.zh: 但他低声笑了——更像是嗤笑——像是想通了什么。不管想通了什么，他都没说出口，一言不发地转身离开了。
StoryData/P10917.json#21#content.en: But he chuckled—scoffed, really—under his breath, as though he'd just worked something out. Whatever it was, he kept it to himself and left without a word.

StoryData/P10917.json#23#content.zh: 阳光是很舒服，我知道，但也别整天泡在里面。你可不想变成那种在店里游荡的人台。
StoryData/P10917.json#23#content.en: The sunshine feels lovely, I know, but don't go basking in it all day. You don't want to end up like those Mannequins shambling around the shops.

StoryData/P10917.json#24#content.zh: 来，靠近点儿。你站在那边，后面的顾客都不知道自己排到哪儿了。
StoryData/P10917.json#24#content.en: Here, come a little closer. The next customers won't know where they are in the queue if you stand over there.

StoryData/P10917.json#26#content.zh: 还在想刚才那位顾客吗？你脸上还挂着那副表情呢。
StoryData/P10917.json#26#content.en: Still thinking about the customer who just left? You've still got that look on your face.

StoryData/P10917.json#27#content.zh: 杜布瓦：哈哈……只是没想到会在你店里看见红派的顾客。我还以为他们不会跟改衣师小姐有来往呢。
StoryData/P10917.json#27#content.en: Haha... I just wasn't expecting to see a Rouge customer at your shop. I didn't think they'd have dealings with you, Miss Alterationist.

StoryData/P10917.json#28#content.en: Anyone who comes looking for fabric is welcome here.

StoryData/P10917.json#29#content.zh: 所以黑派的人求我给他们开店，我一直没答应。而且，说实话，他们还真是不厌其烦地问个不停。
StoryData/P10917.json#29#content.en: That's why I keep ignoring the Noirs when they ask me to run a shop for them. And believe me, they don't tire of asking.

StoryData/P10917.json#30#content.zh: 你的已经好了。再给我一点时间把这一件收个尾，很快就好。
StoryData/P10917.json#30#content.en: Yours is all ready to go. Give me a moment to put the finishing touches on this other one. Won't be much longer.

StoryData/P10917.json#31#content.zh: 这么纯粹、高贵的材料，必须悉心对待……可不是那种能放下再捡起来接着做的活儿。
StoryData/P10917.json#31#content.en: You have to treat such pure, noble material with care... It's not the sort of work you can just put down to pick up again later.

StoryData/P10917.json#32#content.zh: 搭在她膝上的那块布料散发着我从未见过的光泽。这段时间我看过不少布料，但从没见过那样的颜色。
StoryData/P10917.json#32#content.en: The fabric resting in her lap had a radiance I'd never seen before. I'd looked at plenty of fabrics by now, but nothing with a color quite like that.

StoryData/P10917.json#33#content.zh: 我看过的大多数布料，都得仔细端详才能大致判断出各种材质的含量……可这一块？光凭眼睛就能看出它的纯度极高。
StoryData/P10917.json#33#content.en: Most fabrics I've seen so far had to be scrutinized to get an idea of how much of each material was in them... But this one? I could tell it's high-purity just by looking.

StoryData/P10917.json#34#content.zh: 买那样一块布料得花多少眼球啊……？我根本没法想象那价钱。
StoryData/P10917.json#34#content.en: How many eyeballs would it take to buy fabric like that...? I couldn't even begin to put a price on it.

StoryData/P10917.json#35#content.zh: 也许要在1楼捡上几百个季度的眼球……不，我骗谁呢？就算那样也够不着。
StoryData/P10917.json#35#content.en: Maybe if I spent hundreds of seasons picking up eyeballs on 1F... No, who am I kidding? Even that wouldn't put it within reach.

StoryData/P10917.json#36#content.zh: 杜布瓦：你手上这件……是黑派委托你做的吗？
StoryData/P10917.json#36#content.en: That piece you're working on... is it something the Noirs asked you to make?

StoryData/P10917.json#37#content.zh: 嗯哼。是他们的品牌经理定的。

StoryData/P10917.json#38#content.zh: 给他们的铠甲做黄金面料……要那种够“正义”够“崇高”的感觉。这是他们的要求。
StoryData/P10917.json#38#content.en: Golden Fabric for their armor... something suitably "righteous" and "exalted". That was the request.

StoryData/P10917.json#39#content.zh: 杜布瓦：这么漂亮的布料……最后要变成铠甲？真的假的……？
StoryData/P10917.json#39#content.en: All this beautiful fabric... and it's going to end up as armor? Really...?

StoryData/P10917.json#40#content.zh: 杜布瓦：可要是做成裙子，那该有多美啊……？那样肯定好看多了……
StoryData/P10917.json#40#content.en: Wouldn't it be lovely as a dress, though...? It'd be so much better that way...

StoryData/P10917.json#42#content.zh: 把每一层布料叠加起来，一层又一层……就能做出一件坚固又轻便的铠甲。
StoryData/P10917.json#42#content.en: Overlay each ply of fabric, layer after layer... and you can make a suit of armor with plenty of strength and very little weight.

StoryData/P10917.json#43#content.zh: 这能让他们在跟红派的较量中占上风。
StoryData/P10917.json#43#content.en: It'll give them an edge in their competition with the Rouges.

StoryData/P10917.json#44#content.zh: 杜布瓦：较量……哦，怪不得最近这么难预约。
StoryData/P10917.json#44#content.en: Competition... Oh, so that's why it's been so hard to get a reservation lately.

StoryData/P10917.json#45#content.zh: 那，其他顾客怕是得排队等我做完黑派这批大订单了……我连接零活的时间都快挤不出来。
StoryData/P10917.json#45#content.en: Well, customers may have to get in line while I work on the Noirs' bulk fabric order... I can't even squeeze in much time to handle odd jobs.

StoryData/P10917.json#46#content.zh: 改衣师小姐看样子做完了，小心翼翼地把黄金面料放下。
StoryData/P10917.json#46#content.en: Her work apparently finished, Miss Alterationist carefully set the Golden Fabric down.

StoryData/P10917.json#47#content.zh: 现在她做完黑派的订单了，终于轮到我了……我等这一天等了好几个季度。我真的要拿到我的布料了……
StoryData/P10917.json#47#content.en: Now that she's done with the Noirs' order, it's my turn, finally... I've been waiting for this for seasons. I'm actually going to get my fabric...

StoryData/P10917.json#48#content.zh: 给你。你要的绣花布料。看到这些线交织缠绕了吗？我就是这么织出这片浓密繁茂的森林纹样的。
StoryData/P10917.json#48#content.en: Here you go. The embroidered fabric you asked for. See the threads winding through each other? That's how I made that dense, lush forest pattern.

StoryData/P10917.json#49#content.zh: 杜布瓦：哇。要是把这个缠在袖口上……整套衣服会优雅好多……
StoryData/P10917.json#49#content.en: Whoa. If I put this around my cuffs... the whole outfit would look so much more elegant...

StoryData/P10917.json#50#content.zh: 杜布瓦：谢谢你！我下次一定还来找你！
StoryData/P10917.json#50#content.en: Thank you! I'll be sure to come to you again next time!

StoryData/P10917.json#51#content.en: So, where are you headed now?

StoryData/P10917.json#52#content.zh: 我本打算回到1楼我熟悉的那个好地方，先在那儿捡些眼球，然后再去4楼。
StoryData/P10917.json#52#content.en: I'd meant to go back down to a good spot I knew on 1F. Gather some eyeballs there, then head up to 4F.

StoryData/P10917.json#53#content.zh: 我本想去手袋馆找个包，配我正在做的这条裙子……
StoryData/P10917.json#53#content.en: I was going to find a bag from the Handbags Hall to go with the dress I'm working on...

StoryData/P10917.json#54#content.zh: 可我的目光怎么也挪不开，一直落在她放下的那块黄金面料上。
StoryData/P10917.json#54#content.en: Except my eyes wouldn't stay on anything else. They kept returning to that Golden Fabric, sitting right where she'd put it down.

StoryData/P10917.json#55#content.zh: 要是我下到地下楼层……要是我能自己找到那样的材料……
StoryData/P10917.json#55#content.en: If I went down to the basement floors... if I could find materials like that for myself...

StoryData/P10917.json#56#content.zh: 杜布瓦：我想……其实我想去地下楼层看看。
StoryData/P10917.json#56#content.en: I think I'll head... down to the basement floors, actually.

StoryData/P10917.json#57#content.zh: 杜布瓦：听说地下一楼有种饮料，能喝出你想要的任何味道。呃，至少……我是这么听说的。
StoryData/P10917.json#57#content.en: There's supposed to be a drink on B1F that can taste like anything you want. Or, um... that's what I've heard, at least.

StoryData/P10917.json#58#content.zh: 呼呼……我看出你打的什么主意了。不过想弄到做这块布料的材料，可没那么容易。
StoryData/P10917.json#58#content.en: Fuhu... I can see where this is going. But getting hold of the materials for this fabric won't be nearly as easy as you're hoping.

StoryData/P10917.json#59#content.zh: 不过……脚夫们跟我说，下面有不少东西跟地上完全不一样。至少你能找到点不一样的东西。
StoryData/P10917.json#59#content.en: Still... the porters tell me there's plenty down there that's nothing like what we have above ground. You might find something different, at least.

StoryData/P10917.json#60#content.zh: 杜布瓦：那我该付你多少眼球？这看起来可不像上次那样只值200……
StoryData/P10917.json#60#content.en: So, how many eyeballs do I owe you? This looks way too good to pay just 200, like last time...

StoryData/P10917.json#61#content.en: That one...? Just take it. You don't have to pay.

StoryData/P10917.json#62#content.zh: 杜布瓦：等等，真的吗？你要白送我？！
StoryData/P10917.json#62#content.en: Wait, really? You're giving it for free?!

StoryData/P10917.json#63#content.zh: 要是你能到地下二楼，帮我个忙。我有个小道消息，想让你散布给黑派听。
StoryData/P10917.json#63#content.en: Just do me a favor if you manage to get to B2F. A little rumor I'd like you to put about among the Noirs.

StoryData/P10917.json#64#content.zh: 杜布瓦：哦，这个我可以！我很擅长散布消息，其实也算是练出来的了！
StoryData/P10917.json#64#content.en: Oh, I can do that! I'm good at getting a rumor around. I've had a bit of practice, actually!

StoryData/P10917.json#65#content.zh: 杜布瓦：你知道4楼开始流传的那把传说之剑的传闻吗？我亲自把它带到了1楼和3楼！传到你这儿了没？
StoryData/P10917.json#65#content.en: You know the rumor about a legendary sword that started going around on 4F? I brought it to 1F and 3F myself! Has it reached you yet?

StoryData/P10917.json#66#content.zh: ……还没传到我这儿。不过只要你会让顾客们聊起来，那对我来说就够了。
StoryData/P10917.json#66#content.en: ... Can't say it has. But if you know how to get customers talking, that's good enough for me.

StoryData/P10917.json#67#content.zh: 我想让他们听到这样一句话。3楼的平衡撑不了多久了……马上就要彻底崩塌。
StoryData/P10917.json#67#content.en: Here's what I want them to hear. The balance on 3F won't hold much longer... It's about to come apart altogether.

StoryData/P10917.json#69#content.zh: 红派的精品店又重新站稳脚跟了。现在几乎可以说，是他们在引领潮流了。
StoryData/P10917.json#69#content.en: The Rouges' Boutiques are finding their feet again. You could pretty much say they're the ones setting the trends now.

StoryData/P10917.json#70#content.zh: 黑派的品牌经理东奔西跑地想跟上……可那样还不够扭转局面。
StoryData/P10917.json#70#content.en: The Noir Brand Manager's running all over the place, trying to keep up... but that won't be enough to turn things around.

StoryData/P10917.json#71#content.zh: 现在有个“声音”在指引红派……对每一步都有应对。就好像早在开始之前，一切就已经算计好了。
StoryData/P10917.json#71#content.en: There's a Voice guiding the Rouges now... and it has an answer for every move. As if it had the whole thing figured out before it even began.

StoryData/P10917.json#72#content.zh: 而线头已经在松脱，却没人察觉……
StoryData/P10917.json#72#content.en: Without even noticing the threads coming loose...

StoryData/P10917.json#73#content.zh: 总之，我要你转达的就是这些。就靠你了，亲爱的顾客。
StoryData/P10917.json#73#content.en: Anyway, that's all I need you to pass on. I'm counting on you, dear customer.

StoryData/P10917.json#74#content.zh: 杜布瓦：当然！我一定会把这话原原本本地带到。
StoryData/P10917.json#74#content.en: Of course! I'll make sure the message gets through, just as you said.

StoryData/P10917.json#75#content.zh: 我道过别正要离开时，一个个穿着红衣的身影陆续走进了改衣室。
StoryData/P10917.json#75#content.en: I'd said my goodbyes and was about to leave when figures dressed in red began filing into the Alteration Shop, one after another.

StoryData/P10917.json#76#content.zh: 看来她确实有不少红派顾客……也许只是我以前没在对的时候撞见过他们。
StoryData/P10917.json#76#content.en: So she really did get plenty of Rouge customers... Maybe I'd simply never been around at the right time to see them.

StoryData/P10917.json#77#content.zh: 我正这么想着朝出口走去……一把剪刀突然朝我飞了过来，挡在我面前。
StoryData/P10917.json#77#content.en: That was what I was thinking as I made for the entrance... when a pair of scissors came flying into my path.

StoryData/P10917.json#78#content.zh: 剪刀上嵌着一根骨制的钉子……我这才意识到，是某个红派朝我扔了过来。剪刀替我挡下了它。
StoryData/P10917.json#78#content.en: There was a nail, made of bone, embedded in the scissors... and only then did I realize that one of the Rouges had thrown it at me. The scissors blocked it.

StoryData/P10917.json#81#content.zh: 红派的皮衣配上黑派的鞋……？光看这身打扮，我就足够送你直接坠入谷底了。
StoryData/P10917.json#81#content.en: A Rouge leather coat, paired with Noir shoes...? One look at that ensemble was enough for me to send you free-falling to rock bottom.

StoryData/P10917.json#82#content.zh: 杜布瓦：可、可你看它们多搭啊……这样明明更好看……
StoryData/P10917.json#82#content.en: B-but look at how well they go together... It's much prettier like this...

StoryData/P10917.json#83#content.zh: *叹气* 亲爱的顾客……现在不是时候。

StoryData/P10917.json#84#content.zh: 少废话，从那堆线轴后面的帘子出去。赶紧离开这家店，除非你更想摔一跤。
StoryData/P10917.json#84#content.en: Save the talk and get out through the curtains behind that stack of thread spools. Get yourself out of the shop, unless you'd rather take a fall.

StoryData/P10917.json#85#content.zh: 至于你……你可不是来买布料的吧。是那孩子派你来的？
StoryData/P10917.json#85#content.en: As for you... You sure didn't come for fabric. Was it that child who sent you?

StoryData/P10917.json#86#content.zh: 我们珍视的那位给了我们指引。若要关闭黑派的每一家店铺，改衣室必须是我们的首要目标。
StoryData/P10917.json#86#content.en: Our cherished one gave us his guidance. If we're to shut down every last Noir establishment, the Alteration Shops have to be our first targets.

StoryData/P10917.json#87#content.zh: ……瞧瞧那双眼睛。满满的贪婪，满满的渴望……都要烧穿了。
StoryData/P10917.json#87#content.en: ... Look at those eyes. All that greed, all that desire... burning right through.

StoryData/P10917.json#88#content.zh: 也许正因如此，我最终还是没喜欢上黑派的风格。要知道，我就是喜欢你们红派眼里的那种神情。
StoryData/P10917.json#88#content.en: Maybe that's why I never did take to Noir's fashion in the end. I like that look in the eyes of you Rouges, you know.

StoryData/P10917.json#89#content.zh: 所以接下来这一幕，对你们来说想必也不意外：
StoryData/P10917.json#89#content.en: Which means this next part shouldn't come as any surprise to you:

StoryData/P10917.json#90#content.zh: 要是你们想把我剪掉……那最好也有觉悟，自己也会被剪碎。
StoryData/P10917.json#90#content.en: If you'd like to cut me away... you'd better have come prepared to be snipped away yourselves.

_mech/BattleKeywords-a1c10p2.json#Tangle.zh: - 最大层数：30 - 每有1层，受到的伤害+1% - 每有10层，基础威力-1 - 回合结束：每有3层，下回合获得1点束缚（最多10点） - 使用防御技能时，失去一半层数（向上取整）
_mech/BattleKeywords-a1c10p2.json#Tangle.en: - Max Stack: 30 - Take +1% damage for every Stack - Base Power -1 for every 10 Stacks - Turn End: Gain 1 Bind next turn for every 3 Stacks (max 10) - On Defense Skill Use, lose half of the Stacks (rounded up)

_mech/BattleKeywords-a1c10p2.json#Tangle.zh: 百货商场是一个由针线缝合而成的世界。就连来自大海之物，如今也化作了丝线，黑色的海水缠结成了黑纱。
_mech/BattleKeywords-a1c10p2.json#Tangle.en: The department store is a world of sewing, bound together by thread and needle. Even that which came from the sea now finds its body turned to thread, black water tangling into black yarn.

_mech/BattleKeywords-a1c10p2.json#SickBl.zh:
- 最大层数：50
- 每有1层，受到的伤害+1%
- 回合开始：每有25层，获得1层易损
_mech/BattleKeywords-a1c10p2.json#SickBl.en:
- Max Stack: 50
- Take +1% damage for every Stack
- Turn Start: Gain 1 Fragile for every 25 Stacks

_mech/BattleKeywords-a1c10p2.json#SickBl.zh: 每当一缕散线从黑纱中迸裂而出，都带着咸涩的泪水气息……说来奇怪，竟透着一丝怀念。
_mech/BattleKeywords-a1c10p2.json#SickBl.en: Each time a loose strand bursts from the black yarn, it carries the briny scent of tears... strangely nostalgic despite itself.

_mech/BattleKeywords-a1c10p2.json#HeavyB.zh:
- 最大层数：5
- 获得等同于层数的槽位加权值（每个部位分别计算）
- 每有1层，受到的伤害+10%
_mech/BattleKeywords-a1c10p2.json#HeavyB.en:
- Max Stack: 5
- Gain Slot Weight equal to Stack (per Part)
- Take +10% damage for every Stack

_mech/BattleKeywords-a1c10p2.json#HeavyB.zh: 黑色是死亡与质量的具象。正如盛纳黑色海水之物会渐渐沉重，黑线也在结块中不断增重。它将一切揽入自身，收紧成结，沉没，静止。
_mech/BattleKeywords-a1c10p2.json#HeavyB.en: Black is an image of death and mass. Just as what holds black seawater grows heavy, black thread gains weight as it clumps together. It gathers everything into itself, knots tight, sinks, and stops.

_mech/BattleKeywords-a1c10p2.json#HideBl.zh: - 最大威力：6 - 最大层数：2 - 受到攻击时，失去1点威力（每个技能1次） - 回合结束：失去1层 - 威力或层数降至0时失效 - 不会陷入混乱 - 单方面攻击时，造成的伤害+100% - 受到的伤害-100%
_mech/BattleKeywords-a1c10p2.json#HideBl.en: - Max Potency: 6 - Max Count: 2 - When hit, lose 1 Potency (once per Skill) - Turn End: Lose 1 Count - Expires if Potency or Count reaches 0 - Cannot be Staggered - On Unopposed Attack, deal +100% damage - Take -100% damage

_mech/BattleKeywords-a1c10p2.json#HideBl.zh: 如今它既非大海，也非水族箱，只是一潭死水。然而沉淀于其中的巨大思慕，怀藏着足以暂时隐匿躯干的哀伤。
_mech/BattleKeywords-a1c10p2.json#HideBl.en: It is neither sea nor aquarium now, only a stagnant pond. Yet the great longing that has settled there holds enough sorrow to momentarily hide the body.

_mech/BattleKeywords-a1c10p2.json#AngryB.zh:
- 每有1个持有本效果的部位，所有部位的拼点威力+2
- 目标每有3层缠结，造成的伤害+5%（最多50%）
- 回合结束时失效
_mech/BattleKeywords-a1c10p2.json#AngryB.en:
- All Parts gain Clash Power +2 for every Part that has this effect
- Deal +5% damage for every 3 Tangling Stacks on target (max 50%)
- Expires at Turn End
Instinct of the Predator of Eld

_mech/BattleKeywords-a1c10p2.json#AngryB.zh: 每座水族箱都有自己的捕食者，就像百货商场里的楼层经理。如今捕食者以鱼的形态现身，但在更早的西西弗系统中，水族箱里并不存在鱼形生物。生活在那里的人，内心或许是鱼，外形却是人。
_mech/BattleKeywords-a1c10p2.json#AngryB.en: Every aquarium had its predator, much like a Floor Manager in the department store. The predator now wears the shape of a fish, but in an earlier Sisyphe System, there were no fish-shaped beings in the Aquarium. The minds of those who lived there may have been fish, but their forms were human.

_mech/BattleKeywords-a1c10p2.json#BlackY.zh:
- 士气低落
- 使用技能时，若布布为主要目标，则拼点威力+3、基础威力+2
- 受到攻击时，施加1层缠结（每个技能3次）
_mech/BattleKeywords-a1c10p2.json#BlackY.en:
- Low Morale
- On Skill Use, if Pwie is the main target, Clash Power +3, Base Power +2
- When hit, inflict 1 Tangling (3 times per Skill)

_mech/BattleKeywords-a1c10p2.json#BlackY.zh:
- 恐慌
- 所有攻击均以布布为目标
- 使用技能时，若布布为主要目标，则拼点威力+6、基础威力+4
- 战斗开始：将所有技能硬币转化为不可摧毁的硬币
- 受到攻击时，施加1层缠结（每个技能6次）
_mech/BattleKeywords-a1c10p2.json#BlackY.en:
- Panic
- All Attacks target Pwie
- On Skill Use, if Pwie is the main target, Clash Power +6, Base Power +4
- Combat Start: Convert all Skill Coins into Unbreakable Coins
- When hit, inflict 1 Tangling (6 times per Skill)

_mech/BattleKeywords-a1c10p2.json#Flower.zh: - 移除所有混乱区间 - 拼点威力+2 - 因沉沦受到的精神力伤害-50%（向下取整） - 回合结束：回复10点精神力，并于下回合获得5层迅捷 - 拼点胜利：包括自身与援护单位在内的所有友方回复5点精神力
_mech/BattleKeywords-a1c10p2.json#Flower.en: - Remove all Stagger Thresholds - Clash Power +2 - Take -50% SP damage from Sinking (rounded down) - Turn End: Heal 10 SP and gain 5 Haste next turn - Clash Win: Heal 5 SP for all allies including this unit and Assist Units

_mech/BattleKeywords-a1c10p2.json#Flower.zh: 让罪孽的忏悔，在花香之下绽放。
_mech/BattleKeywords-a1c10p2.json#Flower.en: Let the confession of its sins bloom beneath the fragrance of flowers.

_mech/BattleKeywords-a1c10p2.json#Alriun.zh:
- 最大层数：30
- 回合结束：受到等同于层数的精神力伤害
- 若本单位受到沉沦伤害，获得1层
- 震颤引爆时，对其他3名随机友方施加1~2层余香
- 层数达到上限时：
 · 获得2点震颤，并对自身触发震颤引爆
 · 受到等同于自身沉沦的忧郁伤害
 · 余香失效
 · 本回合内无法再次获得
- 死亡时，将本单位一半的余香层数随机分配给友方（向下取整）
_mech/BattleKeywords-a1c10p2.json#Alriun.en:
- Max Stack: 30
- Turn End: Take SP damage equal to Stack
- If this unit took Sinking damage, gain 1 Stack
- On Tremor Burst, apply 1 ~ 2 Faint Aroma on 3 other random allies
- At max Stack:
 · Gain 2 Tremor and trigger Tremor Burst on self
 · Take Gloom damage equal to Sinking on self
 · Faint Aroma expires
 · Cannot gain for the rest of the turn
- On death, apply half of this unit's Faint Aroma Stack randomly between this unit's allies (rounded down)

_mech/BattleKeywords-a1c10p2.json#Alriun.zh: 芬芳催生思慕，思慕转而化作渴望。
_mech/BattleKeywords-a1c10p2.json#Alriun.en: Fragrance begets longing. Longing, in turn, becomes yearning.

_mech/BattleKeywords-a1c10p2.json#Alriun.zh: - 最大层数：3 - 达到3层时，本回合使用强力技能 - 对陷入混乱的目标造成的伤害+（自身花瓣层数×10）% - 回合结束：获得1层
_mech/BattleKeywords-a1c10p2.json#Alriun.en: Max Stack: 3 - At 3 Stacks, use a powerful Skill that turn - Deal +(Petals Stack on self x 10)% damage to Staggered targets - Turn End: Gain 1 Stack

_mech/BattleKeywords-a1c10p2.json#Alriun.zh: 一片花瓣，两片花瓣……然后，三片。
_mech/BattleKeywords-a1c10p2.json#Alriun.en: One petal, two petals... and then, three.

_mech/BattleKeywords-a1c10p2.json#Thread.zh: - 最大层数：3 - 持有本效果时无法获得迅捷 - 回合结束：移除将在下回合获得的迅捷 - 回合结束：下回合获得等同于威力的束缚，并失去1层 - 层数达到上限时，本回合与下回合获得无法行动；随后本效果失效
_mech/BattleKeywords-a1c10p2.json#Thread.en: - Max Stack: 3 - Cannot gain Haste while having this effect - Turn End: Remove Haste that will be applied next turn - Turn End: Gain Bind next turn equal to Potency and lose 1 Stack - At max Stack, gain Immobilize this turn and next turn; then, this effect expires

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-npc-floor-4-b.json#N10.en: Le Noir Footwear Hall Sales Associate

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-4-b.json#Q.en: To the Footwear Hall

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-4-b.json#Q.zh: 我们到了4层。沿着走廊前往制鞋馆吧。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-4-b.json#Q.en: We've arrived at 4F. Let's follow the Corridor to the Footwear Hall.
Follow the corridor to the Footwear Hall
Head to the Footwear Hall

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-4-b.json#Q.zh: 我们给一直跟着我们的孩子取了个名字——“布布”。祂看起来还有些警惕我们……不过眼下，我们应该像之前一样，优先前往4层的制鞋馆。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-4-b.json#Q.en: We gave a name to the child following us—"Pwie". They still seem a little wary of us... But for now, our priority should be to head to the Footwear Hall on 4F, just like before.
Head to the Footwear Hall
Kill Four-legs
Kill One-leg
르루주 신발관 NPC A

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-4-b.json#Q.zh: 与制鞋馆里剩下的人交谈
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-4-b.json#Q.en: Talk to whoever's left in the Footwear Hall
Head to the Furniture Hall

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-4-b.json#Q.zh: 红派制鞋馆的多罗西娅请我们找到一块心脏碎片，好让她找到回家的路。作为回报，她会告诉我们如何前往5层。前往家具馆找她要的东西吧。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-4-b.json#Q.en: Dorothea from Le Rouge's Footwear Hall asked us to find a shard of heart so she can find her way home. In return, she'll tell us how to reach 5F. Head to the Furniture Hall to find what she wants.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-4-b.json#Q.zh: 前往家具馆的快乐衣橱
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-4-b.json#Q.en: Head to the Happy Closet in the Furniture Hall
Talk to the Arc Floor Lamp

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-4-b.json#Q.zh: 家具馆的快乐衣橱依旧一言不发。我们从它身上撬出了一些东西。是时候去找驼背落地灯了。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-4-b.json#Q.en: The Happy Closet in the Furniture Hall still refuses to say a word. We pried a few things loose from them. Time to head over to the Arc Floor Lamp.
Talk to the Arc Floor Lamp

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-4-b.json#Q.zh: 把衣服拿给驼背落地灯
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-4-b.json#Q.en: Take the clothing to the Arc Floor Lamp
Return to the Happy Closet

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-4-b.json#Q.zh: 我们把从快乐衣橱那儿拿来的衣服交给了驼背落地灯。现在其他家具也开始吵着要自己的行头了。返回快乐衣橱那里吧。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-4-b.json#Q.en: We gave the Arc Floor Lamp the clothing we took from the Happy Closet. Now the other Furnishings are clamoring for outfits of their own. Head back to the Happy Closet.
Return to the Happy Closet
Deliver the Clothes to the Furnishings

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-4-b.json#Q.zh: 快乐衣橱再次毫无怨言地交出了它拥有的东西。把衣服送给家具们吧。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-4-b.json#Q.en: Once again, the Happy Closet gave up what they had without complaint. Deliver the clothes to the Furnishings.
Delivery for Bonehanger
Delivery for Mellow Leather Bed
Delivery for Taxidermied Leather Curtain
Delivery for Red-cushioned Stool
Delivery for Skinhide Couch
Delivery for Lamp Twin

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-4-b.json#Q.zh: 询问快乐衣橱能否给我们一块心脏碎片
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-4-b.json#Q.en: Ask the Happy Wardrobe whether we can get a shard of heart

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-4-b.json#Q.zh: 我们帮完了家具们的忙。是时候向快乐衣橱要一块心脏碎片了。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-4-b.json#Q.en: We've finished helping the Furnishings. Time to ask the Happy Closet for a shard of heart.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-4-b.json#Q.zh: 询问快乐衣橱能否给我们一块心脏碎片
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-4-b.json#Q.en: Ask the Happy Wardrobe whether we can get a shard of heart
The Furnishings' Ambush

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-4-b.json#Q.zh: 家具们正把快乐衣橱撕成碎片。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-4-b.json#Q.en: The Furnishings are ripping the Happy Closet apart.
Inspect the Happy Closet's remains

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-4-b.json#Q.zh: 家具们为了抢夺各自的东西把快乐衣橱撕成了碎片，随后又自相残杀直至无人站立。查看快乐衣橱的残骸吧。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-4-b.json#Q.en: The Furnishings tore the Happy Closet apart in their scramble for their belongings, then turned on each other until no one was left standing. Let's search the Happy Closet's remains.
Inspect the Happy Closet's remains
Head to the Rouge Footwear Hall

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-4-b.json#Q.zh: 我们和黑派制鞋馆的事已经办完了。是时候前往紧挨着它楼下的红派制鞋馆了。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-4-b.json#Q.en: Our business with the Noir Footwear Hall is done. Time to head to the Rouge's Footwear Hall just next door below.
Head to the Rouge Footwear Hall
Return to the Rouge Footwear Hall

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-4-b.json#Q.zh: 我们从快乐衣橱那儿收集到了一块心脏碎片。返回红派制鞋馆，把它交给多罗西娅吧。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-4-b.json#Q.en: We managed to collect a shard of heart from the Happy Closet. Let's return to Le Rouge's Footwear Hall and give it to Dorothea.
Return to the Rouge Footwear Hall
Follow Dorothea

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-4-b.json#Q.zh: 我们把从快乐衣橱那儿拿到的心脏碎片交给了多罗西娅，她答应告诉我们如何前往5层。跟着她走吧。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-4-b.json#Q.en: We gave Dorothea the shard of heart taken from the Happy Closet, and she agreed to tell us how to get to 5F. Let's follow her.
Follow Dorothea
The Hole in the Wall

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-4-b.json#Q.zh: 墙上有个洞。我们应该查看一下。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-4-b.json#Q.en: There's hole in the wall. We should inspect it.
Inspect the hole
Head into the Hole

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-4-b.json#Q.zh: 多罗西娅碰了碰鞋跟，墙上出现了一个开口。我们进去吧。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-4-b.json#Q.en: Dorothea clicked her shoes together, and an opening appeared in the wall. Let's head inside.
Head into the hole
Follow the Abnormality

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-4-b.json#Q.zh: 通道把我们引到了一个叫“迷童中心”的地方。一只异想体出现，把多罗西娅掳走了。我们应该追上去。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-4-b.json#Q.en: The passage led us to a place called the Lost Child Center. An Abnormality appeared and carried Dorothea away. We should go after it.
Follow the Abnormality
Inspect the Abnormality's Remains

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-4-b.json#Q.zh: 我们解决了那只异想体。查看它的残骸吧。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-4-b.json#Q.en: We dealt with the Abnormality. Let's inspect its remains.
Inspect the Abnormality's remains
Inspect the Abnormality's Remains

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-4-b.json#Q.zh: 被掳走的多罗西娅倒在地上。查看她吧。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-4-b.json#Q.en: The abducted Dorothea is lying on the floor. Let's inspect her.
Head to the Other Stores

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-4-b.json#Q.zh: 布布有了一双漂亮的新鞋。4层似乎还有我们没去过的店铺。去看看吧。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-4-b.json#Q.en: Pwie has a fine new pair of shoes. There still seems to be stores on 4F we haven't visited yet. Let's go check them out.
Head to the other stores

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-4-b.json#Q.zh: 与手袋馆里的另一名员工交谈
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-4-b.json#Q.en: Talk to the other employee in the Handbags Hall

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-4-b.json#Q.zh: 查看红派手袋馆内的墙壁
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-4-b.json#Q.en: Inspect the Wall in the Le Rouge Handbags Hall

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-4-b.json#Q.zh: 我们应该查看一下那面墙。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-4-b.json#Q.en: We should check the wall out.
Investigate the wall
What was Hidden Behind the Wall?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-4-b.json#Q.zh: 藏在墙后的人现身了。我们该决定拿她怎么办。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-4-b.json#Q.en: The one who was hidden behind the wall revealed herself. We should decide what to do with her.
Decide what to do with Renée
Decide what to do with Renée
Wait for the decision to be carried out.
Decide what to do with Renée
Head to the Other Stores

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-4-b.json#Q.zh: 我们在红派手袋馆的事已经办完了。是时候去看看另一家店铺了。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-4-b.json#Q.en: Our business in the Rouge Handbags Hall is done. Time to check out the other store.
Head to the other stores
Collect the Golden material

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-quest-floor-4-b.json#Q.en: The designer at Le Noir's Handbags Hall asked us to gather some Golden materials. Help out so we can obtain information about where to find the escalator to the 5F. The materials can be taken from Mannequins.

StoryData/S1026B.json#0#content.zh: 好久不见了，异乡人们。听说没有我在的时候，你们玩得挺开心啊，是吗？我本该早就跑来一起凑个热闹的，可是……唉。你们绝对想不到我这堆积如山的工作有多少。
StoryData/S1026B.json#0#content.en: Long time no see, strangers. Word is you've been having all kinds of fun without me around; is that right? I would've come running ages ago to join in, but... ugh. You wouldn't believe how much work I've had piled on me.

StoryData/S1026B.json#1#content.zh: <她还真是哪儿都能冒出来啊……>

StoryData/S1026B.json#2#content.zh: ……既然你都特地过来一趟了，那就回答我一个问题吧。所谓“有失德行”，到底是什么意思？
StoryData/S1026B.json#2#content.en: ... Since you've already dropped in, answer me one thing. What exactly does it mean to be "lacking in virtue"?

StoryData/S1026B.json#3#content.zh: 真是个乏味的问题。跟你那条老掉牙的手臂一样乏味。
StoryData/S1026B.json#3#content.en: What a tedious question. Nearly as tedious as that antiquated arm you've got there.

StoryData/S1026B.json#4#content.zh: 你倒是回答问题啊，行不行？
StoryData/S1026B.json#4#content.en: Just answer the question, will you?

StoryData/S1026B.json#5#content.zh: 唔，好吧。反正结局不会有什么不同，那我不妨告诉你们这么多。再说了……那小崽子等本能一发作，迟早也会明白的。
StoryData/S1026B.json#5#content.en: Hmm, fine. You won't get a different ending anyway, so I suppose I can tell you that much. Besides... I'm sure it'll come to that runt soon enough, when its instincts kick in.

StoryData/S1026B.json#7#content.zh: 有失德行，就是缺乏高贵。也就是说……变得高贵，变得尊贵，你就能被允许进入这个地方。听懂我的意思了吗？
StoryData/S1026B.json#7#content.en: To lack virtue means to lack nobility. Which is to say... become noble, become prestigious, and you'll be granted entry into this place. Do you get what I'm saying?

StoryData/S1026B.json#8#content.zh: 我是半点都没听懂……啊。莫非，这……是关乎时尚的事？
StoryData/S1026B.json#8#content.en: I comprehend it not in the slightest... Ah. Could this, perchance, be... a matter of fashion?

StoryData/S1026B.json#9#content.zh: 要是你到现在还没弄明白在这里“变得更高贵”是什么意思，我可真要大失所望了。
StoryData/S1026B.json#9#content.en: I would have been terribly disappointed if you still hadn't grasped what it means to "become nobler" in here.

StoryData/S1026B.json#10#content.zh: 总而言之，又猜中了。高贵要求与其身份相称的消费——也需要与之相称的服装。而这家店里，唯一能确保提升你身份地位的东西就是……
StoryData/S1026B.json#10#content.en: In any case, bingo again. Nobility demands consumption befitting one's station—and garments befitting it as well. And the one thing in this store certain to raise that station is...

StoryData/S1026B.json#11#content.zh: 一件用名为黄金皮革……或者黄金松脂的材料制成的衣物。
StoryData/S1026B.json#11#content.en: A garment fashioned from the material known as Golden Hide... or Golden Resin.

StoryData/S1026B.json#12#content.zh: 下次再见的时候……务必带着我想要的结果回来，嗯？
StoryData/S1026B.json#12#content.en: The next time we meet... do try to return with the outcome I desire, hmm?

StoryData/S1026B.json#13#content.zh: 看你们这群蠢货在黑暗里瞎摸乱撞固然有趣，但我更希望你们能赶紧去把这座愚蠢的西西弗百货给烧个精光。
StoryData/S1026B.json#13#content.en: As fun as it is to watch you idiots fumble around in the dark, I'd much prefer it if you got on with the "melting this stupid Grand Magasin to the ground" part.

StoryData/S1026B.json#16#content.zh: <她又帮了我们一把，可我还是猜不透她到底图什么。>
StoryData/S1026B.json#16#content.en: <She helped us again, but I still can't tell what she's really after.>

StoryData/S1026B.json#17#content.zh: <而且我是说，如果那是布布自己也能想明白的事，那她好像也没帮上多大忙，对吧？她是不是只是随便冒出来吓唬我们一下之类的……？>
StoryData/S1026B.json#17#content.en: that much, did she? Does she just show up randomly to unnerve us or something...?>

StoryData/S1026B.json#18#content.zh: ……和以前一样，她似乎并不打算提供什么真正有用的信息。或许她的目的更接近于嘲弄，而非帮助。
StoryData/S1026B.json#18#content.en: ... As before, she appears disinclined to provide us with information of genuine utility. Perhaps her purpose lies nearer to mockery than aid.

StoryData/S1026B.json#19#content.zh: 嘿……你觉得她是不是已经先进去了？看起来里面好像有人……
StoryData/S1026B.json#19#content.en: Hey... Do you think she went ahead inside? Looks like there are people in there...

StoryData/S1026B.json#20#content.zh: ……如果“高贵”是进入的先决条件……那或许里面那些人本身就是身份高贵之辈。
StoryData/S1026B.json#20#content.en: ... If "nobility" is prerequisite to entry... then mayhaps those within are themselves persons of noble standing.

StoryData/S1026B.json#22#content.zh: 看起来他们能做的……只是坐在被安排好的位置上，吃被分配到的东西……
StoryData/S1026B.json#22#content.en: It looks like all they can do is... sit where they're told and eat what they're given...

StoryData/S1026B.json#23#content.zh: 嗯……就连上菜的顺序似乎也是预先定好的。一场排场十足的盛宴……我记得这种东西被称作“精致餐仪”。
StoryData/S1026B.json#23#content.en: Hm... The order of ceremony, too, seems predetermined. A repast of pomp and circumstance... I believe it is called "dining of fine nature."

StoryData/S1026B.json#25#content.zh: 为什么他们要等下一道菜，而不是一口气全吃了？这不是在浪费吃饭的时间吗？
StoryData/S1026B.json#25#content.en: Why are they waiting for the next course instead of eating everything all at once? Aren't they wasting eating time?

StoryData/S1026B.json#26#content.zh: 为什么要坐在指定的座位上，吃指定分量的指定食物？
StoryData/S1026B.json#26#content.en: Why do they sit in assigned seats and eat assigned food in assigned amounts?

StoryData/S1026B.json#27#content.zh: 我不懂。他们干嘛不直接一直吃下去？为什么不把一道菜吃干净了再上下一道，直到什么都不剩？
StoryData/S1026B.json#27#content.en: I don't get it. Why don't they just eat and eat? Why don't they just clean a dish and move on to the next one until there's nothing left?

StoryData/S1026B.json#28#content.zh: 唔……不同的“阶层”，不同的文化吧？

StoryData/S1026B.json#29#content.zh: 布布久久地隔着帷幔，默默注视着那场宴席，
StoryData/S1026B.json#29#content.en: For a long while, Pwie silently watched the banquet beyond the curtain,

StoryData/S1026B.json#30#content.zh: 像个饿坏了的孩子，隔着橱窗盯着那场豪宴垂涎欲滴。
StoryData/S1026B.json#30#content.en: like a starving child salivating at a lavish feast past the display glass.

StoryData/S1026B.json#31#content.zh: 我……我好饿。而且我想……穿上它。
StoryData/S1026B.json#31#content.en: I'm... I'm so hungry. And I want... to wear it.

StoryData/S1026B.json#32#content.zh: 一件黄金裹布……用从墙上剥下的黄金皮革做成……
StoryData/S1026B.json#32#content.en: A Golden Shroud... made of Golden Hide, flayed off the walls...

StoryData/S1026B.json#34#content.zh: <这个念头是突然冒出来的吗？>
StoryData/S1026B.json#34#content.en: <Did that thought just come to you?>

StoryData/S1026B.json#35#content.zh: 这个念头是未经任何思虑就冒出来的吗？
StoryData/S1026B.json#35#content.en: Did the thought occur to you without prior deliberation?

StoryData/S1026B.json#36#content.zh: 嗯。就这么突然冒出来的。

StoryData/S1026B.json#37#content.zh: 裹布，你说？裹布是……为踏上最后一段旅程之人准备的衣物。你想穿上这样的东西……？
StoryData/S1026B.json#37#content.en: A shroud, you say? A shroud is... a garment reserved for one embarking upon their final journey. And you wish to wear such...?

StoryData/S1026B.json#38#content.zh: 嗯。是这具躯干这辈子最后穿上的衣服。
StoryData/S1026B.json#38#content.en: Mhm. The last attire that will ever be put on my body.

StoryData/S1026B.json#39#content.en: Because I'm going to... grow up.

StoryData/S1026B.json#40#content.zh: 要长大，我就需要一件合乎我未来模样的衣服。
StoryData/S1026B.json#40#content.en: And to grow up, I'll need clothes made to fit what I'll become.

StoryData/S1026B.json#41#content.zh: <如果是用剥下来的黄金皮革做的……那制作方法应该跟做黄金面料不一样。>
StoryData/S1026B.json#41#content.en: <If it's made of Golden Hide that's been peeled off... then the production process must be different from making Golden Fabric.>

StoryData/S1026B.json#42#content.zh: 如果那位手袋设计师所说属实……地下应该有能处理兽皮的员工。
StoryData/S1026B.json#42#content.en: If the handbag designer's statement was accurate... there should be an employee underground capable of processing hides.

StoryData/S1026B.json#43#content.zh: <那是在地下3层，对吧……？我们大概得先找到它的自动扶梯，就像找5层那次一样。>
StoryData/S1026B.json#43#content.en: <That's B3F, right...? We'll probably have to locate its escalator first, just like we did for the fifth floor.>

StoryData/S1026B.json#44#content.zh: <好了，我们下去，把布布的衣服做好吧。>
StoryData/S1026B.json#44#content.en: <All right, let's head down and have Pwie's clothes made.>

StoryData/S1026B.json#45#content.zh: ……我们会为你做一件合身的衣服。
StoryData/S1026B.json#45#content.en: ... We will make an article of clothing that fits you.

StoryData/S1026B.json#47#content.zh: 因为那是你想要的，而这，也正是我们的愿望。
StoryData/S1026B.json#47#content.en: Because that is what you want, and in turn, our desire as well.

StoryData/S1026B.json#51#content.zh: 嘿，经理兄。你在那儿发什么呆呢？
StoryData/S1026B.json#51#content.en: Hey, Manager Bud. What are you doin' there staring into space?

StoryData/S1026B.json#52#content.zh: <不，只是……听到布布跟我们道谢……>
StoryData/S1026B.json#52#content.en: <No, it's just... hearing Pwie thank us...>

StoryData/S1026B.json#53#content.zh: <这让我想起了你们所有人第一次认真听我说话的那一次。真正在听的那一次。>
StoryData/S1026B.json#53#content.en: <It reminded me of the first time all of you listened to me. Really listened.>

StoryData/S1026B.json#54#content.zh: ……对于那一刻之前发生的一切，以及此后发生的一切……我始终心怀感激。
StoryData/S1026B.json#54#content.en: ... And for all that has transpired before that moment, and what came thereafter... I remain ever grateful.

StoryData/S9992B.json#0#content.zh: 西西弗百货必须被吃掉。
StoryData/S9992B.json#0#content.en: The Grand Magasin must be consumed.

StoryData/S9992B.json#1#content.zh: 即便所有人都必须不停地吃。
StoryData/S9992B.json#1#content.en: Even if all must eat without pause.

StoryData/S9992B.json#2#content.zh: 有人希望这一刻永远不要结束，
StoryData/S9992B.json#2#content.en: Some hope that this moment would never end,

StoryData/S9992B.json#3#content.zh: 希望这份饱足能永远持续，
StoryData/S9992B.json#3#content.en: Wishing that the filling would last forever,

StoryData/S9992B.json#4#content.zh: 如今这座百货商场里的每个人都变成了纯粹的消费者。他们毫无节制地吞食。
StoryData/S9992B.json#4#content.en: Now everyone in this department store has turned into a pure consumer. They consume without restraint.

StoryData/S9992B.json#5#content.zh: 已经没有人再去创造什么了。
StoryData/S9992B.json#5#content.en: There's nobody left to create things.

StoryData/S9992B.json#6#content.zh: 他们会吃、会穿、会排泄、会消耗一切。
StoryData/S9992B.json#6#content.en: They will all eat, wear, excrete, and consume.

StoryData/S9992B.json#7#content.zh: 他们会从自己的敌人开始——黑派、褐派，以及一切不属于红派的人。
StoryData/S9992B.json#7#content.en: They will start with their enemies—Le Noir, Le Kaki, and others who do not belong to the Rouges.

StoryData/S9992B.json#8#content.zh: 而一旦再没有别人可吃，他们便会开始互相蚕食。
StoryData/S9992B.json#8#content.en: And once there is no one left to eat, they will eat each other.

StoryData/S9992B.json#9#content.zh: 这已经成了一股无法阻挡的势头。
StoryData/S9992B.json#9#content.en: This has become a momentum that cannot be stopped.

StoryData/S9992B.json#10#content.zh: 他们会持续互相吞噬，直到只剩下唯一的存在：
StoryData/S9992B.json#10#content.en: They will continue devouring each other until only a single existence remains:

StoryData/S9992B.json#11#content.zh: 布菲。到最后，布菲将会孤身一人，再没有谁能陪伴在侧。
StoryData/S9992B.json#11#content.en: Buffet. In the end, Buffet will be alone, without anyone left to keep them company.

StoryData/S9992B.json#12#content.zh: 人们所追求的体验，并不只是一种活在当下的方式。
StoryData/S9992B.json#12#content.en: The experiences people pursue are not simply a way to live in the present.

StoryData/S9992B.json#13#content.zh: 我们想要的是那已经尝过的滋味。那份饱足。那份愉悦。
StoryData/S9992B.json#13#content.en: We want the same taste we've already tasted. The fullness. The pleasure.

StoryData/S9992B.json#14#content.zh: 我们寻求新的体验，是为了能再一次感受那些旧日的感觉。
StoryData/S9992B.json#14#content.en: New experiences are sought so we many feel those old sensations once more.

StoryData/S9992B.json#16#content.zh: 这不过是我们被设计成的样子。存在于对某种东西、任何东西的无尽渴求循环之中。
StoryData/S9992B.json#16#content.en: That is simply how we were designed. To exist in an endless cycle of yearning for something, anything.

StoryData/S9992B.json#17#content.zh: 这难道不是太残忍了吗？

StoryData/S9992B.json#18#content.zh: 注定永远无法知晓满足的滋味。
StoryData/S9992B.json#18#content.en: To be fated to never know satisfaction.

StoryData/S9992B.json#19#content.zh: 这也正是黑派选择永恒静止的原因。你还记得吗？
StoryData/S9992B.json#19#content.en: And that is why the Noirs have chosen an everlasting inertness. Do you remember?

StoryData/S9992B.json#20#content.zh: 那是因为他们全都感到恐惧。
StoryData/S9992B.json#20#content.en: It's because they are all afraid.

StoryData/S9992B.json#21#content.zh: 出于对死亡的恐惧，黑派把自己钉在过去的记忆里，好在死亡找上门来之前躲过它。
StoryData/S9992B.json#21#content.en: Afraid of death, the Noirs nail themselves inside the memory of the past before death can come to claim them.

StoryData/S9992B.json#22#content.zh: 出于对死亡的恐惧，红派则不断用形形色色的体验填满每一个流逝的瞬间，好让自己得以放下自我。
StoryData/S9992B.json#22#content.en: Afraid of death, the Rouges continue filling every passing moment with different experiences so they can let go of their selves.

StoryData/S9992B.json#23#content.zh: 他们的逃避之路看似天差地别，但每一条都无限延伸，趋向同一条渐近线。
StoryData/S9992B.json#23#content.en: Their routes of escape may look worlds apart, but every path stretches infinitely toward the same asymptote.

StoryData/S9992B.json#25#content.zh: <……你上次说过，那是人类的能力无法分辨的东西。>
StoryData/S9992B.json#25#content.en: <... is not within human ability to distinguish, you said last time.>

StoryData/S9992B.json#26#content.zh: 西西弗百货之外的世界，也没有什么不同。
StoryData/S9992B.json#26#content.en: The world outside the Grand Magasin is no different.

StoryData/S9992B.json#27#content.zh: 只是过程与形式看起来有所不同罢了。
StoryData/S9992B.json#27#content.en: Only the process and the form appear different.

StoryData/S9992B.json#28#content.zh: 每个人都惧怕死亡。每个人都以自己的方式与之抗争。
StoryData/S9992B.json#28#content.en: Everyone fears death. Everyone struggles against it in their own way.

StoryData/S9992B.json#29#content.zh: 一旦被抛入人生这段旅程，死亡便在那条路的尽头等候着。
StoryData/S9992B.json#29#content.en: Once someone has been thrown into the journey of life, death waits at the end of that road.

StoryData/S9992B.json#30#content.zh: 而在那条路上，人们被造就得永远无法真正得到满足。这不过是我们被诞生到这个世界上的方式罢了。
StoryData/S9992B.json#30#content.en: And along that road, people are made unable to remain satisfied. That is simply the way we were birthed into this world.

StoryData/S9992B.json#31#content.zh: 你以为人类为什么被造就成这样？这背后有什么理由吗？
StoryData/S9992B.json#31#content.en: Why do you suppose people were made that way? Is there a reason behind it?

StoryData/S9992B.json#32#content.zh: 但我并不打算去探究或改写人类存在的理由、起源或设计。
StoryData/S9992B.json#32#content.en: But I'm not interested in exploring or rewriting humanity's reason for existence, origin, or design.

StoryData/S9992B.json#33#content.zh: 相反，重要的是让一个人在走完通向死亡的人生旅程时，能始终忠于自己。
StoryData/S9992B.json#33#content.en: Instead, it's about letting someone go through the journey of life toward death while remaining true to themselves.

StoryData/S9992B.json#34#content.zh: 现在……喂饱一个饥饿的孩子，几乎算不上什么罪孽。
StoryData/S9992B.json#34#content.en: Now... feeding a hungry child can hardly be called a sin.

StoryData/S9992B.json#35#content.zh: 可这个孩子将什么都不会留下。
StoryData/S9992B.json#35#content.en: But this child will leave nothing behind.

StoryData/S9992B.json#36#content.zh: 黄金已经被剥到了最后一丝。
StoryData/S9992B.json#36#content.en: The gold has been torn away to the final thread.

StoryData/S9992B.json#37#content.zh: 这座百货商场正被生生剥皮……血肉从骨头上被撕下，枯竭正步步逼近。
StoryData/S9992B.json#37#content.en: The department store is being flayed bare... its flesh stripped from the bone as depletion closes in.

StoryData/S9992B.json#38#content.zh: 饱足将永远遥不可及，但我们仍然可以对他们说……
StoryData/S9992B.json#38#content.en: Fullness will remain forever beyond their reach, but we can still tell them...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 一块干瘪的肉块。散发着一股冰冷的腥味。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: A desiccated slab of meat. It gives off a cold, fishy odor.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 这里堆放着一叠叠折得整整齐齐的布料，多半是从地下2层织出来的。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: Neatly folded stacks of fabric, most likely woven from B2F, are piled here.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 这些大概会一直堆在这儿，直到……过了足够多的季节，搬运工才会把它们运上去。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: These'll probably stay down here until the... Porters bring them upstairs when enough seasons pass.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 门后是一片被黑暗吞没的空旷空间。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: The door opens onto an empty space drowned in darkness.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 上次，走进这扇门把我们带到了泉。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: Last time, entering this door led us to the Fount.
... So dark. Don't go in there.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 呃……我们不会真要进去吧，经理兄？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: Uh... We're not going in there, are we, Manager Bud?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 想到清仓之前我们试过这个入口后发生的事……按常理，不该再试第二次。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: Considering what happened when we tried this etrance before the Liquidation... it would be common sense not to try it again.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 不过这次的西西弗百货，自我们上次来过之后已经发生了些不小的变化。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: But the Grand Magasin this time has changed in some significant ways since our last visit.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 再说……在这里用“常理”来判断事情，本来就没多大意义。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: Besides... it didn't make much sense to make judgments based on "common sense" in here.
Maybe... it'll be different this time?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 一张洁白无瑕的桌子。上面摆放着各种切割好的肉块与兽皮。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: A pristine white table. Various cuts of meat and hides lie arranged across it.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: ……这些长凳是我做的，反正也没人坐。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: ... I make these benches, and no one sits on 'em anyway.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 除了主厨——不，她做的那玩意儿根本算不上烹饪。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: Except for Head Chef—no, what she's doing doesn't even count as cooking.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 我宁愿把这整个买卖砸个稀巴烂。嗯，这话听着才更顺耳。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: I'd much rather smash this whole business to pieces. Yeah, that's much sweeter to my ears.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 他一边自言自语，一边把切肉刀狠狠剁在一块又一块肉上。……现在大概不是跟他搭话的好时机。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: He's muttering to himself as he slams the cleaver down on chunk after chunk of meat. ... Probably not the best time to chat him up.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 梯子的画像上放着一张票。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: There's a ticket laid atop the drawing of a ladder.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: [一张票本身并不能带你去任何地方。]
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: [A ticket alone cannot take you anywhere.]

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: [它只是一个承诺——承诺会把你带到某处。]
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: [It is mererly a promise to bring you somewhere.]

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: [因此，那些清楚自己目的地的人，会把梯子钉死作为票。]
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: [Thus, those who know their destinations nail the ladder down as a ticket.]

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: <你觉得是谁把这个留在这儿的？>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: <Who do you suppose left this here?>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 或许是某个异乡人想方设法使用自动扶梯……不，这种可能性不大。这多半只是巨人的恶作剧。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: Perhaps a stranger struggling to make use of the escalator all... no, that doesn't seem very probable. This is most likely nothing more than Giant mischief.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: <你是说，像让娜……或者神父那样的人，把这个留在了这儿？>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: <You mean people like Jeanne... or the Chaplain... left this here?>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: ……或者是妈妈。又或者是现任巨人的某位前任，也说不定。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: ... Or Mother. Or one of the current Giants' predecessors, perhaps.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 梯子的画像上放着一个指南针。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: There's a compass laid atop the drawing of a ladder.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: [我相当喜欢指南针。它遵循着方位的绝对法则——东南西北……真美。]
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: [I'm quite fond of compasses. It abides by the absolute rule of cardinal directions—north, east, south, and west... Beautiful.]

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: [人心中或许会有些疑虑，是啊：这些规则真的“正确”吗？指南针真的按规则运作吗？……确实，都是些合理的疑虑。]
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: [One may harbor certain doubts in their hearts, yes: are these rules the "right" rules? Does the compass work according to the rules? ... Indeed, all valid concerns.]

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: [但指南针存在的意义，就是在你迷路时为你指路。懂了吧。]
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: [But the point of a compass is to guide you when you're lost. You get the idea.]

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: [都清楚了吗？很好。那我这就下班了。]
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: [All good? Very well. I'll be clocking out now.]

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 意思是结束一天的工作，回家去。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: It means to wrap up a day's work and return home.
... You have to leave home to work?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 嗯……有些工作可以在家里做。但对大多数人来说，“工作”就意味着离开家。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: Well... some works can be done from home. But for most people, "work" means leaving home.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 那……我觉得工作有点糟糕。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: Then... I think work kinda sucks.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: <……是我的错觉，还是这话听起来跟金笠会说的一模一样？>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: <... Is it just me, or did that sound just like what Bamboo-hatted Kim would say?>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 大家都想回家，可还是得忍着，离开家去……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: Everybody wants to go home, but they still gotta hold that in and leave home...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 默尔索继续回答着布布关于“家”的连番提问，浮士德则悄悄从旁边靠近了我。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: As Meursault continued to answer Pwie's stream of questions about "home," Faust quietly approached me from the side.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: ……关于“回家”，是有些东西。虽然这张纸条可能是站在巨人的角度写的……但也可能暗示着，这里其实有一条出路。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: ... There is something about "going home." Though the note may have been written from a Giant's point of view... it may also imply that there is, in fact, a way out of here.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: <……但愿如此。这次，我们一定能成功。>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: <... Sure hope so. This time, we'll succeed.>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 几名居民把头埋进了喷泉里。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: Several residents have their heads plunged into the fountain.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 他们把脸浸没在苏打水里猛灌，几乎快要溺毙。有些人已经彻底一动不动了。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: They are guzzling soda with their faces submerged, right up to the brink of drowning. Some have already gone completely still.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 精肉苏打已经准备好了。就算我是能比默尔索更好地与象征界互动的那位对象，我也不觉得自己能鼓起勇气尝一口。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: The Meat Soda is ready. I doubt I could bring myself to try it even if I were the subject of the Symbolic who could interact with it better than Meursault.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 门被堵住了。把耳朵贴上去，能听见门后传来一片嘈杂——人声、脚步声，还有别的。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: The door is blocked. Pressing an ear against it reveals a jumble of noises beyond—voices, footsteps, and more.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 他们在里面干嘛呢？全都挤成一团……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: What are they all doing in there? All huddled in a group...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 经理问你，能不能看穿这扇被堵住的门。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: The Manager asks whether you can see through the blocked door.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 被堵住的门……？可它没被堵住啊……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: Blocked door...? It's not blocked, though...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 我们和布布看到的，恐怕是不同的东西。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: It is likely that we and Pwie are looking at different things.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 布布在门前徘徊了一阵，好奇心似乎得到了满足——或者只是渐渐消退——便转身去看别处了。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: Pwie hovered in front of the door for a while, then their curiosity seemingly sated—or simply dwindled—turned around and began looking elsewhere.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 门被堵住了。把耳朵贴上去，能听见门后传来一片嘈杂——人声、脚步声，还有别的。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: The door is blocked. Pressing an ear against it reveals a jumble of noises beyond—voices, footsteps, and more.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 敲了敲门，却没有回应。也没有任何生命迹象。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: Knocked on the door, but there's no response. Or any signs of life, for that matter.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 只剩下令人发寒的沉默。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: There is nothing but the chilling silence.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 我们靠近门时，门后有什么人——或什么东西——发出了窃笑声。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: When we approached the door, someone—or something—behind it snickers.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 我受了些皮外伤，但还不至于影响行动。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: I've sustained dermal lacerations, but they are not severe enough to impede me.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 默尔索起身，利落地拍掉身上的灰尘，这时我听见有什么人——或什么东西——在冲他窃笑。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: As Meursault rises and briskly dusts himself off, I could hear someone—or something—snickering at him.
<This one won't be opening, it seems.>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 是的。看来默尔索不符合入内所需的条件。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: No. It appears that Meursault does not meet the conditions required to enter.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 布布轻轻一笑，然后朝默尔索靠近了一步。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: Pwie smiled lightly, then stood a step closer to Meursault.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 狭窄的窗户后面，似乎挂着一层厚厚的遮光帘。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: It looks as though a thick blackout curtain has been drawn behind the narrow window.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: ……时不时地，会传来什么东西被拧干似的、湿漉漉的咕啾声。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: ... Every so often, something makes a wet squelch as though something is being wrung out.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 再次凑近帘子，仔细听了听。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: Leaned in toward the curtain again to listen some more.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 屋内传来一阵湿哒哒的拍打声。片刻后，帘子随着一声清脆的啪响轻轻抖动了一下。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: A wet patter sounded from within. A moment later, the curtain gave a small twitch with a sharp smack.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: ……似乎有什么东西喷溅出来，溅了帘子一身。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: ... Something appears to have sprayed out and splattered all over it.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 此后再没有其他声音传来。
……不过偶尔，我好像能听见帘子底下有水滴滴落的声音。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: ... Though every so often, I think I hear droplets falling from beneath the curtain.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 从半掩的门缝望进去，只见一排排肉块密密麻麻地摆满了整个木地板。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: Peering through the slightly open door reveals rows of meaty chunks, densely arranged all over the wooden floor.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: ……很难分辨那些肉究竟从哪儿来，又是什么肉。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: ... It is difficult to tell where or what that meat came from.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 透过窗户，能看见一个庞大、无法辨认的东西，正把看起来像是兽皮的东西塞进墙上的一个洞里。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: Through the window, a huge, unidentifiable thing is feeding what looks like hide into a hole in the wall.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 布布踮起脚尖，想看清窗户那头的东西。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: Pwie stands on tiptoes, trying to see what's beyond the window.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 那个开口是多户住宅里常见的垃圾处理装置。也被称作“垃圾滑道”。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: That aperture is the kind commonly employed for waste disposal in multi-unit residences. It is also referred to as "dust chute."

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 可是……这不就是栋独栋房子吗？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: But... isn't this just a detached house?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 格里高尔先生，这是都市里建立起来的常识。象征界里的情况，恐怕很难套用同一套标准。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: That is common sense as established within the City, Herr Gregor. It is difficult to apply the same standard to the way things are in the Symbolic.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 哈……你是说，垃圾滑道在这儿根本不算什么常识……？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: Huh... you're saying a dust chute isn't a common-sense concept here then...?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: ……我再一次在两位罪人的争吵升级之前，把他们拉开了。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: ... Once again, I pull the two Sinners apart before their squabbling can get worse.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 看来每次尝试只能触发一场奇遇。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: Only one bizarre adventure per attempt, it seems.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 陈列着一些泛红的肉块与兽皮之类的东西。看起来比外面挂着的那些更新鲜。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: Reddish pieces of meat, hides, and the like have been put on display. They look fresher than the cuts hanging outside.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 自动扶梯前的地板上躺着什么东西。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: Something lies on the floor before the escalator.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 一座起点与终点都无从察觉的自动扶梯……一座甚至不朝任何方向移动的自动扶梯……我该把这座扶梯定义成什么呢？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: An escalator whose origin and terminus alike lie beyond perception... An escalator that doesn't even move in either direction... What would I have defined this escalator as?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 在那些被啃得干干净净的尸体之间，能看见些什么东西。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: Something is visible among the corpses that have been gnawed clean.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 一台自动贩卖机兼指引牌，姑且称之为“贩卖指引机”。我们可以从这里买点东西。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: A vending machine and directory in one. A vendingrectory machine. We can buy something from here.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 边缘上粘着些什么东西。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: Something is stuck to its edge.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 一张看起来像是百货楼层指引图的东西，被粘在一台饮料贩卖机上。大部分文字都因损毁而看不清了。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: What looks like a department-store directory is glued on a drink vending machine. Damage has obscured most of the lettering.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 你们这些人算什么东西，听见没？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: What are you people supposed to be, you hear?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 呃。一个会说话的玩偶……你也是那种人台之类的东西吗？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: Huh. A talking doll... Are you another one of those Mannequin things?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 我才不是什么玩偶，听见没？！我可是副主厨，听见没？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: I am not a doll, you hear?! I am the Sous Chef, you hear?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: ……我刚才怎么又重复了一遍。嗯，副主厨大概就相当于主厨的助手。基本上是厨房里排第二的厨师。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: ... Why did I just repeat that? Yeah, Sous Chef is like an assistant head cook. Second-highest chef in the kitchen, basically.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 哈。这套一问一答的调调还真传染人。我差点问了个自己早就知道答案的问题。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: Huh. This question-and-answer routine's catching. Nearly asked about something I already knew.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 我们在找黄金之茧，一件收在屠夫肉库里的特殊物品。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: We are searching for the Golden Cocoon, a specialty item kept in Boucher's meat storage.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 不过屠夫肉库里的食材可不卖，听见没？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: But ingredients in Boucher's meat storage are not for sale, you hear?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 它们每一丁点儿都得拿去做苏打，听见没？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: Every last bit of them have to go into the soda, you hear?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 啧。我们自己也急着要用它……有没有什么办法能商量商量？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: Tch. We need it pretty badly ourselves... Any way we can work something out?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 唔……要是你们能拿合适的东西来换，倒也许能以物易物，听见没？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: Hmm... Maybe if you bring the right substitute, you can barter for it, you hear?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 让我瞧瞧你们能不能当那个合适的替代品，听见没？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: Let's see if you can be the right substitute, you hear?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 唔……你肯定不行，听见没？墨鱼头到处都是，一抓一大把，听见没？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: Hmm... Certainly not you, you hear? Squid-ink heads come in all the time; they're dime-a-dozen, you hear?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 这个看起来太硬了，煮不熟，听见没？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: This one looks much too tough to cook, you hear?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 这位……倒是稀有货，不过咱们的酿造用不着拖时间，听见没？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: And this one's... rare, but our brew doesn't need more stretched time, you hear?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 副主厨绕着我们转了一圈，嗅了嗅空气，在格里高尔面前似乎短暂地停了一下……随后朝布布走去。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: The Sous Chef circled us, sniffed the air, then seemed to briefly pause in front of Gregor... before making her way to Pwie.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 不管是谁做出来的，这份贪婪也太大了，谁都受不了，听见没？这是……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: Whoever made this, they made it with a greed far too big for anyone, you hear? This is...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: <她该不会是想……把布布当成食材吧？>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: <Does she want to... use Pwie as an ingredient?>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 你绝对不能拿这个当食材用，听见没？要是把这种东西丢进咱们的苏打里……后果可就大大不妙了，听见没？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: You can't ever contribute this ingredient, you hear? If something like this were chucked into our soda... the consequences would be a BIG no-no, you hear?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 你不能变成食材，听见没？你根本就不该出现在这地下，听见没？！
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: You can't become an ingredient, you hear? You shouldn't even be down here, you hear?!

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 这下糟了，听见没？！要出大事了，听见没？！我是说你到底做了什么，听见没？！
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: This is a disaster, you hear?! Something really bad's gonna happen, you hear?! I'm saying what have you done, you hear?!

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: <看起来她是要向我们发难了……>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: <Looks like she's about to attack us...>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 暂……暂停一下，听见没？！好疼，听见没？！
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: Time... Time out, you hear?! That hurts, you hear?!

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 听着……是你先动手打我们的，这点你心里清楚。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: Look... you're the one who attacked us first. You know that.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 可那也不行……那种食材绝不能被混进任何东西里，听见没……？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: But still... that ingredient cannot be allowed to mix into anything, you hear...?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 这点你可以别再反复强调了。我们压根没有半点把这孩子变成食物的意思……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: You can stop hammering that point in. We never had the slightest intention of turning the kid into food...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: ……回到刚才被打断的交涉：作为黄金之茧的交换，我们可以提供猎物反刍肉。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: ... Returning to the interrupted negotiation: in exchange for the Golden Cocoon, we can contribute the Ruminations of the Prey.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 一个异乡人居然知道那个名字，真让人意外，听见没？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: I'm surprised a stranger knows that name, you hear?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 猎物反刍肉是屠夫最钟爱的食材……在所有食材里排第一——
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: The Ruminations of the Prey is Boucher's favorite ingredient... of all ingredients—

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 我们知道。而且我们手上就有。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: We know. And we have it in our possession.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 光是听到这名字我就要流口水了，听见没？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: Just hearing the name makes my mouth water, you hear?
All of you, follow me, you hear?!

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: *喘* *喘* 好久……没跑过步了，听见没？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: *huff* *huff* It's been ages... since I last had to run, you hear?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 我们礼貌地等着副主厨把气息重新调整平稳。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: We politely waited for the Sous Chef to finish wrestling her breath back under control.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 你们又是什么人，听见没？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: And who the heck are you, you hear?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 啊，是熟面孔，值得欢迎的面孔，听见没？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: Ah, a familiar face, a face to be welcomed, you hear?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 屠夫正在给猎物反刍肉摆盘配菜，快好了，听见没？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: Boucher is almost done putting the garnish on the Ruminations of the Prey, you hear?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 要是被那香味勾回来的，那可就不巧了，听见没？异乡人一口都别想尝，听见没？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: If the smell drew you back, too bad; you hear? Strangers aren't getting a single bite, you hear?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: ……我们需要你库房里的黄金皮革。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: ... We need the Golden Hide in your storage.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 异乡人的事已经办完了，我不知道这又是要干嘛，听见没？！黄金皮革是留着下一季做苏打用的，听见没？！
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: The strangers' business here is over, so I don't know what this is about, you hear?! The Golden Hide is in storage for next season's soda, you hear?!

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 副主厨必须尝尝猎物反刍肉，听见没？！屠夫说精肉苏打根本没法跟它比，听见没？！
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: Sous Chef has to taste the Ruminations of the Prey, you hear?! Boucher said the Meat Soda doesn't even compare, you hear?!

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 话音刚落，副主厨便威胁般地把菜刀高高举过头顶。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: With that, the Sous Chef threateningly raised the kitchen knife as high as her arms would go.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 我绝对不会交出去的，听见没？！！
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: I'll never give it up, you hear?!!
Ack! Don't hit me, you hear?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 疼，听见没？！放过我，听见没？！
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: It hurts, you hear?! Leave me alone, you hear?!

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 你们为什么不停手，听见没……？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: Why won't you stop beating me, you hear...?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 你们这么做肯定是有理由的，听见没……？为什么就是不说话，听见没……？！
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: You must be doing this for a reason, you hear...? Why won't you say anything, you hear...?!

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 你们明明什么都有……却还是要为这点东西杀我……？刻薄的……小气的……异乡人……听见没……？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: You have so much... but would still just kill me for it...? Mean... stingy... strangers... you hear...?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 而且……我刚刚才……升职了……你……听见没……？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: And... I just... got promoted... you... hear...?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 在这座既无饥饿也无干渴的西西弗百货里……他们渴求的究竟是什么？他们的饥饿，与红派的饥饿又有何不同？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: In the Grand Magasin, where neither hunger nor thirst exist... what is it that they crave? How is their hunger different from that of Le Rouge?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 空气中那股咸腥味，是来自海水还是血，很难分辨。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: It's hard to tell whether the briny smell in the air is coming from the sea or the blood.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 它们眼中的光彩已经彻底消失了。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: The light has completely gone out of their eyes.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 连抽动都没有。多半已经死了。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: Doesn't even so much as twitch. Most likely dead.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 住手，听见没？！刻薄的外人，听见没？！
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: Stop that, you hear?! Mean outsiders, you hear?!

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 腐烂的肉。布布吃了倒是没事，但我们大概不该碰。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: Rotten meat. Pwie ate it no problem, but we probably shouldn't.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 它正在微弱地抽动。快要死了。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: It's twitching weakly. It will die soon.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 它的眼睛和触手剧烈抽搐着，像是在抽搐痉挛。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: Its eyes and tentacles are twitching violently like it's seizing.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 原来那股腥味是从这儿来的。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: So that's where the fishy smell was coming from.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 布布正戳弄着在水箱里扭动的一只生物。它似乎引起了布布的兴趣。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: Pwie is poking a creature wriggling around inside the water tank. It seems to have drawn their interest.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 戳，戳，戳……他们刚才是不是戳到它眼睛了？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: Poke, poke, poke... Did they just poke it in the eye?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: <……默尔索，你能不能让布布别再那样了？>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: <... Meursault, can you stop Pwie from doing that?>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 默尔索把布布抱起来，放到离水箱有段距离的地方。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: Meursault picked Pwie up and put them down a good distance away from the water tank.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: <咦，水箱里的这个生物……该不会是食物吧？>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: <Huh, a creature inside a water tank... I wonder if it's food?>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: ……是的。看来是美食广场出售的烹饪食材之一。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: .. Yes. It appears to be one of the cooking ingredients sold at the Food Court.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: ……糟了，这个也得付钱吗？布布刚才只是戳了一下，可照“摸了就得买”的规矩来说……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: ... Darn, do we have to pay for this? Pwie just poked it, and y'know, with the "you touch it, you buy it" rule and everything...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 根据我们进入西西弗百货时听到的广播，这种程度的接触大概是被允许的。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: According to the announcement heard upon our entry to the Grand Magasin, it is likely that this degree of contact is permitted.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: <嘿，等等……这该不会又是一只幼虫吧？看起来有点像屠夫库房里那只幼虫。>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: <Hey, wait a minute... Is this another larva? Looks a bit like that larva from Boucher's storehouse.>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 它被加工过，用来蒙骗看客。皮革与血肉的碎片被缝合在一起，做成了幼虫的外形。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: It has been altered to fool the viewer. Patches of leather and flesh were sown together to resemble the outward appearance of a larva.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 真的假的？谁会拿这种事撒谎啊？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: Really? Who'd lie about this kinda stuff?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh:
水箱底部有个什么东西，正被压在上面的重量缓缓压碎。
没过多久，又有更多东西被倒进来，把原本在箱顶上的那些也一并压碎。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en:
There's something at the bottom of the water tank, slowly being crushed by the weight of what is laid on top of it.
It doesn't take long before more are poured over it, crushing what was once on top of the tank.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 它们断断续续地抽动着，敲打着箱壁……但那声响最终渐渐平息下去。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: They twitch intermittently, rapping on the tank walls... but the noise eventually dies down.
Pwie pointed to the bottom of the water tank.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 一个干瘪枯槁的东西，正在压在它身上的重量下渐渐被压扁。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: Something shriveled and dried up is slowly getting flattened beneath the weight pressing down on it.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 哦……嗯，这画面是挺让人不舒服的。要我把它拉出来吗？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: Oof... yeah, that's kinda rough to look at. Want me to pull it out?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 可是……那上面的又会疼了……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: But... then the ones on top would get hurt...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 说得也是……那要不把它们全都拉出来？不过这样做好不好，我也说不准……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: Fair point... Then should we pull all of them out? Not sure that's such a good idea, though...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 正如浮士德所说，一切都已经太迟了。那个被压扁的东西发出了最后一声令人反胃的哀鸣，随即彻底被压碎。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: Just as Faust said, it was already too late. The thing being flattened gave one last sickening whimper before it was crushed completely.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: ……死了就不疼了。可是……我还是不喜欢这样。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: ...If you die, it doesn't hurt anymore. But... I still don't like it.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: ……死亡就是终结？可是……就算它们死了，也还能重新开始啊。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: ... Death is the end? But... Even if they die, they can start again.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 那种区分毫无意义。新的存在并非旧存在的延续。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: That distinction is meaningless. The new existence is not a continuation of the previous one.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 布布转向水箱里的另一个生物，若有所思地注视着它，看它在其他东西的重压下，被缓缓压死。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: Pwie turned toward another being that existed within the water tank and observed it thoughtfully, watching as it was slowly crushed to death under the weight of others.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 看来无论什么掉落在这儿，都会被捡起来放进水箱里。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: It seems whatever falls here is picked up and placed inside the water tank.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 已经被遗弃了一阵子了。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: It's been abandoned for a while.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 不知道挖下去会不会挖出那艘船？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: Wonder if digging in will reveal the ship?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 那艘船埋得太深了。我们得找些机械设备才能把它拖出来。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: The ship is buried so deeply. We're going to need some machinery to pull it out.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 试着往侧面挖了挖，可船身还是远远看不见。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: Tried digging into the side, but the ship's body is still far from visible.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 看起来像黑色丝线的东西缠住了我的脚踝。不知为何，我并没有被水浸湿。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: What look like black threads wrap around my ankles. Somehow, I don't soak up the water.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 破旧不堪，连遮阳挡雨都做不到。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: Too ragged to block out the sun or the rain.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 让人想起那片我们不被允许越过界线的U公司海滩。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: Reminiscent of the U Corp. beach beyond the boundary we weren't allowed past.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 默尔索试着推开它，却徒劳无功。看起来它被设计成永远打不开的样子。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: Meursault tried to push it open to no avail. It looks as though it was designed to never be opened.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 自我们踏进这座百货以来，这是我第一次感觉像是在休息。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: For the first time since we entered the department store, I feel like I'm taking a break.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 这地方一点都不像真正的海滩，
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: This looks nothing like a real beach,

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 但至少在那短短一瞬间，感觉真的很像。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: but it felt like one, at least for the briefest moment.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 这里面究竟会住着什么东西？
