RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: Just what could possibly be living in here?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 墙上钉着一些不祥的警示标志。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: Ominous warning signs have been nailed into the wall.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 在一条阴暗小巷的角落里，发现了几只死去的幼虫。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: Found a few dead larvae tucked in some corner of a dark alleyway.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: ……和上次不同，虚无者们开始现身了。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: ... Unlike during our last attempt, Le Néant are starting to reveal themselves.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: <默……默尔索，刚……刚才发生什么事了？>
格里高尔的手臂被砍断的瞬间，我的视野就陷入了黑暗。随后我们就被送回了洗手间。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: Immediately after Gregor's arm was severed, my vision went dark. We were then returned to the restroom.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: <……好吧。所以格里高尔的手臂正式成了禁区。我们不碰它。>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: <... Right. So Gregor's arm is officially a red line. We don't touch it.>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 在这座既无饥饿也无干渴的西西弗百货里……他们渴求的究竟是什么？他们的饥饿，与红派的饥饿又有何不同？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: In the Grand Magasin, where neither hunger nor thirst exist... what is it that they crave? How is their hunger different from that of Le Rouge?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 屠夫在这儿呢，听见没？*咕咚*
副主厨一边告诉我们，一边擦掉嘴角的口水。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: Sous Chef tells us while wiping the saliva off her mouth.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 穿过鱼市就能找到岸边，听见没？你现在就去把那只幼虫带回来，听见没？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: Pass through the fish market to find the Shore, you hear? You go now bring the larva back, you hear?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 天哪……差点就被砍成挂在钩子上的肉块了。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: Jeez... Almost got chopped down like those meat slabs on hooks.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: <……默尔索确实被变成挂在钩子上的肉块了。>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: <... Meursault did get turned into a meat slab on a hook.>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: <我们可以通过它们的外形来预判它们投掷的轨迹。>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: <We can look at their appearances to predict what kind of trajectory their throws'll have.>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 与那个敌人的碰撞，立刻把我们拖进了阴影界。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: Colliding with that enemy immediately dragged us into the Shadowed.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: <嗯，所以我决定放弃跟它们纠缠，直接返回泉，可是……>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: <Yeah, which is why I decided to give up on fighting them and return straight away to the Fount, but...>
For all that talk about how dangerous Pwie is...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: ……结果最后被砍断手臂的却是默尔索。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: ... she ended up chopping Meursault's arm off.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 她的屠宰手艺，配得上副主厨这个头衔。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: Her butchershop skills live up to her title as the Sous Chef.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: <嗯……我们只要一直逼她，逼到她害怕，她自己就会放弃了。>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: <Well... We just need to pressure her until she gets scared, and she'll give up on her own.>
<Let's head back to the Food Court.>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 墙上渗出一团油脂似的东西。仔细一看，是一只腐烂的幼虫卡在墙里，无力地悬垂在原地。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: There's a glob of grease dribbling out of the wall. Closer inspection reveals a rotten larva stuck halfway into the wall, dangling limply in place.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 或许是有人试图穿墙而过时，把它遗落在了这里。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: Perhaps someone lost it here while while trying to walk through the wall.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 一片被黑暗吞没的空旷空间。没有理由进去。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: An empty space drowned in darkness. There's no reason to go in there.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 一张洁白无瑕的桌子。上面摆放着各种切割好的肉块与兽皮。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: A pristine white table. Various cuts of meat and hides lie arranged across it.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh: 门被堵住了。把耳朵贴上去，能听见门后传来一片嘈杂——人声、脚步声，还有别的。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en: The door is blocked. Pressing an ear against it reveals a jumble of noises beyond—voices, footsteps, and more.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.zh:
水箱底部有个什么东西，正被压在上面的重量缓缓压碎。
没过多久，又有更多东西被倒进来，把原本在箱顶上的那些也一并压碎。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b1-b.js.en:
There's something at the bottom of the water tank, slowly being crushed by the weight of what is laid on top of it.
It doesn't take long before more are poured over it, crushing what was once on top of the tank.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 那位存在带来的将不只是我们的破灭，还有整座百货的破灭。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: That being will bring ruin not only to us, but to the entire department store.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 真不明白，连红派都算不上的人，为何要追随一位假神的声音进军。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: I cannot fathom why those who are not even of the Rouge would march behind the voice of a false god.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 若你们当初与我们携手，或许我们本能一同见证西西弗百货的兴盛……一条未曾选择的路。真是遗憾。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: Had you joined hands with us, we might have watched the Grand Magasin prosper together... A road not taken. Truly, a pity.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 从调色板身上取得了黄金皮革。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: Collected the Golden Hide from Palette's body.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 地下2层楼层经理的尸体。
把这位身上的黄金皮革拿走吧。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: Let us take the Golden Hide from this one.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 从地下2层楼层经理身上取得了黄金皮革。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: Collected the Golden Hide from B2F's Floor Manager.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 染成斑斓杂色的发丝间，渗出一缕泛红的染料。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: Red-tinged dye trickles through hair stained in a multitude of colors.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 它汹涌地涌出，就像我们先前迸发的泪水一样。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: It gushes out in heavy streams, just like the tears we burst before.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 曾经熙攘的线团之巢，如今只剩一片沉默。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: Only silence remains in the once-crowded Nest.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 松散的线头从磨损的线团上脱落，在空中飘荡。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: Loose threads fray free from the worn skein, fluttering through the air.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 他们的躯干在痛苦的嘎吱声中碎裂崩塌。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: Their body, creaking in agony, crumbled apart and collapsed.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 对不起……我明明那么想给您做那件您最喜欢的衣服……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: I'm sorry... I wanted so badly to make you those favorite clothes...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 从他们那儿拿来……我得……吃掉它……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: Take it from them... I have to... eat it...
It will be... so, so tasty...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 安安静静！我们的王醒醒了！
我们的王要开始扎扎啦！
扎扎最美味啦！我们要安安静静地舔干净！
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: Stabby-stabby is tasty-tasty! And we lap it up quiety-quiet!

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 好好好！那就把王想要的东西献上吧！
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: Goody-good! Then let's give the king what he wants!

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: ……不是辛克莱？那我们大概是在地下2层了。我们在这儿做什么呢，执行经理……？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: ... Not Sinclair? We must be on the B2, then. What are we doing here, Executive Manager...?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 这人身上没有别的东西可拿了。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: There's nothing else to collect from this one.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 这人身上没有别的东西可拿了。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: There's nothing else to collect from this one.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 油灰走上前，挡住了我们的去路。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: Putty stepped forward, blocking our way.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 会疼的，但没有办法。你们渴望的东西，和我们渴望的东西，永远无法相遇……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: It will hurt, but it cannot be helped. What you desire and what we desire can never meet...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 让我们尽一切所能，把彼此的渴望都埋葬到底。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: Let us do all we can to sink each other's desires to an end.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 从血肉中渗出来的东西……
全都舔干净……一点都不剩……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: Lick them all... leave none behiiind...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 你们为什么要伤害我们？
油灰走上前，挡住了我们的去路。
巨大的染缸挡住了去路。默尔索试着把它们推开，却纹丝不动。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: Large dye vats are blocking the way. Meursault tries pushing them aside, but they won't budge.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 这里缠绕着一卷卷纯白色的线团。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: Spools of pure white thread are wound here.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 这似乎是某种纺织机。这台装置正以恒定均匀的速度吐出一缕缕丝线。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: It seems to be a spinning machine of sorts. The contraption is spewing strands of threads at a constant, even pace.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 丝线不断涌出，缠绕在线团上。依旧看不出它是从哪儿来的。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: Strands of thread spill forth, winding themselves around the spool. Still no clue as to where it's coming from.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 这就是克罗默“走进去”的那面墙。这不是什么幻觉，她真的穿进了一堵实墙。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: This is the wall Kromer "walked into." It's not an illusion or anything—she really just phased into a solid wall.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 地上这堆没用的废话。是那女人掉的吗？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: Worthless B.S. on the floor. Did that woman drop it?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: <嗯，从她跟我们互动的方式来看……她大概是故意留在这儿的。>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: <Well, judging on how she's been interacting with us.. she probably left it here on purpose.>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: <默尔索，先拿着吧。说不定用得上。>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: <Meursault, take it for now. It might come in handy.>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 这台机器看起来操作起来很复杂。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: The machine looks complicated to operate.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: <默尔索，你知道这东西怎么操作吗？>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: <Meursault, do you know how to operate this?>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 我并不熟悉西西弗下层的作业流程。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: I am not familiar with the work procedures of Sisyphe's lower floors.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 与此同时，奥提斯开始摆弄起这台机器复杂的显示屏。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: Meanwhile, Outis began manipulating the machine's complex display.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 唔……我还不明白它的运作原理，但大致理清了结构。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: Hm... I do not yet understand the operating principle, but I have a general grasp of the structure.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 界面上有三种功能：提取、纺线与染色。您的命令，执行经理？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: The interface presents three functions: extraction, spinning, and dyeing. Your orders, Executive Manager?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 奥提斯所指的显示屏上出现了三个按钮。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: Three buttons appear on the display Outis indicates.
There are three buttons on the screen.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 这是从默尔索身上抽取过丝线的机器。似乎没有理由再试一次。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: It's the machine that drew thread out of Meursault. There doesn't seem to be any reason to try it again.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 伴随着一阵令人不安的嗡鸣，机器把默尔索的一块皮肤吸到了表面上。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: With a disconcerting whir, the machine sucked a patch of Meursault's skin onto its surface.
Huh. These threads are O. of a K.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 伴随着一阵令人不安的嗡鸣，机器把默尔索的一块皮肤吸到了表面上。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: With a disconcerting whir, the machine sucked a patch of Meursault's skin onto its surface.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 伴随着一阵令人不安的嗡鸣，机器把默尔索的一块皮肤吸到了表面上。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: With a disconcerting whir, the machine sucked a patch of Meursault's skin onto its surface.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: ……您……还要再按一次吗，执行经理？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: ... Are... you going to press it again, Executive Manager?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 伴随着一阵令人不安的嗡鸣，机器把默尔索的一块皮肤吸到了表面上。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: With a disconcerting whir, the machine sucked a patch of Meursault's skin onto its surface.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 她在问，经理，您的目的是不是想把皮肤“拆成丝线（split into threads）”。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: She is asking whether your objective is to have the skin "split into threads," Manager.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: <不……不，我不是想干这个……不过辛克莱以前解读过那个词吗？>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: <N-no, that's not what I'm doing... But has Sinclair ever interpreted that one before?>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 他在巴士上解读过“S.E.N.I.T.”，意思是“把每一根神经都拆成丝线（split every nerve into threads）”。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: He has interpreted "S.E.N.I.T." before on the bus. It stands for "split every nerve into threads."

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: <我是真的不记得她说那句话时是什么情境了。>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: <I really don't remember what the context was when she said it.>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 一卷线团从装置里掉了出来。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: A spool of thread plopped out of the contraption.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 看起来这是用……默尔索的皮肤做成的线。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: It appears to be thread made from... Meursault's skin.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 似乎没有理由再按这个按钮了。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: There shouldn't be any reason to press this button again.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 机器把线拉紧时，丝线发出轻微的震颤声。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: The threads twang lightly as the machine pulls them tight.
... Uh, we weren't told anything about increased production volume.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 慢慢-慢！轻轻-轻！会弄坏的！
……附近正在劳作的顾客们都朝我们投来了刀子般的目光。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: ... The customers working nearby are glaring daggers at us.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: ……周围指责的目光太过锋利，不敢再按一次了。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: ... The accusatory glares around me are too sharp to risk pressing it again.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 一条警告显示没有可用的染料。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: A warning states that no dye is available.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 恕我直言，执行经理……我能问问您究竟想达成什么目的吗？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: With all due respect, Executive Manager... may I ask what exactly it is that you intend to accomplish?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: <……我是说……有时候人就是想按按钮玩玩，对吧？>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: <... I mean... Sometimes you just want to mash some buttons, right?>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 正当我又要去砸那个按钮时，有什么东西轻轻碰了碰我的手肘。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: As I try to hammer the button once more, something taps my elbow.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 我转过头，看见了良秀的刀鞘，阿赖耶。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: I turned to find Ryōshū's scabbard, Araya.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 有那么一瞬间，我几乎能确定自己听见它说：“你真该停止这种小孩子似的行为了……”
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: For a moment, I could swear I heard it say, "You really should stop acting like a kid..."

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 嗯，我该停手了。这实在有点荒唐。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: Yeah, I should stop. This is getting ridiculous.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 我正查看布料时，一阵急促的脚步声从某处飞奔而来。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: Hurried footsteps come racing from somewhere as I inspect the fabric.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 我正查看布料时，一阵急促的脚步声从某处飞奔而来。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: Hurried footsteps come racing from somewhere as I inspect the fabric.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: <上次我听到这里传来类似列车轰鸣的声音……>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: <I heard something like the rumble of a train last time coming from here...>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 门后传来类似列车轰鸣的声响。我靠近查看，可跟上次不同，这次一点光都看不见。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: A sound resembling the rumble of a train comes from beyond the door. I move closer to investigate, but unlike before, I can't see any light.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 出于好奇，布布在我查看门的时候凑了过来……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: Curious, Pwie approached me as I inspected the door...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 默尔索说对了。不到一分钟，布布就回来了。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: Meursault was right. Pwie returned in less than a minute.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 里面有丝线在跑。然后它们停下来，又跑起来了。它们为什么要这样做？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: Threads are running inside. And then they stopped, and then ran again. Why are they doing that?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: ……看来这孩子和百货里的其他顾客一样，能进入我们进不去的地方。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: ... It seems this child can enter places we cannot, just like the other customers in the department store.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: <我们得特别留意背后，确保她一直跟着我们。>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: <We'll need to pay special attention to our back and make sure she's following us.>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 断断续续的列车鸣笛声与人群低语声透过缝隙传来。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: The intermittent sounds of train horns and people murmuring are coming through the gap.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 这是一种色调格外纯净的天蓝色染料。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: It's a sky-blue dye with a particularly pure hue.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 旁边的一张字条写着：“测试中的染料。若要使用，请只取少量……”
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: A note beside it reads, "Dye under testing. If you intend to use it, take only a little..."
... Not bad. It has some aesthetic value.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 看起来不需要支付眼球。取一小份样本应该没问题。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: No eyeball payment appears to be required. It should be okay to requisition a small sample.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 获得了一份天蓝色染料样本。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: Obtained a sample of sky-blue dye.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 一片漆黑，什么都没有。默尔索伸手去够那一点几乎难以察觉的微弱光亮。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: Nothing but pitch-black darkness. Meursault reaches toward a tiny twinkle of light so faint that it is almost impossible to notice.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 和上次一样，看着它让人感到平静。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: Like last time, looking at it brings a sense of serenity.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 一种泛黄的染料。乍一看几乎像是金色的。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: A dye with a yellow hue. At a glance, it almost appears golden.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 异乡人。那不是黄金染料，别在旁边晃悠了。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: Strangers. That's not the Golden Dye, so stop hovering around it.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 蓝色染料。良秀别开了头，看上去有些不悦。或许这种湛蓝的色调，让她想起了小指父辈走廊那抹蓝光。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: Blue dye. Ryōshū turns her head away, looking displeased. Perhaps the azure hue reminded her of the blue glow of the Pinky Nursefather's Corridor.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 而阿赖耶则相反，我们靠近蓝色染料时，它开心地嘎嘎作响。或许蓝色是它最喜欢的颜色。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: Araya, on the other hand, is rattling happily as we approach the blue dye. Maybe blue is her favorite color.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 一个装满红色染料的容器。侧面写着“待运往地下3层”。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: A container filled with red dye. "TO BE DELIVERED TO B3" is written along its side.
<... Tart? What's dessert got to do with this?>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: “炽烈而奔放的味道（Torrid and rhapsodic taste）”，经理。
不知道。看到这个颜色，我就觉得心里很平静。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: I dunno. Seeing this color just makes me feel calm.
My legs hurt. I wanna sit down.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 布布指向一张溅满各种颜色的沙发。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: Pwie points to a sofa splashed with all sorts of colors.
If you want to sit, then you need only sit.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 良秀把布布抱起来，放到了沙发上。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: Ryōshū picked Pwie up and set them down on the sofa.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 油灰默默地在沙发和良秀之间来回瞪视，随后一言不发地把注意力转回了染料上。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: Putty quietly glared back and forth between the sofa and Ryōshū, then turned her attention to the dyes without a word.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: <所以这里可以坐……？那我也来歇一会儿吧……>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: <So it was okay to sit here...? Then Iet me take a break too...>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 正当我要坐下时，油灰抬起了她锥子般锋利的一条腿。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: As I move to sit down, Putty raises one of her awl-sharp legs.
<... Yeah, never mind. I'll just stand.>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 这沙发软乎乎的挺好，但不算结实。那孩子没事，可要是你们哪个坐上去，估计当场就塌了。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: This sofa's nice and squishy, but it's not exactly sturdy. The kid's fine, but it'll probably cave right in if one of you sits on it.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 唔。或许我们该去4层家具馆，为您专门购置一张沙发，执行经理。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: Hm. Perhaps we should purchase a sofa for your exclusive use from the Furniture Hall on 4F, Executive Manager.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 一张能跟着您到处走的沙发，让您随时随地想坐就坐，腿就不会累了……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: A sofa that follows you around, allowing you to sit whenever and wherever necessary so your legs do not tire...
<... It's okay. I think I'm fine on my feet.>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 一张看起来像是百货楼层指引图的东西，被粘在一台饮料贩卖机上。大部分文字都因损毁而看不清了。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: What looks like a department-store directory is glued on a drink vending machine. Damage has obscured most of the lettering.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 一张看起来像是百货楼层指引图的东西，被粘在一台饮料贩卖机上。大部分文字都因损毁而看不清了。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: What looks like a department-store directory is glued on a drink vending machine. Damage has obscured most of the lettering.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 里面装满了色调格外纯净的天蓝色染料。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: It's filled with a sky-blue dye with a particularly pure hue.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh:
蓝色染料。良秀别开了头，看上去有些不悦。或许这种湛蓝的色调，让她想起了小指父辈走廊那抹蓝光。
而阿赖耶则相反，我们靠近蓝色染料时，它开心地嘎嘎作响。或许蓝色是它最喜欢的颜色。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en:
Blue dye. Ryōshū turns her head away, looking displeased. Perhaps the azure hue reminded her of the blue glow of the Pinky Nursefather's Corridor.
Araya, on the other hand, is rattling happily as we approach the blue dye. Maybe blue is her favorite color.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 一桶紫色染料。侧面标签写着“纯粹度——合格”。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: A bucket full of purple dye. The label on the side says "PURITY - ADEQUATE".

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 一桶偏蓝的紫色染料。侧面标签写着“纯粹度——尚未检测”。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: A bucket full of blue-ish purple dye. The label on the side says "PURITY - NOT YET CHECKED".

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 一只正被缓缓注入偏红紫色染料的桶。侧面标签写着“特级品”。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: A bucket, slowly filling with reddish purple dye. The label on the side says "PREMIUM GRADE".

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 写着“待丢弃”。再仔细一看，确实有点浑浊。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: Says "TO BE DISCARDED". On second look, it does look a bit cloudy.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 哦，这该不会就是黄金染——啊。桶侧贴着一张写着“不是这个”的标签。看来不是它……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: Ohh, maybe this is the Golden Dy—ah. There's a label that says "NOT THIS ONE" taped on the side of the bucket. Guess this isn't it...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 肯定经常有人把这些搞混。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: Must get these mixed up all the time.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: <嘿，这儿有桶透明液体。会不会是无色染料？>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: <Hey, here's a bucket of transparent liquid. Maybe it's L'Incolore?>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: ……我们无法确定，经理。也可能是别的同样透明的液体。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: ... We cannot say for certain, Manager. It may be a different fluid that is just as transparent.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 不对，不对。这不是透明的。
哦，不是吗？那在你眼里它是什么样的？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: Oho, it's not? Then what does it look like to you?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 它是……安静的……悲伤的……哗啦哗啦的。
这些形容词用来描述颜色，恐怕不太恰当吧？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: Not the most appropriate collection of adjectives for describing color, are they?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 外行。艺术可不只是对可见色彩的简单观察与再现。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: Dilettante. Art isn't just a simple observation and recreation of visible colors.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: <不管怎样，布布现在也不是在搞艺术吧？>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: <Regardless, Pwie isn't exactly doing art right now, are they?>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 布布盯着桶看了一会儿，随后转开了视线。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: Pwie stared into the bucket for a while, then turned away.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 又完好无损地回来了。你们是来道别的吗，走之前？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: Back again in one piece. Did you come to say goodbye before leaving?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 哦，大姐。我说了——他们不是小偷。他们不是来榨干我染料原料的。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: Oh, Big Sis. I told you—they're not thieves. They didn't come to drain my dye material.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 所以……你们这次又是来干嘛的？还需要别的颜色？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: So... What brings you back? Need another color?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 我们需要……你手上的黄金松脂。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: We need... the Golden Resin in your possession.
... You're going to take it by force, aren't you.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 可是……我信任你们的。我还特地为你们打开了楼下的通路。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: But... I trusted you. I even opened the downstairs path for you.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: ……我为辜负这份信任感到遗憾。但你手中的黄金松脂，对我们的任务至关重要。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: ... I regret the breach of trust. But your Golden Resin is essential to our mission.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 不值得信任的异乡人。我根本不该为你们开路。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: Strangers who can't be trusted. I should never have opened you the path.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 照这个势头，战斗恐怕在所难免，执行经理。不过若这是您的选择，我不会犹豫……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: Battle is inevitable at this rate, Executive Manager. But if that is what you choose, I will not hesitate...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: <……我们真的没有什么能拿来交换的吗？>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: <... Do we actually have anything we can trade for it?>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 您打算提出什么样的交易，经理？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: What transaction do you propose, Manager?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 我还以为泉那边来的异乡人……会不一样呢。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: I thought strangers from the Fount... would be different.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 你说得对，大姐。要是这些残忍的人想伤害我们，那我们也只能……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: You're right, Big Sis. If these cruel people want to hurt us, then we can only...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 我还以为你……会不一样呢。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: I thought you... would be different.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 你说得对，大姐。要是这些残忍的人想伤害我们，那我们也只能……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: You're right, Big Sis. If these cruel people want to hurt us, then we can only...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 我还以为你……会不一样呢。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: I thought you... would be different.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 你说得对，大姐。要是这些残忍的人想伤害我们，那我们也只能……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: You're right, Big Sis. If these cruel people want to hurt us, then we can only...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: <如果调色板想要用黄金面料做的衣服，她早该来要默尔索的护手甲或者蠕蠕了。>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: <If Palette wanted clothing made from Golden Fabric, she would have asked for Meursault's gauntlet or Wriggley earlier.>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: <可她向我们要的，一直只有那团线……>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: <But all she had asked from us was the skein...>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: <那把剪刀。把她真正需要的东西给她，好做衣服吧。>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: <The scissors. Let's offer what she actually needs to make the clothes.>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 如果你把黄金松脂给我们，我们就把能让你做出想要的衣服的剪刀给你。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: If you give us the Golden Resin, we will give you scissors you can use to make the clothing you want.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 等等，大姐！剪刀？什么样的剪刀？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: Wait, Big Sis! Scissors? What kind of scissors?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 改衣师安妮特的剪刀……那位为黑派做过许多服饰的裁缝。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: The scissors of Annette the Alterationist... the tailor who made many attire for Le Noir.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 改衣师安妮特……我听黑派顾客提起过她。他们说她的剪刀能把任何丝线都变成最美的布料……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: Annette the Alterationist... I've heard the Noir customers mention her. They say her scissors can turn any thread into the prettiest fabric...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 唉……我还是得拒绝……没有黄金松脂，我做不出黄金染料。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: Ugh... I'm still gonna have to refuse... I can't make the Golden Dye without the Golden Resin.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 没有那把剪刀，你就做不出给姐姐的衣服。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: You're not making any clothing for your sister without the scissors.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 自从满脑子都是日光浴，她就再也没离开过黄金松脂身边，可是……大姐最喜欢的颜色，是……天蓝色。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: Ever since sunbathing occupied her mind, she's never left the Golden Resin's side, but... Big Sis's favorite color, it was... sky blue.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: ……你说得对。我已经不再需要黄金松脂了。可那把剪刀……才是缺失的那一笔。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: ... You're right. I've no need of the Golden Resin anymore. But those scissors... They are the missing stroke.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 我们把磨钝的剪刀放进调色板手中，换来了黄金松脂。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: We placed the dulled scissors into Palette's hands and received the Golden Resin in exchange.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 住手。你为什么要伤害她？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: Stop that. Why are you hurting her?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 有什么想要的，你跟我说就行。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: If there's something you want, you speak to me.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 油灰踉跄了一下，随即挺直了膝盖。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: Putty stumbles, then straightens her knees.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: ……（她用充满威胁的目光盯着我们。）
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: ... (She fixes us with a threatening glare.)

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 伴随着一阵长长的吱呀声，那些手臂开始垂落。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: With a long creak, the arms begin to sag.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 每一只手都朝着调色板曾经所在的方向伸去。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: Every one of those hands is reaching toward where Palette had been.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 破碎的血肉从那一小片布料下若隐若现。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: Mangled flesh peeks from beneath the tiny scrap of cloth.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 粉碎的血肉从那一小片布料下若隐若现。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: Pulverized flesh peeks from beneath the tiny scrap of cloth.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 它已经炸成了蓝色染料与血肉混杂的一团狼藉。很难想象它原本是什么样子。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: It's exploded into a mess of blue dye and flesh. It's difficult to imagine what it could've looked like before.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 因疼痛而流的泪，与因悲伤而流的泪，两者有什么不同？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: What difference is there between tears shed in pain and tears shed in sorrow?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 悲伤与疼痛之间，界线又在哪里？
因疼痛而流的泪，与因悲伤而流的泪，两者有什么不同？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: What difference is there between tears shed in pain and tears shed in sorrow?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 悲伤与疼痛之间，界线又在哪里？
稍稍掀起布料，能看到底下湿漉漉地黏着一团被捣烂的血肉。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: Lifting the cloth slightly reveals flesh mashed to a pulp, clinging wetly to its underside.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 一个装满红色染料的容器。侧面写着“待运往地下3层”。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: A container filled with red dye. "TO BE DELIVERED TO B3" is written along its side.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 一张涂满斑斓色彩的沙发。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: A sofa painted in a riot of colors.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: <那些丝线瞬间缠住了默尔索……他就死了。>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: <The threads wrapped around Meursault in an instant... and he was dead.>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 想跑得比它快很难……尤其是那种黏糊糊的染料还在拖慢我们的行动……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: Outpacing it would be difficult... especially with that sticky dye hindering our movement...

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 唔……或许阻碍它的行动会更有效。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: Hm... It may be more effective to impede its movement instead.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: <等我们出去以后再想想办法吧。>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: <Let's think about it once we're out of here.>
<Just hitting whatever we saw wasn't getting us anywhere.>
<We need to destroy the threads first.>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 朝我们飞来的丝线实在太多了……看来闪避是我们唯一的对策了，执行经理。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: There are far too many threads flying at us... It appears evasion is our only recourse, Executive Manager.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 她说……“不如直接打飞它们？”
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: She said... "How about punching them out of the way?"

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: <我觉得她刚才连“打飞”那部分都还没说完……不过谢了。>
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: <I don't think she even got to the "out of the way" part yet... but thanks.>

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 如果那真的可行……或许可以作为一种可行的办法。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: If that is indeed possible... it may serve as one viable method.
I will bear it in mind.
Skeins of thread lie scattered about.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 已经舀取了一些这种染料。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: Already scooped a bit of this dye.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 已经刮取了一些这种木屑。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: Already scraped a bit of this sawdust.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 有一张被丢弃的排号票。
排号票。蠢货们用来占排队位置的东西。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: A numbered ticket. Something idiots take to secure a place in a queue.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: ……那他们为什么要排队？不能直接进去吗？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: ... So why do they wait in line? Can't they just go in?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh:
不能，因为排队的每个人都渴望第一个进去。
因此，他们共同约定创造出一条叫做“先到先得”的规则，并赋予由此产生的队伍以正当性。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en:
They can't, because everyone in line desires to be the first to enter.
Therefore, they collectively agree to create a rule called "first-come, first-served," and imbue resultant queue with legitimacy.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 唔……我不懂。他们非得这样吗？就因为大家都这么说？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: Mm... I dunno. Do they have to? Just 'cuz everyone says so?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 是的。因为队伍中的每个人都共同相信，一切有价值的目标都要求追求者去等待，而且他们相信等待对所有人都是公平的，所以他们遵守这条规则。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: Yes. Because everyone in the queue shares the same faith that all worthy goals requires its pursuers to wait, and because they have faith that waiting is fair to all, they abide by it.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: ……公平不过是种幻觉。虽然看起来他们都在同一条队伍里、遵守着同样的规则，可这世界运转的方式，从来就不是这样。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: ... Fairness is an illusion. Though it might seem like they're all waiting in the same queue under the same rules, that's just not the way the world spins.

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 一只旧木桶。另一侧写着些什么……
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: An old barrel. There's something written on the other side...
[The higher the sun, the shorter the shadow.]

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: [当影子缩小到看不见时，阳光便是蓝色的。]
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: [When the shadow has shrunk beyond sight, the sunlight is blue.]

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: [虽然有点过曝，但我要用这个颜色来粉刷这个地方。毕竟这是我大姐最喜欢的颜色……正午蓝。]
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: [It's a bit overexposed, but this is the color I'll use to paint this place. It's my big sister's favorite color, after all... Noonday Blue.]

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 盖子还盖着。是调色板忘了这一批，还是……？
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: The lid is still shut. Has Palette forgotten about this batch, or...?

RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.zh: 一桶装满透明液体的染料。我觉得这应该是无色染料，不过……看起来这一批已经放了挺久了。
RPGSystem/rpg-loc-dialogue-floor-b2-b.js.en: A vat filled with transparent liquid. I think it's L'Incolore, but... looks like it's been a while since this batch was made.

_mech/BattleKeywords-a1c10p2.json#Thread.zh: 如尖钉一般，丝线会将你死死缠住，其拘束的颜色早已注定。
_mech/BattleKeywords-a1c10p2.json#Thread.en: Like nails, threads will hold you fast, the color of its binds predetermined.

_mech/BattleKeywords-a1c10p2.json#Spread.zh:
- 若目标持有束缚，额外施加1点流血威力与1层流血
- 使用技能时，若主要目标持有染色丝线或焦油染料，则该技能最终威力+1，造成的伤害+20%
_mech/BattleKeywords-a1c10p2.json#Spread.en:
- If target has Bind, inflict 1 more Bleed Potency and Bleed Count
- On Skill Use, if the main target has Dyed Thread or Tar Dye, the said Skill gains Final Power +1 and deals +20% damage

_mech/BattleKeywords-a1c10p2.json#Spread.zh:
大多数染料都该有自己的颜色。
但这种染料没有。

以粗糙不均的笔触涂抹开来，它只凭纯光的反射与折射，便展现出一整片色谱。
_mech/BattleKeywords-a1c10p2.json#Spread.en:
Most dyes are meant to have a color.
But this one's dye has none.

Applied in rough, uneven strokes, it reveals a spectrum of colors through nothing but the reflection and refraction of pure light.

_mech/BattleKeywords-a1c10p2.json#Sticky.zh:
- 最大层数：1
- 速度最小值与最大值-1（最低为1）
染料黏附在身上，让每一步都变得更加艰难。
_mech/BattleKeywords-a1c10p2.json#Sticky.en: The dye clings, making every step harder to take.

_mech/BattleKeywords-a1c10p2.json#Charge.zh:
- 特殊充能
- 最大层数：20
- 本效果强度与层数的增减同样受普通充能影响
- 回合结束时，本效果的层数减少1层
_mech/BattleKeywords-a1c10p2.json#Charge.en:
- Unique Charge
- Max Count: 20
- Interacts the same way as normal Charge does to effects that raise or reduce Charge Potency and Count
- Turn End: Lose 1 Count

_mech/BattleKeywords-a1c10p2.json#Charge.zh: 那些如浮标般随潮水漂荡的人，或许无法改变事物的流向，但他们仍能壮大这股潮水，并投身于其中的行动。
_mech/BattleKeywords-a1c10p2.json#Charge.en: Those who are carried by the tide like buoys may not be able to change the flow of things, but they can still bolster the tide and commit to their acts within.

_mech/BattleKeywords-a1c10p2.json#Finish.zh:
- 最大层数：30
- 获得或消耗充能层数（包括特殊充能）的技能造成的伤害+（层数）%（最多30%）
- 回合结束：失去5层
  · 若本回合护盾被击破，则改为失去10层
_mech/BattleKeywords-a1c10p2.json#Finish.en:
- Max Stack: 30
- Skills that gain or consume Charge Count (including Unique Charge) deal +(Stack)% damage (max 30%)
- Turn End: Lose 5 Stacks
  · If Shield was broken this turn, lose 10 Stacks instead

_mech/BattleKeywords-a1c10p2.json#Finish.zh: 拥有自身功能的布料，唯有被恰当裁剪之后，才能发挥其用途。
_mech/BattleKeywords-a1c10p2.json#Finish.en: Fabrics with functions of their own can only serve their purpose when properly cut.

_mech/BattleKeywords-a1c10p2.json#LargeT.zh:
- 最大层数：3
- 对罪人造成的伤害+(5+层数x5)%（最多20%）
- 对改衣目标罪人使用技能时，获得等同于层数的拼点威力
_mech/BattleKeywords-a1c10p2.json#LargeT.en:
- Max Stack: 3
- Deal +(5 + Stack x 5)% damage against Sinners (max 20%)
- On Skill Use against Alteration Target Sinners, gain Clash Power equal to Stack

_mech/BattleKeywords-a1c10p2.json#LargeT.zh: 用来切断地底产出的原初材料的剪刀，体型更大，也更加非凡。这把剪刀曾一遍又一遍地裁剪过最初被织就的那块布。花朵会从中绽放，也是理所当然的事——因为它向来只从事物的根源处落剪。
_mech/BattleKeywords-a1c10p2.json#LargeT.en: The scissors used to sever the primordial materials produced underground are larger and more extraordinary still. These scissors have cut and recut the very first cloth ever woven. That flowers should bloom from them is only natural, for they have always cut things at their very roots.

_mech/BattleKeywords-a1c10p2.json#Tailor.zh:
- 速度最小值与最大值+5
- 本回合首次使用的技能拼点威力+3
- 战斗开始：若本单位装备了防御技能，则受到改衣师安妮特造成的伤害-80%
- 回合结束：失去1层
_mech/BattleKeywords-a1c10p2.json#Tailor.en:
- Min & Max Speed +5
- This turn's first-used Skill gains Clash Power +3
- Combat Start: If this unit has an equipped Defense Skill, take -80% damage from Annette the Alterationist
- Turn End: Lose 1 Stack

_mech/BattleKeywords-a1c10p2.json#Tailor.zh: 与其为人改衣以适应身形，她更愿意改造人本身以适应衣服。在这里，衣服才是穿着者的定义；保全衣物、改造顾客，才是维护价值、服务顾客的方式。
_mech/BattleKeywords-a1c10p2.json#Tailor.en: Rather than altering the clothes to fit the person, she alters the person to fit the clothes. Here, clothes are what define the wearer; preserving the garment and altering the person is how worth is protected and how the customer is served.

_mech/BattleKeywords-a1c10p2.json#Scisso.zh:
- 最大层数：9
- 防御等级降低等同于层数的数值
_mech/BattleKeywords-a1c10p2.json#Scisso.en:
- Max Stack: 9
- Lose Defense Level equal to Stack

_mech/BattleKeywords-a1c10p2.json#Scisso.zh: 用来将布料及其他材料裁剪至所需尺寸的裁切痕迹。
_mech/BattleKeywords-a1c10p2.json#Scisso.en: A cutting mark used to trim fabric and other materials to the required measurements.

_mech/BattleKeywords-a1c10p2.json#Damage.zh:
- 最大层数：30
- 回合开始：每有6层，获得1层体力回复效率减少（最多5层）
- 与“制版”或“链式锁边”拼点时，拼点威力降低等同于层数的数值
_mech/BattleKeywords-a1c10p2.json#Damage.en:
- Max Stack: 30
- Turn Start : Gain 1 HP Healing Down for every 6 Stacks (max 5)
- Upon Clashing against "Patterning" or "Surfile à la Chaîne", lose Clash Power equal to Stack

_mech/BattleKeywords-a1c10p2.json#Damage.zh: 布料一旦被剪碎，把碎片重新缝合起来也不过是拼布。它再也无法变回那块由原始丝线织成的完整布料。
_mech/BattleKeywords-a1c10p2.json#Damage.en: Once the fabric has been cut apart, sewing the scraps back together only makes patchwork. It can never return to a single fabric woven from its original threads.

_mech/BattleKeywords-a1c10p2.json#ThirdT.zh:
- 士气低落
- 受到的伤害+7.5%
- 每次受到攻击时，震颤层数+1（每个技能1次，每回合最多5层）
_mech/BattleKeywords-a1c10p2.json#ThirdT.en:
- Low Morale
- Take +7.5% damage
- Every time this unit is hit, gain +1 Tremor Count (once per Skill, max 5 per turn)

_mech/BattleKeywords-a1c10p2.json#ThirdT.zh: 我的手开始发抖了，连剪刀都握不稳……我没法再裁纸样了……
_mech/BattleKeywords-a1c10p2.json#ThirdT.en: My hands are starting to shake, and even the scissors won't stay steady... I won't be able to cut the pattern anymore...

_mech/BattleKeywords-a1c10p2.json#ThirdT.zh:
- 恐慌
- 受到的伤害+15%
- 每次受到攻击时，获得1点震颤威力且震颤层数+1（每个技能1次，每回合最多5层）
_mech/BattleKeywords-a1c10p2.json#ThirdT.en:
- Panic
- Take +15% damage
- Every time this unit is hit, gain 1 Tremor Potency and +1 Tremor Count (once per Skill, max 5 per turn)

_mech/BattleKeywords-a1c10p2.json#ThirdT.zh: 我的手开始发抖了，连剪刀都握不稳……我没法再裁纸样了……
_mech/BattleKeywords-a1c10p2.json#ThirdT.en: My hands are starting to shake, and even the scissors won't stay steady... I won't be able to cut the pattern anymore...

_mech/BattleKeywords-a1c10p2.json#Golden.zh: 目标每有3层针钉，技能最终威力+1（最多+3）
_mech/BattleKeywords-a1c10p2.json#Golden.en: Skill Final Power +1 for every 3 Naildle on the target (max 3)

_mech/BattleKeywords-a1c10p2.json#Golden.zh: 刺目阳光之雨[针线之王]
_mech/BattleKeywords-a1c10p2.json#Golden.en: Shower of Stinging Sunshine [King of Needleworks]

_mech/BattleKeywords-a1c10p2.json#Golden.zh: “你不必再倾听了。只要让自己什么都听不见就好。想做什么便去做吧。不要否定自己。”
_mech/BattleKeywords-a1c10p2.json#Golden.en: "You don't have to listen anymore. You only have to make it so you cannot hear them. Simply do what you want. Don't deny yourself."

_mech/BattleKeywords-a1c10p2.json#NoirSh.zh:
- 最大威力：999
- 基础层数：2
- 不会陷入混乱
- 回合开始：该部位获得等同于层数的护盾
- 本效果视为“护盾管理”效果
- 失去护盾时失去相应层数
- 回合结束：失去1层
_mech/BattleKeywords-a1c10p2.json#NoirSh.en:
- Max Potency: 999
- Base Count: 2
- Cannot be Staggered
- Turn Start: The Part gains Shield equal to Stack
- This effect counts as a "Shield Management" effect
- Lose Stack when losing Shield
- Turn End: Lose 1 Count

_mech/BattleKeywords-a1c10p2.json#NoirSh.zh: 黑曜神。黑曜巨人。铁锤的司祭。执掌保存之力的百货商场黑曜神，会通过直接接触赐下祝福。铁锤坚硬无比，其漆黑色泽吞没万物，令一切停滞……恰如死亡本身。
_mech/BattleKeywords-a1c10p2.json#NoirSh.en: The Obsidian God. The Obsidian Giant. The Chaplain of the Hammer. The Obsidian God of the Grand Magasin, whose domain is the power of preservation, grants his blessing through direct contact. The hammer is hard, and its black hue absorbs all things and brings them to a halt... much like death itself.

_mech/BattleKeywords-a1c10p2.json#NoirSh.zh:
- 最大层数：2
- 受到的伤害-10%
- 达到2层时，最终威力-2
_mech/BattleKeywords-a1c10p2.json#NoirSh.en:
- Max Stack: 2
- Take -10% damage
- At 2 Stacks, Final Power -2

_mech/BattleKeywords-a1c10p2.json#NoirSh.zh: 仿佛有一块虚构的质量碎片压在躯体之上——那是对巨人惩罚的粗劣仿制。依照契约，攀向更高之处，就如背负巨石，在沉默中向上爬行。
_mech/BattleKeywords-a1c10p2.json#NoirSh.en: It feels as though a fragment of imaginary mass is pressing down upon the body—a crude imitation of a Giant's punishment. According to the covenant, ascending to a higher place is akin to bearing a heavy boulder and climbing in silence.

_mech/BattleKeywords-a1c10p2.json#Vibrat.zh:
- 最大层数：2
- 受到的震颤引爆伤害-90%；混乱区间前移量-90%
- 造成的伤害+20%
- 回合结束：失去1层
_mech/BattleKeywords-a1c10p2.json#Vibrat.en:
- Max Stack: 2
- Take -90% damage from Tremor Burst; -90% to Stagger Threshold raised
- Deal +20% damage
- Turn End: Lose 1 Stack

_mech/BattleKeywords-a1c10p2.json#Vibrat.zh: 一道逆向的波，冲着一切追求保存的动作而去，将保存本身震得四分五裂，使其无法成形。
_mech/BattleKeywords-a1c10p2.json#Vibrat.en: A counterwave set against every motion that seeks preservation shakes preservation itself apart, preventing it from taking hold.

_mech/BattleKeywords-a1c10p2.json#NoirFi.zh:
- 最大层数：2
- 回合开始：每损失20%体力，获得1层威力提升与1层伤害提升（各自最多3层）
- 回合开始：所有“黑派”友方的技能获得等同于层数的最终威力

- 回合开始：层数达到1层以上时，对包括本单位在内的所有“黑派”友方施加以下效果：
 · 精神力+10
 · 攻击等级+2
 · 防御等级+2

- 回合开始：层数达到2层以上时，对所有非“黑派”敌人施加以下效果：
 · 速度最大值-1
 · 攻击等级-6
 · 防御等级-2
_mech/BattleKeywords-a1c10p2.json#NoirFi.en:
- Max Stack: 2
- Turn Start: Gain 1 Power Up and 1 Damage Up for every 20% missing HP (max 3 respectively)
- Turn Start: All "Le Noir" allies' Skills gain Final Power equal to Stack

- Turn Start: At 1+ Stack, apply the following effects to all "Le Noir" allies, including this unit:
 · SP +10
 · Attack Power +2
 · Defense Level +2

- Turn Start: At 2+ Stacks, apply the following effects to all non-"Le Noir" enemies:
 · Max Speed -1
 · Offense Level -6
 · Defense Level -2

_mech/BattleKeywords-a1c10p2.json#NoirFi.zh: 一处圣所，保存着黑派所追求的保存这一价值。在其中，黑派的保存行为会为其自身带来益处。这是一片永恒保存之境——一个激起无限趋近死亡之驱力的地方。
_mech/BattleKeywords-a1c10p2.json#NoirFi.en: A sanctuary in which the value of conservation pursued by Le Noir is preserved. Within it, the Noirs' preservative actions are retained to their benefit. It is a realm of eternal conservation—a place that stirs the drive to infinitely approach death.

_mech/BattleKeywords-a1c10p2.json#NoirSq.zh:
- 最大层数：10
- 防御等级降低等同于层数的数值
_mech/BattleKeywords-a1c10p2.json#NoirSq.en:
- Max Stack: 10
- Lose Defense Level equal to Stack

_mech/BattleKeywords-a1c10p2.json#NoirSq.zh: 当那份信念——即每个人都会恪尽职守地履行自己被分配的角色——开始崩塌时，疑虑便会在裂缝中生根。
_mech/BattleKeywords-a1c10p2.json#NoirSq.en: When faith—the faith that each will dutifully carry out their assigned role—begins to crumble, doubt takes root in the cracks.

_mech/BattleKeywords-a1c10p2.json#NoirNa.zh:
- 最大层数：3
- 本单位触发震颤引爆时：
 · 受到等同于自身震颤威力的怠惰伤害
 · 获得1层易损
 · 失去1层
_mech/BattleKeywords-a1c10p2.json#NoirNa.en:
- Max Stack: 3
- When Tremor Burst is triggered on this unit,
 · Take Sloth damage equal to Tremor Potency on self
 · Gain 1 Fragile
 · Lose 1 Stack

_mech/BattleKeywords-a1c10p2.json#NoirNa.zh: 约定之锤受约定所缚，必须将钉子砸下。因此每当铁锤落下，那里便必须存在一枚钉子……即使原本并不存在。
_mech/BattleKeywords-a1c10p2.json#NoirNa.en: The promised hammer is bound by promise to drive in a nail. Therefore, whenever the hammer falls, a nail must exist there... even if none was there before.

_mech/BattleKeywords-a1c10p2.json#Buffet.zh:
- 进入遭遇战后，每2回合的回合开始时，呕吐之影响便会扩张
· 阶段1：布布
· 阶段2：所有友方罪人
· 阶段3：所有目标
_mech/BattleKeywords-a1c10p2.json#Buffet.en:
- After entering the Encounter, Le Vomissement's influence expands at Turn Start every 2 turns
· Stage 1: Pwie
· Stage 2: All allied Sinners
· Stage 3: All targets

_mech/BattleKeywords-a1c10p2.json#Buffet.zh: 呕吐
_mech/BattleKeywords-a1c10p2.json#Buffet.en: Le Vomissement

_mech/BattleKeywords-a1c10p2.json#Buffet.zh:
为求生存、为求成长而吞噬的东西，会把外界之物纳入自我。随后它又被再次排出，于是曾属于自我的东西，又成了外界的一部分。

这是一个循环、扩张而又吞噬的过程。
_mech/BattleKeywords-a1c10p2.json#Buffet.en:
What is devoured for survival, for growth, incorporates what was outside into what is mine. Then it is expelled once more, and what was mine becomes part of the outside.

It is cyclical, expansive, and consumptive.

_mech/BattleKeywords-a1c10p2.json#Buffet.zh: - 进入遭遇战后，每2回合的回合开始时，呕吐之影响便会扩张
_mech/BattleKeywords-a1c10p2.json#Buffet.en: - After entering the Encounter, Le Vomissement's influence expands at Turn Start every 2 turns

_mech/BattleKeywords-a1c10p2.json#Gourma.zh:
- 基础威力+1，将所有技能的全部硬币转化为不可摧毁的硬币
- 自身每有3层流血，造成的伤害+5%（最多30%）；对目标的体力回复量+10%（最多100%，向下取整）
- 不会陷入混乱；受到的流血伤害-90%（强制混乱除外）
- 回合结束：失去1层
_mech/BattleKeywords-a1c10p2.json#Gourma.en:
- Base Power +1, convert all Coins on all Skills into Unbreakable Coins
- Deal +5% damage for every 3 Bleed on self (max 30%); heal +10% more HP on target (max 100%, rounded down)
- Cannot be Staggered; take -90% damage from Bleed (excluding forced Staggers)
- Turn End: Lose 1 Stack

_mech/BattleKeywords-a1c10p2.json#Bloody.zh:
- 最大层数：3
- 使用攻击技能时，获得等同于层数的流血层数（每个技能1次）
- 使用防御技能时，失去1层
- 回合结束：失去1层
_mech/BattleKeywords-a1c10p2.json#Bloody.en:
- Max Stack: 3
- On Attack Skill Use, gain Bleed Count equal to Stack (once per Skill)
- On Defense Skill Use, lose 1 Stack
- Turn End: Lose 1 Stack

_mech/BattleKeywords-a1c10p2.json#Buffet.zh:
- 速度最大值：5
- 每有1层，受到的伤害+5%
- 层数达到上限时，若本单位持有流血，则受到的伤害+10%
_mech/BattleKeywords-a1c10p2.json#Buffet.en:
- Max Speed: 5
- Take +5% damage for every Stack
- At max Stack, take +10% damage if this unit has Bleed

_mech/BattleKeywords-a1c10p2.json#Buffet.zh: 黄金启示
_mech/BattleKeywords-a1c10p2.json#Buffet.en: Golden Revelation

_mech/BattleKeywords-a1c10p2.json#Buffet.zh: 金色的光指引着这孩子，告诉他接下来该伤害谁。即便在那份指引之下，这孩子仍然相信，那是完全出于自己的判断。
_mech/BattleKeywords-a1c10p2.json#Buffet.en: The golden light guides the child toward whom they should harm next. Even under that guidance, the child believes the judgment to be entirely their own.

_mech/BattleKeywords-a1c10p2.json#Buffet.zh: - 速度最小值与最大值+3
_mech/BattleKeywords-a1c10p2.json#Buffet.en: - Min & Max Speed +3

_mech/BattleKeywords-a1c10p2.json#Buffet.zh: 粉红玛丽珍鞋
_mech/BattleKeywords-a1c10p2.json#Buffet.en: Pink Mary Janes

_mech/BattleKeywords-a1c10p2.json#Buffet.zh: 谢谢……给我鞋子。穿上这个，我能去任何地方吗？我想……和你们一起旅行。
_mech/BattleKeywords-a1c10p2.json#Buffet.en: Thanks... for the shoes. Can I go anywhere if I put these on? I wanna... travel with you.

_mech/BattleKeywords-a1c10p2.json#Buffet.zh:
- 防御等级+10
- 回合结束：若本单位陷入混乱，则解除混乱并回复50%体力（每场遭遇战1次）
_mech/BattleKeywords-a1c10p2.json#Buffet.en:
- Defense Level +10
- Turn End: If this unit is Staggered, recover from Stagger and heal 50% HP (once per Encounter)

_mech/BattleKeywords-a1c10p2.json#Buffet.zh: 黄金裹布
_mech/BattleKeywords-a1c10p2.json#Buffet.en: Golden Shroud

_mech/BattleKeywords-a1c10p2.json#Buffet.zh: 这孩子穿上了成人的衣服。不是随便什么衣服，而是一件用他人的死亡制成的兽皮衣物。就这样，这孩子朝着成年又迈近了一步。
_mech/BattleKeywords-a1c10p2.json#Buffet.en: The child has donned the clothes of an adult. Not just any clothes, but a hide garment made from another's death. And so, the child takes one step closer to adulthood.

_mech/BattleKeywords-a1c10p2.json#Buffet.zh:
- 士气低落
- 获得3层守护
_mech/BattleKeywords-a1c10p2.json#Buffet.en:
- Low Morale
- Gain 3 Protection

_mech/BattleKeywords-a1c10p2.json#Buffet.zh: 未被遗忘的痛苦
_mech/BattleKeywords-a1c10p2.json#Buffet.en: Unforgotten Pain

PersonalityVoiceDlg/Voice_Rodion_Contem_.zh:
肩缝垂得略低了些……袖口又短了一拃。领口那根露出来的散线，剪掉才叫干净。
呼呼～这位顾客要改的地方可不少呢。那么，你想先改哪一处？
PersonalityVoiceDlg/Voice_Rodion_Contem_.en:
Shoulder seams hanging a touch too low... hems of the arm a span too short. And that loose thread sticking out of your collar would look much cleaner snipped away.
Fuhu~ Lots of work to be done, this customer. So, which part would you like to have altered first?

PersonalityVoiceDlg/Voice_Rodion_Contem_.zh:
哦，光终于照到店门口了——两件套想必已经清场了吧。那就是说……那些等了我开门等到发慌的黑派顾客，马上就要一齐涌进来了。
……黑派可不怎么待见异乡人。要买的东西赶紧买了，趁现在还来得及就快走吧。
PersonalityVoiceDlg/Voice_Rodion_Contem_.en:
Oh, the light's finally reaching the front door—Two-piece must've cleared out. And that means... every Noir customer who's been waiting forever for me to open is about to rush this place at once.
... The Noirs are not so fond of strangers. Buy what you need and be on your way while you still can.

PersonalityVoiceDlg/Voice_Rodion_Contem_.zh:
这个时段的阳光格外温柔。晒得我的头发和肩膀暖洋洋的，舒服得我几乎睁不开眼……
再不小心点，我说不定会打盹打到忘了有人进过店里。
PersonalityVoiceDlg/Voice_Rodion_Contem_.en:
The sun feels especially gentle at this hour. It warms my hair and shoulders so, so cozily that I can hardly keep my eyes open...
If I'm not careful, I may doze off and forget that anyone ever came into the shop.

PersonalityVoiceDlg/Voice_Rodion_Contem_.zh:
这季的预约已经排满了。补个破洞、缝点简单的活儿我还能接，但……要是想要上等布料，你就得耐心等一阵了。
这儿剩下的大多是些二等丝线，再厉害的手艺，也织不出优雅有型的布料。
PersonalityVoiceDlg/Voice_Rodion_Contem_.en:
This season's bookings are already closed. I can still patch a tear or stitch up something simple, but... if you're after quality fabric, you'll have to settle in for a wait.
There isn't much left here besides second-rate thread, and no amount of skill can coax fabrics of elegance and style out of that.

PersonalityVoiceDlg/Voice_Rodion_Contem_.zh: 你也看得出来，你误打误撞闯进来的这个地方，跟别的店可不一样。这不是展览的地方，也不是卖成品的地方。这儿是我坐着默默缝缝补补出来的布料的销售处。想要结实点、不容易磨损的布料？还是说不合你口味的话，我也能给你找块更轻的方格布，等着被裁成形。
PersonalityVoiceDlg/Voice_Rodion_Contem_.en: As you can see, this place you've stumbled into is quite unlike the other stores. This isn't a place of exhibition, nor is it a place for finalized pieces. This is where I sell the fabrics I've been sitting here patching up in silence. Want something sturdy with fray-resistant fabric? Or if that doesn't suit your taste, I could find you a lighter checked fabric waiting to be given shape.

PersonalityVoiceDlg/Voice_Rodion_Contem_.zh: 有些丝线已经打结打到解不开了。有些又缠得太密，连剪刀都插不进去。这座百货商场里到处散落着没人愿意去修剪的线头和绒毛。每次我看到一个，就忍不住想拿剪刀去修一修……不管那线头到底是什么。
PersonalityVoiceDlg/Voice_Rodion_Contem_.en: Some threads have knotted themselves past the point of untangling. Others are packed so densely that there isn't room to slip the shears through. This department store is littered with loose ends and lint that nobody has bothered to trim. Every time I spot one, I feel the urge to take my scissors to it... Whatever that loose end happens to be.

PersonalityVoiceDlg/Voice_Rodion_Contem_.zh:
黄金松脂渗出的光，最近吸引来了更多信徒。是黑派那副严厉的声音已经满足不了他们了吗……？
话说回来，冻僵了手指的时候，还有什么比阳光更温暖、更让人安心呢。
PersonalityVoiceDlg/Voice_Rodion_Contem_.en:
The light leaking from the Golden Resin has been drawing more worshippers these days. Did they need more than what the stern Voice of Le Noir could give them...?
Then again, nothing feels quite as warm or comforting as sunlight when you're feezing your fingers off.

PersonalityVoiceDlg/Voice_Rodion_Contem_.zh:
哦，那些红色的家伙我可听说不少呢。*轻笑*他们用来缝合内里的那根线，红得那么显眼，意图都从表面透出来了……再明显不过了。
他们迟早会来找我，看着我被剪掉——他们觊觎我的黄金面料，我要是没看出他们有多害怕我剪刀能做出的那些衣裳，那才叫傻。
PersonalityVoiceDlg/Voice_Rodion_Contem_.en:
Oh, I've heard all about those red ones. *chuckle* The thread they've stitched their innards with is so conspicuously crimson that their intentions are showing through the exterior... and it can't be more obvious.
Sooner or later, they'll visit to see me snipped away—they covet my Golden Fabric, and I'd be a fool not to notice how they fear all the garments my scissors may create.

PersonalityVoiceDlg/Voice_Rodion_Contem_.zh: 西西弗百货里的每一件衣物用到的布料，不管是被人渴求还是被人厌恶，都是从一根丝线开始的。备好丝线，剩下的就只需要一枚钉子。当然，还有我这把剪刀。
PersonalityVoiceDlg/Voice_Rodion_Contem_.en: The fabric that goes into every article of clothing within the Grand Magasin, be it desired or abhorred, begins with a single thread. Procure the thread, and we need only a nail to complete the rest. And my scissorblades, of course.

PersonalityVoiceDlg/Voice_Rodion_Contem_.zh: ……好了，搞定。我仔细缝了道锁边针脚。这道边好一阵子都不会再散开了。
PersonalityVoiceDlg/Voice_Rodion_Contem_.en: ... There, done and done. I put in a careful whipstitch. The edge won't unravel again for a good long while.

PersonalityVoiceDlg/Voice_Rodion_Contem_.zh: 撕破的、烧焦的——把不完美的东西带来给我，经我的手，它们都能变得完整。哪怕是未成形的……还有那些渐渐坠入沉睡的。
PersonalityVoiceDlg/Voice_Rodion_Contem_.en: Torn or burnt—bring the imperfect to me, and by my fingers they will be made whole. Even the unborn... and those drifting into sleep.

PersonalityVoiceDlg/Voice_Rodion_Contem_.zh: 我能看出你眼里那股咔嚓咔嚓的冲动。不如告诉我，你想拿剪刀对付什么？
PersonalityVoiceDlg/Voice_Rodion_Contem_.en: I can see the desire to go snip-snip! in your eyes. Why don't you tell me what you'd like to put the scissors to?
Are you prepared to be snipped away?

PersonalityVoiceDlg/Voice_Rodion_Contem_.zh: ……该拿哪块布盖在那上面，才好缝合呢？
PersonalityVoiceDlg/Voice_Rodion_Contem_.en: ... Which patch of fabric should I lay over that one to make the stitching easier?

PersonalityVoiceDlg/Voice_Rodion_Contem_.zh: 看来这下全都散架了……一根丝线都不剩……
PersonalityVoiceDlg/Voice_Rodion_Contem_.en: So it's all coming apart now... every last thread...

PersonalityVoiceDlg/Voice_Rodion_Contem_.zh: 我说过了吧？布料一旦被我好好折叠过，就没那么容易磨损了。
PersonalityVoiceDlg/Voice_Rodion_Contem_.en: Told you, didn't I? Once I've properly folded a piece of fabric, it doesn't fray so easily.

PersonalityVoiceDlg/Voice_Rodion_Contem_.zh: 看来是尺寸不对。我得改一改了。
PersonalityVoiceDlg/Voice_Rodion_Contem_.en: Looks like the fit was wrong. I'll have to make a few alterations.

PersonalityVoiceDlg/Voice_Rodion_Contem_.zh:
走得挺安静的，没怎么闹腾。看来你真的做好了被剪掉的准备，嗯？
至于你留下的这些碎片……嗯，行吧。我会把它们好好整整齐齐地缝在一起。
黑派肯定会喜欢的。
PersonalityVoiceDlg/Voice_Rodion_Contem_.en:
You went quietly without much fuss. I suppose you really were prepared to be snipped away, hmm?
As for the pieces you've left behind... Hmm, sure. I'll stitch them together nice and neat.
The Noirs ought to love this.

PersonalityVoiceDlg/Voice_Rodion_Contem_.zh:
布料已经裁成好看的形状了，针也穿好了线……接下来只需要缝上去、锁个边，再用藏针缝把收口藏起来就行。
以后还有什么要改的，尽管再来找我。不过下次嘛……我可要多收点眼球了，好吗？
PersonalityVoiceDlg/Voice_Rodion_Contem_.en:
The fabric's been cut to a flattering shape, and the needle's all threaded... Now all that's left is to stitch it in place, overcast the edges, and conceal the finish with a blind stitch.
Come find me again if you ever need anything else altered. But next time... I'll be charging more eyeballs, okay?

PersonalityVoiceDlg/Voice_Rodion_Contem_.zh:
……你还真有两下子。既然把我剪掉了，黑派往后可就再也拿不到我的布料了。
你那双眼睛，已经见识过如此炽烈的脉动……所以我相信……剩下的这些我，你会好好利用的。
PersonalityVoiceDlg/Voice_Rodion_Contem_.en:
... You're pretty good. Now that you've snipped me away, you've denied the Noirs any possibility of procuring my fabrics again.
Those eyes of yours have beheld such a fierce pulse... So I'm sure... you'll make good use of whatever remains of me.

_mech/Passives_Abnormality-a1c10p2.json#.zh: 改衣
_mech/Passives_Abnormality-a1c10p2.json#.en: Alteration

_mech/Passives_Abnormality-a1c10p2.json#.zh:
人们说，一件衣服唯有经过改衣，才算真正完成。除非量身定制，否则总要经过调整，才能合身。

这并非只适用于衣物。任何从外界吸纳而来的东西，都必须先经过改造以适应自身，才能被穿上、被容纳、被裁合于心。
_mech/Passives_Abnormality-a1c10p2.json#.en:
They say a garment is only truly finished through alteration. Unless it was made to measure, it has to be adjusted until it fits the wearer.

And that is not true of clothing alone. Whatever is taken in from the outside must first be altered to suit oneself before it can be worn, lived in, and made to fit the heart.

_mech/Passives_Abnormality-a1c10p2.json#.zh: 在遭遇战开始时，或在本单位从混乱中恢复的回合开始时，获得30层[FinishedFabric] 施加[PanicChangeLock]效果 回合结束：若本单位处于恐慌状态，则将精神力变为30 回合开始： - 获得等同于([FinishedFabric]层数)%体力的护盾（最多30%） - 回复等同于[FinishedFabric]层数的精神力

_mech/Passives_Abnormality-a1c10p2.json#.zh: 裁剪
_mech/Passives_Abnormality-a1c10p2.json#.en: Tailoring

_mech/Passives_Abnormality-a1c10p2.json#.zh:
裁剪，就是把布料塑造成版型的过程。裁剪赋予衣物形态，而改衣则让它变得可穿。

对布料而言，裁剪本身也是一种改造。一旦被裁开，布料便会呈现出反映自身特性的形状，成为裁剪者所构想的那件衣物。
_mech/Passives_Abnormality-a1c10p2.json#.en:
Cutting means shaping fabric to a pattern. Cutting gives a garment its form, while alteration makes it wearable.

To fabric, then, cutting itself is a form of alteration. Once cut, the fabric takes on a shape that reflects its own properties, becoming the garment the cutter intended.

_mech/Passives_Abnormality-a1c10p2.json#.zh: 每当改衣师安妮特受到罪人攻击，混乱区间提升等同于0.8%体力的数值 若本单位陷入混乱，则失去全部护盾、[FinishedFabric]与[LargeTailoringShears]；随后获得3层[Vulnerable] 回合开始：体力降至60%或以下时， - 每损失20%体力，获得1层[ResultEnhancement]与1层[SlashDamageUp]（各自最多3层） - 将“修边”最后一枚硬币与“裁剪”第2枚硬币转化为[SuperCoin]
_mech/Passives_Abnormality-a1c10p2.json#.en: Every time Annette the Alterationist is hit by a Sinner, raise Stagger Threshold equal to 0.8% HP If this unit is Staggered, lose all Shield, [FinishedFabric], and [LargeTailoringShears]; then, gain 3 [Vulnerable] Turn Start: At 60% or less HP, - Gain 1 [ResultEnhancement] and 1 [SlashDamageUp] for every 20% missing HP (max 3 respectively) - Convert the final Coin of "Trimming" and Coin 2 of "Cutting" to [SuperCoin]

_mech/Passives_Abnormality-a1c10p2.json#.zh: 永不停歇的剪刀
_mech/Passives_Abnormality-a1c10p2.json#.en: Scissors That Do Not Rest

_mech/Passives_Abnormality-a1c10p2.json#.zh:
一具其价值全由改衣之工塑造的躯体，永不停歇地裁剪下去，被永远改造、永远裁制的冲动所驱使。

即便这躯体正在分崩离析，她也无法让自己停下改衣与裁剪。她生来就是为了把东西剪掉，却剪不掉束缚自己的枷锁。
_mech/Passives_Abnormality-a1c10p2.json#.en:
A body whose very worth was shaped by the work of alteration goes on cutting without end, driven to alter and tailor forever.

Even as the body breaks apart, she cannot bring herself to stop altering and cutting. She is made to cut things away, yet cannot cut herself free.

_mech/Passives_Abnormality-a1c10p2.json#.zh:
需求早已爆表，而生皮却愈发难得。原罪之人的皮革曾是连看都没人愿意多看一眼的东西。直到某一季，一切都变了：需求暴涨，价格飙升，曾经被当作边角料贱卖甚至直接丢弃的东西，如今成了人人觊觎的材料。

如今，就连表面的瑕疵，也被包装成个性，当作卖点出售。
_mech/Passives_Abnormality-a1c10p2.json#.en:
Demand has gone through the roof, while raw hides have only grown harder to come by. The hide of the original sinners was once the sort nobody would so much as glance at. Then one season changed everything: demand surged, prices soared, and what used to be sold for scraps or simply thrown away became coveted material.

Now even the blemishes on its surface are dressed up as character and sold as part of the appeal.

_mech/Passives_Abnormality-a1c10p2.json#.zh:
从茧里传来了声音。
“80支2股以下不算是面料。” “纽扣眼为什么不是横的？”
“是旧式织机织出来的天竺布吗？” “布边的颜色为什么不是红色？”
“这个没做防缩水工艺呢。” “Super150以下的都是廉价面料吧。”
“你说Super等级只代表线的粗细？直径和支数都不一样，怎么连这个都不知道。”
“肯定会用Union Special给下摆做处理吧？” “这个是硬化过的吗？啊，还是说是布边？”
“仔细看去，针脚太均匀了，是用了机器吧？” “不是纯手工缝制就算不上定做。”
“啊，这不是米兰式扣眼啊。” “支数得超过200才能叫衬衫面料吧。”
“啊，从外面能看见缝线呢。” “能看到两列缝线呢。淘汰。”
“缝份怎么处理成这样。” “得超过3股才行。”
_mech/Passives_Abnormality-a1c10p2.json#.en:
Voices seep from the cocoon.

"Anything under 80-count two-ply? Not even fabric!"
"Why aren't the buttonholes horizontal?"
"Jersey knit on machine? Really?"
"Why isn't the selvage red?"
"This hasn't even been shrink-proofed."
"Anything below Super 150 is cheap cloth, obviously."
"You think the Super scale is just yarn thickness? Diameter and yarn count aren't even the same thing. Don't you know that?"
"You're finishing the hem with a Union Special, right? Of course you are!"
"Is this Rigid? ... Oh. Selvage?"
"Wait... the stitch-per-inch count is way too even. You used a machine, didn't you?"
"It's not bespoke if it's not hand-stitched."
"... That's not even a Milanese buttonhole."
"Shirting needs to be over 200-count."
"Ugh, I can see the stitching on the outside."
"There, I can see two rows of stitching there. Rejected."
"What's with this seam finish?"
"Three-ply, minimum."
